items.title: Short-Form Video Editor for Viral, High-Converting Social Content (Real Estate Finance)
items.description:
Ridgeline Capital is a fast growing private lending and mortgage brokerage that serves real estate investors across the country. Content drives our growth, and we're building a content team that performs at the highest level.

We're looking for an INCREDIBLE short-form video editor. Not good. Not great. The best.

You live and breathe the quality of your videos. You check your analytics because you care how your work performs, not because someone asked you to. You know what makes people stop scrolling, watch to the end, and take action. If that sounds like you, keep reading.

How this works

Paid test project first. Shortlisted candidates will edit a small batch of videos for us. This is how we see your skill, speed, and creative instincts firsthand.
Long-term seat. Top performers will be offered an ongoing role on our team.

Real collaboration. You'll work alongside our Social Media Manager and the rest of our team on strategy, ideas, and feedback.

What you'll do:

Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and LinkedIn
Turn long-form content (podcasts, YouTube videos, deal breakdowns, talking-head footage) into scroll-stopping clips

Build hooks that grab attention in the first 3 seconds and pacing that keeps people watching
Add motion graphics, B-roll, sound design, and dynamic captions
Review performance with our Social Media Manager and keep making the content better
Deliver on time, every time

Who you are:

You have a proven track record of viral videos, with links and view counts to back it up
Your content has converted into leads, sales, signups, or real audience growth, and you can show us the results
You're obsessed with hooks, retention, and platform trends
You've mastered your editing tools (Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci, Final Cut, or CapCut)
You're a true team player who communicates clearly, takes feedback well, and makes the people around you better
You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else could

Bonus points:

Experience in real estate, finance, or business and personal brand content
Thumbnail design and long-form YouTube editing skills
Experience working with a social media manager or content team

We don't play second best. We only work with the best, and we expect excellence in every edit. If you're still building your skills, this isn't the right fit yet. If you're already at the top of your game, we want to hear from you.

To apply:

Start your proposal with the word "SCROLL" so we know you read the full post.
Share 3 to 5 links to your best-performing videos, with view counts and the results each one drove.
Tell us about one video that converted and why you think it worked.
Share your typical turnaround time and your rate per video or per hour.

Proposals without performance results will not be considered.

items.title: 300 Word Blog Post Needed
items.description:
Read a book and then write a blog post about it. 

I need a talented writer that is also a quick and thorough reader to read a book and then write an honest 300 word blog post. The post needs to be delivered within two weeks with a rating recommendation between 1 and 5. The book will be provided to you and can range from 100-400 pages. 

The blog post needs to:
-Consist of only opinion no book summary
-Describe the good and bad aspects of the book (post should NOT be completely negative)
-Give opinion and then provide supporting information for that opinion
-Describe the setting of the book, characters, themes, styles, key ideas/story arc
-Give the reader a feel for the plot, but not have any spoilers 
-Mention the name of the author and the book title (optional)
-Contain a rating between 1-5, 5 being the best

Blog post needs to be:
-Creative, engaging and conversational
-Free of grammatical and punctuation errors 
-100% original. Should pass copyscape and plagiarism scan

I'm really looking for a fun and engaging blog post where your personality shines through, so just have a good time with it and be creative.

items.title: Instagram Setup & Content Design
items.description:
**Instagram Setup & Content Design for Agape House of Cards**

I’m looking for a creative freelancer to set up and design an Instagram account for **Agape House of Cards**, the tarot and oracle reading division of Agape Co.

The branding should feel **bright, playful and approachable**, using neon magenta, electric cobalt blue, yellow accents and bold typography. I like pop-art details and card-inspired graphics, with a simple, cohesive layout. The tone should be warm and conversational, inviting curiosity and reflection.

**Initial work:**

- Set up the account with a branded profile image and engaging bio.
- Include a visible, working booking link in the profile and help connect it to a suitable booking platform.
- Create three coordinated posts, including graphics and captions:
 1. An introduction to Agape House of Cards.
 2. The reading options and what clients can expect.
 3. How to book a session.
- Provide editable design templates for future posts.

The account should have its own vibrant personality while showing its connection to **Agape Co.**, with “Part of Agape Co.” in the bio. The tagline is **“A fresh perspective, in full colour.”** Readings should be presented as opportunities for personal reflection and spiritual exploration, without promising guaranteed predictions.

I’ll provide a sample brand showcase as visual inspiration. Final service details and wording will be confirmed with me before posting.

There may also be **ongoing work creating and scheduling posts**, maintaining a consistent visual style and promoting available appointments.

Please share relevant Instagram design examples, your price for the initial setup and three posts, and your options for ongoing content support. The account should remain under my ownership.

items.title: AI Consultant for Small Business AI Assessments
items.description:
Job Description:

We're building an AI assessment and implementation service for small-to-midsize businesses (5–50 employees) — think of it as a paid "AI audit" where we interview a business owner about their operations, identify time-wasting pain points, and recommend specific AI tools and automations to fix them. From there, we offer paid implementation (CRM setup, custom GPTs, workflow automations, voice/speed-to-lead agents, etc.).

We're looking for someone who is both AI-savvy and business-savvy — someone who can sit in a meeting with a business owner, quickly understand their operations, and translate that into clear, practical AI recommendations they'll actually trust and want to pay for. This is not a "build me a chatbot" gig — it's part consultant, part advisor, part solutions architect.

What you'll do:

Join discovery/intake calls with prospective clients (business owners) to understand their workflows, tools, and pain points
Help develop the AI assessment reports — tool recommendations, automation opportunities, and an effort-vs-impact view of what to fix first
Advise on and help scope implementation projects (CRM setup, Zapier/Make automations, custom GPTs/knowledge bases, AI voice agents, dashboards, etc.)
Speak confidently and credibly to non-technical business owners — translating technical capability into business value (time saved, revenue impact, ROI)
Help build and refine our internal process, tools, and templates as we grow

What we're looking for:

Strong working knowledge of AI tools and the broader AI SaaS landscape (not just "knows how to prompt ChatGPT" — genuinely tracks what's out there and what solves real business problems)
Business acumen — you can talk ROI, time savings, and operations fluently, not just tech specs
Comfortable on client-facing calls; confident, articulate, consultative (not a hard-sell personality)
Experience with common small-business tool categories: CRMs, automation platforms (Zapier/Make), meeting/note tools, custom GPT/knowledge base builds, voice AI agents
Self-starter who can work with ambiguity — we're building and refining the process as we go
Bonus: experience in consulting, sales engineering, fractional COO/ops work, or running your own AI/automation agency

About the engagement:
 Please apply with your expected rate/structure (hourly, project-based, or partnership terms) along with a brief note on your relevant experience — we have not set a fixed budget yet and want to hear what makes sense for the scope above.

To apply, please include:

A couple of examples of AI/automation work you've done for a real business (anonymized is fine)
Your sales experience
Your availability and proposed rate/structure

items.title: Google Ads Conversion Tracking Setup
items.description:
Description:

I need Google Ads conversion tracking set up on a static HTML website (about 54 pages, no CMS, hosted on Apache with PHP). The site already has its own consent banner with Google Consent Mode v2: denied by default, an update on consent, and scripts that load only after consent. Your setup must work with this existing banner. No new CMP.


Scope:

Implementation via gtag.js or GTM, your choice with a short reasoning. Tags must load only after marketing consent.
The forms submit via JavaScript without a redirect. Small changes to the existing JS (custom events) are expected.
Create the conversion actions in Google Ads and add them to a campaign-specific goal, not to the account default goals.
Enhanced Conversions for Leads for the form submissions.
Microsoft Clarity: install it (statistics consent) and send custom events for the wizard steps and the lead events.


To apply, please answer:

How do you track an AJAX form submit that has no thank-you page?
How do you make sure no Google tag fires before consent?
Fixed price and timeline for the full scope.

items.title: Administrative Assistant – Remote Contractor
items.description:
We are a growing U.S.-based professional services company seeking a dependable and organized Administrative Assistant to support our day-to-day operations.

This is a remote independent contractor position starting at $3.00 USD per hour, with the opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities based on performance.

Responsibilities include:

* Data entry and updating trackers
* Entering and monitoring tasks
* Organizing documents and information
* Sending follow-up emails
* Reviewing assignments for completion
* Basic online research
* Supporting administrative and operational tasks as assigned
* Managing Google Workspace, including organizing Google Drive files and folders
* Managing Google Calendar, including scheduling meetings, updating appointments, sending calendar invitations, and helping keep the team’s calendar organized

We are looking for someone who is reliable, humble, teachable, detail-oriented, responsive, and able to work independently. You should be comfortable receiving instructions, following established processes, communicating when you have questions, and completing assignments without needing repeated reminders.

Requirements:

* Strong written English
* Reliable internet and computer
* Good attention to detail
* Experience with Google Workspace, Google Drive, Gmail, and Google Calendar
* Comfortable learning new online systems
* Consistent communication
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Available during agreed-upon working hours

This position is best suited for someone looking for a long-term working relationship and an opportunity to grow as responsibilities increase.

Starting Rate: $3.00 USD/hour
Location: Remote
Position: Independent Contractor
Hours: Part-time / as needed, with potential for growth

To apply: Please send a short introduction, your resume/CV, your availability, and tell us about a previous employer or client who gave you an opportunity that helped you professionally and how you handled that opportunity.

Responsibilities may include:

- Planning, drafting, and scheduling social media content
- Creating graphics and branded content in **Canva**
- Creating and editing short-form video content for **TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and other platforms**
- Repurposing existing photos, videos, and content into new social media posts
- Helping develop social media and marketing strategies
- Promoting travel offers, destinations, cruises, resorts, and other travel-related content
- Monitoring trends and identifying content opportunities
- Helping grow engagement and followers organically
- Managing and organizing a content calendar
- Updating website content, promotions, and travel offers as needed
- Drafting newsletters, marketing emails, and client communications
- Following up with clients or leads using provided guidelines/templates
- Researching current travel promotions and supplier updates

items.title: Growth Operator / Client Success Manager for Performance Marketing Agency (US-Based Only)
items.description:
We're a performance marketing company that builds and scales offers for coaching, info-product, and ecommerce brands. We're hiring a Growth Operator to be the main point of contact for our clients and the person who keeps every account moving forward.

You'll sit between our clients and our internal team (copy, creative, media buying, and funnel builds). Your job is to make sure clients feel heard, know exactly what's happening on their account, and see results. You'll run daily client meetings, turn client goals into clear tasks for the team, track performance, and spot growth opportunities before the client asks.

This role is for someone who is organized, confident on calls, and understands marketing well enough to have a real conversation about ads, funnels, and numbers.

LOCATION: Remote (US-based only)
TYPE: Full-time
HOURS: Monday to Friday, US business hours, with availability for daily client calls
COMPENSATION: $3,000 to $5,000/month, based on experience

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Client Success
- Lead daily client check-in calls, plus weekly performance reviews and monthly strategy sessions
- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of client accounts
- Onboard new clients: kickoff calls, gathering assets and access, setting expectations and timelines
- Manage client expectations, handle concerns early, and keep communication clear and consistent
- Track client health and act quickly on retention risks

Growth and Performance
- Monitor account KPIs (ROAS, CPL, cost per booked call, conversion rates, revenue) and explain them to clients in plain language
- Work with media buyers and copywriters to identify what's working and what needs to change
- Recommend new offers, funnels, campaigns, or tests that help clients grow
- Identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts

Operations and Project Management
- Turn client requests and meeting notes into clear, assigned tasks in ClickUp
- Keep internal teams aligned through Slack, and make sure deadlines are met
- Maintain accurate records of client communication, deliverables, and account status
- Build and improve SOPs for onboarding, reporting, and client communication

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves
- Based in the United States
- 5+ years of marketing experience (agency, in-house, or client-facing growth roles)
- Hands-on experience with ClickUp (or a similar project management tool) and Slack
- Comfortable and confident meeting with clients daily over video calls
- Working knowledge of paid ads, funnels, email/SMS marketing, and the metrics behind them
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Highly organized, able to manage multiple accounts and deadlines at once
- Calm under pressure and able to deliver bad news honestly while keeping the relationship strong

Nice-to-Haves
- Agency account management or client success experience
- Experience with coaching, info-product, or ecommerce brands
- Familiarity with GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, or similar platforms
- Experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, or analytics dashboards
- Background in sales or upselling services to existing clients

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- First 30 days: You know every account, every client, and every active project, and you're running client calls on your own.
- First 90 days: Client retention is steady or improving, tasks move through ClickUp without falling through the cracks, and clients see you as their go-to person.
- Ongoing: Accounts grow, clients stay longer, and you're bringing forward ideas that lead to new revenue.

TOOLS YOU'LL USE
ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom or Google Meet, Loom, GoHighLevel, and ad platform dashboards.

WHAT WE OFFER
- $3,000 to $5,000/month, based on experience
- Fully remote, full-time role
- Direct access to leadership and a front-row seat to how offers are built and scaled
- Room to grow into a Head of Client Success role

items.title: B2B Sales Representative | Tech Startup | Remote | Base + Commission
items.description:
SPYL is an Israeli technology startup with a working AI-powered real-time translation and communication platform designed for businesses and organizations.

We are expanding our sales activity into international markets, primarily the US, UK and Europe, and are looking for a motivated B2B Sales Representative to join us remotely.

This is a hands-on sales role with real responsibility and independence.

Your main goal is simple: find relevant businesses, reach the right decision-makers, create sales opportunities, present SPYL, follow up and lead interested prospects through the sales process until closing.

You will not be responsible for technical implementation. Once a customer moves forward, you will work directly with our Operations and technical team, who will handle setup, implementation and technical support.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Research and identify relevant businesses and decision-makers
• Conduct cold calls, emails and other outbound outreach
• Build and manage your own sales pipeline
• Speak with business owners, managers and decision-makers
• Conduct remote sales meetings and product demonstrations
• Understand customer needs and present SPYL accordingly
• Follow up consistently with interested prospects
• Handle objections and commercial discussions
• Lead opportunities from initial contact through pilot and closing
• Convert opportunities into pilots and paying customers
• Keep sales activity and pipeline organized
• Work closely with our Operations team when customers move forward
• Work toward clear weekly and monthly targets

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Previous sales experience, preferably B2B
• Excellent spoken and written English
• Comfortable with cold calling and outbound sales
• Strong communication and persuasion skills
• Able to work independently and take responsibility for results
• Persistent, organized and motivated by targets
• Comfortable presenting a technology product remotely
• International sales experience is an advantage
• SaaS or technology sales experience is an advantage, but not required

COMPENSATION

• $8-$10/hour guaranteed base, depending on experience
• $30 bonus for each qualified pilot that actually starts
• 5% commission on payments received from customers you successfully close, for their first 6 months
• Uncapped commissions

The hourly rate is your guaranteed base. Bonuses and commissions are additional and are designed to reward real sales results.

SCHEDULE

• 25-30 hours per week
• 5 working days per week
• Fully remote
• Working hours should overlap with business hours in the markets you are targeting


SPYL is at an early stage of its international expansion, so this role offers significant room for growth. Strong performance can lead to increased hours, higher compensation and greater responsibility as the company grows.

We are looking for someone responsible, proactive and sales-driven who can create momentum and take ownership of opportunities, not simply wait for leads.

Our goal is to improve our brand presence, generate awareness, and strengthen our visibility in AI search engines and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) results through authentic community engagement and content distribution.

Responsibilities

* Develop and execute a Reddit growth strategy
* Identify relevant subreddits where our expertise can add value
* Create and manage Reddit accounts where appropriate
* Participate in discussions naturally and ethically without spam tactics
* Monitor relevant conversations and engage on behalf of our brand
* Increase brand mentions and visibility through genuine contributions
* Manage and grow our social media presence across platforms such as LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, and others as needed
* Create and publish content aligned with our legal services and target audience
* Repurpose existing content into social media formats
* Track performance and provide regular reporting

Requirements

* Experience with social media management and content distribution
* Understanding of GEO, AI search visibility, brand mentions, and modern SEO concepts

* Ability to communicate complex topics in a simple and engaging way

items.title: Finalizar marketplace jurídico já iniciado em Java/Spring Boot com Stripe
items.description:
I have an existing foundation for LusoLaw, a marketplace for immigration legal services. The project uses Java 17 and Spring Boot 3, with a REST API, JWT authentication, and separate client, lawyer, and administrator roles. It already includes a service catalog, client requests, lawyer approval workflows, an admin dashboard, and an initial Stripe integration. The frontend is built with static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

I’ll share the code through the project’s public GitHub repository. I’m looking for a professional to review the existing implementation and help fix, complete, and prepare it for production while preserving the current foundation rather than rebuilding it from scratch.

The main priorities are to fix the integration tests, complete the Stripe payment flow—including secure webhook confirmation and defining how payments are transferred to lawyers—review permissions and the lawyer approval workflow, and improve the database, security, and deployment setup.

The application handles identity documents and professional credentials, so secure storage and access controls are important. Please do not include credentials or real personal data in the code or commits. I expect the completed work to include implemented changes, passing tests, and documentation for running and deploying the application. Before starting, please review the repository and confirm the scope and priorities.

**Before sharing the repository:** check for personal data, credentials, or other sensitive information, especially in the tracked H2 database files and Git history.

items.title: Paint hidden areas + clean line art in a layered cartoon character PSD (rig-ready, paid test, ~12 characters to follow)
items.description:
We have a cartoon character for a mobile app. It is already cut into layers for 2D rigging: a full-body PSD (1024×1536, about 31 layers) and a matching head PSD (600×600). We need someone with digital painting skills to finish the art prep. This first job is a paid test on one character.

What the job involves:

1. Paint the hidden areas. Under the hair, hood and arms, the parts beneath are flat colour blocks, some with visible seams: the scalp, the shoulders and sides of the tunic, the neck and the back of the hood. Paint them as a natural continuation of the art, so nothing looks blocky when a part moves or is hidden. Match the existing soft shading, colours and line colour.
2. Clean up the line art at 4× zoom. Make the outer outline solid and continuous. Fix breaks and uneven spots in the main lines. Close see-through pinholes, remove stray specks, and move a few floating paint fragments to the right layer. A marked-up guide shows where our checks found problems.

Rules, because the files go straight into a rig:
- Work inside the layered PSDs.
- Do not merge, rename, reorder, move, resize, add or delete layers.
- Leave the overlaps at the joints alone.
- Keep the art's look; no redesign.
- Hand-painted work. AI output is fine only as a starting point that you fix by hand.

We check the return with automated layer checks plus a 4× review. One revision round is included.

This is one of about a dozen characters that we need. If the results are good, we'll work through the others with you (roughly 5–8 hours each; the four animal characters and a dragon have more painting).

Budget: $120 fixed for this test, open to proposals.

To apply, please send:
- 2–3 samples of paint-in / art separation for animation (Live2D, Spine, Moho or cutout) or cartoon digital painting;
- your fixed price and delivery time for this one character.

rawApifyPayload.title: Paint hidden areas + clean line art in a layered cartoon character PSD (rig-ready, paid test, ~12 characters to follow)
rawApifyPayload.description:
We have a cartoon character for a mobile app. It is already cut into layers for 2D rigging: a full-body PSD (1024×1536, about 31 layers) and a matching head PSD (600×600). We need someone with digital painting skills to finish the art prep. This first job is a paid test on one character.

What the job involves:

1. Paint the hidden areas. Under the hair, hood and arms, the parts beneath are flat colour blocks, some with visible seams: the scalp, the shoulders and sides of the tunic, the neck and the back of the hood. Paint them as a natural continuation of the art, so nothing looks blocky when a part moves or is hidden. Match the existing soft shading, colours and line colour.
2. Clean up the line art at 4× zoom. Make the outer outline solid and continuous. Fix breaks and uneven spots in the main lines. Close see-through pinholes, remove stray specks, and move a few floating paint fragments to the right layer. A marked-up guide shows where our checks found problems.

Rules, because the files go straight into a rig:
- Work inside the layered PSDs.
- Do not merge, rename, reorder, move, resize, add or delete layers.
- Leave the overlaps at the joints alone.
- Keep the art's look; no redesign.
- Hand-painted work. AI output is fine only as a starting point that you fix by hand.

We check the return with automated layer checks plus a 4× review. One revision round is included.

This is one of about a dozen characters that we need. If the results are good, we'll work through the others with you (roughly 5–8 hours each; the four animal characters and a dragon have more painting).

Budget: $120 fixed for this test, open to proposals.

To apply, please send:
- 2–3 samples of paint-in / art separation for animation (Live2D, Spine, Moho or cutout) or cartoon digital painting;
- your fixed price and delivery time for this one character.

items.title: White-Label Marketing Agency Partner
items.description:
Haus of Nectar is a marketing agency for beauty and wellness businesses, including med spas, salons, brow and lash studios, yoga/piilates studio, wellness/beauty e-commerce brand and independent estheticians. I'm looking for one experienced, full-service agency to be our white-label partner and handle fulfillment behind the scenes.

HOW THIS WORKS
We sell done-for-you marketing packages under the Haus of Nectar name. When a client buys, the order is created automatically in our system and sent straight to your team with everything you need to start. You deliver the work under our brand, and you're paid per order at a fixed rate we agree on upfront. The whole process is built to run without back-and-forth, so you always know what's coming in and what you'll earn on it.

SERVICES YOU MUST COVER

Website design and build
Funnels
Branding
SEO (on-page, local, and ongoing)
Paid ads on Meta and Google
Email marketing (flows and campaigns)
Social media management
AI agent development (lead response, booking, and rebooking agents)

This is a full-service partnership. I'm only considering agencies that can deliver all six.

WHAT I NEED TO SEE

Real experience with beauty, wellness, med spa, or other appointment-based businesses
Proof of paid ads on Meta and Google: dashboard screenshots or case studies showing actual spend and results (client names can be hidden)
Live examples of websites, email flows, and social accounts your team has built or managed
Experience working white-label, so clients never hear about your agency
Comfort working inside GoHighLevel, Zapier, or similar automation tools
A named project manager and a clear turnaround time for each service

CONTENT AND BRAND STANDARDS

Original copy only. Everything clients and their customers read must be written by a person on your team. I don't accept AI-generated copy, captions, scripts, or emails, even when lightly edited. AI can support research and workflow, and the writing itself comes from you.
Branding comes first. Every deliverable should reflect the client's voice, visual identity, and positioning, and stay consistent across every channel.
No discount language. Our clients are premium, so no percent-off offers, flash sales, coupons, or "limited time deal" messaging in ads, emails, social posts, or websites. We sell on expertise and results.

HOW TO APPLY
Please include the following in your proposal:

Your white-label rate card, with a fixed price per service and package, per order
Your standard turnaround time for each service
Two or three examples of paid ad results from Meta and Google
Your best work in beauty or wellness
Who my main contact would be and how your team is set up
A short note on how you protect a client's brand voice when you write for them

Start your proposal with the word NECTAR so I know you read this all the way through.

I'm building Haus of Nectar for the long term, and the right partner will grow with us.

items.title: Short-form video editor and content planner for a small Minnesota BBQ spice company
items.description:
Hey, I'm Zach. I run Lakes Spices, a small BBQ spice company out of Minnesota. I started it after I left the corporate world, right around when COVID hit. I've always loved barbecue, grilling and smoking meat, but the best part has always been everything around it. Shooting the breeze around a fire, managing the pit, and getting a good group of people together to eat once it's done.

We proved the concept the first time around. We had orders, shipped across state lines, and people still ask me all the time when we're coming back. Now I've got the time and resources to do it right. No more mixing spices in my basement. We've got barcodes, a professionally designed label, a warehouse, all the stuff you don't think about when you're starting out.

Where we're at: I just paid for our inventory and it's headed to the warehouse now. The new website should be done in the next week or so. Once bottles are in hand I'll be filming and pounding the pavement at the same time.

WHAT I NEED HELP WITH

I'm a big consumer of social media, not a creator. I'm totally fine talking about the brand on camera. Where I get stuck is picturing what will look good on camera, how to hook somebody in the first couple seconds, and putting together a schedule I'll actually stick to. I've tried to work through it on my own and it gets overwhelming, so I'd rather bring in someone who knows it and learn from them along the way.

So I'm looking for one person who can bring ideas to the table, build a plan for our launch, and edit the footage I shoot into posts for TikTok, Instagram and Facebook.

WHAT WE'RE ABOUT

We're a humble, laid back company. I want this to be fun. Some goofy stuff is fine, but that's not the whole point, and we're not trying to copy the brands that post completely insane stuff to go viral. We share what we know and we don't gatekeep. Whether it's 10 people who love what we do or 100, we're going to stay true to ourselves.

Hard no on clickbait. No cooking something totally bonkers just for views, and nothing that has nothing to do with the product. If that's your style, this isn't the right job.

THE WORK (ABOUT 6 WEEKS)

Prelaunch is short, just 1 or 2 teaser posts letting people know we're close. Then launch week, then about 4 weeks after launch getting the name out there and showing us actually operating: cooking, packing orders, the warehouse, customers.

Milestone 1: Paid trial ($150)
- Quick call so you can get to know me and the brand
- A one-page outline of how you'd approach the launch
- Edit 2 short videos from footage I send you
If it's not a fit for either of us, no hard feelings, we stop here.

Milestone 2: Content plan
- Posting schedule for the teasers, launch week and the 4 weeks after
- Video ideas with a hook for each
- Simple shot lists so I know what to film

Milestone 3: Teasers and launch week, about 4 videos

Milestone 4: Post launch, about 8 to 10 videos (2 to 3 a week)

Every video should be:
- Vertical, roughly 15 to 60 seconds
- Captioned and easy to read
- Using music that's cleared for business accounts
- Exported clean with no watermarks
- Delivered with a draft caption
- Turned around within about 72 hours, with up to 2 rounds of revisions

I'll post and handle comments myself, so you won't need access to any accounts. I'll send footage through Google Drive. Lakes Spices owns all finished work.

WHO I LIKE WORKING WITH

People who are on time, communicate well and are pretty laid back. Straight shooters. No corporate jargon, no politics. I've always worked best with people who'd hate being stuck in a cubicle all day, who think outside the box and find ways to make the work fun. It shouldn't feel like work.

My schedule bounces around and I travel a lot, but I always have my phone and laptop on me. If we book time, you'll have my full attention. Email, phone, Zoom, whatever works for you.

Budget is up to $1,500 total including the trial. If it's a good fit, I'd love to keep working together after launch.

To apply, send 2 or 3 short videos you've edited and a line on what you did on each.

items.title: Senior AWS Solutions Architect / Cloud Engineer (AI a plus) — remote worldwide
items.description:
Senior AWS solutions architect / cloud engineer for production AWS workloads. Worldwide OK (Pakistan, India, and similar). Strong written and spoken English is required, plus reliable overlap with US Pacific / US business hours.

This starts with hands-on deployments and architecture work. If those go well, it can grow into a longer engagement with more hours. We are looking for a long-term individual contributor relationship — not an agency, not a team that rotates people, and not someone who outsources work.

What you will do
- Design and implement AWS architectures (networking, IAM, compute, storage, observability)
- Own end-to-end deployments with clear documentation and handoff
- Prefer candidates who have worked with AI/ML on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, or similar) — nice-to-have if core AWS SA skills are strong
- Communicate clearly in English (async updates + live overlap with US time zones)

Must-haves
- Senior AWS experience (Solutions Architect / Cloud Engineer level)
- Individual freelancer only — no agencies, no staffing firms, no “we have a team”
- Strong communication — proposals and updates we can trust without rework
- Reliable overlap with US hours
- Comfortable owning deployments, not just advising

Nice-to-haves
- AI/GenAI on AWS
- IaC (Terraform / CDK / CloudFormation)
- Prior long-term client relationships on Upwork

Acceptance criteria (definition of done for early work)
- Deliver agreed AWS architecture and deployment for the scoped workload
- Document setup, IAM, networking, and how to operate/monitor it
- Handoff is clear enough for another engineer to continue without redoing the work
- Communication stays clear and timely during US overlap hours

How we work
Start with scoped deployments. Success leads to more hours and a longer relationship. Do not include customer names or confidential project details in your proposal — focus on your AWS track record and communication.

Budget is up to $25/hr. Apply only if that works for you.

items.title: Video Editor: Turn Screen Recordings into YouTube + Short-Form Content (Ongoing)
items.description:
I record short screen walkthroughs and need an editor to turn each one into multiple videos for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn.

What needs to be done:

You'll receive 2–3 raw screen recordings per week (5–15 min each) through Google Drive.
From each recording, create:
1 YouTube video (5–10 min)
3–5 vertical short clips (30–60 sec) for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels
1 LinkedIn clip
Upload drafts to a review folder. After approval, schedule the posts.

How we want it:

Strong hook in the first 3 seconds. Show the result first.
Burned-in captions on every video.
Zooms and highlights on the important parts of the screen.
Tight pacing: remove pauses, filler and dead time.
Blur all sensitive information (names, logos, phone numbers, emails, URLs, keys). This is mandatory on every video.
Clean, professional look. No over-the-top effects.
Turnaround: 48–72 hours per recording.

Engagement:

Starts with a paid test: 1 recording turned into 1 YouTube video and 3 shorts.
If it goes well, this becomes ongoing work on a monthly retainer.

To apply, answer these questions:

Share 2–3 links to short-form videos you've edited. Screen recording or tutorial-style content is preferred.

items.title: Social Media Assistant with Data Research Experience
items.description:
We are a small content and growth agency working with e-commerce and SaaS brands. We need a dependable social media assistant who is also strong at data research. You will keep client accounts active and organized, and you will build the research behind our campaigns: creator lists, competitor tracking and prospect data.

This is an execution role. Accuracy and follow through matter more than speed. We would rather receive 30 well checked records than 100 unchecked ones.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Social media support
Schedule posts, reels and stories across client accounts
Proofread captions, tags and hashtags
Monitor comments and DMs and flag anything that needs a reply from our team
Keep a weekly content calendar updated in Google Sheets

Data and market research
Research competitors and log their posting frequency, content types and engagement
Build lists of relevant brands, pages and communities for each client
Find public contact details and LinkedIn profiles for decision makers where needed
Record the source for every entry so our team can trust it

Influencer research
Find creators on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X that fit each client's niche
Log handle, profile link, followers, average recent views, engagement, niche and public contact email
Check for genuine engagement and skip accounts with inflated numbers
Avoid duplicates by checking against our master list before adding anyone

Outreach and admin support
Send outreach from templates we provide and log replies
Keep records in our CRM current: status, notes and follow up dates
Clean and deduplicate spreadsheets and convert PDFs or messy exports into usable Excel or Google Sheets files
Send a short weekly report: what was completed, what is pending, and any issues

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU
1+ year of experience in data research, lead generation or virtual assistant work
Hands on experience managing or supporting social media accounts
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
Familiarity with tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or Hunter.io
Clear written English
Very organized. You tell us early if something is unclear or running late

NICE TO HAVE
HubSpot, Zoho or Pipedrive experience
Experience with Metricool, Buffer or a similar scheduling tool
Background in e-commerce or SaaS clients
Overlap with US Eastern hours for a short weekly check in

HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS
Every research list delivered in our template with sources included
No duplicate records across lists
Scheduled posts go out on time with no missed slots
Deadlines met, or flagged in advance

PAID TEST
Shortlisted freelancers will receive a short paid test: research 10 creators for a niche we provide and schedule 5 sample posts from a content brief. We will review accuracy, sources and formatting before moving to ongoing work.


TO APPLY
Please tell us:

A. Your most relevant data research or social media project and what you delivered
B. The tools you would use for this job and why
C. Your hourly rate and weekly availability
D. How you check that a creator's engagement is genuine

What does the work include?

items.title: Junior Account Manager- Google Ads
items.description:
Vision Web PPC | Full-Time | Remote | 

Performance-Based Compensation

Vision Web PPC is looking for a Junior Google Ads Account Manager to join our growing team. This is a fully remote opportunity designed for someone who is proactive, hardworking, organized, and capable of managing their responsibilities independently.

No minimum years of experience are required. Previous Google Ads or digital advertising experience is preferred, but we care more about your ability to learn quickly, communicate professionally, take ownership of your accounts, and consistently deliver for clients.

Compensation & Growth
The position begins with a 14-day paid training period at $500. During training, you’ll learn our Google Ads optimization process, client management standards, reporting expectations, and internal systems.
Upon successfully completing training, you’ll receive an offer to join the team full-time.
Full-time Account Managers earn 20% of the monthly management fee for every client account they manage and retain. Client management fees typically range from $500–$2,000+ per month.

You’ll initially manage approximately 12–15 client accounts, with the opportunity to take on an additional 5–10 accounts per month as you demonstrate that you can effectively manage and retain your existing clients.

Current account managers earn approximately $500–$2,000 per week, depending on the number and value of accounts they manage and retain. There is no predetermined cap on the number of accounts you can manage as long as you continue delivering quality service and maintaining client relationships.

What You’ll Be Doing

Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns for multiple clients
Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement
Manage lead-generation campaigns with a focus on conversions and cost-effective customer acquisition
Manage e-commerce campaigns with a focus on ROAS and profitable growth
Conduct approximately one 30-minute weekly client call per account to review performance, discuss strategy, and maintain strong relationships
Transition established clients to bi-weekly meetings when appropriate
Maintain and monitor accurate client information, notes, and activity in HubSpot
Maintain professional and consistent communication with clients
Participate in a weekly one-hour meeting with your manager for coaching, strategy, and account reviews
Follow Vision Web PPC’s campaign management and optimization processes
Take ownership of client retention and overall account relationships
Client calls will be monitored or reviewed for quality assurance, training, and coaching purposes.

What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for someone who is proactive and accountable rather than someone who needs to be constantly managed. You should be comfortable taking ownership of your client portfolio, identifying problems, asking questions when necessary, and following through on responsibilities.

The ideal candidate is fluent in English, communicates confidently with clients, is highly organized, can work autonomously, learns quickly, and is comfortable being held accountable for their work.

Google Ads, PPC, marketing agency, client management, or digital marketing experience is preferred but not required. We will train the right person on our processes and expectations.

Schedule & Location
This position is 100% remote, and we’re currently especially interested in candidates based in the United States and United Kingdom.

You will have significant flexibility in how you organize your schedule, but you must be consistently available during our core working hours of 9:00 AM–2:00 PM Pacific Time. One to two time weekly you will meet with management outside of those hours. 
Outside of required meetings, client calls, and core availability, you’ll have flexibility to structure your workday around your responsibilities.

How Success Is Measured
Campaign performance matters. Lead-generation accounts will primarily be evaluated based on conversions and related performance metrics, while e-commerce accounts will primarily be evaluated based on return on ad spend (ROAS).
However, your compensation is tied to the accounts you manage and retain—not directly to individual campaign performance metrics. The better you become at managing client relationships and retaining a growing portfolio of accounts, the greater your earning potential.

Why Join Vision Web PPC?
This isn’t a traditional fixed-salary account management position. It’s designed for someone who wants their income and responsibilities to grow alongside their performance.
You’ll receive hands-on training, direct access to management, a portfolio of existing clients to begin working with, and the opportunity to steadily expand your book of business.
If you’re ambitious, dependable, comfortable speaking with clients, and interested in building a career in Google Ads and digital marketing, we’d like to hear from you.
To apply, please include a short introduction explaining why you’re interested in the position, your location/time zone, your experience with Google Ads or digital marketing (if any), and your experience working directly with clients.

items.title: Senior Direct Response Copywriter: Ads, Funnels & Webinars
items.description:
We're a performance-driven marketing company that builds and scales offers for coaching, info-product, and ecommerce brands. We're looking for a senior direct response copywriter who can own the words behind our campaigns, from the first ad a prospect sees to the webinar that closes them.

This isn't a content writing or blog role. You'll write copy that's measured in clicks, opt-ins, show-up rates, and sales. If you've spent years testing hooks, rewriting headlines until they convert, and studying why one angle beats another, you'll fit right in.

LOCATION: Remote (outside the US)
TYPE: Full-time, independent contractor
COMPENSATION: $1,500 to $2,500 USD/month, based on experience, plus performance bonuses

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Ad Copy
- Write high-volume ad copy for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), YouTube, TikTok, and Google
- Develop multiple hooks, angles, and variations per campaign for creative testing
- Write scripts for UGC, talking-head, and VSL-style video ads
- Review performance data with the media buying team and iterate on winning and losing angles

Funnel Copy
- Write complete funnels: opt-in pages, sales pages, VSL scripts, order forms, upsells/downsells, and thank-you pages
- Write email and SMS sequences for lead nurture, launches, cart abandonment, and reactivation
- Audit existing funnels and identify copy-driven conversion leaks

Webinar Copy
- Write webinar registration pages, confirmation pages, and show-up sequences (email + SMS)
- Script full webinar presentations using proven frameworks (story, belief-shifting, offer stack, close)
- Write replay, follow-up, and closing sequences to maximize post-webinar sales

Strategy & Research
- Conduct customer and market research (reviews, forums, sales call transcripts, competitor ads) to extract messaging and language
- Develop offer positioning, big ideas, and unique mechanisms with the strategy team
- Maintain a swipe file and share learnings on what's working across accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves
- 8+ years of professional copywriting experience, primarily direct response
- Proven track record writing for coaching/info-product brands AND ecommerce brands (both required)
- Portfolio showing ads, funnels, and webinar scripts, ideally with results attached (ROAS, conversion rates, revenue generated)
- Native-level or near-native English fluency, with a strong grasp of American tone, slang, and cultural references
- Deep understanding of direct response principles: awareness levels, sophistication levels, offer construction, objection handling
- Ability to write in a brand's voice quickly and adapt across very different audiences
- Comfortable working with data and making changes based on performance

Nice-to-Haves
- Experience with GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, or similar funnel builders
- Experience writing for agency clients across multiple niches at once
- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and reading ad performance metrics
- Experience writing for high-ticket offers ($5K+) and application/call funnels
- Trained under or familiar with frameworks from established direct response mentors

TOOLS YOU'LL USE
Google Workspace, Slack, GoHighLevel, Loom, ClickUp (or similar project management), and AI writing tools as a speed aid (not a replacement for thinking).

WHAT WE OFFER
- Stable, long-term role with consistent monthly pay in USD
- Performance bonuses tied to campaign results
- Exposure to multiple brands, niches, and offers at once
- Direct access to leadership and media buying data, so you see what your copy actually does

items.title: Experienced Developer Needed for AI-Powered Multi-Vendor Marketplace
items.description:
I'm looking for an experienced developer to build a polished multi-vendor online marketplace in the secondhand/resale retail space.

Participating stores will be able to join the platform, create their own storefronts, list and manage their merchandise, receive orders, and ship their own products. Customers should be able to search and browse merchandise from all participating stores in one marketplace and purchase directly through the site.

I'm intentionally keeping the specific domain and some details of the concept private in the public posting. I can share more with serious candidates.

The marketplace will need seller registration and approval, individual seller/storefront pages, seller dashboards, product creation and inventory management, support for primarily one-of-a-kind merchandise, product categories and attributes, strong search and filtering, attractive individual product pages, customer accounts, favorites or saved products, shopping cart and checkout, order management, marketplace commissions and seller payouts, seller-managed shipping and tracking, and admin controls for managing sellers, products, orders, commissions, categories, and other marketplace functions.

The site needs to work extremely well on mobile, particularly for sellers adding merchandise from their phones. It should also be SEO-friendly, fast, easy to navigate, and have a polished, visual shopping and discovery experience rather than feeling like a generic marketplace template.

One of the most important features is making it extremely fast and easy for participating stores to list merchandise. Ideally, a seller could take or upload several photos of an item and AI would create a draft listing for the seller to review, edit, and publish.

Using an existing AI/vision service, the system could assist with the product title, description, category and subcategory, brand when reasonably identifiable, color, style, relevant attributes, search keywords or tags, and potentially a suggested selling price or price range. The seller should always review and approve the information before the listing is published. The goal is to dramatically reduce the amount of time it takes a store to list individual secondhand items.

AI-powered product search is also important. I would like shoppers to be able to describe what they are looking for in normal conversational language rather than relying only on traditional keyword searches and filters. For example, a shopper might type, "I'm looking for a blue Ralph Lauren women's sweater under $50," and the system should understand the request, search the current merchandise available from participating sellers, and return the most relevant matches.

The conversational search should work alongside traditional search and filtering. I would like your recommendation on the best practical way to accomplish this using existing AI and search technology.

Customers should be able to purchase directly through the marketplace. Marketplace commissions and seller payouts should be handled automatically through an appropriate payment solution so that I am not manually collecting money and then paying individual sellers.

Because a customer may purchase merchandise from several different stores, I would also like your recommendation for handling a cart containing products from multiple sellers, including separate seller orders, shipping charges, marketplace commissions, and seller payouts while keeping the checkout experience simple for the customer.

The individual sellers will be responsible for fulfilling and shipping their own orders. Sellers should be able to manage their orders and provide shipping and tracking information through their accounts.

I'm open to WordPress/WooCommerce with a strong multi-vendor marketplace solution or another platform if you believe there is a better approach. I would prefer to use reliable existing marketplace software, plugins, APIs, payment solutions, AI services, and search technology where appropriate rather than custom-building functionality unnecessarily.

At the same time, I want the finished site to look and function like a polished standalone business and be built in a way that allows it to grow.

The type of developer is very important to me. I'm looking for someone who is proactive, resourceful, communicates well, and likes to get things done quickly. I particularly value someone who can take ownership of the technical side, research and solve problems independently, and keep the project moving without requiring a lot of day-to-day direction from me. Of course, I'm available whenever something requires my input, access, approval, or a business decision.

When applying, please tell me about multi-vendor marketplaces or similar platforms you have personally built and provide examples if possible. I'd also like to know what platform and technology you recommend for this project and why, how you would implement the AI photo-to-listing feature, how you would implement the conversational AI product search, how you recommend handling marketplace commissions and seller payouts, and how you would handle purchases involving products from multiple sellers.

Please also include your estimated time to complete the site and have it ready to launch, your fixed-price estimate for the complete project, and any significant ongoing software, AI/API, search, payment, plugin, or hosting costs I should expect.

I'm ready to get started and would prefer someone who has the availability to move quickly and consistently. Speed matters to me, but so does getting it right.

There may also be additional work available for the right person. I have multiple online projects and would love to find a developer I can rely on long-term.

The marketplace will need seller registration and approval, individual seller/storefront pages, seller dashboards, product creation and inventory management, support for primarily one-of-a-kind merchandise, product categories and attributes, strong search and filtering, attractive individual product pages, customer accounts, favorites or saved products, shopping cart and checkout, order management, marketplace commissions and seller payouts, seller-managed shipping and tracking, and admin controls for managing sellers, products, orders, commissions, categories, and other marketplace functions.

The site needs to work extremely well on mobile, particularly for sellers adding merchandise from their phones. It should also be SEO-friendly, fast, easy to navigate, and have a polished, visual shopping and discovery experience rather than feeling like a generic marketplace template.

One of the most important features is making it extremely fast and easy for participating stores to list merchandise. Ideally, a seller could take or upload several photos of an item and AI would create a draft listing for the seller to review, edit, and publish.

Using an existing AI/vision service, the system could assist with the product title, description, category and subcategory, brand when reasonably identifiable, color, style, relevant attributes, search keywords or tags, and potentially a suggested selling price or price range. The seller should always review and approve the information before the listing is published. The goal is to dramatically reduce the amount of time it takes a store to list individual secondhand items.

AI-powered product search is also important. I would like shoppers to be able to describe what they are looking for in normal conversational language rather than relying only on traditional keyword searches and filters. For example, a shopper might type, "I'm looking for a blue Ralph Lauren women's sweater under $50," and the system should understand the request, search the current merchandise available from participating sellers, and return the most relevant matches.

The conversational search should work alongside traditional search and filtering. I would like your recommendation on the best practical way to accomplish this using existing AI and search technology.

Customers should be able to purchase directly through the marketplace. Marketplace commissions and seller payouts should be handled automatically through an appropriate payment solution so that I am not manually collecting money and then paying individual sellers.

Because a customer may purchase merchandise from several different stores, I would also like your recommendation for handling a cart containing products from multiple sellers, including separate seller orders, shipping charges, marketplace commissions, and seller payouts while keeping the checkout experience simple for the customer.

The individual sellers will be responsible for fulfilling and shipping their own orders. Sellers should be able to manage their orders and provide shipping and tracking information through their accounts.

I'm open to WordPress/WooCommerce with a strong multi-vendor marketplace solution or another platform if you believe there is a better approach. I would prefer to use reliable existing marketplace software, plugins, APIs, payment solutions, AI services, and search technology where appropriate rather than custom-building functionality unnecessarily.

At the same time, I want the finished site to look and function like a polished standalone business and be built in a way that allows it to grow.

The type of developer is very important to me. I'm looking for someone who is proactive, resourceful, communicates well, and likes to get things done quickly. I particularly value someone who can take ownership of the technical side, research and solve problems independently, and keep the project moving without requiring a lot of day-to-day direction from me. Of course, I'm available whenever something requires my input, access, approval, or a business decision.

When applying, please tell me about multi-vendor marketplaces or similar platforms you have personally built and provide examples if possible. I'd also like to know what platform and technology you recommend for this project and why, how you would implement the AI photo-to-listing feature, how you would implement the conversational AI product search, how you recommend handling marketplace commissions and seller payouts, and how you would handle purchases involving products from multiple sellers.

Please also include your estimated time to complete the site and have it ready to launch, your fixed-price estimate for the complete project, and any significant ongoing software, AI/API, search, payment, plugin, or hosting costs I should expect.

I'm ready to get started and would prefer someone who has the availability to move quickly and consistently. Speed matters to me, but so does getting it right.

There may also be additional work available for the right person. I have multiple online projects and would love to find a developer I can rely on long-term.

items.title: Payroll Processor for Canada and UK
items.description:
Payroll Consultant (Contract): Canada and/or UK Payroll on ADP
Remote | Part-time contract | Immediate Start | 10-30 Hrs/week

About Melita Group
Melita Group is an HR outsourcing firm based in San Jose, California. It is part of Allvia, a platform of HR services companies. We provide integrated HR, payroll, benefits administration, leave of absence administration and HR compliance services to small and mid-market employers. As our clients grow internationally, we're adding contract payroll specialists who can run in-country payroll for their employees in Canada and the United Kingdom.

About the role
We're hiring for two specialties and may engage two separate consultants. You don't need experience in both countries. Please apply for the one that fits you, or both if you have done both:
•	Canada track: hands-on experience processing Canadian payroll on the ADP Workforce Now Canada technology platform
•	UK track: hands-on experience processing UK payroll on the ADP iHCM technology platform
You'll work with Melita's Global Payroll Services Manager to process payrolls for multiple clients in each country.

What you'll do
•	Process recurring and off-cycle payrolls from start to finish in ADP WFN/iHCM, including inputs, validation, approvals and final submission
•	Review payroll registers, reconcile results, and fix variances before funds are released
•	Make sure statutory deductions, filings and remittances are accurate and on time
•	Handle new hires, terminations, final pay, and changes to pay and deductions
•	Support quarter-end and year-end processing
•	Answer client and employee payroll questions clearly and quickly
•	Point out compliance risks and any upcoming legislative changes that affect our clients

Canada track: required experience
•	At least 3 years processing Canadian payroll, with recent hands-on work in ADP Workforce Now Canada platform
•	Solid knowledge of CPP/QPP, EI, federal and provincial income tax, and employer health taxes
•	Year-end experience with T4 and T4A forms, plus Records of Employment (ROE)
•	Quebec payroll experience, including RL-1 and QPIP, is strongly preferred
•	PCP or CPM designation from the National Payroll Institute is preferred

UK track: required experience
•	At least 3 years processing UK payroll, with recent hands-on work in ADP iHCM platform
•	Solid knowledge of PAYE, National Insurance and RTI submissions (FPS/EPS) to HMRC
•	Experience with pension auto-enrolment, statutory payments (SSP, SMP, SPP), student loan deductions and attachment of earnings
•	Year-end experience with P60, P11D and P45 forms
•	CIPP qualification is preferred

What we're looking for
•	Close attention to detail and steady judgment under payroll deadlines
•	Clear written and spoken communication with clients and internal teams
•	Comfort working on your own, remotely, across time zones that overlap with US Pacific time

Engagement details
•	Independent contractor, fully remote
•	Estimated 10-30 hours per week, which may vary with payroll cycles and year-end
•	Start date: Immediate

items.title: Looking for Microsoft 365 / Power Automate Expert-Healthcare Email Triage & Task Automation (HIPAA)
items.description:
We are a small outpatient healthcare/psychiatry practice looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 and Power Automate specialist to build a reliable email triage and task-management workflow.

Our website developer is already handling our website/domain transition and creation of our Microsoft 365 mailboxes. This job is specifically for the Microsoft 365/Outlook/Power Automate automation portion.

This system will involve patient communications that may contain PHI, so healthcare/HIPAA experience is strongly preferred. Please do not apply if your proposed solution requires sending patient emails/PHI through Zapier or random third-party AI/automation platforms.

THE PROBLEM WE NEED TO SOLVE

We receive patient emails involving:

Prescription/refill requests

Urgent clinical concerns

Appointment/scheduling issues

Lab/medical questions

Billing/insurance

Routine administrative questions

Currently, too much depends on a staff member noticing an email, remembering that it requires action, and remembering to come back to it.

I want Microsoft 365 to automatically identify actionable emails, categorize them, create a persistent task/work item, assign it to staff, and continue escalating it until someone intentionally marks it complete.

Simply opening or reading an email should NOT cause it to disappear from the workflow.

DESIRED WORKFLOW

Patient email arrives in Outlook

→ Automatically screened/classified

→ Categorized as:
URGENT / REVIEW NOW
REFILL
APPOINTMENT / SCHEDULING
LAB / MEDICAL
BILLING / INSURANCE
ROUTINE

→ If actionable, create OPEN task/work item

→ Assign to appropriate staff member

→ Task remains OPEN until intentionally completed

→ Reminder/escalation if not completed within specified timeframe

→ Practice owner receives reports of outstanding items

PHASE 1 - RULE-BASED EMAIL CLASSIFICATION

I want the initial system to be reliable and rule based rather than depending entirely on AI.

Examples:

REFILL:
refill, prescription, medication, pharmacy, Walgreens, CVS, out of medication, prior authorization, pharmacy didn't receive prescription, etc.

APPOINTMENT:
appointment, schedule, reschedule, cancel, booking, availability, missed appointment, running late, etc.

URGENT:
suicidal, suicide, self harm, kill myself, overdose, emergency, ER, hospital, psychosis, hallucinations, mania, withdrawal, severe medication reaction, etc.

The trigger lists should be EASY FOR US TO EDIT after the project is completed.

URGENT MESSAGE WORKFLOW

Potentially urgent messages should:

Be marked high importance.

Receive an URGENT / REVIEW NOW category.

Immediately alert appropriate staff.

Create an OPEN task/work item.

Escalate again if the item remains unresolved after approximately 30 minutes during our designated monitoring hours.

IMPORTANT: I do not want an AI system deciding that a potentially concerning patient message is "safe" or clearing it automatically.

The system should err toward human review.

ACTIONABLE TASK SYSTEM

This is one of the most important requirements.

An actionable email should become something similar to:

REFILL

Patient/sender: Jane Smith
Subject/request: Medication refill
Received: 10:42 AM
Assigned to: Staff member
Status: OPEN
Link to original Outlook email

It should remain OPEN until someone intentionally marks it DONE/COMPLETED.

I am open to Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Lists, To Do, Teams, or another appropriate Microsoft 365 solution. I would like the developer to recommend the simplest and most reliable architecture.

Staff should have a very simple view showing:

WHAT NEEDS TO BE DONE NOW?

rather than having to manage complicated Power Automate screens.

ESCALATION RULES

Initial desired rules:

URGENT:
Immediate notification + repeat escalation approximately 30 minutes later if still unresolved during monitoring hours.

REFILL:
Escalate if still unresolved approximately 2-4 business hours later.

APPOINTMENT/SCHEDULING:
Escalate if unresolved by end of business day.

ROUTINE:
Escalate if unresolved the following business day.

These intervals should be easy for an administrator to modify later.

AUTOMATED SYSTEM EMAILS

We receive emails from healthcare platforms such as TherapyNotes, Grow Therapy, Headway, and similar services.

12:00 PM
4:30 PM

How staff see all OPEN tasks

How flow failures are reported

EMAIL ARRIVES

items.title: CAD Sneaker shoe designs
items.description:
I have 3 sneaker designs that i need to convert into CAD 3d so i can share it with manufacturers and test color variations.

File formats
1. Native source file (whatever software you model in, e.g. .blend / .3dm / .zprj / .ma), so I have the editable master
2. GLB (glTF 2.0) with materials embedded, for viewing and recoloring
3. FBX, as a backup for other 3D/render software



Model setup (very important)
- Please split the shoe into separate, clearly named parts, each with its own material slot, e.g.: toe cap, vamp, quarter (medial/lateral), heel counter, eyestay, tongue, collar, lining, laces, midsole, outsole, logo/branding
- Please UV-unwrap all parts so I can apply textures (leather, suede, mesh, knit), not just flat colors
- Please use real-world scale (mm) and include the size you modeled (e.g. EU 42 / US 9)
- Clean geometry, no merged or overlapping parts



Colorways and renders
- 4 colorways of the same design (I'll share the color/material list per panel)
- Renders of each colorway from front, side (both), back, top, sole, and 3/4 angle, on a plain white background, high resolution (at least 2000 px)

items.title: Graphic Designer for Digital Marketing, Email & Ongoing Creative Projects
items.description:
We’re looking for a talented and reliable Graphic Designer to work with our growing creative brand on an ongoing basis. This role will focus primarily on creating beautiful, polished marketing assets for our digital advertising and email campaigns, along with supporting a variety of additional design projects throughout the year.

What You’ll Be Working On

-Designing digital ads for Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Google
-Designing engaging email newsletters and promotional campaigns
-Building and formatting email campaigns directly in Klaviyo
-Creating graphics for product launches, promotions, and seasonal campaigns
-Designing print materials such as magazine advertisements
-Assisting with catalog design and layout
-Creating additional marketing and graphic design assets as needed
-Taking creative concepts, product photography, brand assets, and campaign direction and turning them into polished, cohesive designs

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone with a strong eye for layout, typography, color, and brand consistency who can create beautiful work while also thinking about how design supports marketing and sales.

The ideal designer:

-Has professional graphic design experience, particularly with ecommerce or consumer brands (even more amazing if you are a crafter, or understand or have worked in the craft industry!)
-Has experience designing digital advertising and email marketing
-Is comfortable working directly in Klaviyo
-Understands designing for both desktop and mobile
-Has experience with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator
-Can work within an established brand while bringing fresh creative ideas to the table
-Is organized, responsive, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple projects
-Pays close attention to details, sizing requirements, spelling, and brand consistency
-Can collaborate with our team and take feedback and creative direction well
-Experience with Shopify, ecommerce brands, product-based businesses, stationery, crafting, or other creative/lifestyle brands is a plus.

About Us

Honey Bee Stamps is an established paper crafting and creative products company. We design products for card makers, scrapbookers, and paper crafters, and our brand is centered around creativity, beautiful design, and the joy that comes from making something by hand.

We have an active ecommerce business and regularly launch new product collections, promotions, and marketing campaigns throughout the year. We’re looking for a designer who can become familiar with our brand and work with us consistently rather than simply completing a single project.

To Apply
Please include:

-A link to your portfolio
-Examples of digital ads you have designed
-Examples of email/newsletter design, if available
-Your experience working in Klaviyo
-Any experience working with ecommerce or product-based brands
-Your typical availability and turnaround time
-Please also tell us a little about your design style and what types of projects you most enjoy working on.

We’re looking forward to finding a creative partner who can help us bring our marketing ideas to life! 

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is interested in finding a long-term home with our team. We want to build a lasting working relationship with someone who will get to know our brand, grow alongside us, and truly become part of the Honey Bee family. If you’re looking for more than just your next project and would love to become a valued part of a creative business for years to come, we’d love to hear from you.

items.title: Corporate Recruiter - Hospitality
items.description:
Job description:
Corporate Recruiter — Hospitality Patrice & Associates | 100% Remote
Commission-based | $50K-$70K-$90k UNCAPPED
About the job
We're growing our corporate recruiting team. This is a 100% remote seat on a small internal team that works the open jobs already sitting in our system — restaurant, hotel, and hospitality management roles for clients across the country.
Since 1989, Patrice & Associates has specialized in placing exceptional hospitality management talent. Our network includes more than 150 independently operated offices, and as an NRA Allied Member, we have access to over 30,000 hospitality operators nationwide.
Our recruiters are supported by a proprietary database of more than 875,000 candidates and a strong pipeline of opportunities. We currently have 426 active job orders systemwide, including more than 250 open positions available for recruiters to work. With average placement fees exceeding $13,700 in 2026, the opportunity is substantial. Now, we’re looking for more recruiters to help connect outstanding candidates with our growing roster of hospitality clients.
That's the whole job: take the demand that already exists and turn it into placements.
Your role
●	Work a list of open client roles from intake to placed
●	Source and call candidates using the platform stack we provide — HyperSpark AI (our proprietary, in-house-built recruiting assistant), TE Recruit, Signal Hire, and CallMantra
●	Make high-volume outbound contact — phone, email, and messaging. 100+ dials per day.
●	Screen and qualify candidates against what the client actually needs, not what looks
close enough on paper
 
●	Prep candidates, manage the submission, and drive the process through offer and
acceptance
●	Chase passive candidates — the people who aren't job hunting and don't answer the ﬁrst
time. They tend to be the best hires and the longest tenures
●	Communicate fast with clients and internally. Speed to response is not a nice-to-have here
●	Own your numbers: dials, conversations, submissions, submission-to-placement rate, and revenue produced
Our placement-to-submission conversion is roughly 1 in 4 — well ahead of the industry benchmark of 1 in 10. Your job is to feed that funnel and keep it moving.
Compensation
Target: $50,000–$70,000 Commission-based, uncapped.
We want to be straight with you: this is a commission seat. You eat what you place. The upside is genuinely uncapped and our top performers are the reason we're hiring more of them — but there is a ramp, and the ﬁrst placements take work.
What you get
●	Work from anywhere. No office, no commute, no storefront.
●	Set your own hours. Hit the performance metrics and nobody is watching your calendar.
●	Real sales experience without door-knocking. Everything happens by phone, email, and message.
●	Access to serious people. You'll be on the phone with executives, owners, and operators
at large companies — the kind of conversations that build a career, not just a quota.
●	A brand that opens doors. 35+ years in the market means candidates and clients take
your call.
●	Training and mentoring from the founder and CEO, plus a proven curriculum. Must have (required)
●	Genuine tolerance for rejection and repetition. You will dial a lot and hear no a lot before
the yes
 
●	Coachability that shows up in behavior, not just attitude. You'll get feedback on your calls in your ﬁrst week, and we need people who change the next call rather than defend the last one.
●	Self-direction without supervision. Nobody is going to tell you to start dialing at 9 or keep going at 4. If you need someone standing behind you to keep the pace up, remote commission work will not be kind to you.
●	Reliable home office: high-speed internet, quiet workspace Nice to have (not required)
●	Prior sales, phone sales, recruiting, or high-volume phone experience — any industry
●	A track record of getting people to commit over the phone: an interview, a signature, an
appointment, a hard yes
●	Agency or staffing recruiting experience
●	Experience selling or recruiting on commission
●	Comfort learning, running, and improving a script
●	Comfort in a CRM and dialer without getting sloppy on follow-up Backgrounds that tend to do well here

items.title: Event Photo Editor (Lightroom)
items.description:
We're an Austin video and photo agency (Social Cuts) and we shoot a lot of corporate events and dinners. We need a photo editor to cull and color a multi-day event gallery so it matches the look we've already established for this client.

The job:

Cull 5,600 RAW files down to about 800 selects (doesn't have to be exactly 800). This gallery has two jobs: capture the vibe of the room (decor, tablescapes, lighting, wide shots, details) and make sure the people in it can find themselves. So this is not a tight edit. Kill the blinks, the soft ones, the misfires, and the back-of-head shots, but keep two or three options of a person or group when the frames are good. The client will want to choose. Every moment of the program should be covered.

Then color the 800ish. A good chunk of the event is low light and a little grainy, so you need to be comfortable with careful noise reduction that cleans it up without making faces look like plastic. Exposure, white balance, skin tones, straightening, light cleanup. No heavy retouching.

The main thing: we'll send you a reference gallery of past edits for this client. Your job is to make the new photos look like those. Not your style, ours. If you can look at a reference set and match it on the first pass without a lot of back and forth, you're who we want.

What you need:

Lightroom Classic. Real event photography experience (dinners, conferences, dark venues, mixed lighting). A culling tool or a fast process, 5,600 one at a time is not going to work. A portfolio with event work in it, not just portraits or product. Reliable turnaround.

We have events every month after this, so this becomes ongoing work for the right person.

Budget: $800 fixed for the cull and the 800 edits. Turnaround: 3 Days from receiving the files.
