items.title: Podcast Producer for a Weekly Interview Show (Editing, Show Notes, Clips, Publishing)
items.description:
I host Made in Italy, an English-language interview podcast with Italian founders and executives. Episodes run about 38 minutes. I handle guest outreach and the recording. I'm looking for a producer to take over everything after that.

Once I upload a recording, you'd own:
- Editing and cleanup: remove filler and dead air, level audio, add intro/outro. Many guests are non-native English speakers, so a light touch matters.
- Show notes: title, episode description, guest bio and links.
- Publishing: upload and schedule on Spotify and other platforms.
- A couple of short clips (30-60 sec) with captions for LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube Shorts.
- Simple cover art or episode graphics if you can do it quickly.

I record on Riverside and edit in Descript, but I'm open to your own tools if the result is better. I want someone reliable who runs this without me chasing. Clear communication and consistent turnaround matter more to me than fancy production.

Budget and time: about $20/hour, roughly 2-3 hours a week. Ongoing work, 3-6 months to start. You'd need to be efficient and have a repeatable workflow to fit that.

To apply, please answer:
1. Send 1-2 podcast episodes you edited, and say exactly what you did on each.
2. Which tools do you use for editing, show notes and clips? (Descript, Riverside experience?)
3. What is your typical turnaround from raw file to published episode?
4. How do you handle guests with strong accents or uneven audio?
5. Can you do this at about $20/hour? How many hours do you usually need per 38-minute episode?
6. How many episodes a month can you take on reliably?

items.title: Caracas Local Field Tester - Android Photo Mapping & Business Verification
items.description:
We are looking for someone based in Caracas to complete a short paid familiarization and qualification task using photo mapper, our Android photo-mapping app.

This first assignment should take around 1–2 hours and is intended to lead to larger paid local verification assignments for people who demonstrate good photo quality, careful app use, and reliable field work. You do not need to travel across the city; use a convenient nearby area.

You will:
- Install photo mapper on an Android phone and create an account.
- Walk around a convenient nearby area and photograph ordinary businesses, places, or mapped objects.
- Correctly connect each capture to the matching mapped feature, or add a genuinely missing place/object.
- Ask when something is unclear rather than guessing.
- Send brief feedback about anything confusing, buggy, slow, or difficult.

Photo quality standard:
- Get close enough that the subject is immediately obvious.
- For businesses, aim for 3+ distinct useful views when practical: storefront/entrance, visible name/signage, and another useful view such as offerings, interior, or surrounding context.
- Do not upload duplicate or near-duplicate views. Landscape orientation is fine when useful.
- Prefer daylight and good visibility. Avoid making identifiable people the subject and do not photograph sensitive government, military, security, airport, port, or checkpoint infrastructure.
- Match photos to the correct place. If something is genuinely missing, add it rather than attaching photos to the wrong feature.

The familiarization task is complete when you have demonstrated that you can take useful ground-level photos, correctly use the photo mapper workflow, add missing places appropriately, and communicate any uncertainty or app problems.

Strong performers will be considered for a larger follow-on assignment in a compact area of Caracas involving targeted businesses and organizations that need to be visited, photographed, and verified.

Experience with photography, mystery shopping, Google Maps or local business listings, field research, audits, GIS/OpenStreetMap, app testing, or similar work is especially relevant, but not required.

Android phone required.

Compensation for the familiarization task is $6/hour, with approximately 1–2 hours expected.

items.title: QA Coordinator / Agency for 100 Android User Tests
items.description:
Job description
We are looking for a QA coordinator or testing agency with access to a pool of real Android users to organize 100 end-to-end user tests for a mobile app for short vertical series.
The goal is to test the production Android app with real users, real devices, real Google Play accounts, and real in-app purchases.

Scope
The selected coordinator will organize 100 individual Android testers.
Each tester will be required to:
- Install the app from Google Play
- Create and verify a new account
- Test profile functionality
- Browse and watch selected series
- Test creator following and social interaction features
- Test subtitles when available in their language
- Purchase the smallest available in-app coin package
- Use the purchased coins to unlock premium episodes
- Test coin balance and insufficient-balance behavior
- Verify that purchased content remains accessible
- Report whether all required steps were completed and flag any issues found
A detailed step-by-step test specification will be provided after hiring.
Testers can complete the flow independently and do not need to participate at the same time.

Who we are looking for
We prefer a coordinator or agency that already has access to a reliable pool of Android users.

You will be responsible for:
- Recruiting and managing the testers
- Distributing our testing instructions
- Making sure each tester completes the full required flow
- Managing participant payments and in-app purchase reimbursements
- Collecting the required tester information
- Tracking completion
- Providing one consolidated final spreadsheet
- Reporting recurring bugs or issues

Required report
For every completed tester, we will need at minimum:
- Tester/user ID
- Email used to register in the app
- App nickname
- Country
- Cost and currency of the smallest coin package purchased
- Completion status of all required testing steps
- Any bugs or problems found
We will verify account activity and purchases in our own admin system.

Budget
Total fixed project budget: $750 for 100 successfully completed testers.
This is an all-inclusive project budget.
The coordinator is responsible for paying participants and reimbursing the actual local cost of the smallest available in-app coin package from the agreed project budget.
Each successfully completed tester should receive $3 compensation for completing the test, in addition to reimbursement of their required in-app purchase.
The remaining amount after participant compensation and purchase reimbursements is the coordinator’s fee.
No larger coin packages should be purchased without prior approval.

Important
This is a mobile QA and usability testing project.
We are not requesting Google Play ratings or reviews.
We need genuine Android users using real devices and following the supplied test instructions.

Please include in your proposal
1. Do you already have access to a pool of Android testers?
2. How many testers can you provide?
3. Which countries are your testers located in?
4. Have you previously managed mobile testing involving real in-app purchases?
5. How will you organize and track 100 participants?
6. Please confirm that you understand that the $750 fixed budget is all-inclusive, including participant compensation, in-app purchase reimbursements, and your coordination fee.

items.title: Product Naming Copywriter
items.description:
We are a nutraceuticals (food supplement) startup based in the UK. We have a number of products in the market and are working on a number new launches. 

We currently have a mix of product names, some that are creative and most that are descriptive. This confusion reflects the different channels we sell in. - primarily marketplaces like Amazon. 

We want to create a product naming system/ startegy for our upcoming products - that helps 
1. With stopping customer scroll on platforms like Amazon and Tiktok, and also improve product recall. 
2. With creating creative (maybe even slightly humorous) product names
3. They should not have any trademark issues (primarily in UK, but also EU and US)
 4. At the same time it should not leave the customer guessing about what the product does. Unlike brand naming, product naming needs to take into account customer search and buying intent into account. We usually try to include either the main benefit or product ingredient into the name, so that customers can instantly understand that the product matches their search intent. 

Ideally you will have
1. Experience with such projects. 
2. Understand the rules and regulations around supplements in the UK. We are not allowed to make any health claims (other than an approved list) - so product names need to met that requirement

In all we have 4 upcoming products, for which we need help. But we are hoping the project creates an actual product naming system, that can also be used to name future products and maybe even rename some of the existing products.

items.title: Fixed-price quote: multi-tenant SaaS web platform for social media management
items.description:
We want a fixed-price quote for a multi-tenant SaaS web platform where businesses and agencies plan, create and publish social media content from one workspace.

PLEASE GIVE US A TOTAL PROJECT PRICE (not an hourly rate): one total price for an MVP and one total price for the full first version, with what is included in each.

MVP scope:
- Multi-tenant core: organisations, several brands per organisation, team roles and permissions, invitations
- Email and Google sign-in
- Subscriptions and credit-based billing through a payment provider
- Content calendar with drafts, approval flow and scheduled publishing
- ONE social network integration (OAuth connection, publishing)

Full first version adds:
- Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn publishing (TikTok later), with basic insights
- AI-assisted generation of text and images through third-party model APIs, with usage metering
- Media library on cloud object storage
- Admin panel, usage and cost reporting, transactional emails
- Public marketing site (landing, pricing, legal pages), English first
- Responsive web UI (no native apps)

Target: production-ready in about 2-3 months, then ongoing support.

Definition of done: deployed to a production server, source code and documentation delivered to us, automated tests for core flows, working demo of each feature above.

In your proposal please state: 1) the TOTAL fixed price for the MVP, 2) the TOTAL fixed price for the full first version, 3) what is NOT included in the price, 4) timeline and team, 5) 1-2 similar projects you delivered. Honest numbers are more useful to us than polished proposals.

items.title: Utilities Coordinator (Contract, Part Time, Remote US)
items.description:
A Real Home Away (ARHA) is a furnished short-term and mid-term rental management company operating across Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Dallas-Fort Worth, and the Indianapolis metro. Our onboarding team takes properties from investor handoff to guest-ready, and utilities are one of the first and most important steps in that process.

We're looking for a detail-oriented Utilities Coordinator to own utility setup for newly onboarded properties. This role is a great fit for someone who is organized, persistent on the phone, and genuinely enjoys getting a messy process to the finish line.

What You'll Do
- Set up, transfer, and confirm electric, gas, water, trash, and internet service for new properties across multiple markets
- Coordinate directly with utility providers to resolve account issues, schedule service starts, and follow up until everything is active
- Communicate with property owners to gather account information and keep them updated on progress
- Track account status, start dates, and payment setup in our internal systems so the team always knows where each property stands
- Partner with our onboarding and accounting teams to make sure each home is connected and ready on schedule

What We're Looking For
- Experience in utilities management, property management, customer service, or a similar - coordination role
- Clear, professional communication by phone and email
- Strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple properties at different stages at once
- Comfort working independently with reliable availability during US business hours
- Familiarity with property management software or tools like Breezeway, Notion, or Google Sheets is a plus

items.title: Freelance Photo Editor | Pet Photography Business
items.description:
Hi, I’m Bree, the owner of Bree Ruby Photography, based in Melbourne’s Yarra Valley and eastern suburbs.

I specialise in photographing senior pets, end-of-life sessions and the bond people share with their animals. I also offer seasonal pet mini sessions. 
I’m looking for a skilled, reliable photo editor to help with editing client photographs while maintaining my style. I’d love to find someone I can trust so I can spend more time photographing clients and running my business.

About the role
This is a small, flexible freelance arrangement initially, with work provided as needed rather than guaranteed weekly hours. There is potential for ongoing work if we’re a good fit.
I’ll provide selected photographs, examples of my finished work and editing instructions. My style is warm, rich and natural, with beautiful colours and an emphasis on the connection between pets and their people.

Responsibilities
•	Edit selected photographs in Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop.
•	Match my existing editing style consistently across a gallery.
•	Adjust exposure, white balance, colour and contrast.
•	Use masks and local adjustments to enhance subjects and backgrounds.
•	Remove leads, distracting objects and other unwanted elements where requested.
•	Retouch pets and people naturally, preserving fur detail, skin texture and individual features.
•	Deliver finished files in the agreed formats and within agreed turnaround times.
•	Make reasonable revisions based on feedback.
Who I’m looking for
•	Strong experience with Lightroom and Photoshop.
•	A portfolio showing professional photo editing, ideally including pets and outdoor portraits.
•	Excellent attention to detail, particularly around fur, edges and object removal.
•	Ability to follow reference images and match another photographer’s style.
•	A natural approach to editing without excessive smoothing or artificial effects.
•	Clear communication, reliability and willingness to receive feedback.
•	Reliable internet and your own computer and Lightroom and Photoshop. 
•	Respect for client privacy. Images must not be shared, published or used in a portfolio without my permission.

Working together
Flexible working hours are welcome. We’ll agree on the scope, price and turnaround time before each batch of photographs.

To apply
Please include:
•	A short introduction and your relevant editing experience.
•	Before-and-after examples of your work, especially pets or outdoor portraits.
•	Your hourly rate or per-image pricing, specifying the currency.
•	Whether your pricing differs for basic edits and detailed Photoshop work.
•	Your usual turnaround time and availability.
•	The software you use. 

Please tell me about a pet who has been special to you, or your favourite animal if you haven’t had a pet. A few sentences is plenty. I’d love to get to know the person behind the application.

I’d love to find someone who appreciates how meaningful these photographs are to my clients and can help me deliver beautiful, consistent galleries.

items.title: Podcast Producer for a Weekly Interview Show (Editing, Show Notes, Clips, Publishing)
items.description:
I host Made in Italy, an English-language interview podcast with Italian founders and executives. Episodes run about 38 minutes. I handle guest outreach and the recording. I'm looking for a producer to take over everything after that.

Once I upload a recording, you'd own:
- Editing and cleanup: remove filler and dead air, level audio, add intro/outro. Many guests are non-native English speakers, so a light touch matters.
- Show notes: title, episode description, guest bio and links.
- Publishing: upload and schedule on Spotify and other platforms.
- Short clips (30-60 sec) with captions for LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube Shorts.
- Cover art or episode graphics per episode.
- Light tracking of what's published and when.

I record on Riverside and edit in Descript, but I'm open to your own tools if the result is better. I want someone reliable who runs this without me chasing. Clear communication and consistent turnaround matter more to me than fancy production.

Budget: about $150-$250 per episode for edit, show notes and 3 clips. Ongoing work, 3-6 months to start.

To apply, please answer:
1. Send 1-2 podcast episodes you edited, and say exactly what you did on each.
2. Which tools do you use for editing, show notes and clips? (Descript, Riverside experience?)
3. What is your typical turnaround from raw file to published episode?
4. How do you handle guests with strong accents or uneven audio?
5. What's your rate per episode for edit + show notes + 3 clips?
6. How many episodes a month can you take on reliably?

items.title: Website Privacy Audit: Identify and Remove Tracking Pixels, Implement Cookie Consent
items.description:
We're looking for an experienced web privacy and analytics engineer to audit our company websites for third-party tracking technologies, document what they do, and remediate them. 

Scope of work
1. AUDIT - Scan our website and inventory every tracker, pixel, cookie, tag, SDK, session-replay tool, chat widget, and embedded third-party script. Examples include Meta/Facebook Pixel, Google Analytics/Tag Manager, LinkedIn Insight Tag, TikTok Pixel, Hotjar, and similar.
2. VERIFY - Review a list of trackers we provide and confirm whether each one is present, when it fires (before or after any user consent), and what data it sends and to whom.
3. EVIDENCE (before changes) - Capture the current state (screenshots, HAR/network logs, tag configurations, and the date and time of capture) before modifying anything.
4. REMEDIATE - Remove trackers that aren't needed. For any we decide to keep, implement a consent management platform (such as OneTrust, Cookiebot, Osano, or Usercentrics) so that non-essential trackers do not load until the visitor opts in.
5. VALIDATE - Confirm through network testing that no non-essential tracker fires before consent, on desktop and mobile.

Deliverables
- Compliant to the following privacy acts 1. California Invasion Privacy Act "CIPA", 2. Electronic Communications Privacy Act "ECPA", & 3. California Comprehensive Computer Data Access and Fraud Act "CDAFA"
- A tracker inventory spreadsheet listing the site, tracker, vendor, purpose, data collected, whether it fires pre-consent, and the action taken.
- A plain-English summary report for a non-technical reader (our legal counsel), with before and after evidence.
- Remediated sites and a working consent banner.
- A short guide our team can follow to keep new trackers from being added without consent.

Required skills
- Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, browser DevTools, and HAR analysis.
- Experience implementing a consent management platform.
- Familiarity with US privacy and wiretap-type tracking laws (CIPA, CCPA/CPRA, VPPA) is a strong plus.
- Clear written communication for non-technical audiences.

Requirements
- NDA must be signed before receiving site details
- Please provide examples of similar audits you've done

Completion time :: ONE WEEK

Trim mistakes, repeated takes, and unnecessary pauses.

Add thoughtful jump cuts and occasional punch-ins.

Create accurate, readable captions and emphasize key words.

Add simple visual overlays, such as checklists, strategy cards, and examples.

Improve audio and adjust lighting/color as needed.

Deliver vertical videos ready to post, with text positioned safely for Instagram.

Two or three relevant examples, including one with visual overlays.

Your rate per Reel or package, including revisions.

Your turnaround time and weekly capacity.

Your editing software and whether project files are included.

I’m looking for someone creative, reliable, and communicative who can help build a consistent style and make the editing process easier.

items.title: *NEW SOCIAL APP* Social Media & Creative Growth Manager: Create ad assets & post organically
items.description:
Exciting new social media app Zi Social (US only - pre-seed testing stage) is looking for a hands-on creative marketer - Social Media & Creative Growth Manager - who can independently build our organic social presence and turn winning ideas into performance ad creatives



Zi Social is an early-stage, video-first social app with the mission to make small / aspiring creators grow into larger creators by systematically helping them overcome their biggest hurdles: fear of being judged / doubt to find the right audience, lack of ideas, lack of attainable incentive, insufficient consistency / volume:
+ Every ~48h a new challenge drops to all users (e.g., “Tell us the craziest red flag you’ve ever seen during a date”)
+ Users receive the challenge directly in their notification center with a clear CTA to post their take until the next challenge drops
+ Other people’s take only becomes visible once the user has posted their own take
+ Every challenge week, one content creator gets a prize reward for scoring the most points from creator activity and engagement during that week
**→ Check out the app: **https://zi.social/get-app
→ Use access code “MARKET” to get in (i.e., skip the waitlist)
→ Website: https://zi.social/p/market



What you’ll own:

1. Organic social content - primary responsibility
+ Own Zi’s organic presence on Instagram and TikTok, with YouTube Shorts and Snapchat available for experimentation
+ Post frequently: expected output of 5-10 short-form concepts per week
You’ll independently move from:
Trend / insight → concept → hook → script → content creation → edit → publish → analyze → iterate

This includes:
+ Developing short-form video concepts that feel native to TikTok and Instagram rather than traditional brand advertising
+ Creating strong hooks designed to win attention in the first 1–3 seconds
+ Producing and editing short-form videos using tools such as CapCut, Canva, AI tools and other creative software
+ Repurposing and remixing UGC created inside Zi — we have marketing usage rights
+ Experimenting with trends, memes, challenges, founder/product content and other formats
+ Testing different hooks, structures, CTAs and creative angles
+ Reviewing performance and using the results to inform the next batch of content
+ Publishing consistently and moving quickly rather than spending weeks perfecting individual assets
+ We care much more about learning velocity and finding formats that work than maintaining a perfectly polished content calendar.
‌

2. Paid creative pipeline - secondary responsibility
Turn promising concepts into creatives that can be tested through paid Meta/Instagram campaigns
You’ll help with:
+ Creative concepts and angles
+ Hook and script development
+ Conversion-focused CTAs
+ Video creation and editing
+ Creating multiple variations of promising concepts
+ Analyzing creative performance and developing the next iterations
+ Experience managing Meta Ads campaigns is a plus, but not required. The primary requirement is being able to create ads that perform, not being a media buyer.
‌

3. Community & Social presence
Help Zi behave like a native participant on social platforms rather than a brand broadcasting into them.
+ Replying to comments and engaging with users
+ Engaging with relevant creators and accounts
+ Identifying conversations and trends Zi can naturally participate in
+ Helping develop Zi's social voice and community culture


What we’re looking for:

You should:
+ Have proven track record (action: share 2-3 accounts that you grew!) of creating short-form social content that actually performs, particularly on IG / TT
+ Understand what makes someone stop scrolling in the first 1-3 seconds
+ Have E2E ad campaign creation capabilities and toolkit: You are comfortable going from concept / rough idea → script → video asset / creative → post → performance analysis → next iteration without much micro-guidance
+ Understand TikTok/Reels-native storytelling, hooks, pacing, editing and CTAs
+ Be highly experimental and comfortable quickly testing an idea
+ Be quick on your feet - bring an idea quickly to audience testing
+ Use data to learn - monitor watch time, retention, engagement, CTR, conversions) and learn why a creative got 1.5s avg. watch time vs. 5s and adjust creatives accordingly
+ Be comfortable working independently without waiting for detailed creative briefs
+ Be resourceful - utilize various AI models as needed, rely on UGC videos from the app / existing video content and libraries, etc.
+ Understand the difference between content that looks good and content that gets watched and drives action
+ Be comfortable to also film yoruself or find UGC creators if needed for production

Nice to have:
+ Experience marketing consumer/social/mobile apps
+ Experience working with Gen Z audiences
+ UGC/creator marketing experience
+ Meta Ads Manager experience
+ Brand strategy experience
+ Experience growing an account from a small starting audience



What we want to see when you apply:
1. 2–3 examples of short-form content you personally created or substantially contributed to
2. The account(s) you helped grow and what changed while you worked on them
3. Performance/results for your strongest examples, where available
4. What you personally did — concept, scripting, filming, editing, publishing, strategy, etc.
5. The tools you normally use to create content



Engagement:

We’ll start with 1-month paid trial on an hourly basis, with the potential to turn this into a longer-term / full-time role if there’s a strong fit

During the trial, the goal is simple: ship creative, learn quickly, and find repeatable content formats that can grow Zi.

The application process will entail a 24h-turnaround task that will be paid

items.title: Amazon Listing Optimization & SEO Expert Needed
items.description:
Job Title
Amazon Listing Optimization & SEO Expert Needed (1-Time Fix / 1 Product (for now) / Pure Organic Growth)

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Amazon Seller Central expert to help us optimize a single product listing and fix a category placement issue to drive 100% organic sales growth (No PPC).

Current Major Issue:
The product is currently miscategorized under consumer Automotive - Car Care. Because this is an industrial chemical meeting strict specific standards, it is completely invisible to our target B2B and industrial audience.


Scope of Work:
 1. Browse Node / Category Correction: Audit and safely request a category change through Seller Central to ensure the product is placed in the most relevant Industrial & Scientific category to trigger proper organic indexing.
 2. Deep Keyword Research: Use Helium 10 or Jungle Scout to identify high-volume, high-intent organic search terms used by industrial buyers, machine shops, aerospace manufacturers, and B2B buyers looking for passivation solutions.
 3. Full Listing Copywriting Rewrite: Rewrite the Title, Bullet Points, and Product Description to blend technical specifications seamlessly with conversion-focused SEO copywriting.
 4. Back-End Optimization: Fully optimize backend search terms, subject matter tags, and target audience fields.
 5. Conversion Audit: Provide a brief critique of our current main images and offer actionable recommendations on how to visually communicate the "Industry Approved / Meet ASTM standards" value proposition to improve our organic conversion rate.


Requirements:
* Proven track record of successful Amazon SEO optimization (portfolio examples or screenshots of organic keyword rank improvements required).
* Access to your own enterprise Amazon keyword research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, etc.).
* Excellent written English, specifically for technical B2B or industrial/scientific products.
* Ability to safely navigate Seller Central category change requests without getting the listing suppressed.


Project Details:
* Budget: Open to fixed-price bids
* Duration: 1–2 weeks
* Location Preference: East / South Asia (Philippines, Vietnam, etc.)

items.title: Web Designer & Developer Needed For Houston Local Service Website Plus Local Seo
items.description:
We are a Houston, Texas-based local service company looking for an experienced web designer/developer to create a professional, modern, conversion-focused website for our company, Bolt Property Works.

This is not an e-commerce website. Customers will not be purchasing services or receiving instant pricing online. Most of our projects require a phone conversation and/or an on-site walkthrough before we can provide an estimate.

Our primary website conversion goals are:

Request a Free Estimate
Call Now
Submit project information/photos
Generate qualified local leads organically through Google
ABOUT OUR BUSINESS

Bolt Property Works provides property, demolition, land clearing, tree, and site services throughout the Houston area.

Our primary service categories will include:

Demolition:

Residential Demolition
Commercial Demolition
Interior / Selective Demolition
Pool Demolition & Removal
Concrete Demolition & Removal
Garage / Shed / Structure Removal
Land Clearing & Site Work:

Land Clearing
Lot Clearing
Brush Clearing
Forestry Mulching
Site Preparation
Tree & Stump Clearing
Grading / Dirt Work as the company expands
Tree Services:

Tree Removal
Tree Trimming
Stump Grinding
Multiple-Tree / Lot Clearing
Storm & Hazard Tree Cleanup
Property & Site Cleanup:

Construction Site Cleanup
Construction Debris Removal
Junk Removal
Full Property Cleanouts
Estate / Hoarder Cleanouts
Our business is NOT primarily a junk removal company and we are NOT a dumpster rental company.

The website should position Bolt Property Works as a professional Houston contractor capable of handling serious demolition, land clearing, tree, site preparation, and cleanup projects.

WEBSITE STYLE / INSPIRATION

We will provide several Houston-area competitor websites as references.

We like different things about each company:

Doctor Demolition — overall visual quality, professional appearance, branding, and how individual demolition services are presented
Right On Time Demolition — broad service offering and business model
JRP Tree & Demolition Services — service-page structure, tree/demolition positioning, and Request a Free Estimate flow
G & R Land Services — land clearing / site-work positioning
These websites are for inspiration only. We do NOT want them copied.

We want Bolt Property Works to have its own professional identity while achieving a similar level of quality.

WEBSITE STRUCTURE

We are looking for a true multi-page website, not a single landing page.

Expected structure may include:

Home
About Us
Services
Individual Service Pages
Service Areas
Projects / Gallery
Request a Free Estimate
Contact
Major services should have dedicated pages rather than placing every service on one generic services page.

For example, Pool Removal, Concrete Removal, Interior Demolition, Residential Demolition, Land Clearing, Tree Removal, etc. should be capable of having their own SEO-focused pages.

REQUEST A FREE ESTIMATE FORM

This is extremely important.

The website needs a professional Request a Free Estimate form.

The form should collect information such as:

Name
Phone Number
Email
Property / Project Address
Type of Customer (Homeowner, Contractor, Builder, Property Manager, etc.)
Service Needed
Project Description
Preferred Contact Method
Photo Uploads if possible
The website should NOT provide instant pricing.

After a customer submits the form, our team will contact them to discuss the project and schedule an on-site walkthrough when necessary.

“Request a Free Estimate” and “Call Now” should be strong calls-to-action throughout the website.

SEO REQUIREMENTS

We are specifically looking for someone who understands LOCAL SERVICE BUSINESS SEO, not just website design.

Our goal is to build long-term organic visibility in Houston without relying entirely on paid advertising.

The initial build should include a strong SEO foundation, including:

Proper website architecture
On-page SEO
Local SEO structure
Keyword-focused service pages
SEO-friendly URLs
Title tags and meta descriptions
Proper heading structure
Internal linking
Image optimization
Mobile optimization
Page-speed optimization
Technical SEO fundamentals
Schema where appropriate
Google Search Console setup/integration
Google Analytics setup/integration
Ability to expand with additional Houston-area service/location pages in the future
We understand SEO is an ongoing process. We are not expecting instant rankings.

However, the website must be built correctly from the beginning so that ongoing SEO can be added later without rebuilding the site.

DESIGN REQUIREMENTS

The website should feel:

Professional
Modern
Clean
High-end
Trustworthy
Strong enough for both residential and commercial clients
Easy to navigate
Mobile-friendly
Conversion-focused
We do NOT want the website to look like a cheap, generic junk-removal template. We do not want low-quality clipart design elements the site should feel very custom, polished & professional.

Our target customers include:

Homeowners
Builders
General Contractors
Developers
Property Managers
Investors
Realtors
Commercial Property Owners
PLATFORM

WordPress is preferred, but we are open to recommendations if you strongly believe another platform such as Webflow would be better for this project.

We must have full ownership and administrative access to the finished website, domain connections, analytics, forms, plugins, and any other accounts/assets used for the project.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Please apply only if you have strong experience with:

Web Design
Web Development
WordPress
Responsive Web Design
Local SEO
On-Page SEO
UI/UX
Conversion Rate Optimization
Lead-generation websites
Experience building websites for U.S. local service companies is strongly preferred.

Examples may include:

Demolition
Tree Service
Land Clearing
Excavation
Landscaping
Roofing
HVAC
Plumbing
Construction
Junk Removal
Restoration
Other contractor / home-service businesses
WHEN APPLYING

Please include:

3–5 examples of local service business websites you personally designed or developed.
Examples of websites where you were responsible for SEO structure, not only visual design.
Which platform you recommend for this project and why.
Your estimated timeline.
What is included in your fixed-price proposal.
Whether you handle both design and development yourself or work with a team.
Your experience with U.S. local SEO.
How you would structure a multi-service company like ours so demolition, land clearing, tree services, and cleanup can each rank independently.
Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste proposal.

We are looking for someone who understands that the goal is not simply to make a nice-looking website.

The goal is to build a professional Houston service-business website that converts visitors into estimate requests and provides a strong foundation for long-term organic SEO growth.

items.title: Webflow Designer with GoHighLevel Experience – Coaching Brand Website
items.description:
PREFERENCES
Job Success 90%+ | English: Fluent | Location: any | 4+ hours/day overlap with Mountain Time | Visibility: Anyone

DESCRIPTION
We're The Rebuild (therebuild.ca), a Canadian 1:1 health and behaviour-change coaching company led by head coach Dillon Phaneuf: sixteen years of coaching, 1,500+ clients. We need a Webflow designer/developer to build our new brand website from approved renderings and finished copy, with GoHighLevel (GHL) handling every form, application and booking calendar.

THE SITE HAS THREE JOBS
1. Book sales calls: one Apply page (a GHL form) leading to a booking calendar.
2. Capture every visitor who isn't ready yet: wait list, a short quiz and a weekly Letter, all GHL forms.
3. Build the brand: premium through depth, not price. Phone-first; most visitors arrive from Instagram.

SCOPE (full brief attached)
- About 14 pages: Home (11 sections), The Method, The Experience, Results, Coaches, Our Story, Letters + Letter template, FAQ, Apply, Confirmed, Wait list, Quiz, and the legal pages (text supplied).
- Webflow CMS collections for Results (client stories), Coaches and Letters, editable by our team after handover.
- Embed our existing GHL forms, survey and calendar. You embed and style them; our operations lead builds and owns all GHL automation. No automation work inside our GHL account.
- Hidden fields on every form for source, campaign, referrer and landing page.
- GA4 and the Meta pixel installed, with cross-domain tracking between therebuild.ca (Webflow) and go.therebuild.ca (GHL).
- Domain connection at launch without disturbing our Google Workspace email records.
- Mobile load under 2.5 seconds, accessible contrast, captions on video, SSL, a redirect map.
- A recorded handover walkthrough so we can update the CMS ourselves.
- No e-commerce, no checkout, no prices on the site.

WHAT WE PROVIDE
Renderings for all pages (desktop and phone, with design notes), finished copy, brand colours and fonts, photography and testimonials, the GHL forms and calendar, and a company-owned Webflow account (you work inside it or transfer the site to it).

TIMELINE
Start by Oct 9. Live by Oct 31. If the full site can't be done by then, a phase-one launch (Home, Method, Experience, Our Story, Apply, Wait list, Quiz, legal) on Oct 31 with the rest within two weeks is acceptable. Tell us what's realistic.

BUDGET
Fixed price, paid in four milestones (design, build, integrations and testing, launch and handover). Quote your price for the attached scope.

YOU HAVE
- Live Webflow sites you built that embed GoHighLevel/LeadConnector forms or calendars. This is required. Please link them.
- Experience with Webflow CMS, responsive phone-first builds, GA4 and Meta pixel setup, and moving domains safely.
- Clear written English and availability through October with replies within one business day.

TO APPLY
Answer the screening questions, link 2–3 live Webflow sites (tell us which used GHL), and give your fixed price and earliest start date. Proposals that don't mention GoHighLevel won't be considered.

SCREENING QUESTIONS
1. Link 2–3 live Webflow sites you built that embed GoHighLevel/LeadConnector forms or calendars. What exactly did you embed on each, and how did you style it?
2. How would you set up cross-domain tracking so a visitor who lands on therebuild.ca (Webflow) and applies on go.therebuild.ca (GoHighLevel) keeps their original source in GA4?
3. Our domain runs Google Workspace email. Walk us through how you connect a domain to Webflow without breaking email.
4. If hired by October 9, can you have the site live by October 31? What would you build first, and what would you move to a second phase if time ran short?
5. What is your fixed price for the scope in the attached brief, and how many hours a week can you give this project through October?

items.title: AI Video Creator / Producer – Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia (Long-Term, Remote)
items.description:
We're Nextwave, a small AI video studio making short-form ads, product promos and cinematic content for e-commerce brands and agencies. Work is growing, and we're looking for 1–2 AI video creators to join the team long-term.

See our work: akiaistudio.com

Location: Serbia, Croatia or Bosnia and Herzegovina only. Same time zone means faster feedback, and we can talk in our own language.

What you'll do:
- Turn scripts and briefs into finished AI videos (product ads, UGC style, cinematic promos)
- Generate scenes in Seedance, Kling, Veo or similar, and keep product and character consistent across shots
- Edit and finish in Premiere, After Effects or CapCut so it looks clean, not like raw AI
- Deliver in 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9

What we're looking for:
- A portfolio with real AI video work. Show us what you've actually made.
- A good eye for hooks, pacing and lighting
- Reliable: you hit deadlines and tell us early when something's off
- Bonus: ComfyUI, ElevenLabs, lip-sync or avatar tools

How we work: hourly, $10–30/hr depending on experience and quality. We start with a short paid test.

Definition of done for each project:
- Final video delivered in the agreed formats and length
- Product and characters look consistent across all shots, no warped products or obvious AI artifacts
- Edited, color-matched and finished (music/VO synced if part of the brief)
- Delivered on the agreed deadline, with one round of revisions included

To apply: send your portfolio and 2–3 videos you're proud of, plus which tools you use. Start your proposal with "NEXTWAVE" so we know you read this.

items.title: In-Person Secret Shopper for College Admissions | Ontario, CA
items.description:
We’re a marketing agency looking for someone local to Ontario, California, to evaluate the admissions experience for a higher education client.

You’ll go through the process as a prospective student, from the first inquiry through the enrollment steps, documenting your experience along the way. This includes calls, emails, online meetings, and in-person campus visits.

Our goal is to understand what prospective students experience, what works well, and where confusion or obstacles could cause someone to drop out of the process.

What you’ll do

Submit an inquiry and participate in admissions calls and follow-ups.

Visit the Ontario campus for interviews, tours, and required assessments.

Work through the agreed enrollment steps and track communications leading up to the class start date.

Keep a dated log of interactions, response times, instructions, and next steps.

Save relevant emails, texts, screenshots, and materials.

Provide progress updates and flag any roadblocks.

Write a final report with clear observations, specific examples, and feedback on the overall experience.

Who we’re looking for

Located in or near Ontario, CA, with reliable transportation.

Available for campus appointments during business hours.

Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable asking questions.

A clear writer who can separate what happened from their personal impressions.

Discreet and able to follow a research brief.

Secret shopping, research, or customer experience work is a plus.

Project scope

This is a paid, one-time project that may involve multiple visits and follow-ups over several weeks. We’ll provide the research brief, reporting format, and agreed stopping point before you begin. You will not be expected to attend classes, pay tuition, or take on financial obligations.

To apply, please include

Your location and availability.

Any relevant secret shopping or research experience.

A short example of how you document and report findings.

Your hourly rate or estimated project fee, including travel and campus visits.

items.title: ikTok/ Reels Video Editor For Ecommerce Business (Ongoing)
items.description:
Looking for a freelancer that has the knowledge of editing engaging ecommerce IG Reels and TikTok style videos for organic growth, not paid ads. This is an opportunity with consistent volume and room to grow. 

Scope of work:
Edit short vertical videos (15-25 seconds) from raw footage we send you. We have viral formats that already works for us that we will share, but also appreciate someone who thinks outside the box. Our audience is mostly female based, so the videos are cute, warm, and emotional.

What we send you:
Raw footage and the music for each video. You edit around the sound.

What we need from you
-Experience with editing organic content for Reels or TikTok.
-A good sense of the first 1-2 seconds. We want hooks that stop the scroll, not only a clean edit.
-Cuts that land on the beat. Fast-paced, clean, no filler.
-Simple logo placement.
-No texts on screen. 
-Simple color correction on each clip so the footage looks consistent. No preset filters and must NOT apply one grade over the whole video, rather each individual clip. 
-Basic skills in CapCut or DaVinci Resolve.
Reliable delivery. You'll be working in weekly batches.

Volume and schedule
5-10 videos per week. We send footage for the week ahead, and you deliver everything within 1-2 days.

Nice to have
Experience with e-commerce, family, or lifestyle content. Understanding of what makes people save and share a video.

To apply, please send:
-3 organic Reels or TikToks you edited, with view counts if you have them.
-A short note on which one performed best and why you think it did.
-Your rate per video (15-25 second edits).
-Your typical turnaround for a batch of 5-10 videos.

items.title: Performance Marketing Agency Needed to Scale Online Spanish Learning Business – Customer Acquisition
items.description:
Job title
Performance Marketing Agency Needed to Scale Online Spanish Learning Business – Google Ads, Meta Ads & Customer Acquisition
Job description
About the Business
Spanish Survival Method is a newly launched online Spanish learning business based in the UK, offering live online Spanish lessons to students worldwide.
Our methodology focuses on practical communication, guided repetition and helping students Speak Spanish from Day One.
Our website and e-commerce infrastructure are now fully developed and live, including online payments, customer accounts, analytics and conversion infrastructure.
We are now ready for the next stage: customer acquisition and growth.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for an experienced performance marketing agency or small specialist team to develop, launch, manage and scale a paid customer acquisition strategy for Spanish Survival Method.
Our primary objective is very clear:
We are not simply looking for traffic, impressions, clicks or followers. We want paying students.
We want a marketing partner who can build a measurable acquisition system and demonstrate how advertising investment translates into genuine customers and revenue.
The strategy may include:
• Google Ads / Search campaigns
• Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
• Retargeting / remarketing
• Conversion tracking and attribution
• Audience and keyword research
• Campaign optimisation
• Landing-page and conversion-rate recommendations
• Testing different offers, audiences and creatives
• YouTube advertising where appropriate
• Expansion into additional channels and markets when supported by performance data
We are open to recommendations regarding other acquisition channels if you can demonstrate why they would be appropriate for this business.
Our Products
Our current offers include:
• Group lessons from £15
• Monthly group packages from £100
• Private 1-to-1 lessons from £30
• Monthly private packages from £210
• Complete Spanish courses from £349
Because customers may initially purchase a single lesson and subsequently purchase packages, courses or continue learning with us, we are particularly interested in understanding customer acquisition cost (CAC), repeat purchases, retention and customer lifetime value (LTV) rather than evaluating campaigns solely on the value of the first transaction.
Target Market
Spanish Survival Method can serve students internationally.
However, we do not want to simply launch one generic worldwide campaign.
We want our marketing partner to identify and test the most promising markets, audiences and acquisition channels first, compare their performance and then scale into additional markets based on real data.
We expect decisions about geographic expansion and advertising investment to be driven by measurable performance.
Measurement & Performance
We want clear visibility into the complete customer acquisition journey:
Advertising spend → website visitor → lead/customer → purchase → repeat purchase/subscription → customer lifetime value.
The successful partner should therefore be comfortable working with and reporting metrics such as:
• CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
• CPA (Cost per Acquisition)
• Conversion Rate
• ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)
• LTV (Customer Lifetime Value)
• Retention / repeat purchase behaviour
We are looking for someone who thinks commercially and understands business growth, not simply someone who knows how to operate advertising platforms.
Experience We Are Looking For
We are particularly interested in agencies or specialist teams with demonstrable experience in areas such as:
• Online education
• Tutoring
• Language learning
• Online courses
• Memberships or subscriptions
• Direct-to-consumer online services
Relevant experience in scaling a business from an early growth stage would also be valuable.
We will prioritise applicants who can provide real case studies and measurable results rather than general marketing claims.
Account Ownership
All advertising accounts, tracking infrastructure, campaign data, audiences and other marketing assets created for Spanish Survival Method must remain under the ownership of Spanish Survival Method.
The selected agency/team will be provided with the appropriate access required to manage the campaigns.
Commercial Proposal
We are intentionally not specifying a predetermined advertising or management budget at this stage.
As part of your proposal, we would like you to recommend:
• An appropriate initial advertising strategy
• Your recommended initial monthly advertising spend and the reasoning behind it
• Your management fee and exactly what is included
• Any setup or additional costs
• How you would scale advertising investment if campaigns perform successfully
• Whether you offer or would consider a performance-related compensation structure linked to verified paying customers
We will evaluate proposals based on experience, strategy, demonstrated results and overall commercial value.
Long-Term Opportunity
We are not looking simply for someone to set up a few advertising campaigns.
We are interested in building a long-term relationship with the right marketing partner.
If the acquisition model proves successful and scalable, our intention is to continue expanding the business into additional audiences, markets and acquisition channels.
Please Answer the Following Questions in Your Proposal
1. Have you previously managed paid customer acquisition for an online education, tutoring, language-learning or similar business? Please provide specific examples and measurable results.
2. What advertising budgets have you previously managed, and across which platforms?
3. Based on the business described above, which acquisition channels would you prioritise initially and why?
4. If a customer initially purchases a £15 lesson but later purchases monthly packages or a £349 course, how would you measure whether that customer was profitably acquired?
5. How would you track purchases, repeat purchases, subscriptions and customer lifetime value?
6. What would your strategy look like during the first 30, 60 and 90 days?
7. Based on the information provided, what advertising budget would you recommend for the initial testing phase, what would your management fee be, and why?
8. Would you be open to a performance-related component of your compensation based on verified paying customers? If so, how would you structure it?
9. Who specifically would manage our account after we hire you? Please clarify whether the work would be handled by you directly or delegated to another team member.
10. Please provide 2–3 relevant case studies with actual performance metrics where possible, including advertising spend, customer acquisition cost and/or ROAS.
IMPORTANT
Please begin your proposal with the exact words:
“Speak Spanish from Day One”
This will confirm that you have read the complete project description before applying.
We are ready to begin once we find the right marketing partner.

items.title: B2B Cold Calling & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant – Appointment Setting
items.description:
Yes. This is the important part. We want the description to make it very clear that you need one person who can find the leads AND actually call the businesses, while also helping with the other VA duties.
You can copy and paste this entire description into Upwork:
Swift Diagnostics Center is seeking a reliable and experienced Virtual Assistant to support our growing diagnostic testing business. This position is primarily focused on B2B cold calling, lead generation, customer acquisition, and appointment setting, along with administrative support.
I am looking for someone who can handle the full outreach process — not just build lead lists. You should be comfortable researching potential businesses, identifying the correct decision-makers, obtaining accurate contact information, making outbound calls, introducing our services professionally, following up with prospects, and helping turn those conversations into business opportunities.
Responsibilities include:
- B2B cold calling to U.S. businesses
- Researching and generating qualified business leads
- Finding owners, HR representatives, managers, and other decision-makers
- Introducing our services professionally to prospective business clients
- Appointment setting and follow-up
- Email outreach and follow-up
- Answering incoming business calls when needed
- Maintaining accurate records of calls, leads, follow-ups, and outcomes
- CRM/data entry and general administrative support
- Assisting with social media and other business tasks as needed
Requirements:
- Proven experience making outbound B2B cold calls
- Strong spoken and written English
- Comfortable speaking with U.S. businesses and decision-makers
- Experience with lead generation and appointment setting
- Professional and confident telephone presence
- Ability to work independently and follow detailed instructions
- Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional environment for calls
- Experience using Dialpad or another VoIP/business phone system is preferred
- Must be available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–3:00 PM Eastern Time
When applying, please tell me about your B2B cold-calling experience, including the types of businesses you have called, your experience generating your own leads, and your experience setting appointments. Please also tell me which phone/VoIP and CRM systems you have used and confirm whether you are available during the required Eastern Time schedule.
I am looking for someone dependable, productive, professional, and interested in developing an ongoing working relationship as the business grows.

items.title: Senior Python / React Developer — Trading Platform Maintenance & Operations
items.description:
We're looking for an experienced developer based in the United States, Canada or the UK to help maintain and develop our live trading platform.

Our immediate priority is to broaden technical coverage. We want another capable engineer who can learn the platform and progressively take independent responsibility for maintaining, deploying, troubleshooting and recovering its services.

You'll work alongside our current developer, with access to existing architecture documentation, operational procedures and automated tests.

THE PLATFORM

Our stack includes:
- Python / FastAPI backend
- React / Next.js / TypeScript website and admin dashboard
- PostgreSQL / Supabase, including authentication and permissions
- MongoDB data synchronisation
- DigitalOcean, Docker and GitHub Actions
- Broker APIs, OAuth, webhooks and background processing

INITIAL PAID TRIAL

We'll begin with a paid two-week trial at 15–20 hours per week, with agreed onboarding milestones.

During the trial, we'll ask you to:
- Set up the development environment and run the existing tests.
- Work with our developer to understand the architecture and key business processes.
- Walk us through your understanding of a selected application flow.
- Complete a small, meaningful change through a reviewed pull request.
- Identify and improve any missing or unclear setup instructions.

We'll assess your technical approach, communication, judgement and ability to get familiar with an existing system. We don't expect you to master the whole platform in two weeks.

FOLLOWING A SUCCESSFUL TRIAL

The initial engagement is expected to run for 1–3 months, with the potential for ongoing maintenance, operational support and feature development.

Further onboarding milestones will include:
- Tracing registration, account provisioning, broker connections and dashboard updates.
- Demonstrating deployment and rollback in a suitable test environment.
- Diagnosing a simulated service or data-synchronisation failure.
- Demonstrating a recovery procedure in an isolated environment.
- Updating operational instructions so another developer can follow them.

The goal is for you to perform these tasks independently, with an existing developer observing rather than directing each step.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You should have:
- Strong production experience with Python/FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
- Working proficiency with React, Next.js and TypeScript.
- Experience taking over or sharing responsibility for an existing production application.
- Confidence with deployments, logs, monitoring, database migrations, backups and recovery.
- A sound understanding of APIs, OAuth, webhooks and background jobs, including retries, duplicate prevention and failure recovery.
- Careful judgement when working around live customer data and production systems.
- Clear communication and a collaborative approach to pairing, code reviews and knowledge sharing.

items.title: Bookkeeper for E‑commerce Store (QuickBooks, Link My Books)
items.description:
We run a US‑based e‑commerce store (single‑member LLC) selling physical products internationally and are looking for a detail‑oriented bookkeeper to clean up our books and stay with us long term.

The situation

We currently use QuickBooks Online with Synder for syncing sales and payment data. Synder has caused ongoing issues, and our previous bookkeeper is no longer available, so the books need a proper cleanup. We want to migrate from Synder to Link My Books.

What you'll do

Review our QuickBooks file and remove or correct the transactions synced through Synder
Set up Link My Books and connect our two payment channels: PayPal and a merchant account with a smaller, less common processor
Reconcile sales, fees, refunds, and payouts so the books are accurate and clean
Handle ongoing monthly bookkeeping: reconciliations, categorisation, and clear monthly reports
Flag anything that looks off and suggest improvements to our setup

What we're looking for

Proven experience with QuickBooks Online and e‑commerce bookkeeping
Hands‑on experience with Link My Books (and ideally Synder, so you know what you're cleaning up)
Comfortable with PayPal and merchant‑account reconciliation
Very attentive to detail, organised, and responsive
Someone who wants a long‑term engagement, not a one‑off job

To apply

Briefly describe a similar cleanup or migration you've done, which e‑commerce platforms and payment processors you've worked with, and your hourly or monthly rate.

If you want, I can add the store platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, etc.) and rough monthly transaction volume — those two details usually get you better‑matched applicants.

items.title: AI Creative Designer / AI Image Generation Specialist for Ecommerce Brands
items.description:
We are an ecommerce Email + SMS marketing agency looking for an AI Creative Designer / Image Generation Specialist to join our team on an ongoing basis.

We work with a variety of ecommerce brands across fashion, beauty, food & beverage, jewelry, home goods, and other consumer categories.
One of the biggest limitations we run into when designing emails is simply not having enough high-quality lifestyle and campaign imagery from our clients. We want to change that.

Your primary responsibility will be to create high-quality, realistic, on-brand AI-generated assets for our clients every month. These assets will primarily be used within email and SMS campaigns, but may also be provided to clients for use across their website, organic social media, and other marketing channels.

This is not just an AI prompting position. We need someone with a strong creative eye who understands composition, lighting, branding, product presentation, and what makes an image actually usable in marketing.

What you'll be doing:

- Create a monthly library of custom AI-generated assets for multiple ecommerce brands
- Take existing client product photography and place products into new lifestyle, studio, seasonal, and campaign environments
- Create realistic product-focused imagery while maintaining the accuracy of the original product
- Generate seasonal assets for launches, promotions, holidays, BFCM, etc.
- Create images specifically composed for email design, including intentional negative space for headlines, copy, and CTAs
- Work from brand guidelines, existing photography, websites, and creative direction to match each client's visual identity
- Edit, composite, retouch, and refine AI generations when necessary
- Work alongside our Email Account Managers and Designers to create assets based on upcoming campaign calendars
- Organize and deliver final assets so our design team can easily use them

The most important part of this role is product accuracy.

If we provide you with a photograph of a client's handbag, coffee bag, jewelry, clothing, packaging, or other product, the final image needs to actually look like that product. Logos, packaging, colors, proportions, patterns, typography, and important product details cannot randomly change between generations.

We're looking for someone who knows how to combine AI generation + traditional editing/compositing to achieve a polished final result rather than relying entirely on a single prompt.

Ideal Candidate

You should have experience with tools such as ChatGPT/Image Generation, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Photoshop, Flux, Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI, or similar AI creative tools. We don't care exactly which stack you use as long as the final work is excellent.

You should also have a strong understanding of ecommerce creative, photo composition, Photoshop/image editing, realistic product placement, lighting and shadows, maintaining brand consistency, and creating assets around specific aspect ratios and design requirements.
Experience working with ecommerce brands or marketing agencies is a major plus.

We're looking for someone we can work with long-term, not for a one-time project. If you're a great fit, you'll become our go-to person for producing creative assets across our portfolio of ecommerce clients.

items.title: Travel Referral Partner – Earn 25% Commission Per Booking
items.description:
Travel Referral Partner – Earn 25% Commission Per Booking
About the Opportunity
We're looking for motivated Travel Referral Partners who can help us connect with people who are interested in booking vacations and travel.
This is a commission-based opportunity with no hourly schedule. You find the potential traveler, send us the referral, and our travel team handles the rest.

You earn 25% of the commission we actually receive from every qualifying client you refer.

What You'll Do
Your job is simple:
Find people who are interested in booking travel.
Introduce them to our travel business.
Send us the potential client's name and phone number so we can contact them.
Provide any basic information you have about their travel plans, such as destination, dates, or type of vacation.
Let us handle the travel planning, quotes, booking, and customer service.
You can find clients through:
Facebook and other social-media platforms
TikTok and Instagram
Personal networks and word of mouth
Online communities
Networking
Content creation
Other legitimate marketing methods
How You Get Paid
You receive 25% of the commissionable revenue we actually collect from clients you refer.
For example:

If we receive $500 in commission → you receive $125
If we receive $1,000 in commission → you receive $250
If we receive $2,500 in commission → you receive $625
If we receive $5,000 in commission → you receive $1,250
You do not have to make the booking yourself. Your primary responsibility is finding and referring the client.
When You Get Paid
You are paid after we receive our commission from the applicable travel supplier/booking.
If a booking is canceled, refunded, charged back, or otherwise does not result in commission being paid to us, there is no commission to distribute for that booking.

Referral Tracking
To receive credit for a referral:
You must provide the client's name and phone number.
The referral must be submitted before or when the client begins working with us.
We must be able to identify the client as your referral.
Only qualifying business that generates commission for us is eligible for the 25% commission split.
Please only provide contact information for people who have given you permission to share their information with us.
Who We're Looking For
This could be a great fit for:
Social-media creators
Affiliate marketers
Salespeople
Networkers
Travel enthusiasts
People with strong personal or professional networks
Anyone who is comfortable finding and connecting with potential customers
Previous travel-industry experience is not required.
We're looking for people who are motivated, professional, and willing to actively look for potential clients.

What We Provide
We'll handle the travel side of the business, including:
Travel planning
Quotes
Booking
Customer service
Supplier communication
Support throughout the booking process
You focus on finding the customer and making the referral.
Why Join?
25% commission on qualifying commissionable revenue
No hourly schedule
Work remotely
Flexible opportunity
No need to handle the actual travel booking
No travel-industry experience required
Unlimited referral potential
This is a commission-only independent contractor/referral opportunity. Your earnings depend on the amount of qualifying business you generate.
How to Apply
When applying, please tell us:
A little about yourself.
Why you're interested in the opportunity.
How you plan to find potential travel clients.
Whether you have experience with sales, social media, marketing, networking, or affiliate marketing.
Approximately how many people you believe you could reach through your personal network or social media.
We're interested in building long-term relationships with reliable referral partners, not just finding someone for a one-time project.

items.title: Motion Graphics Designer & AI Editor
items.description:
About the project:

We're a fast-growing entertainment company producing premium short-form series in action, sci-fi, superhero, and adjacent genres. We're looking for a freelance AI video designer to make the ads that bring new viewers to our shows.

This is a freelance, remote, ongoing opportunity with steady weekly volume.

The role: 

You'll generate new cinematic hook scenes with AI tools like Seedance and Higgsfield, and cut punchy trailers from our existing shows and movies. Briefs and scripts will be provided by our creative strategy team, but new ideas are always welcome!

Speed, responsiveness, and clear communication matter as much as craft here.

What you'll do: 

AI-generated ad hooks
• Create new hook scenes for action, superhero and sci-fi titles using Higgsfield.
• Turn scripts and briefs into high-impact openers: explosions, transformations, fights, reveals, and cliffhanger moments that stop the scroll
• Keep characters, look, and tone consistent with the original show across generated shots

Trailers and cutdowns
• Cut trailers and ad edits from our existing shows and movie content
• Add pacing, sound design, music, text overlays and captions that make each cut land

Iteration and feedback
• Deliver first drafts and iterate quickly on notes 

What you'll bring:

• 2+ years in video editing, motion design or ad creative, with a portfolio of trailers, promos, or video ads
• Hands-on experience generating scenes with AI video tools, especially Seedance and Higgsfield 
• Strong editing skills in Premiere Pro and After Effects
• A sharp sense of pacing, rhythm, and what makes the first 3 seconds of a video impossible to skip on platforms like YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, etc
• A track record of quick turnarounds and handling high-volume feedback rounds
• Availability for regular weekly work and some overlap with US Pacific hours

Nice to have: 

• A real love for action, superhero and sci-fi movies, and an eye for what makes their trailers work
• Familiarity with microdramas, especially male-focused shows, and their ad style
• Experience making UA ads for apps, games or streaming platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)

How to apply:

Send your proposal with a portfolio or reel, with at least one AI-generated scene and one ad/reel.

Speed, responsiveness, and clear communication matter as much as craft here.

AI-generated ad hooks
• Create new hook scenes for action, superhero and sci-fi titles using Higgsfield.
• Turn scripts and briefs into high-impact openers: explosions, transformations, fights, reveals, and cliffhanger moments that stop the scroll
• Keep characters, look, and tone consistent with the original show across generated shots

Trailers and cutdowns
• Cut trailers and ad edits from our existing shows and movie content
• Add pacing, sound design, music, text overlays and captions that make each cut land

Iteration and feedback
• Deliver first drafts and iterate quickly on notes

• 2+ years in video editing, motion design or ad creative, with a portfolio of trailers, promos, or video ads

• A sharp sense of pacing, rhythm, and what makes the first 3 seconds of a video impossible to skip on platforms like YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, etc

items.title: Bilingual Operations Manager for Tech/SaaS Company — Full-Time, Long-Term
items.description:
We are looking for a full-time bilingual Operations Manager to join a growing tech/SaaS company.
This person will work closely with the founder and leadership team and will be responsible for making sure the operation runs efficiently every day.
You will be managing tickets, assigning work to technicians, following up on completion, monitoring staff performance, helping organize priorities, and making sure things do not fall through the cracks.
We are looking for someone who is proactive, assertive, organized, and comfortable holding people accountable.
This is not a role where you wait around for someone to tell you what to do. When things are slow, we expect you to actively look for what needs attention, what can be improved, and what needs to get done next.
Responsibilities
- Manage and monitor incoming tickets
- Assign tickets to the appropriate technicians or team members
- Follow up consistently to ensure tickets are completed
- Track outstanding and overdue work
- Stay on top of technicians and staff throughout the day
- Help prioritize urgent tasks and escalations
- Maintain strong communication with the founder and leadership team
- Make sure team members are completing assigned responsibilities
- Identify operational issues and help resolve them quickly
- Keep workflows organized and efficient
- Hold team members accountable when work is delayed
- Look for ways to improve processes and daily operations
What We Are Looking For
The right candidate should be:
- Fluent in English and Spanish
- Highly organized
- Proactive and self-motivated
- Comfortable managing people
- Comfortable giving follow-ups and holding people accountable
- Strong communicator
- Able to work independently
- Able to handle pressure and direct feedback
- Professional and emotionally composed
- Comfortable working with a straightforward leadership team
- Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions
- Interested in a long-term position
You will be working directly with the founder, who has a very direct and results-driven communication style. He is respectful, but he is also very clear about expectations, deadlines, and what needs to be done.
Because of that, we are looking for someone with thick skin, confidence, and strong character who is comfortable receiving direct feedback and operating in a fast-paced environment.
We are not looking for someone who will leave after a few weeks because the role becomes demanding. We want someone who is interested in growing with the company and taking on more responsibility over time.
Position Details
Pay: $10–$15/hour
Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday
Industry: Tech / SaaS
Languages: English and Spanish required
Position Type: Long-term
Start Date: ASAP
When Applying, Please Answer the Following
1. Tell us about your previous operations management experience.
2. Have you managed technicians, support staff, or ticketing systems before?
3. Which ticketing, CRM, or project management tools have you used?
4. Give an example of a time when a team member was falling behind and how you handled it.
5. How would you describe your management style?
6. What is your English level?
7. What is your Spanish level?
8. What hourly rate are you requesting?
9. When can you start?
10. Are you looking for a long-term position?
We are looking to hire as soon as possible and will be reviewing candidates immediately.

items.title: Productionise existing questionnaire website (server-side scoring + Supabase + Stripe paid result)
items.description:
I need a developer to turn an existing working questionnaire prototype into a clean, production-ready standalone web app at www.contractprofile.co.uk.

This is not my main website. My main brand/shop will be www.thetraumacontract.co.uk and I will build that myself in Shopify. The only work in this job is the Contract Profile questionnaire site.

A large amount of the work is already done. I will provide:
- a working standalone HTML questionnaire prototype;
- the final 198 questionnaire items;
- 12 scored scenarios;
- the complete scoring logic;
- 11 Contract/archetype definitions;
- all 55 possible two-Contract profile combinations;
- all final paid profile copy;
- machine-readable JSON files;
- scoring and backend acceptance tests;
- a detailed developer handover document;
- a starter Supabase/Postgres schema and data dictionary;
- the visual style/colour system already used in the prototype.

I am therefore looking for implementation, testing and deployment rather than discovery, copywriting, psychometric design or product strategy.

CORE MVP SCOPE
- Responsive landing/introduction page.
- 198 self-report statements using a 1–5 Likert scale.
- 12 scenario questions using A–D choices.
- Progress indicator, section validation, previous/next navigation.
- Autosave/resume on the same device using localStorage while the questionnaire is in progress.
- Server-side validation and exact implementation of the supplied scoring logic when the questionnaire is completed.
- Free results page showing Primary, Secondary and Third Contract, Contract Family, score bands, all 11 scores / herd and six wider indices. Primary + Secondary alone determine the named Contract Profile; Third is an additional influence only.
- Client-owned Supabase backend storing completed assessment/result data. Raw response rows should be stored only according to the configured privacy/retention consent setting.
- I must be able to log into Supabase myself to view/filter/export the dataset; no custom admin dashboard is required.
- CTA to unlock the full personalised Contract Profile.
- Stripe Checkout integration for the full profile. Price controlled through a Stripe Price ID / environment variable, not hard-coded.
- Paid profile content must not be hidden in public browser JavaScript. After successful payment, verify the Stripe Checkout Session server-side and return only the purchased profile.
- Record payment/entitlement status against the correct assessment in Supabase.
- Full profile page using supplied copy, with Print / Save as PDF styling.
- Links back to www.thetraumacontract.co.uk.
- Deploy to www.contractprofile.co.uk.
- Source code, Supabase schema/migrations, setup notes and account handover at completion.

PREFERRED LEAN APPROACH
A lightweight Next.js/Vercel + Supabase + Stripe build is ideal, although an equivalent stack is acceptable if it meets the handover and security requirements. There are no participant accounts, no member dashboard, no CMS and no custom admin dashboard in this MVP.

OWNERSHIP / SECURITY
- Supabase, Stripe, GitHub/repository, hosting and domain/DNS must be client-owned.
- The developer may be granted access for implementation but must not make production dependent on freelancer-owned accounts.
- Do not expose Supabase service-role or Stripe secret keys in browser code.
- Public/anonymous users must not be able to SELECT assessment/response data directly from Supabase.
- Do not change question wording, scoring rules, profile names, family mappings or paid profile copy without written approval.
- This is a reflective profiling tool, not a clinical or diagnostic assessment.

items.title: Brand Identity Designer for Burke Group Ltd. — Parent & Child Brand System
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced brand identity designer to develop a new visual identity for Burke Group Ltd., a parent company based in the Cayman Islands.
Although the group currently includes businesses connected with property development, construction and related services, the Burke Group identity must be sector-neutral and scalable. The group may add companies in different industries in future, so the parent identity should not rely on property, construction, rooflines, buildings, or a fixed number of colours/elements representing the current companies.
The first child brand will be Burke Realty Ltd., so the identity should be designed with future child brands in mind.

We require six genuinely different initial logo concepts to present to our board. By six concepts, we mean different creative directions rather than variations of the same symbol or layout.
The board will narrow these to two preferred directions for further development before selecting one final identity.

The final deliverables will include:
- Burke Group Ltd. final logo and appropriate variations
- Burke Realty Ltd. adaptation
- Colour palette and typography
- Favicon/submark where appropriate
- Vector/source files and standard digital formats
- Brand guidelines covering the core identity and its usage

We are looking for something established, confident and contemporary rather than overly trendy or sector-specific.

Please include examples of relevant corporate or multi-brand identity work in your proposal.
