items.title: Beta Reader for Historical Mystery Romance Novella
items.description:
I’m looking for an experienced beta reader for a completed historical mystery-romance prequel set in Western New York in 1936.

The Last Will at The Terraces is intended to serve as a reader lead magnet and prequel to a planned historical mystery-romance series. It should work as a satisfying standalone story while also leaving readers eager to continue into Book One, Shadows Left Behind. The manuscript has been self-edited and was developed with AI assistance during the writing and revision process. I am specifically looking for a thoughtful human reader’s reaction before the manuscript moves to professional line/copy editing.

The Last Will at The Terraces combines an old Victorian house, a contested inheritance, murder, small-town secrets, and a developing romance between an independent community midwife and the man who finds himself falling for her.

I am not looking for proofreading or a rewrite at this stage. I want to know how the story actually feels to a reader.

Genre: Historical Mystery / Cozy Mystery / Historical Romance
Setting: Western New York, 1936
Word Count: 30,860

I’m looking for someone who regularly reads and understands historical fiction, cozy or traditional mystery, and romance—particularly stories where the mystery and romantic relationship are both important.

Feedback I’m looking for
I will provide a short beta-reader questionnaire, but I would especially like feedback on:
•	Overall reader impression and whether the opening pulled you into the story
•	Pacing—where the story moved well and anywhere your attention wandered
•	Whether the central mystery was engaging, understandable, and fairly constructed
•	Whether clues and revelations felt natural rather than too obvious or too hidden
•	Character believability and consistency
•	Evie and Thomas’s chemistry and whether their developing relationship feels earned
•	Emotional engagement with the characters and story
•	Whether the inheritance/family-history elements are clear or confusing
•	Dialogue that sounds unnatural, overly formal, repetitive, or out of character
•	Timeline or continuity problems
•	Repetitive language, unusual phrasing, or passages that feel noticeably AI-generated
•	Whether the historical setting feels immersive without becoming overly descriptive
•	Whether the ending feels satisfying
•	Most importantly: After finishing the prequel, would you genuinely want to continue into Book One of the series? Why or why not?

I would also like inline comments in the Word manuscript when you have an immediate reader reaction—for example, when something confuses you, makes you suspicious, surprises you, feels slow, makes you laugh, makes you emotionally invested, or pulls you out of the story.
Please don’t feel obligated to comment constantly. I’m more interested in authentic reader reactions than a manuscript covered in edits.

When applying, please tell me:
Your experience beta reading or editing historical mystery, cozy mystery, historical fiction, and/or romance.

A few authors or books you enjoy in these genres.

Whether you are comfortable providing both a written feedback report and inline Word comments.

Your typical turnaround time for a manuscript of this length.

Please include a sample beta-reader report if you have one available.

Please begin your proposal with the words “The Terraces” so I know you have read the full posting.

items.title: FCPX Video Editor — Descript FCPXML Roundtrip & Finishing (Paid Test)
items.description:
Job Title:
Final Cut Pro Finishing Editor: 12-Min Pastoral Docuseries (Descript FCPXML Roundtrip)

Job Overview:
Looking for an experienced Final Cut Pro (FCP) editor for a paid 12-minute test project. The content is an emotional, high-stakes pastoral/testimonial talking-head interview.

I have completed the narrative edit and script assembly in Descript. I need a visual finishing editor to take the exported FCPXML and eliminate jump-cut fatigue across ~100 edits while preserving an organic, cinematic documentary feel.

All raw media files (4K camera footage, high-quality audio, B-roll) will be provided via a high-speed cloud drive link.

Workflow & Scope:
Import & Relink: Import the Descript FCPXML natively into Final Cut Pro and relink to the original raw 4K footage.

Visual Finishing: Smooth ~100 dialogue jump cuts using multi-cam simulation, B-roll layering, and natural pacing.

Roundtrip Delivery: Return the completed project as an FCPXML file (plus a 1080p web draft MP4 for review) so I can run final color grading and audio mix passes on my system.

Technical Guidelines & Requirements:
Dynamic Scale Re-Framing: Apply clean 10–15% push-ins/scale adjustments at key narrative shifts to simulate a 2-camera setup (wide to medium/tight).

Organic B-Roll Placement: Layer client-provided photos and personal video clips over jump cuts during extended monologue sections. No generic stock footage required.

Audio Crossfades (J & L Cuts): Smooth out dialogue edit points to maintain seamless, uninterrupted audio transitions.

Selective Flow Transitions: Use FCP’s native "Flow" transition sparingly—only on static micro-pauses where facial alignment is identical. Do not apply over active hand gestures or head movements.

100% Native FCP Tools Only: Do not use third-party plugins, paid transitions, or custom generators requiring external licenses. The timeline must open cleanly on my system without missing asset errors.

Project Timeline & Deliverables:
Turnaround: 3 to 5 business days from asset handoff.

Deliverables:

Final FCPXML file.

1080p MP4 preview render (H.264).

Successful completion of this test project will lead to a long-term milestone contract for the remaining episodes of this docuseries.

items.title: Video Creator + Editor (AI UGC, Editing, Scripting)
items.description:
We're spending $100k+ a month on Meta and need more winning creative than we can make in-house. We're looking for a weapon: someone who writes, edits, and ships ads that convert, at volume, without needing to be babysat.

What you'll do

Write scripts and hooks for direct response video (15 to 45 seconds)
Edit real footage: crew B-roll, customer-shot UGC, and talking head content
Produce AI UGC with tools like Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Kling, and Seedance (we already have accounts and a trained avatar ready to go)
Design static ads and carousels
Turn one winning concept into 10+ variations: new hooks, new first 3 seconds, new CTAs, new formats
Review the numbers with us (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per lead, cost per booked job) and iterate on what's working

What we need to see

Real results: a portfolio of direct response ads you made that actually spent money. Tell us the spend and the result for each (CPA, ROAS, or CPL), not just the edit.
A system for volume: we'll need around 20 to 50 new assets per month. Show us how you organize briefs, naming, versioning, and turnaround.
Range: real skill in both AI UGC and editing real footage. You should be able to spot when AI looks like AI and know how to fix it.
Hooks: strong hook writing. The first 2 seconds are the job.
Compliance: you know the rules. No fake testimonials, no AI "customers" claiming experiences they never had, and you understand Meta ad policy and FTC regulations.

Bonus points

Experience with moving, home services, or local lead gen
Captions and motion graphics that feel native to the feed, not templated
Comfortable working in Slack and Google Drive or Notion

To apply, answer these:

Link 3 ads you made, with the spend and result for each.
Walk us through how you'd produce 25 ads in one week: your tools, steps, and timeline.
What's the best hook you've ever written, and why did it work?
Which AI video and voice tools do you use, and how do you fix "this looks AI"?

Start your proposal with the word "POTATO" so we know you actually read this.

Generic proposals get skipped.

items.title: Saviynt IAM Implementation Engineer
items.description:
I'm looking for a senior Identity and Access Management professional who has personally led a Saviynt implementation from the ground up, not just supported one, to work with me directly as a mentor. 

This is a coaching and knowledge-transfer engagement, not a staffing role for a client project. I want to learn the platform the way someone learns it by building it: architecture decisions, configuration choices, common pitfalls, and the judgment calls that only come from having done it end to end.

What I'm Looking For

- Someone who has owned a Saviynt deployment from initial design through go-live, ideally in an enterprise environment
- Sandbox build is highly preferred
-Able to work with a limited budget

How This Would Work

- Recurring video sessions (weekly or biweekly, open to your availability)
- Hands-on walkthroughs directly on Saviynt: identity lifecycle management, access governance, role design, connectors, and policy configuration within Saviynt

Ideal Background

- 5+ years in IAM, with direct hands-on Saviynt implementation experience (not just administration or support)
- Strong grasp of identity lifecycle management, access certification, SoD, and governance concepts
- Experience with related IAM technologies (Active Directory, LDAP, SAML, SSO/MFA concepts) is a plus

PS: budget is tight so quote me a reasonable price

items.title: Build a Custom Personal + Business Expense & Financial Tracking System
items.description:
I’m looking for an experienced financial systems specialist to build a simple, highly organized expense and cash-flow tracking system for both my personal finances and business finances.

The objective is not basic bookkeeping. I want a system that gives me a clear, high-level view of where my money is going, what my true monthly overhead is, what bills are coming due, and how much cash I need to maintain my operations.

There should be two clearly separated trackers/dashboards:

1. Personal Financial Tracker

The personal side should track:

Monthly fixed expenses

Variable expenses

Recurring bills

Bill due dates

Payment/autopay status

Credit-card payments

Loan/debt payments

Monthly income

Monthly cash flow

Savings

Emergency fund

1-, 3-, and 6-month overhead/reserve requirements

Investments

Other financial goals

Actual vs. projected spending

I want to be able to quickly see:

Total monthly personal overhead → upcoming obligations → available cash → reserve coverage → monthly surplus/deficit.

2. Business Financial Tracker

The business side should separately track:

Business income

Fixed operating expenses

Variable operating expenses

Payroll/contractors

Software/subscriptions

Marketing

Transportation

Professional services

Taxes/tax reserves

Debt obligations

Recurring bills

Bill due dates

Payment/autopay status

Monthly cash flow

Operating reserves

Actual vs. projected expenses

I want to immediately understand:

Revenue → operating expenses → total overhead → upcoming obligations → available cash → operating reserve → monthly surplus/deficit.

Dashboard Requirements

The system should be visually clean and easy to understand.

I do not want an overly complicated spreadsheet that requires significant manual work every week.

The dashboard should clearly display key metrics such as:

Personal monthly burn rate

Business monthly burn rate

Total combined overhead

Upcoming bills

Cash available

Monthly income/revenue

Monthly expenses

Monthly surplus/deficit

Emergency/operating reserves

Months of cash runway

Debt obligations

Savings/investment contributions

The system should also make it easy to identify:

Unnecessary or excessive expenses

Expenses that can be reduced

Changes in overhead

Missed/late payments

Upcoming cash requirements

Progress toward financial goals

Automation

Automation is important.

Ideally, the system should minimize manual data entry through bank/credit-card data imports, integrations, or another reliable workflow.

I currently use or am considering Monarch Money as the transaction/account aggregation layer, so experience with Monarch Money is a major plus.

I am open to recommendations regarding the best platform for the custom tracker/dashboard, including:

Google Sheets

Excel

Looker Studio

Power BI

Airtable

Another appropriate platform

The priority is simplicity, reliability, and ease of maintenance, not unnecessary complexity.

Deliverables

At completion, I expect:

Fully functioning Personal Expense Tracker

Fully functioning Business Expense Tracker

Executive-level dashboard for each

Recurring expense/bill calendar

Expense categorization structure

Cash-flow tracking

Overhead calculations

Reserve/runway calculations

Actual vs. projected expense tracking

Automated formulas and calculations

Clear instructions for maintaining the system

A short walkthrough/training session

The system should be built so that I can operate it myself after the project is completed.

Ideal Candidate

You should have experience with:

Personal finance dashboards

Business financial dashboards

Expense tracking systems

Cash-flow modeling

Google Sheets and/or Excel

Financial reporting

Dashboard/BI tools

Automation

Monarch Money or similar financial aggregation platforms

Experience working with entrepreneurs, 1099 earners, or small-business owners is preferred.

When Applying

Please include:

Examples/screenshots of financial dashboards or expense trackers you've previously built.

The platform you recommend for this project and why.

How you would automate or minimize transaction entry.

Whether you have experience with Monarch Money.

Your estimated timeline.

Your fixed-price estimate.

Please start your proposal with the words “FINANCIAL TRACKER” so I know you've read the complete description.

Primary Goal

When this project is finished, I should be able to open the system and understand within 60 seconds:

What I have → what I owe → what's due → what I'm spending → my true overhead → my available cash → my runway → whether my financial position is improving or declining.

Ideally, the system should minimize manual data entry through bank/credit-card data imports, integrations, or another reliable workflow.

I am open to recommendations regarding the best platform for the custom tracker/dashboard, including:

Google Sheets

Excel

Looker Studio

Power BI

Airtable

Another appropriate platform

The priority is simplicity, reliability, and ease of maintenance, not unnecessary complexity.

Fully functioning Personal Expense Tracker

Fully functioning Business Expense Tracker

Executive-level dashboard for each

Recurring expense/bill calendar

Expense categorization structure

Cash-flow tracking

Overhead calculations

Reserve/runway calculations

Actual vs. projected expense tracking

Automated formulas and calculations

Clear instructions for maintaining the system

A short walkthrough/training session

The system should be built so that I can operate it myself after the project is completed.

Ideal Candidate

You should have experience with:

Personal finance dashboards

Business financial dashboards

Expense tracking systems

Cash-flow modeling

Google Sheets and/or Excel

Financial reporting

Dashboard/BI tools

Automation

Monarch Money or similar financial aggregation platforms

Experience working with entrepreneurs, 1099 earners, or small-business owners is preferred.

Please include:

Examples/screenshots of financial dashboards or expense trackers you've previously built.

The platform you recommend for this project and why.

How you would automate or minimize transaction entry.

Whether you have experience with Monarch Money.

Your estimated timeline.

Your fixed-price estimate.

When this project is finished, I should be able to open the system and understand within 60 seconds:

What I have → what I owe → what's due → what I'm spending → my true overhead → my available cash → my runway → whether my financial position is improving or declining.

items.title: Gadget.dev Developer — Fix & Complete Shopify → Klaviyo New Arrivals Notification App
items.description:
We run a Shopify store with a subscriber base who opt into collection-specific new-arrival email notifications via Klaviyo. 

An existing Gadget.dev app sits between Shopify and Klaviyo: it receives new-product events, matches them against collection subscribers, and fires per-follower Klaviyo events that trigger flow emails.

The app is live in production but has three defects blocking 75%+ of notifications from firing. Codebase is ~150 lines, well-structured, ready for you to iterate on - not a rewrite.

**Scope of work**

**1. Replace hardcoded team matching with Shopify Admin API collection lookup**

Current `matchTeams()` in `api/lib/fanout.js` uses a static 30-item MLB team array and matches against `product.tags`. This misses every NHL, NFL, NBA, brand, player, college and league-wide subscriber (200+ Shopify collections total).

Replace with: query Shopify Admin API at request time for the product's actual collection memberships, return an array of collection handles, use those handles directly to filter Klaviyo profiles on the `subscribed_collections` custom property. Also update `sendNewArrivalEvent()` to pass `Collection` / `CollectionHandle` in event properties instead of `Team`.

**2. Diagnose and fix production route 404**

After a recent redeploy, `/api/new-arrival` began falling through to catch-all `/*` and returning 404. Route file exists in production, code returns 401/400/202 (never 404). Likely a route registration failure post-deploy. Diagnose and fix.

**3. Add configurable fan-out delay**

`api.enqueue` fires immediately on product update, before Shopify has finished CDN-processing images. Defer by 15–30 min (configurable via env var). Recommendation on the cleanest Gadget pattern for this welcome — scheduled action, cron, or delayed enqueue.

**Deliverables**

- All three fixes deployed to Gadget production environment
- Test POST to `/api/new-arrival` returns 202 with backgroundId, background job completes ~20 min later, Klaviyo receives "New Arrival" event with valid resolvable image URLs
- Existing subscribers with populated `subscribed_collections` receive events for products in matching collections

**What we provide**

- Gadget account access (owner-invite)
- Existing codebase and full data-flow context
- Sample product IDs, sample Klaviyo profiles, prod log access
- Access to Klaviyo and Shopify admin
- Direct line to founder for questions (fast responses)

**Required**

- Shipped Gadget.dev projects in production (routes, actions, background jobs, Shopify connection)
- Shopify Admin API GraphQL fluency
- Klaviyo Events API (revision 2024-10-15+)
- JavaScript / TypeScript
- Can read existing code and iterate rather than rewrite

**Nice to have**

- Shopify Flow workflow experience
- Klaviyo flow architecture experience

**Timeline**

ASAP - live subscriber base currently receiving zero notifications. Target: 2-4 business days from start.

**To apply, please include**

1. One prior Gadget.dev production project (link or brief description)
2. 2–3 sentences on how you'd approach fix #1 (the Shopify Admin API query pattern inside a Gadget action)
3. Fixed price or hourly rate + estimated hours
4. Earliest start date and hours/day availability

Fixed price preferred. Applications without a Gadget.dev-specific example will be skipped.

items.title: Senior Backend Engineer — Systems Architecture / GCP / Python
items.description:
Senior Backend Engineer, Systems Architecture / GCP / Python

Remote, full-time, 40 hours/week
Primarily Central Time
Hiring within the next two weeks

About Reventure App

Reventure App is a real estate data and analytics platform used by more than 2 million people across the U.S.

Our platform processes housing, economic, demographic, and geographic data across more than 30,000 ZIP codes, 3,000 counties, and 50+ data points, with many datasets going back decades.

Our product includes housing forecasts, valuations, interactive maps, investor analytics, property tools, mobile applications, and AI-driven features.

We also have a built-in audience of more than 1 million followers across our media channels. This allows us to launch new features to a large user base, measure how people respond, and iterate quickly.

We are profitable, growing, and looking for a senior backend engineer who can take meaningful ownership of the architecture, performance, and reliability of our platform.

The Role

This is primarily a backend architecture and production systems role.

We are not looking for a pure data engineer or data scientist.

The most important requirement is the ability to understand how a modern production application works end-to-end and improve how the different layers work together.

You should be comfortable moving across:
Cloud infrastructure → backend services → APIs → databases and analytical query layers → caching/CDN → frontend

When something is slow, unreliable, expensive, or overly complicated, you should be able to investigate the entire system, identify the actual bottleneck, and implement the appropriate solution.

That could mean:

- Improving an API or backend service
- Redesigning how data is queried or served
- Improving database or analytical-query performance
- Adding or changing a caching strategy
- Determining what should be dynamically queried versus precomputed
- Improving CDN or edge behavior
- Reducing unnecessary requests
- Improving cloud infrastructure
- Making a targeted frontend change
- Improving monitoring, logging, and observability
- Simplifying an architecture that has become unnecessarily complex

You should be comfortable owning these problems yourself rather than depending on a separate architecture or DevOps team to diagnose them for you.

Our Technology Stack

Our production environment includes technologies such as:

- Google Cloud Platform
- BigQuery
- Python
- Cloudflare
- Cube.js
- Next.js
- React / TypeScript
- Firebase
- Mapbox
- Stripe
- PostHog
- Sentry
- ETL and scheduled data-processing systems
These technologies support our web application, mobile application, analytical data products, reporting tools, mapping features, authentication, payments, and other production workflows. 

You do not need to have worked with every exact technology above (GCP and Pythons are musts, however). 

However, you should have enough backend and systems experience to quickly understand an unfamiliar production architecture and make informed decisions about performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

What You’ll Own

Backend Architecture and Performance
This is the most important part of the role.

You will:

- Understand and improve the architecture of our production application
- Identify bottlenecks across APIs, databases, analytical query layers, caching, infrastructure, and frontend requests
- Improve application speed, reliability, and scalability
- Design better caching and data-serving strategies
- Optimize backend services and APIs
- Optimize SQL and analytical queries
- Work with Cloudflare and edge/CDN infrastructure
- Work with Cube.js or comparable analytical serving technologies
- Improve GCP infrastructure and production services
- Diagnose production issues across multiple layers of the application
- Improve logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability
- Evaluate architectural tradeoffs involving latency, cost, complexity, freshness, and reliability
- Deploy and validate production changes yourself

A typical project might involve a data-heavy page taking five seconds to load.

You would investigate the browser requests, backend services, APIs, query layer, database, cache behavior, and infrastructure to determine where the bottleneck actually exists.

Then you would implement the fix and verify that the production experience improved.

Python and Data Engineering

Strong Python and data engineering skills are also required, but they are secondary to backend architecture and production systems expertise.
You will:
- Build and maintain Python backend services
- Work with ETL and data pipelines
- Write and optimize advanced SQL
- Process large historical and geographic datasets
- Maintain scheduled and asynchronous workloads
- Work with queues and background jobs
- Work with BigQuery and production databases
- Diagnose data-quality issues
- Manage incremental updates and historical backfills
- Improve the reliability and efficiency of data-processing workflows
- Build and maintain APIs serving our web and mobile applications
Our data covers tens of thousands of geographic areas and decades of history, so you should be comfortable working with large record counts and complex historical datasets.

Frontend Ability

You do not need to be a frontend specialist.
However, you should be comfortable making targeted changes to an existing React / Next.js / TypeScript application when necessary.
A backend feature should not become blocked simply because a small frontend change is required.
We actively use modern AI development tools to help engineers work effectively across unfamiliar parts of the stack.

Product Ownership

We are not looking for someone who simply completes tickets.

We want someone who can take ownership of a feature or technical problem from beginning to end.

A typical workflow might look like:
Architecture → backend → data/query layer → API → frontend integration → deployment → monitoring → analytics → iteration
Shipping the code is not the finish line.
We want engineers who ask:
- Is the feature fast enough?
- Is it reliable?
- Are users actually using it?
- Where are users dropping off?
- Did the feature improve engagement, conversion, or another target metric?
- What should we change next?
Experience with PostHog, Amplitude, or another product analytics platform is strongly preferred.

Required Experience

You should have strong professional experience with:
- Backend application development
- Production system architecture
- Application performance optimization
- Google Cloud Platform
- APIs and backend services
- Databases and advanced SQL
- Caching and data-serving strategies
- Production debugging
- Monitoring and observability
- Python
- ETL and data pipelines
- Large datasets
- Asynchronous and background processing
- Git and modern software development workflows

You should also understand how frontend applications consume backend services and be comfortable working with React, JavaScript, or TypeScript when necessary.

Strongly Preferred

Experience with some of the following is particularly valuable:
- Cloudflare
- CDN and edge caching
- Cube.js
- BigQuery
- GCP Compute Engine
- Firebase
- Next.js
- PostgreSQL
- Mapbox
- Sentry
- PostHog
- Data-intensive web applications
- Geographic or time-series datasets
Comparable technologies are completely acceptable.
We care more about whether you understand the underlying systems and architectural concepts than whether every tool on your resume exactly matches ours.

Forecasting and Data Science

Forecasting and data science experience is a plus, but it is not the primary focus of this position.
Relevant experience could include:
- Time-series forecasting
- Feature engineering
- Statistical modeling
- Model evaluation
- Backtesting
- Economic, demographic, or real estate datasets
A candidate with excellent backend architecture and production systems experience but limited forecasting experience can still be a strong fit.
AI-Native Development
We actively encourage the use of tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and similar AI development platforms.
We want an engineer who uses AI as a force multiplier to:
- Understand unfamiliar code
- Investigate production issues
- Write and improve tests
- Refactor systems
- Evaluate architectural alternatives
- Accelerate development
- Work effectively outside their primary specialization
We care about quality, speed, understanding, and results, not whether every line of code was typed manually.
You should still be able to independently reason about the system, verify AI-generated work, debug incorrect output, and take responsibility for what reaches production.

Working Style

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week remote role, with consistent availability during Central Time business hours.

You will work closely with the CEO and engineering team through:
- Daily team standups
- Brief 1-on-1 check-ins with the CEO
- Regular communication throughout the workday
- Direct collaboration on architecture, technical problems, and product priorities

This is not a loosely asynchronous freelance role where tasks are assigned and reviewed several days later.

We move quickly and expect proactive communication.

If something is blocked, behind schedule, or technically risky, we want to know early, ideally along with your recommended solution.
You will have direct access to the person making product decisions, which means strong technical ideas and architectural improvements can move into implementation quickly.

Who Will Succeed Here

You will likely do well in this role if you:
- Naturally think about the entire system rather than only your assigned component
- Enjoy tracing technical problems across multiple layers
- Can independently diagnose why an application is slow or unreliable
- Prefer solving root causes instead of patching symptoms
- Are comfortable making architectural decisions
- Remain hands-on and enjoy writing production code
- Can work across backend, infrastructure, databases, data pipelines, APIs, and occasional frontend changes
- Communicate problems early rather than waiting for someone to ask
- Take responsibility for what happens after a feature is launched

Location

This is a fully remote position.

We are primarily considering candidates located in:
- United States
- Canada
- Europe
- Central America
- South America
You must be able to consistently work a 40-hour week aligned primarily with Central Time.
Exceptional candidates in other locations may also be considered.

Hiring Timeline

We are moving quickly and expect to make a hire within the next two weeks.

The ideal candidate is available to begin an initial engagement shortly after selection.

items.title: Website Development for my Psychology Practice
items.description:
Hello!

I’m looking for an experienced WordPress website designer/developer to help me design and build a professional website for my psychology/therapy practice, My Growth Place. 
Website: https://mygrowthplace.com/

I am a Clinical Psychologist and the practice currently consists of just me. The website will primarily target high-functioning adults, college and working professionals who are interested in personal growth, managing anxiety, OCD, ADHD, executive functioning, stress, overwhelm and reaching their personal and professional goals.

Website Scope:
I’m envisioning a relatively simple, polished website with approximately 5-6 main sections, such as:
Main Landing page
About
Services / Areas of Focus
Insurance Accepted
Contact / Schedule an Appointment
Potentially an additional section such as FAQs or Resources

I would like the design to feel clean, modern, sophisticated, warm, and professional, rather than looking like a traditional clinical/medical therapy website.

Design Direction:
I am particularly interested in:
A primarily white/clean background
Green typography and/or accents
A visual concept that subtly communicates growth, development, possibility, and forward movement
Minimal, sophisticated design rather than something overly clinical
A website that feels appropriate for high-functioning adults and professionals
Strong typography and thoughtful use of whitespace
Mobile-responsive design
I’m open to your professional recommendations regarding the exact color palette, fonts, imagery, layout, and overall visual direction.

Competitive Research:
One part of the project I’m particularly interested in is having you research other successful psychology, psychotherapy, and private-practice websites that appeal to a similar demographic.
Can you please identify approximately 5–10 relevant websites and provide some insight into:
What design elements are working well
How they structure their services/content
What makes the websites feel professional and appealing
What could be improved
Ideas we could incorporate into My Growth Place while still making the site feel unique
I would also appreciate your recommendations for the overall website structure and content, based on your research and experience.

Future Growth:
Although this is initially a small website for a solo practice, I want the site to be designed so that it can easily accommodate additional therapists as the practice grows in the future.
I also have two additional niche psychology/mental-health websites that I would potentially like to develop in the future. If this project goes well, I would be interested in continuing to work with the same designer/developer on those sites.

A Few Questions:
Before moving forward, could you please provide:
An estimate of approximately how many hours you anticipate this project would take.
Your estimated total project cost (or hourly rate and estimated hours).
What would be included in your scope — e.g., design, WordPress setup/configuration, development, mobile optimization, basic SEO, forms, etc.
Whether you would also help with website structure/content recommendations and competitive research.
What information/content you would need from me to get started.
Your current availability and approximately how long you would expect the project to take from start to completion.
A few examples of WordPress websites you have designed, particularly for professional services, healthcare, psychology, wellness, or other premium service businesses.
Whether you provide post-launch revisions/support and, if so, how that is typically handled.

I’m looking for someone who can bring their own design expertise to the project rather than simply implementing a template. I’m very open to ideas and would appreciate someone who can help me think through the best design and user experience for the brand.
Thank you and I look forward to seeing your proposal and examples of your work!

Taleen

items.title: Systems Technician & Automation Specialist
items.description:
Here is the clean, formatted version ready to copy and paste directly into UpWork or any job board:

We are seeking a technical, detail-oriented Systems Technician & Automation Specialist to map out, integrate, and automate our core agency tech stack.

Your primary mission will be to eliminate manual data entry, streamline workflows, and ensure flawless, bi-directional data flow across our sales, project management, time-tracking, accounting, and communication tools.

If you are a master at building custom webhooks, setting up API-based integrations via Make/Zapier, and creating bulletproof operational workflows, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
1. Multi-Tool Integration & Workflow Automation

Email & CRM Integration: Connect incoming client/lead emails into HubSpot and automatically generate corresponding projects and task structures in Teamwork.com.

Time Tracking & Operations: Connect Hubstaff with Teamwork.com to align time tracking against specific project milestones and team tasks.

Accounting & Billing Pipelines: Automate data syncs between HubSpot, Teamwork, Hubstaff, and QuickBooks Online to streamline invoicing, time-tracking logs, contractor payments, and revenue reporting.

Middleware Management: Build, monitor, and optimize scenarios/zaps in Make (Integromat) or Zapier with robust error handling and log monitoring.

2. Architecture & Data Hygiene

Systems Mapping: Review our current tool environment and map out end-to-end data pipelines from lead intake to project delivery and invoicing.

Troubleshooting & Maintenance: Audit existing connections to identify broken webhooks, sync errors, or data discrepancies across tools.

Documentation: Create clear visual workflow diagrams and technical documentation for all custom integrations and automated paths.

Qualifications & Requirements
Integration Expertise: Proven experience building integrations across HubSpot, Teamwork.com, QuickBooks Online, Hubstaff, and email clients.

Automation Platform Mastery: Deep expert-level experience with Make (Integromat) and/or Zapier (including webhooks, JSON parsing, API calls, and router logic).

API & Webhook Proficiency: Ability to work with REST APIs, authentication methods, and custom webhooks when native Zapier/Make modules fall short.

Systems Architecture: Experience designing scalable agency workflows so data moves cleanly without duplicate records or lost information.

Clear Communication: Ability to explain technical setups clearly via Loom videos and brief written documentation.

Application Requirements
To apply, please submit your proposal with the following:

A brief overview of your experience connecting HubSpot, Teamwork, and QuickBooks (or similar multi-app stacks).

Which middleware automation tool you specialize in (Make vs. Zapier) and why you'd recommend it for this stack.

Your hourly rate or fixed-price project estimates for tech stack integrations.

items.title: B2B Prospect Researcher – Commercial Cleaning Vendor Opportunities
items.description:
About the Project

Ambient Cleaning Solutions is a commercial cleaning company seeking an experienced B2B prospect researcher to identify qualified vendor, subcontracting, and recurring cleaning opportunities in Georgia.

This is NOT a project where we simply need hundreds of business names and phone numbers. We previously tried broad lead lists and are now focused on quality, verified opportunities where there is a realistic path to becoming a vendor or subcontractor.

Primary Targets:

1. Apartment communities and multifamily property management companies that use outside vendors for make-ready/unit-turn cleaning, move-out cleaning, deep cleaning, or related services.
2. Restoration companies that use outside cleaning crews/subcontractors or may need overflow cleaning support.
3. Established commercial cleaning/facility-service companies that subcontract work or use local cleaning partners for overflow or regional accounts.

For each qualified prospect, we need:

• Company/property name
• Location
• Website
• Decision-maker name and title when available
• Verified phone number
• Verified email/direct contact information when available
• Property management/parent company when applicable
• Vendor registration/application link when available
• Evidence or notes showing why this is a qualified opportunity
• Any available information regarding their vendor/subcontractor process

Important: We do NOT want scraped lists containing generic businesses with unverified contact information. The researcher should investigate each prospect and prioritize companies that actually use outside vendors, accept vendor applications, subcontract cleaning work, or have another identifiable reason to contact them.

We will begin with a small test assignment. Strong performance may lead to ongoing weekly work.

When applying, please answer:

1. What tools/methods do you use to verify B2B decision-makers, emails, and phone numbers?
2. Have you researched vendor or subcontracting opportunities before? Please explain.
3. How would you determine whether an apartment/property management company uses outside cleaning vendors?
4. Please provide an example of the type of information you would include for one qualified prospect.

Please begin your proposal with the words “AMBIENT VENDOR RESEARCH” so I know you read the full description.

items.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer for Client Portals, AI Automations, and Integrations
items.description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer for Client Portals, AI Automations, and Integrations
We’re looking for an experienced full-stack software engineer to help build and maintain reusable software systems for a growing AI automation agency.
The work may include client-facing portals, internal dashboards, workflow automations, API integrations, authentication, databases, reporting tools, and AI-powered features. We need someone who can understand a business requirement, recommend a sound technical approach, and implement the complete solution—not just complete isolated coding tasks.
Responsibilities
- Build responsive client portals and internal web applications
- Develop frontend features using React, Next.js, or a similar framework
- Build secure backend services and APIs
- Design database schemas and data workflows
- Integrate CRMs, payment systems, analytics tools, and third-party APIs
- Implement authentication, permissions, validation, and error handling
- Connect applications with AI models and automation services
- Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and improve production applications
- Create reusable, configurable systems that can support multiple clients
- Document architecture, setup instructions, and important technical decisions
Ideal experience
- Strong JavaScript or TypeScript experience
- React and Next.js
- Node.js and/or Python
- PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, or similar platforms
- REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and third-party integrations
- Git, GitHub, CI/CD, testing, and cloud deployment
- Vercel, AWS, Google Cloud, or similar infrastructure
- AI API integrations and workflow automation
- Multi-tenant applications or configurable client portals
What we’re looking for
You should be comfortable taking ownership of a feature from planning through deployment. Strong communication is important: we expect clear estimates, regular progress updates, early reporting of blockers, and documentation that another developer can follow.
We especially value engineers who build maintainable systems instead of one-off solutions. Shared functionality should remain reusable, while each client’s branding, content, credentials, integrations, and data stay properly separated.
When applying, please include
1. A brief introduction and your primary technology stack
2. Two or three relevant projects you personally worked on
3. Your specific contribution to each project
4. Experience with portals, integrations, automation, or AI features
5. Your availability, time zone, and hourly rate
6. The word “STACK” at the beginning of your proposal
This will begin with a defined paid project and may develop into an ongoing relationship for the right engineer.

items.title: Instagram Community Outreach Assistant
items.description:
Instagram Community Outreach Assistant
Part-Time | Remote | 5–10 hours per week initially

I’m a bestselling author looking for a reliable, detail-oriented virtual assistant to help me identify and engage potential readers on Instagram.

This is not a content creation position. The work is focused on reader outreach and community building.

The primary task will be monitoring selected Instagram posts from book influencers, reviewers, and other accounts featuring my novels. You will identify people who like, comment on, or positively engage with those posts, review their profiles to make sure they appear to be genuine readers, and send them a friendly direct message.

I will provide the wording and templates for the DMs, so you do not need to create marketing copy yourself.

The goal is to invite interested readers to join my author newsletter and, when appropriate, my advance reader/ARC list for my forthcoming novel, The Empress’s Cape.

You will also keep a simple tracking spreadsheet so we know:

• Who has been contacted
• Which Instagram post they came from
• Whether they responded
• Whether they expressed interest in the newsletter or ARC program
• Whether follow-up is needed

It is important that outreach feels personal and friendly, never automated or spammy. You will also need to avoid contacting the same person more than once.

The ideal person:

• Has experience using Instagram professionally
• Writes and understands fluent English
• Is comfortable engaging directly with readers
• Is careful, organized, and good at following instructions
• Can maintain a simple spreadsheet
• Is dependable and comfortable with repetitive outreach work

Experience with Bookstagram, publishing, author marketing, or online reader communities would be especially helpful, though it is not required.

We would begin with a small number of hours each week and expand the role if the outreach proves effective.

Does this fit your experience? If so, I’d love to hear briefly about any Instagram outreach, community engagement, or similar work you have done.

items.title: Data Scraping List Building From Various Sources
items.description:
# Data Scraping & Lead List Building Specialist – Insurance Recruiting & Homeowner Data

We are a growing life insurance agency looking for an experienced **data scraping, data enrichment, and lead list-building specialist** who can help us build large, accurate prospecting databases.

Our immediate priority is **insurance-agent recruiting data**, but we have several ongoing data projects. If you are good at this, this could become a long-term relationship with consistent projects.

## PROJECT #1 – Insurance Agent Recruiting / Job-Seeker Data — MAIN PRIORITY

Our first and most important project is identifying insurance professionals who are currently employed by specific insurance companies and appear to be actively looking for a new opportunity.

Example:

We would like to identify people who currently or recently work for companies such as:

- Globe Life
- American Income Life
- Family First Life
- Symmetry
- Primerica
- Other large life insurance agencies/IMOs

We are especially interested in candidates who are actively looking for new employment opportunities.

Indeed is one potential source, but we are open to other compliant sources and methods that can produce the same or better data.

Ideally, each record would include:

- First Name
- Last Name
- Personal Phone Number
- Personal Email
- City
- State
- Current Employer
- Current Job Title
- Previous Employer(s)
- Insurance experience
- Source
- Date data was collected
- Any indication that the person is currently looking for employment

The end goal is to import these leads into our CRM so our recruiting team can contact prospective agents.

**Volume is important.** We are not looking for 50–100 manually researched contacts. We want someone who understands how to build systems capable of producing thousands of accurate records when sufficient source data exists.

## PROJECT #2 – Newly Licensed Life Insurance Agents

We also want to build databases of individuals who have **recently received a life insurance license**.

For example:

Find individuals who received a Florida **2-14 Life & Variable Annuity license** within the previous 30–60 days.

We would eventually like to replicate this across all 50 states.

Potential information:

- First Name
- Last Name
- License Type
- License Number
- License Issue/Effective Date
- Resident State
- City
- Phone Number
- Email Address
- Individual vs. Business/Agency
- Source

We specifically want **individual insurance agents**, not insurance agencies or business entities.

We understand that licensing information and available fields differ by state. Part of this project will involve determining the best public/licensed sources and then enriching the records with legally usable contact information.

## PROJECT #3 – New Homeowner / Mortgage Protection Data

Our company sells mortgage protection life insurance.

We would like to identify **recent home purchasers** based on criteria such as:

- Property recently sold
- Sale price between $100,000–$500,000
- Property address
- Sale date
- Buyer/homeowner name
- County
- State
- Property type
- Estimated mortgage amount, if available
- Phone number
- Email address
- Other useful homeowner/contact information

We are interested in understanding what can be obtained through county property records, recorder/deed data, licensed data providers, or other compliant sources.

## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You should have experience with some combination of:

- Web scraping
- Python
- APIs
- Public-record databases
- Data extraction
- Data enrichment
- Contact enrichment
- Data cleaning/deduplication
- Lead generation
- Large CSV/database creation
- Automation
- CRM-ready data

We care more about **accurate, usable data at scale** than simply scraping the largest possible number of records.

Data should be cleaned, deduplicated, and organized so it can easily be uploaded into our CRM.

## IMPORTANT

We only want data obtained through lawful and compliant methods, including public records, authorized/licensed data sources, or sources where the collection and intended use are permitted.

items.title: Cold Calling SDR – Book Demos for Truck Repair Shop Software | Pay Per Demo + Commission
items.description:
We're a Startup software company that builds shop management software for heavy-duty truck repair shops. Our software handles work orders, technician time tracking, parts, invoicing, and customer approvals, all in one simple system made for the shop floor.

Our pricing is simple: per user, per month, with no extra location fees. That makes it an easy conversation with shop owners who are tired of bloated, overpriced software or still running their shop on paper and spreadsheets.

We're looking for experienced, self-driven cold callers (SDR/BDR) to book qualified demos with heavy-duty repair shop owners and managers in the USA, Canada, and Australia.

This is a performance-based role. You get paid for results. If you're good on the phone, the earning potential is uncapped.

What You'll Do
Cold call heavy-duty truck, trailer, and fleet repair shops
Reach the decision maker (owner, GM, or service manager)
Qualify the shop and book a demo directly on our calendar
Log every call outcome and leave short notes on each booked demo
Share call feedback with us (objections and what's working) so we can sharpen the pitch together
What We Provide
Lead lists of heavy-duty repair shops with phone numbers
A call script, objection-handling guide, and product walkthrough
A booking calendar link and a simple tracking sheet
Fast feedback and direct access to the founding team

Have your own data? You're welcome to use it, as long as the leads fit our target profile below. Demos from your own leads are paid at the same rate.

What You Bring
Your own dialer and calling setup. We do not provide a dialer.
Proven B2B cold calling experience. Automotive, trucking, fleet, or SaaS experience is a big plus.
Clear, confident spoken English
Ability to call during US/Canada business hours (Australia hours are optional)
Compliance awareness. You must follow applicable calling rules, including DNC scrubbing where required and honoring opt-out requests immediately.
Compensation

1. Pay per Qualified Demo Paid weekly as an Upwork fixed-price milestone.

2. Close Commission: one full month of the customer's subscription value When a shop you booked becomes a paying customer, you earn the value of their first month's subscription, paid as an Upwork bonus. The bigger the shop, the bigger your commission. There is no cap on demos or commissions.

How We'll Start

We start with a 2-week paid pilot. If the demos are qualified and the show rate is solid, we scale you up with more leads and a long-term contract.

To Apply (Important – Please Read)

Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed:

Start your proposal with the words "Bay Ready" so we know you read this post
Attach or link a 60-second recording of you delivering a cold call opener. Pitch any product you like.
Tell us which dialer you use and how many dials per day you typically make
Share your best results: demos booked per week in a past role, and the industry
Tell us your timezone and available calling hours

We review every application personally and respond fast.

items.title: Senior Art Director – Wayfinding & Environmental Graphic Design
items.description:
NOTE: 
The creative has been approved we are looking for final file delivery for printers of the signage system . 

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Art Director / Graphic Designer with a strong background in wayfinding systems, environmental graphics, and signage design for commercial, institutional, and corporate environments.

This role requires much more than strong creative skills. The ideal candidate understands how graphic design translates into a physical environment—from exterior identification and freestanding totems to interior directional signage, directories, room identification, maps, and complete wayfinding systems.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute comprehensive interior and exterior wayfinding systems

Design freestanding totems, directional signage, directories, identification signage, maps, and environmental graphics

Translate architectural plans, site measurements, and floor plans into clear and intuitive wayfinding solutions

Develop signage families and systems that are visually consistent, functional, scalable, and aligned with established brand standards

Create detailed design concepts, mock-ups, presentations, production artwork, and mechanical files

Work closely with architects, contractors, fabricators, signage suppliers, project managers, and clients

Understand the practical requirements of signage production, including materials, dimensions, mounting, visibility, legibility, and installation

Maintain exceptional consistency and accuracy across large, complex signage programs

Required Experience & Skills

Minimum 10+ years of professional graphic design / art direction experience

Demonstrated experience developing building wayfinding and signage systems

Strong portfolio showing completed environmental graphic design and wayfinding projects

Exceptional graphic design, typography, layout, hierarchy, colour, and information-design skills

Advanced expertise in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop

Extremely strong attention to detail and accuracy

Comfortable working with measurements, architectural drawings, elevations, floor plans, and detailed production specifications

Able to manage complex projects involving dozens or hundreds of individual signage elements

Strong understanding of preparing accurate, production-ready artwork

Ability to take creative direction while also independently identifying design, consistency, or production issues

The Person We Are Looking For

You are meticulous by nature. You notice when something is misaligned, inconsistent, incorrectly scaled, poorly spaced, or simply does not work within the physical environment.

You understand that successful wayfinding is not just about making signs look good—it is about creating a coherent visual system that helps people intuitively navigate a space.

This is a senior-level professional position. We are specifically looking for candidates with substantial real-world experience in wayfinding, signage, and environmental graphic design. This is not an entry-level or junior design role.

Applicants should provide a portfolio containing relevant examples of wayfinding systems, building signage, environmental graphics, totems, directories, or similar large-scale projects.

items.title: English-to-Spanish Translation and Formatting of Medical New Patient Packets
items.description:
We are an internal medicine practice in Hemet, California, seeking an experienced medical translator to translate our new patient packets from English into Spanish.

These packets contain forms patients complete when establishing care with Dr. Roman H. Felix, including patient information, medical history, acknowledgments, authorizations, office policies, and informed consent forms.

Scope of work

We have approximately 3–4 patient packets in PDF format. 

We need complete Spanish versions that are accurate, professional, easy for patients to understand, and ready to print and use.

Requirements

Use clear Spanish appropriate for Spanish-speaking patients in the United States, particularly patients from Mexico and Latin America.

Accurately preserve the meaning of medical terminology, consent language, policies, and patient responsibilities.

Translate all instructions, headings, questions, labels, and acknowledgment statements.

Maintain the existing organization and layout as closely as possible, including checkboxes, answer spaces, and signature lines.

Adjust spacing where necessary so Spanish text fits comfortably and remains readable.

Use consistent terminology across all packets.

Flag unclear wording, outdated information, or inconsistencies for our review before making substantive changes.

Proofread all translations and check the final formatting.

Deliverables

A separate, print-ready Spanish PDF for each agreed-upon packet.

Editable source files, preferably in Google Docs.

One round of revisions after our review.

Ideal qualifications

Native or near-native Spanish fluency and strong English proficiency.

Demonstrated experience translating medical intake forms, patient materials, and informed consent documents.

Experience formatting forms and working with PDFs and editable documents.

Strong attention to detail.

Please include in your proposal

Your relevant medical or non medical translation experience.

A sample of similar work, with any patient information removed.

Your fixed-price quote and estimated turnaround time.

The editable file format you will provide.

items.title: Manual QA Tester for LucidDock
items.description:
Manual QA tester needed for LucidDock, a personal and family organizer SaaS app preparing for public launch. The app securely stores addresses, insurance, IDs, vehicles, contacts, photos, documents, and important dates, with smart reminders and AES-256 encryption. Built with React, TypeScript, and Firebase, it runs in Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge on desktop and mobile. Authentication is Google Sign-in only, with Free and Pro plans. items.title: Social Media Strategist & Creator Manager for Established Beauty & Wellness Brand
items.description:
We're an established beauty and wellness brand with a small in-house team, and social has outgrown what we can manage internally. We're looking for an experienced social media strategist to take full ownership of our organic presence across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, and to act as a true strategic partner to our team, not an order-taker.

We've tried posting consistently without a real strategy behind it. Our feed looks fine, but it isn't building trust, growing the right audience, or driving people to our site. We need someone who can diagnose what's missing and build a social presence that educates, builds community, and converts followers into customers.

What this role includes:
    •    Conduct a brand and competitor audit, then build a full social strategy with clear content pillars tailored to our audience
    •    Develop monthly content calendars, short-form video concepts, scripts, and creative briefs
    •    Source, onboard, and manage UGC creators and influencers, including outreach, briefs, and deliverable tracking
    •    Write all captions and copy in our brand voice, optimized for search and discovery
    •    Own scheduling, publishing, and community management
    •    Deliver monthly analytics reporting with clear insights and strategy refinements based on results
    •    Collaborate with our team on campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments
The ideal candidate:
    •    Has led social strategy for multiple consumer brands, with beauty, skincare, or wellness experience strongly preferred
    •    Has hands-on experience managing UGC creators and influencer programs at scale
    •    Can show measurable results (reach, engagement, profile visits, link clicks) from organic strategy, not just a pretty feed
    •    Works independently, communicates proactively, and brings ideas to the table without needing direction
    •    Has a team or systems in place to deliver consistently month over month

We're open to an agency or studio as long as there is a dedicated strategic lead. We're looking for a long-term partnership with a monthly retainer for the right fit.

items.title: Klaviyo Email Campaign Setup for Small E-commerce Brand
items.description:
I run a small ecommerce brand, and I need a Klaviyo freelancer to help with one simple email marketing task.

Our Klaviyo account is already connected to our Shopify store. I am looking for someone who can create one promotional email campaign that is clean, professional, and aligned with our brand.

Task

For this $15 project, you will:

* Create one email campaign in Klaviyo
* Use our existing Klaviyo account and brand assets
* Create a simple, attractive email layout
* Write or improve the email copy
* Add a clear call-to-action button
* Link the CTA to the appropriate product/store page
* Send the campaign to an appropriate existing customer/subscriber segment
* Perform a basic check to ensure everything looks correct before sending

I will provide the campaign objective, product information, and any promotional details you need.

Important

This is a small one-time task, not a full Klaviyo setup or ongoing management project.

I am not looking for someone to build multiple flows, perform a complete audit, manage our email marketing strategy, or redesign our entire account.

The budget for this project is $15 fixed price.

IDEAL FREELANCER

You should:

* Have experience using Klaviyo
* Know how to create Shopify e-commerce email campaigns
* Understand basic email copywriting and design
* Be able to complete a straightforward campaign without requiring extensive supervision
* Have examples of Klaviyo campaigns you have created

When applying, please briefly tell me about your Klaviyo experience and include 1–2 examples of email campaigns you have created.

items.title: Commission-Only Sales Representative – UK Property/Law Memberships
items.description:
COMMISSION-ONLY SALES ROLE – £250/MONTH BUSINESS MEMBERSHIP

Love Law is looking for an experienced B2B salesperson who can sell our £250/month legal support membership to UK businesses.

This is NOT a data-entry or general lead-generation role. We are looking for someone who can speak confidently to business owners and decision-makers, handle objections, follow up properly and CLOSE sales.

THE OFFER

Our Love Law membership is £250 per month and is aimed primarily at UK SMEs, particularly businesses operating in:

• Estate agency
• Lettings
• Property sourcing
• Construction
• Property-related services
• Other suitable SMEs

You will be provided with sales material and prospect information. Your job is to turn those prospects into paying members.

COMMISSION

You will receive $30 commission for every membership you successfully sell.

There is no hourly salary for this role. The opportunity is designed for someone who is confident selling on results and wants uncapped earning potential based on the number of memberships they close.

The initial Upwork project is a short trial. If you demonstrate that you can consistently generate sales, there is an opportunity to continue working with us on an ongoing basis.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You should have proven experience in:

• B2B sales
• Cold calling
• Telemarketing
• Closing sales
• Speaking with business owners and decision-makers
• Following up leads
• Handling objections
• Selling professional services or subscriptions

Experience selling legal, financial, property, SaaS, business services or other professional services would be particularly useful.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Contact supplied prospects
• Speak directly with decision-makers
• Introduce the Love Law membership
• Explain the value of the service clearly
• Handle objections
• Follow up interested prospects
• Maintain accurate records of prospects and outcomes
• Convert interested prospects into paying members
• Report sales activity and results

WHO WE WANT

We want a salesperson who is commercially minded and focused on results.

If you are used to making calls but rarely closing sales, this probably isn't the role for you.

If you have a strong sales record, are confident speaking to UK business owners and enjoy working on commission, we want to hear from you.

APPLICATION

Please include:

1. Your B2B sales experience
2. What products/services you have previously sold
3. Your experience with cold calling
4. Your experience closing sales
5. Your typical sales results
6. Why you believe you can sell a £250/month business membership

Please also give one example of a difficult sale you personally closed and explain briefly how you handled the objection.

We are looking to start the trial promptly.

Title: All-in-One Local Marketer: WordPress SEO, ChatGPT Content Backlog, Directories & Social Media

Project Description:
We are looking for a Top Rated, Intermediate-to-Expert Local Digital Marketer to manage a comprehensive growth strategy for a plumbing service business based in Northern California (Livermore/East Bay Area). 

CRITICAL NOTE: Our website is built on WordPress. We are NOT an e-commerce brand. Please do not apply if your primary experience is on Shopify. We need a specialist who understands local service business marketing, directory management, and WordPress optimization tools (e.g., RankMath/Yoast).

Scope of Work:
1. Long-Tail Keyword Strategy: Research high-intent local keywords and specific long-tail search terms (e.g., "emergency water heater replacement in Livermore") targeting our service area.
2. AI-Assisted Content Backlog: Build a content calendar and use ChatGPT to efficiently draft localized website articles and service pages.
3. Human-Touch Editing: You MUST heavily hand-edit all ChatGPT outputs to remove robotic phrasing, ensure perfect native English, and maintain absolute technical accuracy for a licensed trade.
4. Social Media Posting: Repurpose our SEO content backlog into engaging weekly posts for Facebook, Instagram, and Nextdoor to drive local calls.
5. Directory Cleanup: Conduct a local citation audit to ensure our Name, Address, and Phone Number (NAP) are 100% accurate and consistent across Google Business Profile, Yelp, and Apple Maps.

Requirements:
- Proven experience managing WordPress websites and Local SEO.
- Experience building AI prompt workflows (ChatGPT) with strong human copyediting skills.
- Native or Bilingual English proficiency.
- Ability to maintain a 3-hour minimum work overlap with US Pacific Time (PT).

To apply, please answer our screening questions. To prove you read this entire description, start your cover letter with the exact phrase: "WordPress Plumbing Marketer". Any proposals failing to include this phrase or mentioning Shopify will be instantly declined.

items.title: TikTok Slideshow & CapCut Content Assistant — Long-Term, $3–$7/hr
items.description:
We run two apps: NextMove (travel and things to do) and Life Leveling (habits and self-improvement). We need an affordable, reliable content assistant for repeatable TikTok slideshow and short-video production.

We provide ideas, text, examples, templates, and feedback. Your job is to recreate our existing style closely: image choices, fonts, spacing, slide order, text placement, timing, and music. Please follow the reference rather than redesigning it.

Tasks:
- Find suitable images/clips from sources we approve and keep source links.
- Create TikTok photo slideshows and simple vertical videos in CapCut/Canva or similar tools.
- Add the supplied text and approved music, check spelling/layout, and export finished posts.
- Keep files organized and provide editable project files when possible.
- Later, after training and trust, help upload or schedule approved content.

We handle creative strategy and performance analysis. No filming, appearing on camera, or full social media strategy is required.

Requirements:
- Strong written English and careful attention to instructions.
- CapCut/TikTok or similar short-form editing experience.
- Good visual taste, especially choosing images that match a reference.
- Reliable communication, deadlines, and willingness to apply feedback.
- Individual freelancers only; no agencies.

Budget: $3-$7/hour. Part-time to start, approximately 5-10 hours/week depending on output and fit, with potential for ongoing work. Hours and volume will be agreed before starting; please quote your actual rate within this range.

Shortlisted finalists will be offered a small PAID test to recreate 1-2 existing posts from references. We will agree the scope, payment, and deadline before any work begins. No unpaid custom samples.

To apply, please send:
1. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.
2. 2-3 relevant examples, ideally TikTok slideshows, travel/lifestyle content, or simple short videos; explain what you personally did.
3. Which editing tools you use and how you match an existing style.
4. Your estimated time to make one 5-8-slide post when text and a reference are supplied, including image sourcing.
5. Whether you are comfortable following a detailed template closely and making revisions.

Please start your application with “STYLE MATCH” so we can see you read the brief.

items.title: Wikidata & Google Knowledge Panel Specialist for a Fintech Founder
items.description:
The goal of this engagement is a Google Knowledge Panel for the client, a fintech founder and Forbes Business Council member. You will build the entity foundation on Wikidata and advise on the identity footprint that feeds the panel.

A lot of groundwork is already done:
- The client's primary bio page is live with JSON-LD Person schema deployed and validating clean
- A complete digital-footprint dossier is compiled: 23 verified links across company sites, founder profiles, social accounts, corporate records, and media mentions
- Corporate records are gathered, including state entity filings and a July 2026 SEC Form D
- The Crunchbase founder profile is updated with current photo, titles, and bio
- A Ballotpedia update is submitted and under staff review; an IMDb bio update is filed and processing
- Investor deck and verified company documentation are on hand

Deliverables:
1. A new, policy-compliant Wikidata item (person) with accurate statements, qualifiers, and references to reliable sources for every claim
2. Proper linking: sitelinks where they exist, identifiers (VIAF/ISNI etc.) where obtainable, and correct instance-of / occupation / employer statements
3. A short written assessment of notability standing under Wikidata's notability policy, and an honest read on Wikipedia article viability (no promises, no guarantees, I want the truth)
4. A Knowledge Panel readiness review: what is already in place, what is missing, and a prioritized punch list of the 3 to 5 highest-value sources or citations to obtain next

Requirements:
- Demonstrable history of Wikidata contributions (link your user page / edit history)
- Working knowledge of Wikidata notability policy and referencing standards
- You must comply with all paid-contribution disclosure requirements on any Wikimedia project you touch
- Clear written English; you will document every statement you add and why

Nice to have:
- Experience with Wikipedia article creation through AfC
- Familiarity with Google Knowledge Panels / entity SEO and sameAs strategy
- Experience sourcing founder/executive profiles

How to apply:
1. Link 2-3 Wikidata items or Wikipedia articles you have created or substantially improved
2. In 3-4 sentences, describe how you would approach sourcing for a living businessperson whose coverage is currently thin on independent press
3. Confirm you will make all required paid-editing disclosures

Note: this posting intentionally contains no links or names. The full dossier and all assets are shared after hire.

items.title: Assistant At Digital Marketing Agency
items.description:
Project Coordinator / Social Media Assistant

ABOUT US
CreativeFruit is a Dallas social media marketing agency. We produce short form video and run social media for restaurants and local businesses.

THE ROLE
You are the right hand to our Project Manager. He runs clients and priorities. You make sure the day to day work actually gets done, on time, with nothing falling through the cracks. This is an execution role, not a strategy role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Social media management
- Schedule and publish posts, reels and stories across client accounts
- Write and proof captions, tags and hashtags
- Update bios, links, highlights and profile details
- Set up new social accounts and connect them to our scheduling tool
- Monitor comments and DMs and flag anything that needs a reply from the PM

Project coordination
- Keep every task in our CRM current: status, due date, description, files
- Chase editors, designers and videographers for deliverables before they are late
- Turn requests from the team into clear tasks with a due date and an owner
- Send a short end of day report: what moved, what is stuck, what is overdue
- Prep onboarding for new clients: account access, brand assets, first post dates

Influencer and outreach support
- Build influencer lists for each client
- Send outreach, follow up and track replies
- Confirm visit dates with the influencer and the client
- Track what was posted and collect the content

Small fulfillment
- Quick client requests: reposts, link updates, simple graphic or copy changes
- Order prints, signs and supplies and track delivery
- Organize footage and files in Drive

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU
- 1+ year in social media management, agency coordination or virtual assistant work
- Strong written English
- Very organized. You close loops without being asked twice
- Comfortable with Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Google Drive and a scheduling tool like Metricool
- Fast responder during work hours
- Honest about status. If something is late, you say so early

NICE TO HAVE
- Restaurant or local business clients
- Influencer outreach experience

HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS
- Zero overdue tasks without a note explaining why
- Every request gets a due date within 24 hours
- Influencer outreach numbers hit each week

TO APPLY
Send your resume and a short note on the most tasks you have ever juggled at once and how you kept track of them.

items.title: Brevo Email Template Expert to Fix Figma-to-Brevo Rendering Issues
items.description:
ZIVO (zivo.co) is a Costa Rica real estate platform built around a "place before property" philosophy. We've designed our email templates in Figma and built them in Brevo, but our test emails aren't rendering the way they were designed. We need an experienced Brevo template specialist to work directly with our marketing and content lead and get our template looking and behaving exactly as intended on desktop and mobile.

The main issues we're running into:

- Font sizes render inconsistently in Brevo.
- Live text in Brevo defaults to a fallback font, so it doesn't match our brand typography. We've been swapping text for images to keep the look, which isn't ideal.
- Text in 2 and 3 column blocks has rendered blurry when blocks expand.
- We need the right balance of live text and images so key messages still come through when an email client blocks images by default.

What you'll do:

- Review our Figma designs and current Brevo templates and diagnose what's causing the rendering issues.
- Fix the template so fonts, sizing, spacing, and layout display consistently across major email clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail) on desktop and mobile.
- Set up web-safe or properly embedded fonts so live text stays on brand.
- Advise on image vs. live text balance, email width, and best practices for image-blocked and dark mode views.
- Deliver a clean, reusable master template and a short walkthrough so our team can replicate it for future emails.

What we're looking for:

- Proven experience building and troubleshooting templates in Brevo (formerly Sendinblue).
- Strong understanding of HTML email rendering and cross-client compatibility.
- Experience translating Figma designs into email templates.
- Familiarity with testing tools like Litmus or Email on Acid is a plus.
- Clear communication and availability to start right away. We'd like this done within the next week.

To apply, please share one or two examples of email templates you've built from a design file, and let us know which email clients you typically test across.
