items.title: USA B2B Appointment Setter / SDR – IT, CRM, ERP & Digital Transformation
items.description:
We are a UK-based IT and Digital Transformation consultancy expanding our presence in the United States and are looking for an experienced US B2B Appointment Setter / SDR to help us generate qualified conversations with American businesses.
This is not simply a lead-list-building role.
We need someone who can identify suitable businesses, reach the right decision-makers, have credible initial conversations, uncover genuine business challenges and book qualified discovery meetings for our consulting/sales team.
Our team will take responsibility for deeper discovery, solution demonstrations, proposals and closing.
What we offer
We provide technology and digital transformation services across:
- CRM implementation and optimisation
- ERP / Odoo
- HRMS
- Microsoft 365 & Cloud
- IT Support / Managed Services
- Business Process Management & Automation
- Power BI / Data & Reporting
- Custom application development
- System and API integrations
- Website and digital solutions
You are not expected to sell all of these services.
Your role is to uncover an initial business problem that creates a genuine reason for a conversation.
Target US customers
Initially, we want to focus primarily on SMEs with approximately 20–500 employees.
Good target sectors include:
Manufacturing | Distribution | Warehousing | Logistics | Packaging | Professional Services | Retail/eCommerce | Field Services | Growing technology-enabled SMEs
Typical contacts include:
CEO / Founder / President / COO / CFO / VP Operations / Operations Director / CIO / IT Director / Head of IT / Sales Director / RevOps / Business Systems leaders
What problems should you look for?
Rather than pitching technology immediately, we want you to uncover issues such as:
- Too many spreadsheets/manual processes
- CRM not being properly used
- Disconnected CRM, finance, inventory or operational systems
- Legacy ERP/business applications
- Manual reporting
- Lack of management visibility
- Repetitive administrative processes
- Integration problems
- Growing business outgrowing existing systems
- Expensive or ineffective technology platforms
- Need for workflow automation
- IT support/service issues
- Need to modernise business applications
A conversation around one problem can become our foot in the door.
Foot-in-the-door approach
We don't expect a prospect to immediately purchase a large ERP or digital transformation programme.
We would rather start with a smaller, high-value conversation such as:
CRM Health Check
Business Systems Review
Process Automation Assessment
ERP Readiness/Discovery
Reporting & Power BI Review
Microsoft 365 Review
Integration Assessment
IT/Technology Review
Our consultants can then identify wider opportunities once trust has been established.
What you will do
You will:
- Research suitable US companies and decision-makers
- Build targeted prospect lists where required
- Conduct outbound calling
- Use LinkedIn and email outreach where appropriate
- Speak with senior decision-makers
- Identify current business/technology challenges
- Qualify genuine opportunities
- Book discovery meetings directly into our team's calendar
- Provide concise notes before each meeting
- Maintain basic CRM/outreach records
We strongly prefer quality over simply booking large numbers of meetings.
What counts as a qualified appointment?
A meeting should normally have:
Right Company + Right Decision-Maker + Identified Problem/Opportunity + Genuine Interest + Agreed Meeting
For every appointment, we expect:
Company:
Contact & Job Title:
Company size/sector:
Current systems (if known):
Business challenge:
Service/opportunity identified:
Reason for meeting:
Any relevant timeline/budget information:
A calendar booking without genuine interest or qualification will not be considered a qualified appointment.
Who we're looking for
You should have proven experience with US B2B outbound sales, SDR, appointment setting or business development.
Experience generating opportunities for any of the following would be particularly useful:
IT Services | MSP | SaaS | ERP | CRM | Microsoft | Odoo | Software Development | Automation | Digital Transformation | Technology Consulting
You should be comfortable speaking with senior US decision-makers and have excellent spoken and written English.
Previous US-market experience is important.
You must also be able to work appropriate US business hours for the territory being targeted.
Initial paid trial
We intend to start with a small paid trial and expand the engagement if we see good-quality conversations and appointments.
Our priority is not hundreds of calls with poor-quality results.
We would rather see a smaller number of well-researched accounts and genuinely qualified meetings that have potential to become long-term customers.
When applying, please answer:
1. How many years of US B2B appointment-setting/SDR experience do you have?
2. Which US industries have you targeted?
3. Have you sold or generated appointments for IT/SaaS/ERP/CRM/MSP companies?
4. Which US time zones can you cover?
5. Do you primarily use cold calling, LinkedIn, email or multi-channel outreach?
6. How do you qualify a meeting before putting it into a salesperson's calendar?
7. What tools have you used: Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, etc.?
8. Please give one example of a successful US appointment-setting campaign.
Start your proposal with “USA” so we know you have read the complete brief.

Company:

items.title: Vector Logo and Embroidery Adaptation
items.description:
Yes. Based on the final project scope, this is the **Upwork description I would post**:

### Project Description

We are looking for an experienced **vector production illustrator** to professionally recreate our existing Body Zone gym logo and supporting artwork as clean, true vector files.

**THIS IS NOT A LOGO REDESIGN.**

We are happy with our existing artwork and do **not** want the design, style, composition, lettering, character, proportions, or overall appearance changed. Minor professional cleanup is acceptable where necessary to correct rough edges or imperfections from the existing raster artwork, but the finished vectors should remain faithful to the artwork provided.

We have **3 official Body Zone logo versions** that need to be recreated as true vector artwork. The logo includes detailed elements such as the muscular skull figure, barbell and weight plates, BODY ZONE lettering, and diamond-plate background. The finished master artwork needs to scale cleanly from normal print and digital applications to **very large windows, wall graphics, banners, and signage** without loss of quality.

We also need our existing supporting artwork recreated as vectors, including:

- Phone number — straight and curved
- WEIGHTS — straight and curved
- BACKYARD — straight and curved
- MACHINES — straight and curved
- CARDIO — straight and curved
-BODY ZONE - curved alone

We need production-ready versions of the logo in **black/white/gray (3-color), black-on-light, and white-on-dark/reverse**.

We also need a separate **embroidery/merch production version of the FULL Body Zone logo**. For this version only, fine details may be simplified where technically necessary for embroidery, hats, shirts, screen printing, or other small-format production. We do **not** want a new icon, alternate logo, or redesigned version.

### Final Deliverables

Final files should include editable **Adobe Illustrator (AI), SVG, EPS, vector PDF, and high-resolution transparent PNG files**, along with appropriate **RGB and CMYK versions**.

Every visible part of the official master artwork must be true vector artwork. **Please do not place the existing PNG inside an Illustrator/PDF file and call it vector.** Manual recreation and professional path cleanup are expected.

Full commercial usage rights and ownership of the completed source/vector files must transfer to Body Zone.

**Attached artwork is the logo and examples of the lettering. ** There is more wording that will need to be done.

items.title: Video podcast producer needed to bring more life to podcast videos
items.description:
Podcast Video Editor + YouTube Thumbnails, Titles & Descriptions

I’m looking for a reliable video editor to help produce my weekly podcast, Complex Couples Podcast.

The podcast is primarily talking-head content focused on relationships, marriage, and complex relationship dynamics. I’m looking for someone who can keep the videos polished and professional without making them feel overly produced or distracting.

What I need help with

For each episode, I would provide the recorded video/audio and would like you to:

Edit the full podcast video for YouTube

Clean up obvious pauses, mistakes, or awkward transitions as needed

Add tasteful B-roll, images, text, or other visual elements where they genuinely improve the viewer experience

Add music where appropriate

Add a consistent intro and outro

Make sure audio levels are clean and consistent

Create an engaging YouTube thumbnail

Suggest/write a strong YouTube title

Write the YouTube description

Export the finished video in the appropriate format for YouTube

Export audio file for podcast platforms

I do not want a highly flashy, fast-cut editing style. My audience is primarily adults listening to thoughtful relationship content, so I’m looking for editing that feels warm, professional, engaging, and natural.

A good fit would be someone who:

Has experience editing podcasts or long-form YouTube videos

Understands when B-roll adds value versus becoming distracting

Has a good visual eye for professional thumbnails

Understands YouTube titles and packaging

Can maintain a consistent look from episode to episode

Is comfortable working fairly independently once we establish the style

Communicates clearly and meets deadlines

When applying, please send:

Examples of podcast or talking-head videos you have edited

Examples of thumbnails you have created

Your typical turnaround time for a 30–60 minute podcast episode

Your pricing per episode or monthly package

A brief explanation of how you approach B-roll and keeping viewers engaged during long-form content

This could become an ongoing weekly relationship with the right person.

items.title: Junior Accountant with Admin Experience
items.description:
Junior Accountant
Remote | Full-Time

About the Role

We are a growing group of companies based in Las Vegas with businesses in real estate, property management, short-term rentals, and international trade.
We are looking for a Junior Accountant to support the accounting and financial needs of multiple companies. This role will be primarily focused on accounting, bookkeeping, reconciliations, financial organization, and reporting support.

Because we operate several businesses, this position will also include some administrative and operational responsibilities as needed. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working beyond strictly accounting tasks when additional support is needed.
This is a potential long-term position with the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as you become familiar with our companies and operations.

Primary Accounting Responsibilities:

Bank and credit card reconciliations
Maintain and review transactions in QuickBooks Online
Prepare journal entries
Assist with month-end close
Review bookkeeping for accuracy and identify discrepancies
Organize and maintain invoices, receipts, and supporting financial documentation
Assist with accounts payable and payment tracking
Please include the color blue in your cover letter. 
Track expenses and ensure proper supporting documentation
Maintain accounting spreadsheets and financial records
Assist with financial reporting
Research and resolve transaction discrepancies
Help maintain accurate records across multiple companies and accounts
Assist with organizing information needed by our bookkeeper, CPA, and management
Maintain accurate and organized digital accounting files
Assist with other accounting and finance-related projects as needed

Additional Administrative Support
As part of the role, you may occasionally assist management with administrative and operational tasks, including:
Maintaining spreadsheets, trackers, and company records
Organizing documents and company files
Drafting basic emails and business correspondence
Conducting online research
Following up on invoices, documentation, or outstanding items
Communicating and negotiating with vendors or other business contacts
Assisting with scheduling and coordination
Helping organize information related to our properties and businesses
Assisting with special projects as needed

Experience
We are looking for candidates with:

2+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience
Strong bank and credit card reconciliation experience
QuickBooks Online experience
Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills
Experience maintaining organized financial records
Professional written and verbal English communication
Experience working remotely is preferred
Experience working with multiple companies, real estate, property management, or short-term rentals is helpful but not required.

Schedule & Opportunity
This position will begin with the potential to grow to be a part of our permanent team.
Our companies and management team operates on a Pacific Time schedule. Candidates must be able to work and communicate around our PST business hours as needed, regardless of their location or time zone.
Compensation will be based on experience and credentials.

How to Apply
Please submit:

Your resume/CV
A brief introduction describing your accounting and bookkeeping experience
Your experience with QuickBooks Online
Your experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations
We are looking for someone interested in a long-term opportunity who can grow with our companies as the position develops.

items.title: Sales Closer for AI Service — Appointment Setting Opportunity Available
items.description:
We’re looking for a confident Sales Closer to sell an AI receptionist service to small service businesses in the United States, primarily HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and similar trades.
THE SERVICE
Our AI receptionist helps business owners stop losing leads when they can’t answer the phone.
It works on the business’s existing phone number. When a call is missed, the AI answers, collects the customer’s name, callback number, address, and problem, then sends the information to the owner by text and email.
The AI does not quote prices or make decisions for the business. The owner receives the lead and calls the customer back.
YOUR PRIMARY ROLE — CLOSING
Your main responsibility will be running scheduled sales calls with business owners and closing deals.
Sales calls are approximately 30 minutes.
You will:
- Run the discovery portion of the call
- Understand how many calls/leads the owner is currently missing
- Present the service using our sales deck
- Walk the prospect through a live demonstration
- Handle objections
- Ask for the sale and close the deal
- Keep clear notes on each call
We provide the closing script, presentation, offer structure, demo process, and sales materials.
OPTIONAL SECOND ROLE — APPOINTMENT SETTING
If you are also strong at outbound cold calling, there is an opportunity to handle appointment setting as well.
For setting, we provide the prospect lists and script. You would call business owners, qualify their interest, and book 30-minute demos.
Someone capable of doing both can therefore handle the process from first cold call → booked demo → closed customer.
However, closing is the priority for this position. You do not need to be a setter to apply.
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You should be comfortable speaking with U.S. small-business owners and have strong spoken English.
Previous experience with B2B sales, high-ticket sales, home-service businesses, SaaS, AI services, or phone sales is a plus.
More importantly, you should be good at discovery, objection handling, and confidently asking for the sale.
WHEN APPLYING
Please tell me:
1. What have you personally sold and closed before?
2. Were the leads inbound, booked appointments, or cold prospects?
3. What was the typical price of the product/service you sold?
4. Are you interested in closing only, or both setting and closing?
5. Please include a short voice recording so I can hear your spoken English and sales presence.
If you’re a strong closer and the collaboration works well, I’m looking for someone we can continue working with as sales volume grows.

items.title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper for Events Company
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper to support the financial operations of multiple event‑based business units. This role requires strong QBO setup skills, excellent organization, and the ability to maintain clean, accurate books across several entities. You will work directly with the owner to ensure our accounting system is structured properly, transactions are recorded accurately, and invoicing and vendor processes run smoothly.

BUSINESS UNITS
• Multi‑event production projects

QUICKBOOKS ONLINE RESPONSIBILITIES
• Set up and maintain multi‑entity QuickBooks Online structure
• Build and maintain chart of accounts, classes, tags, and custom fields
• Maintain accurate P&L reporting by business unit
• Ensure books follow best practices and remain organized
• Support cash flow tracking and reporting

BANKING & RECONCILIATION
• Categorize and match bank/credit card transactions
• Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations

ACCOUNTS PAYABLE
• Vendor and contractor setup
• Collect and maintain W‑9s
• Prepare and manage 1099 filings

ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE
• Customer setup and maintenance
• Create and manage invoices (products, services, sponsorships, ticketing)
• Set up payment links and processing
• Follow up on outstanding invoices and communicate with customers
• Facilitate smooth payment processing and customer support

SPONSORSHIP & TICKETING SUPPORT (OUTSIDE QUICKBOOKS)
When a sales rep closes a sponsorship or ticket package:
• Prepare sponsorship agreements using provided templates
• Send agreements, invoices, and W‑9s to customers
• Recommend improvements for sending agreements/invoices through QuickBooks if beneficial

BUDGET SUPPORT
• Assist owner with event budget updates, maintenance, and tracking
• Provide periodic reporting and variance checks

REQUIRED SKILLS
• Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
• 3+ years QuickBooks Online experience
• Experience with multi‑entity or multi‑business‑unit bookkeeping
• Strong understanding of chart of accounts, classes, tags, and reporting
• AP/AR management experience
• Bank reconciliation expertise
• Strong communication skills for customer‑facing invoice follow‑ups
• Experience with event‑based or project‑based businesses (preferred)
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and OneDrive

AVAILABILITY
• Ongoing monthly work
• Weekly check‑ins
• Must be responsive during Los Angeles business hours (PST preferred but not required)

items.description:
Job Description
We are a UK-based IT and Digital Transformation consultancy looking for an experienced B2B Appointment Setter / Business Development professional to help us build relationships with SMEs primarily across UK.
This is not a high-volume cold-calling exercise.
Our objective is to identify suitable local businesses, engage decision-makers, uncover genuine business challenges and secure qualified introductory meetings for our UK Account Manager/Consultant.
Once a qualified meeting is booked, our Account Manager will take responsibility for discovery, solution discussions, proposals and closing.
What you'll be promoting
We don't expect you to sell a complex technology solution on the first call.
Your job is to identify a business problem or opportunity that gives us a reason to meet.
Our capabilities include:
- IT Support & Managed IT Services
- Microsoft 365 & Cloud
- CRM implementation and optimisation
- Odoo ERP/CRM
- HRMS
- Business Process Improvement & Automation
- Power BI, reporting and data solutions
- System integrations
- Websites & digital solutions
The initial opportunity could be as simple as an IT/technology health check, CRM review, process improvement discussion or business systems consultation.
Target Market
Primary focus:
Milton Keynes → Buckinghamshire → surrounding 20–50 mile area
Target organisations will generally be 20–500 employees, particularly:
Manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, packaging, distribution, professional services, charities/non-profits, retail and other growing SMEs.
Typical decision-makers:

items.title: Senior AI/Full-Stack Architect Needed to Audit & Optimize Production AI SaaS
items.description:
Senior AI / Full-Stack Architect — Independent Technical Audit of Production AI SaaS

We are seeking a highly experienced senior AI engineer/software architect to perform an independent technical audit of an existing production AI SaaS platform.

This is initially an AUDIT AND ADVISORY engagement, not a rewrite or development project.

About the Platform

The application analyzes recorded conversations/transcripts using AI and proprietary business rules, producing structured evaluations, scoring and automated reports.

The platform includes:

* AI/LLM processing
* Audio/transcript processing
* Deterministic business-rule/evaluation logic
* Structured AI outputs and scoring
* API integrations
* Automated report generation
* Web dashboard
* Database/storage infrastructure
* Vercel-based deployment

A significant portion of the application was developed with AI-assisted coding. The platform is functional; our objective is to independently evaluate the underlying engineering before further scaling.

What We Want Evaluated

Architecture & Code

* Overall system architecture and data flow
* Code quality and maintainability
* Technical debt and duplicated/dead logic
* API design
* Dependency management
* Error/failure handling
* AI-generated code risks

AI / LLM Architecture

* Prompt/model architecture
* Structured outputs
* Model configuration/versioning
* Reliability and consistency
* Deterministic vs. probabilistic responsibilities
* Retry/failure handling
* Hallucination/error controls
* Token/API cost efficiency
* Latency and unnecessary model calls

A particularly important requirement is determining whether business rules that require deterministic behavior are properly separated from LLM interpretation, and how repeatability/regression testing should be implemented.

Infrastructure & Performance

* Vercel/deployment architecture
* Database/storage design
* Environment/secrets management
* Logging and observability
* Performance bottlenecks
* Concurrency/scaling risks
* Backup/disaster recovery
* Development/staging/production separation

Security

* Authentication/authorization
* API security
* Secret exposure
* Data leakage
* Dependency vulnerabilities
* Sensitive-data/PII handling
* Logging of sensitive information

Initial Engagement

The initial engagement will be read-only.

Do NOT refactor, rewrite, deploy or modify production code during the audit without explicit authorization.

We expect to begin with approximately 10 hours, review preliminary findings together, and authorize additional audit time if warranted.

Deliverables

We want a concise written technical assessment including:

1. Executive technical summary
2. Current architecture/data-flow overview
3. Findings categorized as Critical / High / Medium / Low
4. AI/LLM architecture assessment
5. Security assessment
6. Performance/scalability assessment
7. Technical-debt assessment
8. Testing/reliability recommendations
9. Prioritized remediation roadmap

For significant findings, please use:

Problem → Evidence → Business Impact → Recommended Solution → Estimated Effort

We specifically want to distinguish genuine engineering risks from unnecessary rewrites or over-engineering.

Ideal Background

Strong experience with production AI/LLM SaaS systems, software architecture, Python, APIs, modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, databases, cloud/serverless infrastructure, application security, performance optimization, testing and observability.

Experience auditing applications built substantially with AI-assisted development is particularly valuable.

When Applying

Please briefly answer:

1. How many production AI/LLM applications have you personally architected or audited?
2. Describe an architecture/reliability/scaling problem you discovered in an existing AI application and how you diagnosed it.
3. How would you test whether an LLM-based evaluation system produces sufficiently consistent results from identical inputs?
4. How do you decide which responsibilities belong to an LLM versus deterministic application code?
5. What would you examine first when auditing a production Vercel-hosted AI SaaS application?
6. Have you audited a codebase substantially created using AI-assisted development? What issues did you encounter?
7. What access would you require for a read-only audit?
8. Please provide or describe an example of a previous technical audit/architecture assessment. Client-sensitive information may be redacted.

Please begin your proposal with the words “TECH AUDIT” so we know you read the complete posting.

Strong performance on the audit may lead to a separate engagement implementing approved improvements and potentially ongoing architectural/engineering work.

items.title: Adobe Illustrator (Part-Time) - Graphic / Brand Designer, Packaging Designer, or Illustrator
items.description:
We're looking into the design and illustration space and want to understand in detail how designers actually build, refine and hand off vector work in Adobe Illustrator.

What you'll do (about 10 hrs/week)
Showing us your real workflows in Adobe Illustrator: how you build a logo from sketch to final vector, construct complex shapes with the Pen tool, Pathfinder and Shape Builder, set up a brand system with color swatches, type styles and symbols, create an illustration or icon set, prepare a packaging or print layout with dielines, bleeds and spot colors, and export assets for web, print and other Adobe apps - and answering questions along the way: why this step, what's the shortcut, where do people go wrong?

If you use Adobe Illustrator regularly and can talk through your process clearly, you're exactly who we're looking for. No prep needed, just your day-to-day expertise.

Who you are - any of these backgrounds fits
- Graphic / Brand Designer - you produce logos, identity systems, marketing collateral and presentations, and Illustrator is where the real work happens.
- Packaging or Print Production Designer - you build dielines, labels and packaging artwork and prepare files for print: spot colors, overprint, bleed and prepress.
- Illustrator / Icon Designer - you draw in vector: editorial illustration, icon sets, infographics, character work or technical illustration.

Must-have: 5+ years of hands-on, near-daily use of Adobe Illustrator (tell us which other Creative Cloud apps you work in); fluency with the Pen tool and path editing, Pathfinder and Shape Builder, layers and artboards, type and color management, symbols and global swatches, appearance and effects, and export and asset handoff; able to articulate why you do what you do, not just click through it.

Nice-to-have: Photoshop, InDesign or Figma alongside Illustrator; motion or 3D handoff (After Effects, Dimension, Substance); prepress or production experience with a print vendor; a portfolio showing a range of vector styles.

What you'll do (about 10 hrs/week)
Showing us your real workflows in Adobe Acrobat: how you build a fillable form with validation and calculations, combine, reorder and edit a multi-source document, run OCR and clean up a scanned file, redact and Bates-number a production set, remediate a document for accessibility and run the checker, apply security, signatures and certificates, and set up an Action to automate a repeat job - and answering questions along the way: why this step, what's the shortcut, where do people go wrong?

If you use Adobe Acrobat regularly and can talk through your process clearly, you're exactly who we're looking for. No prep needed, just your day-to-day expertise.

Who you are - any of these backgrounds fits
- Document Production / Word Processing Specialist - you turn out finished PDFs all day: combining, editing, bookmarking, stamping, converting and fixing whatever comes in.
- Forms or Accessibility Specialist - you build fillable forms and remediate documents to PDF/UA, Section 508 or WCAG, tags and reading order included.
- Legal, Compliance or Admin Professional - you prepare filings and productions: redaction, Bates numbering, OCR, certification and security on sensitive documents.

Must-have: 5+ years of hands-on, near-daily use of Adobe Acrobat Pro (tell us which version and whether you also use Acrobat Sign); fluency with form creation and field properties, editing and combining, OCR, redaction, accessibility tagging and the Accessibility Checker, security and digital signatures, and Actions / batch processing; able to articulate why you do what you do, not just click through it.

Nice-to-have: Acrobat Sign or Adobe Document Cloud workflows; JavaScript in Acrobat forms; prepress and print production (Preflight, PDF/X); experience with other PDF tools (Foxit, Nitro, Bluebeam) for comparison.

items.description:
We're looking into the e-signature and agreement space and want to understand in detail how teams actually build, send, track and administer agreements in DocuSign.

What you'll do (about 10 hrs/week)
Showing us your real workflows in DocuSign: how you build a reusable template with fields, roles and signing order, prepare and send an envelope with conditional fields and custom branding, set up a PowerForm or a bulk send, handle corrections, voids and resends, track envelopes through to completion and the audit trail, and administer users, groups and account settings - and answering questions along the way: why this step, what's the shortcut, where do people go wrong?

- Contracts / Legal Operations Specialist - you run agreements through DocuSign for a living: NDAs, MSAs, SOWs and amendments, routing for signature, tracking status and filing executed copies.
- Sales Ops, HR or Finance Operations - you send high volumes of envelopes from a connected system (Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite, Greenhouse) and keep the process moving.

Must-have: 5+ years of hands-on, near-daily use of DocuSign eSignature (tell us whether you're an account admin or a sender); fluency with templates and fields, recipient roles and routing order, conditional logic, PowerForms or bulk send, envelope tracking and reporting, and account administration; able to articulate why you do what you do, not just click through it.

Nice-to-have: DocuSign CLM or IAM experience; integrations with Salesforce, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace or an HRIS; a migration from another e-signature tool (Adobe Sign, PandaDoc, Dropbox Sign); a DocuSign certification.

items.title: Tableau (Part-Time) - BI Developer, Data Analyst, or Analytics Manager
items.description:
We're looking into the business intelligence and analytics space and want to understand in detail how analysts and BI teams actually build, govern and deliver dashboards in Tableau.

What you'll do (about 10 hrs/week)
Showing us your real workflows in Tableau: how you connect to and model a data source (joins, relationships, extracts vs live), build a dashboard from a blank canvas through to a polished interactive layout, write and debug calculated fields, LOD expressions and table calculations, tune a slow workbook, and publish, schedule and permission content on Tableau Server or Cloud - and answering questions along the way: why this step, what's the shortcut, where do people go wrong?

- BI Developer / Tableau Developer - you build and maintain the dashboards a business runs on: data modeling, calculations, performance tuning and publishing to Server or Cloud.

- Tableau Administrator / Analytics Engineer - you own the platform side: sites and projects, permissions and row-level security, extract refresh schedules, published data sources and governance.

Must-have: 5+ years of hands-on, near-daily use of Tableau Desktop (tell us whether you also work in Tableau Server, Cloud or Prep); fluency with data source modeling, calculated fields, LOD expressions and table calculations, parameters and actions, dashboard design and performance optimization; able to articulate why you do what you do, not just click through it.

items.title: Lifestyle Image Generation for Furniture
items.description:
Lifestyle Image Creator Needed: Bedroom Scenes for Furniture (Beds)

We're a UK furniture brand looking for a skilled creator to produce realistic lifestyle images of our beds. We supply high-quality cutout images of each bed. You place them into believable, well-styled room scenes. This is ongoing work for a growing catalogue, so reliable, consistent people will get repeat orders.

What we supply

Cutout (transparent PNG) images of each bed, in one or more angles
Product dimensions, colour/finish names, and any notes on what makes the product special (e.g. storage, ottoman lift, headboard style)
A short brief for each batch (target room style and audience)

What you deliver, per bed

[4-6] lifestyle images, each in a different room setting or angle
At least one wide room shot, one closer/detail-focused shot, and one styled hero shot
Final files at a minimum of 2000 x 2000 px (square) and, where requested, 16:9 and 4:5 crops
JPG or PNG, RGB, sharp, no compression artefacts
Optional: transparent or clean background alternates if requested

Non-negotiables (images will be rejected if they fail these)

The product must not be altered. Shape, proportions, colour, fabric/finish, stitching, legs, headboard and any storage feature must match the cutout exactly. No redesigning, smoothing or "improving" the bed.
Realistic scale. The bed must be the correct size relative to the room, doors, windows and other furniture. We will check against the dimensions we send.
Realistic lighting and shadows. The bed must have a believable contact shadow and ambient shadows that match the room's light direction and softness. No floating, no pasted-on look, no visible cutout edges or halos.
Correct perspective. The camera angle and floor plane of the room must match the angle of the bed cutout.
Accurate colour. Product colour must be true to the original under the room lighting. Tell us if a scene would shift it noticeably.
No AI artefacts. No warped bedding, melted objects, distorted hands/faces, garbled text, extra limbs, or odd patterns. Check every image closely before sending.
No branding or text from other companies, no watermarks, and no recognisable people or copyrighted artwork in the scene.

Style and content guidelines

Bright, clean, aspirational but believable homes, suitable for UK customers (UK-style rooms, sockets, radiators, proportions)
Styling should support the bed, not compete with it: neutral or soft palettes, tasteful bedding, a few props (lamp, rug, plant, bedside table)
Bed must be the clear focal point in every image
Children's/kids' rooms (where briefed): age-appropriate, safe-looking, uncluttered, no hazards such as loose cords or dangerous objects near the bed

items.title: Short-Form Social Lead & Editor for Horror Series Launch
items.description:
ABOUT DRAMABYTE
DramaByte is hiring a hands-on Short-Form Social Lead / Video Editor to execute the launch campaign for Cursed, an original vertical supernatural drama series.

This is not a strategy-only role and it is not a generic “post when you can” social-media role. We need someone who can take approved footage and a defined campaign plan, turn it into polished, high-retention short-form edits, and publish them correctly across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X.

Cursed lives at the intersection of supernatural horror, occult/ritual mystery, dark comedy, friendship drama, money/aspiration, character drama, and fan theory. Your job is to turn those lanes into daily audience conversation while protecting spoilers, rights, and brand safety.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN
• Edit approved Cursed footage into strong 9:16 videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
• Build sharp first-three-second hooks, clean pacing, meaningful captions/subtitles, cover frames, end cards, and platform-native versions.
• Create cutdowns and variants from the same approved source so every platform feels native—not lazily duplicated.
• Human-QC every export for correct dialogue, subtitle accuracy, spoiler risk, safe-area placement, sound, and final frame.
• Schedule or publish approved posts at the required time on TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, and X.
• Add approved platform-specific captions, titles, descriptions, hashtags, covers, pinned comments, Story prompts, and X conversation starters.
• Help execute approved fan-culture formats: #CursedJar symbolic-object prompts, money-wish / Endless Riches reaction content, friendship/roommate debate prompts, dark-comedy hooks, mystery/theory conversation, and cleared cast/BTS/fan moments.
• Assist with lightweight, brand-safe comment moderation and approved replies after posts go live.
• Send a concise daily status update and a weekly readout with links, performance signals, learnings, and next-week edit/publishing recommendations.

FIRST-MONTH DELIVERABLES
• Execute a 21-day countdown plus premiere/launch-day content cadence.
• Maintain an organized asset tracker with source, version, platform, status, caption, owner, and posted URL.
• Produce approved daily vertical assets and platform adaptations from the campaign plan.
• Publish or schedule approved posts across all four channels.
• Keep a reliable folder structure for masters, exports, covers, captions, and post copy.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
• Proven editing and publishing work for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts—preferably entertainment, film/TV, fandom, music, or creator-led brands.
• Strong retention editing: hooks, story compression, rhythm, captions, sound design, cover selection, and export QA.
• Advanced working knowledge of CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent professional tools.
• Native publishing workflow experience: metadata, covers, captions, hashtags, Stories, pinned comments, and basic analytics.
• Excellent taste. You know the difference between a polished campaign asset and a generic auto-captioned clip.
• Organized, responsive, and comfortable working from an approval workflow. You cannot publish unapproved footage, claims, spoilers, music, or cast material.

NICE TO HAVE
• Horror, genre entertainment, vertical drama, BookTok, HorrorTok, WitchTok, or fandom-community experience.
• Motion graphics, thumbnail/cover design, and simple social graphics.
• Creator outreach and UGC-brief experience.
• X community-programming experience alongside video-first social channels.

IMPORTANT BOUNDARIES
Cursed is fictional entertainment. Community prompts must never be presented as real-world spiritual instruction, manifestation promises, or unsafe challenges. We will not accept generic AI captions pasted over raw footage, identical uploads everywhere with no platform adaptation, unapproved music/graphics/templates, spoilers, or applicants who are strategy-only and do not personally edit and publish.

WHAT WE PROVIDE
A defined 21-day campaign plan and approved copy bank; current footage, source timestamps, story/category guidance, spoiler and content-class rules; existing campaign formats; and a small internal team for approvals.

TO APPLY
Please include:
1. Two to three relevant examples of vertical video you personally edited and published.
2. A brief note explaining how you would adapt one 12-second horror-drama clip across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X without simply uploading the identical file everywhere.
3. Which editing tools you use and your weekly availability for the next four weeks.
4. Your proposed hourly rate.
5. A one-paragraph answer: What makes a short-form entertainment clip feel premium rather than generic?

We will prioritize clear proof of taste, fast but careful execution, and a strong instinct for building a real audience around a story—not merely accumulating views.

items.title: B2B sales leader (growth)
items.description:
B2B Sales | AI Startup | High Commission + Equity
Who We Are

We’re a US-based AI startup helping marketing teams actually adopt and get value from AI.

We’re building Cofilm.ai, an AI platform focused on three things:

AI Memory: helping companies retain and reuse institutional knowledge
AI Visibility: helping brands understand how they show up in AI-powered search and conversations
AI Ads: helping companies build and run advertising in the new AI-driven landscape

Check us out: cofilm.ai

We’re early, ambitious, and moving fast. We’re looking for someone who wants to build with us, not just take another sales job.

Who You Are

You’re highly motivated, competitive, and genuinely hungry to make money.

You know how to create opportunities from scratch. You’re comfortable picking up the phone, sending cold outreach, running a real discovery call, giving a strong demo, and asking for the deal.

We care much more about what you can do than where you’re from. The one requirement is that you have native-level US English and can communicate naturally with US customers.

You should have:

6+ years of B2B sales experience
A proven ability to generate pipeline through cold calling and outbound
Strong discovery and qualification skills
The ability to run compelling product demos
The confidence and skill to close deals
Excellent communication and follow-through
A strong sense of ownership and urgency
A serious desire to make money and grow with the company
What We Offer

This is a performance-driven role with meaningful upside.

40% commission on every deal you close
Equity based on performance
Strong base salary
Direct access to the founders
The opportunity to join early and have a real impact on the company

If you’re someone who can consistently create pipeline and close business, you can make a lot of money here.

How to Apply

Don’t send us a long cover letter.

Send us a 60-second Loom video introducing yourself and answering two questions:

1. Who are you?
2. Why do you think you’re the right person for this role?

We want to see how you communicate, how you think, and how you sell.

If you’re hungry, confident, and ready to build something big, we want to hear from you.

items.title: Facebook Ad Uploader — 8-Figure DTC Brand
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced Facebook ad uploader to handle the daily uploading, launching, and management of ad creatives inside Facebook Ads Manager for a high-volume DTC brand spending six figures per day on Meta.

This is not a media buying role. You are not deciding strategy, setting budgets, or optimizing campaigns. You are the person who takes the creatives, copy, and campaign specs from the media buying team and gets them live — accurately, quickly, and at volume.

At our scale, upload speed, accuracy, and reliability are everything. One wrong UTM, one mismatched creative, one campaign launched with the wrong settings costs real money. We need someone who has done this before at a brand spending serious budget and understands that precision matters as much as pace.

Responsibilities:

Ad Uploading & Launching
- Upload and launch Facebook and Instagram ad creatives daily based on specs and briefs from the media buying team.
- Set up campaigns, ad sets, and ads accurately — correct objectives, targeting, placements, budgets, bid strategies, and naming conventions every time.
- Upload creatives in bulk using Facebook's bulk upload tools, bulk sheets, or third-party uploaders to maintain speed at high volume.
- Match the correct creative assets (images, videos, GIFs) to the correct copy (primary text, headlines, descriptions) and the correct landing page URLs with correct UTM parameters — zero mismatches.
- Launch test variations at volume — multiple hooks, multiple creatives, multiple copy variations — organized cleanly inside the ad account.

Naming Conventions & Organization
- Follow strict naming conventions for campaigns, ad sets, and ads so the media buying team and reporting tools can read performance cleanly.
- Maintain an organized, consistent ad account structure that the media buyer can navigate without confusion.
- Tag and label creatives, angles, hooks, and funnels correctly so performance can be attributed and analyzed accurately.

Project Management & Communication
- Work from a shared Notion board (or equivalent project management tool) where the creative team stages assets and copy for upload.
- Track upload status — what's been uploaded, what's pending, what's live — and keep the board updated so nothing falls through the cracks.
- Communicate clearly with the media buyer and creative team on upload timelines, blockers, and any issues with assets or specs.
- Flag problems before they go live — wrong aspect ratios, missing copy, broken URLs, policy-risk creatives — rather than uploading blindly and letting the media buyer discover the issue.

Account & Profile Management
- Use your own Facebook profile with a clean history and ad account access.
- Manage your profile and Business Manager access responsibly — no policy violations, no account flags caused by careless behavior.
- Understand how to maintain account health at scale — you know what triggers restrictions and how to avoid them.

QA & Accuracy
- QA every ad before it goes live — preview the ad on mobile and desktop, verify the landing page URL loads correctly, confirm UTMs are firing, check that the creative matches the copy.
- Double-check targeting, placement, and budget settings against the brief before launching.
- Catch and fix errors before they cost money — not after.


Must-Have Experience
- Direct experience uploading ads for a brand spending at minimum seven figures annually on Facebook, ideally eight figures. You need to have operated at real scale — not a small account with 5 ads a week.
- Experience using Facebook bulk upload tools, bulk sheets, or third-party bulk uploaders to launch ads at volume.
- Your own Facebook profile with a clean history, active Business Manager access, and no outstanding policy strikes or restrictions.
- Experience with strict naming conventions and organized ad account structures at scale.
- Experience using Notion or a comparable project management tool to track creative pipelines and upload workflows.
- Extremely high attention to detail — UTMs, URLs, creative-copy matching, targeting, and budget settings must be right every time.
Ability to work fast without sacrificing accuracy. Speed and precision are equally important.

Nice to Have
- Experience with proxied Facebook profiles as backup profiles in case of account issues. If you've managed backup profiles before and understand how to set them up and maintain them safely, that's a significant plus.
- Experience uploading for DTC supplement, health, or wellness brands — familiarity with the ad policy landscape for health-adjacent products.
- Experience with direct response ad formats — advertorial click-throughs, VSL campaigns, lead gen, and multi-step funnel structures.
- Familiarity with Triple Whale, Hyros, or other attribution tools and how UTM structures feed into them.
- Experience with TikTok or Google Ads uploading in addition to Facebook.


What Success Looks Like
- Ads go live on time, every time — the media buyer never waits on uploads.
- Zero upload errors — correct creatives, correct copy, correct URLs, correct UTMs, correct settings. Every time.
- The ad account is clean and organized — anyone on the team can navigate it and understand the structure.
- The Notion board is always current — the creative team and media buyer know exactly what's been uploaded, what's pending, and what's live.
- You flag problems before they go live, not after. Broken links, wrong assets, policy-risk creatives — you catch them.
- Account health stays clean — no preventable restrictions or policy strikes caused by upload-side mistakes.

Who This Is Not For
- If you have only managed small ad accounts with low volume — the pace and precision required at our spend level will be a significant step up.
- If you do not have your own Facebook profile with clean account access — we cannot onboard you.
- If your attention to detail is "good enough" rather than obsessive — one wrong UTM at our scale can misattribute thousands of dollars of spend.
- If you see this as a stepping stone to become a media buyer — this is an execution role and we need someone who takes pride in doing it perfectly.

How to Apply:
1. Submit details including your desired rate and earliest start date.
2. Answer the required prescreening questions

items.title: 3D sculptor for a print-ready character figure (≈20 cm, multi-part, ASA) + small connector test kit
items.description:
I'm developing a range of humorous seated character figures for outdoor and indoor display. The first is an Irish leprechaun, seated and gripping a steering wheel. Each figure clicks onto a separate small base. I have concept renders and a full engineering sheet set for the base and connector (attached PDF, "Rev B").
 
I need a sculptor who designs for FDM 3D printing, not just for renders.
 
If this goes well, more characters will follow on the same base, so I'm looking for someone to work with for a few more projects.
 
The job — two milestones:
 
1. Connector test kit (small, first). A black base deck (120 × 90 × 16 mm) with two sockets, and a small block with the two matching click pegs (Ø8, 44 mm apart), to the attached Rev B dimensions (sheets 1 and 5). I print this to test the fit before any sculpting. Expect 1 adjustment round after my test print.
2. The Leprechaun figure. About 200 mm tall including the base. One fixed figure (the customer never takes it apart) whose two pegs click into the base. Note: Rev B shows the hat, head, body and seat joined by twist locks. I want to compare three ways of joining those parts instead — see question 3 below. Split into 3–4 colour parts at natural edges (hat / head / body+seat+wheel) so it prints in multi-colour without painting, with hidden seams (2–3 mm overlaps under the hat brim, beard and coat). Max 4 colours per part.
 
Technical requirements:
- Material: ASA on FDM (outdoor, UV, heat). Hollow, 2–2.5 mm walls. Target total weight ≤ 230 g including base.
- Peg/socket clearance 0.3–0.5 mm (to be tuned on the test print). No thin flexing tabs; pegs short and solid.
- Supports only on hidden faces; please orient parts so layer lines are least visible on the face.
- Deliver STL + 3MF per part (3MF with colour regions), plus the source file. Slicer weight per part.
- Adult, witty styling — not a children's toy look. Colours: green, black, white, skin, copper-red hair/beard, gold buckle only on the hat. No blue. No logos or brand marks anywhere.
 
Terms:
- Full commercial IP transfer on payment, worldwide, any manufacturing method (3D printing now, possibly moulding later), including the connector standard.
- NDA before the base/connector files are shared in detail.
- 2 revision rounds on the sculpt.
 
To apply, please send:
1. 2–3 photos of real printed figures you designed (not renders), ideally multi-part or multi-colour.
2. Your fixed price for milestone 1 and milestone 2 separately, and the turnaround for each.
3. For joining the hat, head and body, your price and your recommendation for each of: (a) glued, (b) permanent snap-fit (no glue), (c) snap-fit that can be un-snapped, in printed ASA — which holds best, which is quickest to assemble, and what each adds to the design cost. I'd prefer no glue.
 
Proposals without real print photos won't be considered.

items.title: Interior Glass & Glazing Takeoff Estimator – Architectural Drawings & Specifications
items.description:
Action Glass Inc. is an established glazing contractor in British Columbia, Canada. We are looking for an experienced glass and glazing estimator/takeoff specialist to review architectural drawings, specifications and tender documents and prepare accurate takeoffs for our estimating team.

This position is specifically focused on **interior architectural glass and glazing**. We are not looking for exterior window, curtain wall or building-envelope takeoffs.

This will initially be project-based work, with the potential for ongoing work if we find the right person.

## Scope of Work

You will receive architectural drawing sets, specifications, addenda and other tender documents in PDF format.

You will review the complete package and identify items that fall within our interior glazing scope, including where applicable:

- Interior glass partitions
- Interior aluminum-framed glazing systems
- Interior glass doors
- Aluminum doors and frames associated with our glazing scope
- Sidelites and transoms
- Office fronts and glazed entrance systems
- Tempered glass
- Laminated glass
- Specialty/decorative glass
- Fire-rated glazing
- Back-painted glass
- Mirrors
- Shower glass and enclosures
- Railing glass
- Glass thicknesses and make-ups
- Door and glazing schedules
- Hardware associated with glass doors and glazing systems
- Relevant architectural details, elevations and sections
- Specification requirements affecting our glazing scope

### Exterior Glazing Exclusions

Do **not** include exterior building window systems or building-envelope glazing unless specifically requested by Action Glass.

This includes:

- Exterior wall windows
- Window wall
- Curtain wall
- Exterior punched windows
- Exterior building-envelope glazing systems

The estimator must be able to distinguish these systems from interior glazing shown on the same architectural drawings.

## Required Takeoff Information

For each glazing item, provide as much of the following information as is available:

- Item number
- Description
- Quantity
- Width
- Height
- Glass type
- Glass thickness/make-up
- Framing/system information
- Hardware requirements
- Location/room
- Floor/level
- Drawing/page reference
- Detail reference
- Relevant specification section
- Notes
- Items requiring clarification or RFI

The completed takeoff must be provided in a clean, organized Excel spreadsheet that our estimating team can use directly for pricing.

## Required Experience

We are specifically looking for someone with experience in:

- Glass and glazing estimating
- Division 08 estimating
- Interior architectural glazing
- Reading architectural drawings and specifications
- Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift or comparable takeoff software

General construction estimating experience alone is not sufficient.

## When Applying

Please provide:

1. Your experience specifically with glass and glazing takeoffs.
2. Examples of previous glazing takeoffs, with confidential information removed where necessary.
3. The takeoff software you use.
4. Your experience with Canadian construction drawings and specifications.
5. Your hourly rate and/or typical fixed project price.
6. Your expected turnaround time.
7. Which Division 08 specification sections you normally review.
8. Your experience distinguishing interior glazing from exterior window, curtain wall and window-wall systems.

## Paid Test Project

Selected candidates may be given a small paid test project before larger projects are assigned.

The test will be evaluated primarily on:

- Accuracy
- Completeness
- Understanding of glazing
- Ability to identify our scope
- Ability to identify exclusions
- Organization of the completed takeoff
- Ability to identify discrepancies or missing information in the drawings

Accuracy and completeness are more important to us than simply providing the lowest price.

We are looking to develop an ongoing relationship with the right estimator as our tendering volume grows.

items.title: Local patient marketing specialist for Brickell MIami for a Chiropractic office
items.description:
I own a private-pay chiropractic and holistic health practice in Brickell, Miami. I am looking for an experienced digital marketer who can help generate more LOCAL new patients, not simply increase followers or post generic social media content.
I am particularly interested in Facebook/Instagram marketing, local lead generation, community outreach, and other strategies that can produce qualified patients within approximately 10 miles of Brickell.
I already have an established Google Business Profile, website, strong patient reviews, and Zocdoc. I am looking to diversify beyond Google and develop additional reliable sources of new patients.
Responsibilities may include:
Developing a local patient lead-generation strategy
Facebook and Instagram marketing
Creating/promoting compelling local offers and content
Identifying additional local marketing opportunities

items.title: HVAC & Plumbing Go-to-Market Expert - Demand Validation for an AI Front-Office CSR Product
items.description:
Who we are: 
We are a B2B communication software company. We are evaluating a product expansion into the home services "AI CSR / front office" category, and we are hiring an industry expert to help us validate demand before we commit engineering resources.


The situation:
A new category has formed in home services: the AI front office. Vendors like Avoca.ai, Sameday AI, Rosie, Goodcall, and Nexa — and natively, ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro — sell an AI agent that answers every inbound call, books the job directly into the contractor's field-service software with capacity awareness, covers after-hours and overflow, runs outbound nurture campaigns to the existing customer base, and scores calls for coaching. 

We are evaluating whether to compete in this category.

We have real advantages we can bring to it, and real gaps we would have to close. Before we ask our engineering organization for two to three quarters of work, we need evidence that we can generate enough demand to justify engineering resources needed to build.

What we're hiring for:
We are looking for a home services industry expert — someone who has sold into, consulted for, or operated inside HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, garage door, or pest control businesses — to help us design and run a short, rigorous demand-validation program.

We are not looking for a generic market research report. We have already completed competitive intelligence on this category.

We are looking for someone who can get us in front of real buyers quickly, and who can help us read the resulting signal honestly — including telling us "no."

The question we need answered in 4-6 weeks:
Is there enough qualified demand for a home-services AI front-office offer from a new entrant to justify a two-to-three-quarter engineering investment — and if so, which trade, which offer, and which channel?

Supporting questions:
• Which trade and which segment should we lead with, and why?
• What wedge offer gets a contractor to take a meeting in the first place?
• What would they pay, what are they paying today, and what would they need to see before switching?
• How do we reach these buyers efficiently, and what does a qualified conversation cost us?

*Scope of work:
Phase 1 — Buyer and market map (week 1)
Translate your knowledge of this market into a working map: the segments worth targeting, the buyer personas (owner-operator vs. general manager vs. PE-backed platform ops lead), current spend on call handling and answering services, the displacement triggers, and the channel landscape. Validate or correct the ICP we have already drafted. Deliverable: a target list of 200–500 named accounts with contact paths, plus a one-page channel plan.

Phase 2 — Offer and message design (week 2)
Working with our team, define the wedge offer, the positioning, and the qualifying questions. Deliverable: one landing page's worth of copy, one outbound sequence, and a qualification framework.

Phase 3 — Demand test (weeks 2–5)
Run the test. This can combine outbound, paid media to a landing page, email, your own warm network, and — where you have them — direct introductions. We will supply the demand-generation machinery and the budget; we need you for targeting, credibility, and buyer access. Deliverable: qualified conversations on the calendar, plus a weekly read on what's landing and what isn't.

Phase 4 — Signal synthesis and recommendation (week 4-6)
Score the evidence against pre-agreed thresholds and give us a clear go / no-go / pivot recommendation with the reasoning and the raw evidence behind it. Deliverable: a written recommendation and a 60-minute working session with our leadership team.

* we are open to a revised scope of work if you have suggestions/recommendations on more effective ways to accomplish the objective


What we will bring:
• Demand-generation infrastructure and a paid media budget — we can run outbound, email and landing-page tests at volume
• Product and engineering time to answer feasibility questions


Who we're looking for:

Required:
• Direct, verifiable experience in the US home services trades — you have sold to, consulted for, worked inside, or operated an HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, garage door, or pest control business. Tell us which and when.
• Working knowledge of the field-service software ecosystem: ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, FieldEdge, Jobber — how contractors actually buy, implement, and use them.
• Buyer access. This is the single most important requirement. You can get qualified contractors on the phone or into a meeting within two weeks, and you can show us how.
• Experience designing or running go-to-market validation, pilot programmes, or early-customer acquisition for a B2B product sold into the trades.
• Comfort working with ambiguity and delivering a recommendation that might be "don't build this."

Strongly preferred:
• Prior experience at a company selling into the trades: ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, Podium, Sameday, Nexa, Avoca, a trade buying group, a distributor, or a PE-backed multi-location platform.
• Relationships inside the trade channel: Nexstar Network, EGIA, Service Nation, PHCC, ACCA, the ServiceTitan partner ecosystem, distributor networks, or the major contractor communities and Facebook groups.

items.title: Strategy
items.description:
Job Title: Competitor Ad Analysis — Meta & LinkedIn for Canadian Business Schools

We are looking for an experienced digital marketing researcher to compare advertising across four Canadian business schools:

Rotman School of Management — University of Toronto

Ivey Business School — Western University

Smith School of Business — Queen’s University

International Business University (IBU)

Project Goal

Understand how these schools attract prospective MBA and graduate business students through Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and LinkedIn, and identify practical opportunities to improve Smith’s advertising and lead generation.

What to Research

Review active ads and publicly available ads from the past three months. Compare:

Programs and events: Which programs, information sessions, and recruitment events are promoted?

Messaging: How do schools communicate career advancement, reputation, flexibility, networking, and return on investment?

Creative: What images, videos, alumni stories, testimonials, and headlines do they use?

Audience: Who does the messaging appear to address? Clearly label inferred audiences; do not claim access to actual targeting settings.

Calls to action: Do ads encourage prospects to book a consultation, register for an event, download a brochure, or apply?

Lead journey: Review landing pages and publicly accessible forms for clarity, ease of use, and qualification questions.

Platform differences: How does each school’s approach differ between Meta and LinkedIn?

Opportunities for Smith: Where could Smith improve its messaging, creative, or inquiry process?

Deliverables

Excel or Google Sheets comparison: Include school, platform, program, ad copy, creative format, CTA, destination link, date observed, and research notes.

Ad examples: Screenshots and source links, aiming for at least five distinct ads per school across both platforms where available.

Short presentation: Summarize the main findings, each school’s approach, and opportunities for Smith.

Five prioritized recommendations: Explain the evidence and reasoning behind each.

Three proposed ad tests for Smith: Include sample headline, message, creative concept, intended audience, CTA, and success metric.

Performance Measurement

Recommend a framework for measuring Smith’s own campaigns using:

Cost per qualified lead.

Cost per attended recruitment consultation.

Cost per completed application.

Cost per enrolled student.

Lead-to-enrolment conversion rate.

Define a qualified lead and explain what tracking is needed to connect ads to recruitment outcomes.

Research Requirements

Use public ad libraries and school websites. Identify unavailable information and distinguish facts from assumptions.

We understand that competitor advertising costs, conversion rates, applications, and enrolments may not be publicly available. Do not invent these results or rank ads by profitability without supporting data. Engagement and ad duration alone should not be treated as proof of success.

Do not submit inquiry forms or contact the schools.

Ideal Freelancer

Experience with Meta and LinkedIn advertising, competitor analysis, and actionable reporting. Higher education marketing experience is preferred.

To Apply

Please provide:

A relevant research or advertising audit sample.

Your proposed approach and any expected data limitations.

A fixed-price quote and estimated completion time.

Overview:
We are launching a premium B2C single-product store on Shopify (1 product, 4 colorways). We are looking for an experienced developer who doesn't just write code, but takes lead on design implementation, UX layout, and store performance to build a clean, high-converting experience.

Core Deliverables:
1. Live Personalization Preview (Critical):
* Real-time customizer allowing customers to select a colorway, type custom text/initials, and preview it live on the product case before adding to cart.

* A "Will my glasses fit?" module guiding customers through measuring frame width, lens height, and temple length against the product dimensions.

3. High-Performance Brand Design:
* Custom Shopify landing pages built from provided brand assets (style guide, fonts, color palettes, product copy, and 3D renderings).

---

"Share a live link to a Shopify product page where you built a custom text/color preview module, and tell us what you built custom vs. what an off-the-shelf app handled."

Applications without a live, working link answering this question will not be considered.

items.title: Architect & Structural Engineer Engagement for drawings
items.description:
SCOPE OF WORK
Architect & Structural Engineer Engagement

Fairfax County Building Permit: 15′×30′ Screened Porch Addition

1. Scope of Work
Review and verify attached preliminary structural notes against VRC 2021 and Fairfax County Typical Deck Details requirements
Confirm or correct footing sizing
Provide structural calculations for:
Footing design
LVL front beam
Ledger connection
Post sizing verification
Lateral support adequacy

The requirements is to create new drawing and any update to the drawing based on feedback from County Reviewer

2. Project Background
Converting an existing attached 12′×25′ wood deck into a 15′×30′ screened porch addition at the rear of the residence. The scope extends the existing deck 5′ to the east and 3′ in depth, adding a gable roof, screen wall enclosure on three sides, a door, and a new electrical circuit.

A preliminary permit package (Generated use AI claude) was prepared by me and submitted for approval. The county plan reviewer has issued two comments requiring corrections before approval. I'm attaching details for your review, include location plat plan. Please feel free to use these as the design basis.

3. County Reviewer Comments to Address

Comment 1 --- Location Plat
"The house location plat must reflect the proposed structure (screened porch) to scale in the proposed location."

Based on the comments, the new drawing (Location Plat) will showing the lot boundary, existing house footprint, and proposed 15′×30′ porch with setback dimensions (Wooden Deck). The architect is to review this, verify dimensions against the recorded plat, and produce a compliant location plan at an appropriate scale.

Comment 2 --- Missing Plan Requirements

"Submitted plans are missing some of the building plan minimum submission requirements. Please add the following: Plan scale (min 1/4"=1′-0")."

Reference: 
https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/landdevelopment/building-plan-minimum-submission-requirements
https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/landdevelopment/sites/landdevelopment/files/assets/documents/pdf/publications/deck-details.pdf

items.title: Full-Time Content Editor & Publishing Specialist
items.description:
We are a growing educational media company producing podcasts, keynote speeches, interviews, educational videos, and social media content. We are looking for an exceptional Content Editor who wants to become a long-term member of our team.

This is not a freelance project. We are looking for someone who wants to build systems, improve processes, and grow with our company for years.


**Flat Monthly Salary:** ** $800 USD per month**

This is a long-term, full-time remote position (approximately 40 hours per week).

Performance bonuses and pay increases will be available based on quality, reliability, and long-term contribution.

## Responsibilities

You will be responsible for taking content from raw footage to published content.

Your responsibilities include:

* Edit long-form YouTube videos
* Create YouTube Shorts
* Create Instagram Reels
* Create TikTok videos
* Create Facebook clips
* Add captions
* Add motion graphics
* Audio cleanup
* Color correction
* Select B-roll
* Create engaging hooks
* Improve pacing and audience retention
* Create thumbnails (preferred)
* Upload finished content to YouTube and other social media platforms
* Schedule content according to our publishing calendar
* Maintain organized project folders
* Track production status
* Meet weekly publishing deadlines
* Suggest ideas to improve our content and workflow

## Weekly Production Expectations

Our content calendar is built around consistent publishing.

The successful candidate will be expected to consistently produce and publish approximately:

* **2 professionally edited long-form YouTube videos each week**

* **15–20 high-quality short-form videos each week** (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook Reels)

* **Upload and schedule all completed content** according to our publishing calendar

* Ensure all videos include:

 * Professional captions
 * Correct titles
 * Descriptions
 * Hashtags
 * Thumbnails
 * End screens (when applicable)

Quality is more important than speed, but consistency is essential.

## Ideal Candidate

You are:

* Highly organized
* Detail-oriented
* Creative
* Reliable
* Proactive
* Able to work independently
* Excellent at English communication
* Interested in building a long-term career

You should enjoy improving systems—not simply waiting for instructions.

## Required Skills

Experience with one or more:

* Adobe Premiere Pro
* DaVinci Resolve
* Final Cut Pro

Preferred:

* Adobe After Effects
* Photoshop
* Canva

## Experience

Experience editing:

* Podcasts
* Educational videos
* Business content
* Personal brands
* Public speakers
* YouTube creators

is required

## To Apply

Please answer all of the following:

1. Tell us about yourself. (Please do not use AI. We want to hear your own voice.)

2. How many years have you been editing professionally?

3. Please provide links to:

 * Two long-form videos you edited
 * Five short-form videos you edited

4. Walk us through your editing workflow from receiving raw footage to publishing the finished content.

5. What do you believe is the most important factor in keeping viewers engaged on YouTube?

6. Have you uploaded and managed YouTube channels before? If so, describe your experience.

7. What editing software do you primarily use?

8. What are your normal working hours and time zone?

9. When are you available to start?

10. At the very beginning of your proposal, type:

 **CONTENT IS KING**

Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

items.title: Social Media Content Strategist for Photography Business (Scripts + Trend Research)
items.description:
Job Description

About the business:
Sweetums Photos is a photography business based in San Antonio, TX, specializing in weddings, engagements, senior portraits, and family sessions. We're bilingual (English/Spanish) and personality-forward, our brand is built on authenticity, candid moments, and a warm, fun voice, not stiff or corporate.

What we need:
I shoot and film all content myself, that stays with me. What I need is someone to handle the research and planning side so I can spend my time behind the camera instead of staring at a blank page trying to figure out what to post.

This role will:

Research current social media trends, formats, and what's working in our industry (and adjacent ones)
Translate trends into actual shootable scripts, not just vague ideas. Scripts should include shot-by-shot beats, timing, and hook direction I can film directly
Write captions and hashtag sets aligned with our brand voice
Build and maintain a content calendar
Work from a shared brand reference document (hook framework, content pillars, tone guide) to keep output consistent with our voice rather than generic

Not required for this role (for now): full account management, scheduling/posting, or community engagement, we may revisit this later, but the initial scope is strategy, research, and scripting.

Skills & Qualifications

Required:

Proven experience in social media content strategy (Instagram specifically), portfolio or past examples required
Strong understanding of current Instagram trends, formats, and the algorithm (Reels, carousels, Stories)
Excellent scriptwriting ability, comfortable breaking a concept into a literal, shootable shot list, not just a loose idea
Strong copywriting/caption-writing skills
Ability to work from and stay consistent with a provided brand voice/style guide

Preferred (nice to have, not required):

Experience with service-based or local businesses (photography, events, beauty, wellness)
Familiarity with hook/persuasion frameworks (e.g., Cialdini's principles) or content pillar structures
Spanish-language content experience
Experience with Meta Ads / paid social strategy

Working style we're looking for:

Someone detail-oriented who asks clarifying questions upfront rather than guessing
Comfortable with a collaborative, iterative process, we'll likely go through a few rounds of revisions per script/concept as we build a rhythm together
Reliable, consistent delivery on a set cadence (weekly or biweekly)

To apply, please include:

2-3 examples of past content strategy or scripts you've written
Your typical process for researching trends and turning them into content
Your availability/capacity (hours per week or deliverables per month)

items.title: Direct Response Scriptwriter for Short Form Video Ads
items.description:
I'm looking for a scriptwriter who understands buyer psychology and can write short, tight video ad scripts that get people to act and MOST IMPORTANT, it must sound human and NOT sound like AI slop. We all use AI and know what it looks like at this point. I don't care about views or likes. I want scripts that get calls booked and sales made.

What you'll do

Write 30 to 90 second video ad scripts: hook, body, CTA

Write multiple hooks for each script so we can test what stops the scroll

Turn raw notes, interviews and offers into angles that hit a real pain or desire

Rewrite scripts based on ad data when something isn't working

What you need to bring

A real grasp of persuasion: you know why people buy, what makes them hesitate and how to move them past it

Concise writing. Every line earns its place, and nothing is filler.

Experience writing ads that ran on Meta or TikTok or with paid spend behind them

Proof that your scripts made money, not just samples
Reliability. 

You hit deadlines and communicate when something's off.

Include in your application

What you've done: links to 2 or 3 ads you scripted that ran

Who you've worked with: the businesses or industries behind them

Proof of results: cost per lead, ROAS, sales, hook rate, Ads Manager screenshots, or a client who will vouch for you. Blur what you need to, but show real numbers.

How you've fixed a script: tell me about an ad that wasn't working. What did you notice, what did you change, and what happened?

Your approach: the psychology you lean on most when writing a hook, and why

How this works
It starts with a paid test: one brief, 5 hooks and 1 full script. If the work is strong and you're reliable, I'll keep you busy with ongoing work.

Start your application with the word "hook" so I know you read this and let's schedule an interview
