items.title: Sharp Generalist Analyst: Research, Data & Business Projects
items.description:
**The work**

I run a finance and data company out of Rotterdam. I work with founders and CFOs, and I'm also building B2B software products. I need someone sharp to take work off my plate across all of it.

The work varies week to week. Some examples:

- Research a market, a competitor or a target company and come back with a short, useful summary
- Map what similar firms offer, how they package it and what they charge
- Take a messy spreadsheet and turn it into something clean and usable
- Pull together numbers and materials for proposals and client work
- Build prospect lists and help with outreach
- Turn something I've done once into a repeatable template
- Build a simple tracker or dashboard for something I'm doing manually
- Prepare materials before a call: agenda, background, key questions

You won't get detailed instructions every time. I'll tell you what I need and roughly why, and you'll come back with a first draft plus the questions you hit along the way.

**Who I'm looking for**

Someone early in their career with a track record of performing against a real standard: a strong degree from a competitive program, scholarships, olympiads, competitions, a demanding first job. I care more about raw thinking and hunger than years of experience.

- You figure things out. When you don't know something, you find out before asking
- You restate the ask before you start, so we catch misunderstandings early
- Comfortable with numbers, even if finance isn't your background
- Strong Excel or Sheets, and willing to learn tools as needed
- Commercially minded. You're interested in how businesses make money, not just in the analysis
- You use AI tools well, as a thinking aid rather than a shortcut
- You write clearly and concisely in English
- Reliable. Deadlines happen without me chasing you
- Some overlap with Central European hours

Background matters less than how you think. Finance, consulting, research, engineering, economics, law: all fine if the thinking is there.

**How this works**

I'm going to trial several people on paid tasks and keep the ones who are clearly strong. If that's you, the hours grow, the rate goes up, and the work gets more interesting. I'd rather work with a few exceptional people than a lot of average ones.

**Engagement**

Starting at around 10 to 15 hours per week, flexible, ongoing. We start with a paid trial task.

**How to apply**

Applications without a Loom video won't be considered. Keep it under 3 minutes and cover:

1. A time you were given a vague task with no clear instructions. What did you do?
2. Share your screen and show me something you've built or figured out for someone else. Walk me through it.
3. Which AI tools you actually use in your work, and for what.

Unpolished is fine. I care about how you think, not production quality.

Put the Loom link in the first line of your proposal and start your message with "Figured it out" so I know you read this far. Keep the written part short, three honest sentences beat a formatted proposal.

items.title: Freelance Ads Manager - PPC + Paid Social
items.description:
Freelance Ads Manager — PPC + Paid Social

 Type: Contract, ongoing, volume based on what you can handle
 Location: Remote

About the role
We're a growing media and marketing agency looking for an expert to manage specific Pay Per Click and Meta ad campaigns for our clients. We run paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, and other paid social platforms, and we need someone who can own the day-to-day on them.

This is not a full-time role. Volume is based on what you can realistically handle well, and we figure that out together during the interview. The ceiling grows as the roster grows.

In one sentence: you keep campaigns running clean, give our account managers the updates they need, flag what needs attention from our media or creative team, and work inside the system we're building to manage it all.

What you'll be doing
Managing active PPC and paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts. That includes:

Campaign setup, structure, and ongoing optimization
Budget pacing and spend management
Audience and targeting work
Keyword and bid management on PPC
Reading performance, catching issues early, and acting on them
Weekly updates to the right account manager on each account, in a format we'll agree on
Flagging when creative is stale, when a landing page is hurting conversion, or when a campaign needs a strategy shift, so the right person on our team can get involved
Being both proactive (spotting issues before we ask) and reactive (handling what we send you quickly)

The system we're building
We're building our own internal management platform where this work will eventually live. It's a custom system that gives us visibility into campaign status, performance, and what needs attention across every client.
While we build it, this role runs out of our current tools. Once the platform is ready, you'll work inside it and your input will help shape how the ads side of it actually runs. You don't need to be a product person. You just need to be able to explain how your work actually gets done, clearly.

What we're looking for
Expert-level with PPC and paid social, specifically Google Ads and Meta. Comfortable managing multiple client accounts without dropping balls.
Follows instructions. We have ways we want things done. If we ask for a specific format, cadence, or approach, we need that followed.
Consistent. Same quality every week, every account, every update. Clients notice when the work gets sloppy, and so do we.
Communicative. Fast replies, clear updates, no going dark. If something's off, you tell us. If we miss something, you flag it.
English strong enough for client-adjacent reporting. You won't be on calls with clients, but your reports and updates get read by our account managers and sometimes forwarded to clients, so the writing needs to be clean.

How to apply
Send us a short note covering:

Platforms you specialize in, and roughly how many client accounts you've managed at once
A few examples of campaigns you've run, what the goal was, and what the result was
A sample of a report you typically send to a client or account manager, even if it's just a Google Ads export or a simple weekly summary
Your general availability and the kind of weekly volume you can take on

items.title: eBay Dropshipping VA – Full Store Management & Profit Reporting
items.description:
eBay Dropshipping VA – Full Store Management & Profit Reporting

I’m looking for an experienced eBay Dropshipping Virtual Assistant for a long-term partnership.

My eBay account and Payoneer are already set up and ready. I’m not looking for account setup or basic training. I need someone who can professionally manage the day-to-day operation of the store and help grow it over time.

Responsibilities

- Profitable product research
- Finding reliable suppliers
- Listing and optimizing approximately 3–5 products per day
- Pricing and profit-margin management
- Stock and price monitoring
- Order processing and tracking
- Customer service
- Returns, refunds, and cancellations
- Monitoring overall store/account performance
- Weekly and monthly profit reporting

Profit Reports Are Very Important

I need accurate reports showing:

- Total sales/revenue
- Product/supplier costs
- eBay fees
- Advertising costs
- Returns/refunds
- Software and other operating expenses
- Real NET PROFIT after all expenses

I’m not interested in seeing only high sales numbers. I want to know exactly how much the store is actually making.

eBay Policy Compliance

I want to build this business for the long term, so the sourcing/dropshipping method must comply with eBay’s current policies.

I am not looking for a strategy mainly based on purchasing from Amazon or Walmart after receiving an eBay order.

Please explain which suppliers and sourcing strategy you would use.

When Applying, Please Answer:

1. How many years of eBay dropshipping experience do you have?
2. Which suppliers would you use and why?
3. How do you find profitable products?
4. Which tools do you use (AutoDS, ZIK Analytics, Terapeak, etc.)?
5. Can you manage orders, tracking, customer service, returns, inventory, and listings?
6. How many quality products can you realistically list per day?
7. Can you provide detailed weekly/monthly profit reports?
8. Please provide examples of previous eBay results, with private client information hidden.
9. What would you charge for long-term management?
10. Are you open to a fixed hourly/monthly rate, or a percentage of NET PROFIT after expenses?

Starting Arrangement

I prefer to begin with a short paid trial.

If your work, product selection, communication, and store management are good, I’m interested in continuing long-term and scaling the store together.

Please do not apply if your main strategy is simply Amazon/Walmart retail-to-eBay dropshipping.

Sobre la tarifa por hora o presupuesto $$$ dime como trabajas (por hora, comisión o ambas) y arreglamos. No puse una tarifa fija en el post porque no hay fija, prefiero saber cuánto cobras según el trabajo que puedas lograr.

Enviarles un primer mensaje según una plantilla que yo te entrego, personalizando lo básico

Mantener organizada una lista/hoja con los contactos y su estado.

Español nativo, redacción clara y natural.
Experiencia en prospección, ventas, atención al cliente o generación de leads.
Organizado/a y constante.
No necesitás cerrar ventas — sino conseguir interesados

Detalles:

items.title: Quiz Video Editor
items.description:
Experienced YouTube Quiz Video Editor Needed – $25 Per Video

I’m looking for an experienced YouTube quiz video editor for ongoing work on my YouTube channel.

You MUST have previous experience creating and editing quiz/trivia-style YouTube videos. Please do not apply if you have never worked on this type of content before.

Pay & Video Length

* $25 USD per completed video, including thumbnail
* Videos will be approximately 8 minutes long
* Ongoing work available for the right editor

Your Responsibilities

You will be responsible for creating the complete quiz video from start to finish, including:

* Researching and creating the quiz questions and answers
* Making sure all questions and answers are accurate
* Editing the complete 8-minute video
* Creating engaging question and answer screens
* Adding countdown timers and answer reveals
* Sourcing suitable images and/or short video clips
* Adding background music and sound effects
* Adding animations and transitions
* Keeping the video fast-paced and engaging
* Using copyright-safe assets
* Checking spelling, grammar and accuracy
* Creating an eye-catching YouTube thumbnail for each video

I will provide the quiz topic/theme and any specific instructions, but you will be responsible for the questions, research, editing and final thumbnail.

Requirements

* Previous experience with YouTube quiz/trivia videos is REQUIRED
* Must provide examples of quiz videos you have personally created or edited
* Experience creating YouTube thumbnails
* Good understanding of pacing and viewer retention
* Strong research skills and attention to detail
* Ability to follow the existing style of my channel
* Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times

To Apply

Please include:

1. Links to quiz/trivia videos you have personally created or edited
2. Examples of YouTube thumbnails you have created
3. Your typical turnaround time for an approximately 8-minute video + thumbnail
4. Confirmation that you agree to the $25 USD fixed rate per completed video, including thumbnail

Applications without previous quiz-video examples will not be considered.

Start your proposal with the word “QUIZ” so I know you have read the full job description.

The businesses have similar sales processes, so much of the role will involve helping me stay organized, prepare sales documents, manage leads and opportunities, and make sure sales-related tasks are completed quickly and accurately.
I’m looking for someone who doesn’t need to be constantly reminded of tasks. You should be comfortable taking direction, learning our processes, following up on outstanding items, and proactively identifying what needs to be done next.

Main Responsibilities

- Assist the CEO with day-to-day sales tasks across three businesses

Strong written English and communication skills are important since you’ll be helping draft client-facing sales documents and emails.

items.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 OmniChannel Expert Needed – Resolve Legacy Dependency Issue
items.description:
We are seeking an experienced Dynamics 365 OmniChannel expert to help resolve a deployment issue caused by legacy OmniChannel dependencies in our environment.

Background

We have a Dynamics 365 Sales Hub solution that has historically been deployed successfully from DEV to PROD.

At one point, we installed Sales Hub Dialer (Preview) in our DEV environment. This created a number of OmniChannel-related dependencies. Since then, Microsoft has deprecated Sales Hub Dialer (Preview), several associated OmniChannel solutions, and introduced Teams Dialer as its replacement.

We do not use OmniChannel or Customer Service functionality. Our environment is focused exclusively on Sales Hub.

We have removed all OmniChannel solutions and components that could be deleted, however some dependencies remain. These dependencies are now preventing deployment of our DEV solution to PROD, with errors indicating missing OmniChannel components.

What We Need

We are looking for someone who can:

Investigate the remaining OmniChannel dependencies in our DEV environment.
Identify why these dependencies continue to exist and block deployments.
Recommend and implement a remediation approach.
Remove or resolve obsolete OmniChannel references where possible.
Validate that our solution can be successfully deployed to PROD.
Provide clear advice on any Microsoft-supported actions required.
Required Experience
Dynamics 365 OmniChannel architecture and administration.
Dynamics 365 solution dependency analysis and troubleshooting.
Managing deprecated OmniChannel components and legacy dependencies.
Solution deployment and ALM processes across DEV and PROD environments.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

This is a short-term troubleshooting engagement for a specialist who has deep experience with OmniChannel internals and Dynamics 365 solution dependencies. We are looking for someone who can quickly diagnose the issue and help us restore our deployment path.

items.title: Senior .NET / AWS Backend Engineer — Long-Term Contract
items.description:
We’re looking for an experienced Senior .NET Backend Engineer to join an ongoing enterprise software project on a long-term contract.

This is not a short-term build. We’re looking for someone who can become a consistent part of the development team, understand an existing system, and independently own backend features, integrations, and cloud infrastructure work.

Contract

Budget: $2,000–$2,500 USD/month

Workload: Approximately 5 hours/day

Schedule: Must have consistent availability during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) working hours

Duration: 12-month contract with the possibility of extension

Location: Remote

Core Tech Stack

We’re primarily looking for strong hands-on experience with:

C# / .NET Core

ASP.NET Core / Web APIs

REST and SOAP API integrations

AWS services and cloud deployments

Terraform / Infrastructure as Code

SQL and enterprise backend development

Microservices / distributed application architecture

Docker and containerized applications

Git and CI/CD workflows

Experience with some of the following is a plus:

Kubernetes

Azure

Angular, React, or Vue.js

Workday integrations

Salesforce integrations

PHP / Laravel

Enterprise system modernization and legacy application migration

Who We're Looking For

Ideally, you have 6+ years of professional software development experience and have worked on complex production systems rather than only small websites or basic CRUD applications.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of technical tasks, debugging existing systems, designing APIs and integrations, reviewing architecture, and communicating technical decisions with the rest of the team.

Strong spoken English is important because there will be regular communication with a U.S.-based team.

Application Requirement — Loom Video

Please include a short 1–2 minute Loom video with your proposal introducing yourself and briefly covering:

Your recent .NET Core experience

Your AWS and Terraform experience

One complex backend/API integration you've worked on

Your availability during Eastern Time

Proposals that include a Loom video will be reviewed first. Applications without a Loom video will be considered afterward.

We're looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term working relationship rather than a short freelance engagement.

items.title: GTM Lead: Market Research, Positioning & Outbound
items.description:
**The work**

I run a finance and data company out of Rotterdam. I work with founders and CFOs, and I'm also building B2B software products. I need someone to help me take offers to market.

I need help with everything around the offer: understanding the market properly, sharpening how it's positioned, finding the right people to talk to, and getting in front of them.

**What you'd do**

- Research markets and competitors: what similar firms sell, how they package it, what they charge, who they target
- Pressure-test my offers: who they're really for, what's unclear, where the pricing sits against the market
- Sharpen positioning and messaging so the offer reads clearly to the buyer
- Build targeted prospect lists with the right roles at the right companies
- Write and iterate cold email sequences and LinkedIn outreach
- Track what's working: open rates, replies, meetings booked, and what to change
- Do the same across both the services side and the software side

I write the offer. You help me test it, position it and take it to market.

**One thing to be clear about**

This isn't a fixed scope. I'm running a services business and building software products, and I have more ideas than time. Some weeks you'll be deep in one market. Other weeks I'll send you three unrelated things and ask what you make of them. Some of what we look at will go nowhere, and that's fine, finding that out quickly is part of the job.

If you need a clear brief and a defined lane, this will frustrate you. If you like poking at new problems and figuring out whether there's something there, you'll enjoy it.

**What I'm looking for**

- You've taken a B2B offer to market before and can show what happened
- Comfortable with research: you can map a market without being handed the sources
- You write well. Cold email that sounds like a person, not a template
- You know the outbound tooling: list building, enrichment, sequencing, deliverability
- Commercially minded. You're interested in what makes someone buy, not just in the analysis
- You work from a rough direction rather than a brief. You come back with a first draft and the questions you hit along the way
- Comfortable with ambiguity and with work that changes direction
- Clear written English, some overlap with Central European hours

**Nice to have**

- Experience selling into finance, SaaS or professional services
- Experience with productized services or consulting offers
- Familiarity with AI tools for research and copy, used as a thinking aid rather than a shortcut

**Not a fit**

Pure brand or content marketers, agency account managers, and SDRs looking for a calling role. This combines strategy and hands-on execution in the same person.

**Engagement**

Starting at around 10 to 15 hours per week, ongoing. We'll start with a paid trial task. Hours can grow as this works.

**How to apply**

Applications without a Loom video won't be considered. Keep it under 3 minutes and cover:

1. An offer or product you've taken to market. What was it, what did you do, and what happened?
2. Share your screen and show me something you've built: a sequence, a research doc, a list, a campaign breakdown. Walk me through it.
3. Which tools you use for research, list building and outreach.
4. A time the work changed direction on you, or you were asked to look into something with no clear brief. What did you do?

Unpolished is fine. I care about how you think, not production quality.

Put the Loom link in the first line of your proposal and start your message with "Positioned" so I know you read this far. Keep the written part short.

items.title: SEO & AI Search Optimization (GEO/AEO)
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist to help grow our website’s organic visibility across traditional search engines as well as emerging AI-powered search platforms.

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who understands that modern search is no longer limited to traditional Google rankings. We want to improve our visibility across Google Search, AI Overviews, ChatGPT-style search experiences, answer engines, and other AI-driven discovery platforms, while continuing to build strong organic traffic and conversions.

We are looking for someone who can build a sustainable, data-driven SEO + AI visibility strategy, not someone who relies on automated spam, low-quality backlinks, or outdated SEO tactics.

Scope of Work
1. Complete SEO Audit
Start with a detailed audit of the website covering:

Technical SEO

On-page SEO

Off-page SEO

Content quality

Keyword targeting

Search intent

Internal linking

Website architecture

Crawlability and indexation

Canonicalization

XML sitemaps

Robots.txt

Schema/structured data

Core Web Vitals and page experience

Duplicate/thin content

Content gaps

Competitor analysis

Backlink profile

Google Search Console data

Organic traffic and conversion opportunities

We expect clear documentation of problems, priorities, and recommended solutions.

2. Keyword Research & Search Intent
Develop a comprehensive keyword strategy based on:

Commercial keywords

Informational keywords

Transactional keywords

Long-tail keywords

Question-based searches

Semantic keywords

Topical clusters

Entity-based search

High-intent keywords

Low-competition opportunities

Keywords with strong conversion potential

The goal is not simply to increase keyword count, but to target keywords and topics that can generate qualified organic traffic and business results.

3. Traditional Google SEO
Optimize the website for organic search visibility, including:

Title tags

Meta descriptions

H1-H6 structure

Content optimization

Internal linking

URL structure

Image optimization

Schema markup

Entity optimization

Topical authority

E-E-A-T signals

Technical SEO

Crawl/indexation improvements

Content pruning and optimization

Featured snippet opportunities

People Also Ask opportunities

4. AI Search / GEO / AEO Optimization
A major part of this project will be improving our visibility in AI-powered search and answer engines.

We want an SEO professional who understands concepts such as:

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

AI Search Optimization

AI Overviews

ChatGPT search visibility

AI-powered search experiences

Entity optimization

Knowledge graphs

Semantic search

Query fan-out

Conversational search

Question-based content

Citation/mention opportunities

Brand/entity authority

Structured and machine-readable content

You will research how our target audience asks questions through AI-powered search and develop content/SEO strategies that increase the chances of our website being understood, cited, mentioned, or surfaced in relevant AI-generated answers.

We are NOT looking for someone promising guaranteed "ChatGPT rankings." We understand that AI search results can change dynamically. We want a professional who can build measurable strategies around AI visibility, citations, mentions, entities, content quality, and search demand.

5. Content Strategy & Topical Authority
Develop a complete content roadmap around our target market.

This may include:

Pillar pages

Supporting articles

Topic clusters

Comparison pages

FAQ content

How-to content

Problem/solution content

Commercial landing pages

Supporting informational content

Expert-led content

Content refreshes

Content gap opportunities

Every piece of content should have a clear search intent and purpose.

We want content that is genuinely useful to users rather than AI-generated filler written purely to target keywords.

6. On-Page & Content Optimization
Review and optimize existing content for:

Search intent

Topical depth

Clarity

Factual accuracy

Entity relevance

Semantic coverage

Internal linking

Conversion opportunities

FAQ opportunities

Featured snippets

AI answer visibility

User experience

Where appropriate, recommend improvements rather than simply rewriting everything.

7. Authority & Off-Page SEO
Develop a sustainable authority-building strategy.

Potential activities include:

Digital PR

Relevant editorial backlinks

Industry publications

Guest contributions where genuinely valuable

Brand mentions

Unlinked mention opportunities

Competitor backlink analysis

Link reclamation

Digital authority building

Absolutely NO:
PBNs

Spam backlinks

Automated link-building software

Link farms

Fiverr-style bulk backlinks

Irrelevant directory spam

Comment spam

Private blog networks

Any strategy that could put the website at unnecessary risk

Quality and relevance are more important than backlink quantity.

8. Competitor Research
Analyze competitors to identify:

Their strongest ranking pages

Keyword gaps

Content gaps

Backlink opportunities

Topic clusters

Search intent coverage

SERP features

Brand/entity visibility

AI search visibility where measurable

We want to understand why competitors are visible and where genuine opportunities exist for us.

9. Tracking & Reporting
Set up and/or improve tracking using relevant tools such as:

Google Search Console

Google Analytics 4

Ahrefs

Semrush

Screaming Frog

Looker Studio

Bing Webmaster Tools

Other relevant SEO/AI visibility tools

Monthly reporting should clearly show:

Organic clicks

Organic impressions

CTR

Keyword movement

Landing-page performance

Organic conversions

New ranking opportunities

Content published/updated

Technical improvements

Backlink/authority activity

AI search visibility/mentions where measurable

Key problems discovered

Recommended next actions

We care about business impact, not vanity metrics alone.

What We Expect From You
You should be able to create a practical roadmap such as:

First 30 Days
Complete SEO audit

Technical analysis

Keyword research

Competitor research

Search intent mapping

AI search/GEO opportunity research

Identify quick wins

Create prioritized action plan

30–60 Days
Implement technical improvements

Optimize priority pages

Build topic clusters

Improve internal linking

Create/refresh high-priority content

Begin authority-building activities

Establish AI search visibility tracking where possible

60–90+ Days
Scale content strategy

Expand topical authority

Continue technical optimization

Build relevant authority

Analyze ranking and traffic data

Identify new keyword opportunities

Refine GEO/AEO strategy based on observed results

Requirements
Please apply only if you have genuine hands-on experience with SEO.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with:

Technical SEO

Content SEO

Keyword research

Topical authority

Semantic SEO

Entity SEO

GEO/AEO

AI search optimization

Google Search Console

GA4

Ahrefs/Semrush

Technical SEO crawlers

Content strategy

Digital PR/link acquisition

Strong analytical and communication skills are important.

To Apply
Please include the following in your proposal:

2–3 SEO case studies with measurable before/after results.

Tell us about a website where you improved organic traffic, rankings, or conversions.

Explain your experience with GEO/AEO/AI Search Optimization.

How would you approach improving a website's visibility in Google Search + AI-powered search?

Which SEO tools do you use regularly?

What would you audit during the first 7–14 days?

What would your first 90-day strategy look like?

Your hourly rate or monthly retainer.

Your expected availability per week.

Please mention the phrase "AI SEO 2026" at the beginning of your proposal so we know you have read the complete job description.

Important
We are looking for a long-term SEO partner, not someone promising overnight rankings.

We value:

Strategy → Technical SEO → High-quality content → Topical authority → Relevant authority building → Measurement → Continuous optimization

Our goal is to build a strong organic presence that can generate sustainable traffic, qualified leads/customers, and visibility across both traditional search engines and the rapidly evolving AI search ecosystem.

H1-H6 structure

Internal linking

URL structure

Image optimization

Schema markup

Entity optimization

Topical authority

E-E-A-T signals

Technical SEO

Content pruning and optimization

Featured snippet opportunities

People Also Ask opportunities

AI-powered search experiences

Knowledge graphs

Semantic search

Conversational search

Question-based content

Pillar pages

Digital authority building

items.title: German-Speaking Short-Form Video Clipper / Editor – IG Reels, Shorts & TikTok
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced German-speaking short-form video clipper/editor for an independent documentary series.

You will work with our long-form documentary footage and turn the strongest moments into engaging short-form clips for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok.

This is not just an editing job. You need to understand storytelling, hooks, retention and what makes people want to keep watching and ultimately visit our platform.

Before starting, we expect you to study our existing Reels — including several clips that have reached hundreds of thousands of views — to understand our style and audience.

Fluent German is mandatory.

You must have previous experience with similar short-form/clipping work and be able to show us examples you personally created.

We would start with a paid two-week trial (6 clips). If it works well, we are looking for an ongoing collaboration producing approximately 3 clips per week.

Budget: €300–€500 per month, depending on experience, quality and the results of the initial two-week trial.

items.title: Market
items.description:
Busco estratega de Marketing Digital, Funnel y Meta Ads para negocio de autopublicación

Estoy desarrollando y ampliando un negocio especializado en servicios editoriales y publicación de libros para autores independientes.

Actualmente ya cuento con experiencia, clientes, servicios editoriales en funcionamiento y algunos productos digitales alojados en Hotmart. Sin embargo, una parte importante de mis clientes actuales llega a través de un socio comercial externo.

Mi objetivo ahora es desarrollar un canal propio de adquisición de clientes, que me permita atraer autores que todavía no conocen la marca y construir progresivamente un sistema de ventas que no dependa exclusivamente de terceros.

¿Qué tengo actualmente?

Cuento con diferentes productos y servicios relacionados con la publicación de libros, entre ellos:

* Servicios de publicación en Amazon KDP y otras plataformas.
* Diseño profesional de portadas.
* Diagramación y preparación de libros para publicación.
* Revisión editorial.
* Servicios relacionados con ISBN y publicación.
* Otros servicios complementarios para autores.
* Productos digitales alojados en Hotmart.
* Un curso de autopublicación creado anteriormente, que estoy considerando actualizar o reemplazar.
* Una herramienta denominada Ficha Editorial, asistida por IA, que ayuda al autor a preparar información necesaria para publicar su libro, como descripción, palabras clave, categorías, BISAC, recomendaciones de precio y otros metadatos editoriales.

Estoy abierta a comenzar con un MVP, modificar productos existentes, cambiar la estructura de la oferta o probar una estrategia diferente si el análisis lo justifica.

Objetivo de esta primera etapa

No estoy buscando inicialmente contratar una gestión mensual de publicidad ni comenzar con una inversión elevada en Meta Ads.

Antes de invertir en campañas o dedicar tiempo a reconstruir productos, quiero realizar un diagnóstico estratégico y definir una primera prueba de mercado concreta.


Fase 1: diagnóstico y estrategia de validación

Para esta primera etapa espero que el profesional pueda:

* Revisar los productos, servicios y activos que ya tengo.
* Comprender cómo llegan actualmente mis clientes y qué servicios contratan.
* Analizar mi oferta y modelo actual.
* Identificar el segmento de clientes más razonable para una primera prueba.
* Recomendar qué producto, servicio u oferta deberíamos validar primero.
* Evaluar específicamente la hipótesis Curso + Ficha Editorial como posible producto de entrada.
* Definir una propuesta de valor y posicionamiento inicial.
* Diseñar (idea) un funnel mínimo y realista para realizar la prueba.
* Determinar qué activos necesito preparar antes del lanzamiento y cuáles NO necesito desarrollar todavía.
* Proponer los primeros ángulos y conceptos publicitarios que tendría sentido probar mediante Meta Ads.
* Recomendar un presupuesto inicial de validación.
* Definir las principales métricas y criterios que permitirán determinar si debemos continuar, modificar o detener la prueba.

No espero en esta primera fase la gestión mensual de campañas, producción completa de anuncios ni construcción de todo el funnel. Eso formaría parte de una segunda etapa.

Entregable esperado

Además de una sesión estratégica, espero recibir un plan de acción escrito y concreto que pueda utilizar como hoja de ruta para la primera validación.

Idealmente, debería dejar definidos al menos estos puntos:

1. Oferta recomendada para la primera prueba.
2. Perfil o segmento de cliente al que dirigirla.
3. Propuesta de valor y mensaje principal.
4. Funnel mínimo recomendado.
5. Activos que necesito preparar antes de lanzar.
6. Primeros conceptos o ángulos de anuncios a probar.
7. Presupuesto publicitario inicial sugerido y estructura básica de la prueba.
8. Métricas que debemos observar.
9. Criterios para determinar si continuar, modificar o detener la prueba.
10. Próximos pasos priorizados.

No busco un informe extenso ni teórico. Sino, una estrategia breve, práctica y aplicable.

Perfil que busco

Busco una persona con experiencia demostrable en:

* Estrategia de marketing digital.
* Meta Ads / Facebook e Instagram Ads.
* Funnels de conversión.
* Productos digitales y/o cursos online.
* Hotmart o plataformas similares.
* Validación de ofertas.
* Landing pages y optimización de conversión.
* Investigación y definición de audiencias.
* Estrategias de adquisición con presupuestos iniciales controlados.

La experiencia trabajando con autores, autopublicación, servicios profesionales, educación online o negocios editoriales será especialmente valorada, aunque no es indispensable.

Forma de trabajo

Quiero comenzar con un proyecto pequeño y definido, no con una contratación mensual.

Para esta primera fase tengo contemplado un presupuesto aproximado de US$120, aunque estoy abierta a propuestas razonables dependiendo de la experiencia del profesional y del alcance que proponga.

Si después de esta primera etapa encontramos una estrategia coherente y existe una buena dinámica de trabajo, podremos continuar con una segunda fase de implementación, lanzamiento y optimización de las campañas.

Al enviar tu propuesta

Por favor, cuéntame brevemente:

* Qué experiencia tienes validando productos digitales u ofertas mediante Meta Ads.
* Si has trabajado con Hotmart, cursos online, servicios profesionales o negocios similares.
* Un ejemplo concreto de una oferta o funnel que hayas ayudado a validar.
* Cómo abordarías inicialmente un negocio que ya tiene clientes, productos y servicios, pero todavía no cuenta con un canal propio y predecible de adquisición.
* Qué información necesitarías conocer de mi negocio antes de recomendar invertir en publicidad.

Valoro especialmente a profesionales capaces de explicar el razonamiento detrás de sus recomendaciones y de decirme qué NO debería hacer todavía, en lugar de simplemente recomendar aumentar la inversión publicitaria.

items.title: Expert 3D Jewelry Designer & Renderer for Hyperrealistic Visuals
items.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled 3D Designer with a specialized focus on fine jewelry. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise not only in creating breathtaking, hyperrealistic renders but also in actual jewelry production and manufacturing standards. You will be responsible for bringing our concepts to life through photorealistic visuals that showcase the brilliance, texture, and exact proportions of the pieces.

Key Responsibilities:

Translate 2D sketches, technical drawings, or reference images into highly accurate 3D CAD models.

Create exceptionally high-quality, hyperrealistic renders of jewelry pieces, paying close attention to gemstone refraction, metal finishes (e.g., high polish, matte, brushed), and realistic studio lighting.

Ensure all 3D models are structurally viable for real-world manufacturing, accounting for prongs, settings, metal shrinkage, and casting tolerances.

Collaborate on design iterations to refine the aesthetic and structural integrity of each piece.

Required Skills & Experience:

3D Modeling & CAD: Advanced proficiency in industry-standard jewelry software such as Rhino, Gemvision Matrix/MatrixGold, or ZBrush.

Hyperrealistic Rendering: Mastery of rendering engines like KeyShot, V-Ray, Octane, or Blender (Cycles), specifically tuned for jewelry, diamonds, and colored gemstones.

Production Knowledge: A strong understanding of jewelry manufacturing processes (casting, stone setting, polishing) to ensure designs are practical and ready for production, not just conceptual.

Attention to Detail: A meticulous eye for scale, proportion, and the physics of light behavior on precious materials.

Portfolio: A robust portfolio demonstrating a track record of producing photorealistic jewelry renders and production-ready CAD files.

Deliverables:

High-resolution still renders from multiple angles (e.g., front, side, top, perspective) for each piece.

Final 3D CAD files (e.g., .STL, .3DM) optimized and ready for 3D printing and casting.

Project Scope & Timeline:

Start Date: Immediately

Volume: Open and flexible — we are looking to build a long-term, ongoing relationship.

Timeline: Open / Ongoing

How to Apply:
Please submit your proposal with a brief overview of your experience in both design and physical jewelry production. You must include a link to your portfolio specifically highlighting your best hyperrealistic jewelry renders and examples of pieces that have successfully gone to production.

items.title: New message indicator does not pop up on 1st message after going back online #102094 - Expensify
items.description:
Expensify is a team of generalists developing today's leading expense management tool. Maintaining our reputation as an innovative leader in the world of finance requires an incredibly reliable and secure system for processing financial transactions. Accordingly, we primarily leverage time-tested languages, but we're looking to unify our front-end across platforms. For this, we're leveraging React Native and are looking toward the community on Upwork to help solve a variety of problems, both big and small, related to this migration.

Please see the GitHub issue for full details: github.com/Expensify/App/issues/102094

Your Proposal:

- You *must* post a proposal for how you will fix this issue in the GitHub issue linked above.
- Your proposal should include a technical explanation of the changes you will make. You are not required to submit the final solution or code along with your proposal.
- Your proposal will be reviewed.
- If your proposal is accepted, you should post the proposal in Upwork and you will be hired for the job.
- AFTER your proposal is accepted in Upwork and you have accepted the offer, you may submit the code to implement your solution. To submit the code, go to the Expensify/App GitHub repo where you'll create a fork of our codebase. You'll create a branch on that fork, and when your code is ready for review, you'll create a pull request in our repository to merge your code into our codebase. Include screenshots and confirmation that you have tested the pull request on all platforms. Our engineers will review the code, and approve and merge when the code meets our requirements.

Please review our Contributor Guidelines before submitting a proposal - github.com/Expensify/App/blob/main/contributingGuides/CONTRIBUTING.md

**Important:** As documented in our CONTRIBUTING.md, payment amounts are variable, dependent on any regressions your work causes.

For this, we're leveraging React Native and are looking toward the community on Upwork to help solve a variety of problems, both big and small, related to this migration.

Please see the GitHub issue for full details: github.com/Expensify/App/issues/102094

Your Proposal:

- You *must* post a proposal for how you will fix this issue in the GitHub issue linked above.
- Your proposal should include a technical explanation of the changes you will make. You are not required to submit the final solution or code along with your proposal.
- Your proposal will be reviewed.
- If your proposal is accepted, you should post the proposal in Upwork and you will be hired for the job.
- AFTER your proposal is accepted in Upwork and you have accepted the offer, you may submit the code to implement your solution. To submit the code, go to the Expensify/App GitHub repo where you'll create a fork of our codebase. You'll create a branch on that fork, and when your code is ready for review, you'll create a pull request in our repository to merge your code into our codebase. Include screenshots and confirmation that you have tested the pull request on all platforms. Our engineers will review the code, and approve and merge when the code meets our requirements.

items.title: AI Image Generation Specialist – Photorealistic Character Consistency & Glamour
items.description:
I’m looking for an experienced AI image generation specialist for an ongoing virtual influencer project.

I already have the character and several reference images. I am NOT looking for someone to create a new character from scratch.

Your job will be to use my existing reference images to create new photorealistic images while maintaining extremely high consistency.

The most important requirements are:

• Strong facial identity consistency — the face must remain recognizably the same character across different images.
• Consistent body type and proportions.
• Natural, realistic anatomy.
• Highly realistic skin texture, including natural pores and small imperfections. I do not want plastic-looking AI skin.
• Realistic hair, lighting, clothing and environments.
• Ability to create different poses, outfits and locations without losing the character's identity.
• Ability to work from multiple reference images.

I am particularly interested in freelancers experienced with professional workflows such as:

• ComfyUI
• Stable Diffusion / SDXL
• FLUX
• LoRA
• IP-Adapter / FaceID
• ControlNet
• Inpainting
• Other advanced character-consistency techniques

Using ChatGPT or other AI tools as part of the workflow is absolutely fine. What matters to me is the final quality and consistency.

CONTENT:

The images will include normal lifestyle/social-media content as well as sensual glamour content.

Examples include:

• Everyday outfits
• Dresses
• Bikini
• Lingerie
• Bra and panties
• Sexy or provocative poses
• Glamour-style photography

I am NOT requesting pornography or explicit nudity.

The character is an adult.

The initial $100 budget is for a first test/project. I prefer to start small and evaluate the quality, realism and character consistency before expanding the collaboration.

If the results are good, I am interested in an ongoing collaboration and regular image production.

IMPORTANT:

Please do not apply if you only use simple one-click AI generators and cannot maintain the same character consistently.

When applying, please:

1. Show me examples of your most photorealistic AI character work.
2. If possible, show examples where the SAME character appears in multiple different images.
3. Tell me which tools and workflow you use.
4. Tell me whether you have experience with ComfyUI and Stable Diffusion.
5. Confirm that you are comfortable creating lingerie/glamour images within the limits described above.

Character consistency and photorealism are more important to me than the number of images produced.

items.title: Fashion Designer in Lahore
items.description:
Looking for a Fashion / Production Business Partner in Pakistan 🇵🇰 × 🇫🇷

I'm based in Paris and am working on launching a women's fashion brand that brings together contemporary Western silhouettes with subtle South Asian influences, fabrics and craftsmanship.

I'm looking for a hands-on fashion/product development partner in Pakistan, ideally Lahore, who would be interested in building this with me.

I'm not looking for an investor. I'm looking for someone who understands fashion and can take a design/concept from inspiration to a well-finished physical product.

Ideally, you already have experience in fashion, apparel production or running a boutique/production setup and have access to a reliable team, particularly:

• An experienced Master / pattern cutter who understands Western cuts and silhouettes — this is essential
• Skilled stitching/tailoring
• Embroidery/addā and other finishing capabilities when required
• Fabric and trims sourcing
• Sampling and small-batch production
• Strong quality control and ability to meet agreed timelines

The creative direction will be focused on clothing that feels modern and wearable in Paris/Europe while carrying elements of Pakistani craftsmanship rather than traditional Eastern wear.

I travel to Pakistan regularly, so being based in Lahore would be ideal, although I'm open to the right person elsewhere in Pakistan.

 I'm primarily looking for capability, reliability, creativity and someone who genuinely connects with the concept. We can discuss the commercial/partnership structure once we establish that we're a good fit.

If this sounds like you or you know someone who could be a great fit please comment or DM me with a little about your background and, ideally, examples of your work.

Thank you! 🇵🇰🤝🇫🇷

items.title: Part Time VA with Full Time Executive Assistant Pathway
items.description:
Virtual Assistant / Personal & Business Operations

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage both **personal and business administrative responsibilities**. The goal is to create order, consistency, and momentum across daily operations.

This begins as a **part-time execution role** with the opportunity to become a **full-time Executive Assistant position** for the right person who demonstrates reliability, initiative, speed, organization, and the ability to leverage AI.

### Core Responsibilities

**📅 Schedule & Organization**

* Organize and maintain personal and business calendars
* Schedule meetings, appointments, calls, and follow-ups
* Help prioritize daily and weekly tasks
* Maintain task lists and deadlines
* Keep personal and business responsibilities organized separately
* Prepare daily/weekly schedules and accountability checklists

**📋 Administrative**

* Complete and submit applications
* Track application status and follow up until completion
* Organize documents, information, and files
* Research companies, people, opportunities, and vendors
* Maintain spreadsheets, CRM records, and tracking systems
* Handle routine administrative tasks and follow-ups

**📈 Business Development / Rule of 100 — 100 Days**
Help execute a consistent **100-day prospecting and outreach campaign**, including:

* Building highly targeted prospect lists
* Finding decision-makers and contact information
* Sending personalized DMs
* Sending emails
* Following up with prospects
* Tracking responses and conversations
* Updating CRM/pipeline status
* Researching prospects before outreach
* Scheduling qualified appointments
* Maintaining daily activity numbers
* Using AI to research, personalize, organize, and accelerate work

**🤖 AI & Automation**

* Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to complete tasks faster
* Build repeatable workflows and SOPs
* Use AI for research, list building, writing, summarization, organization, and follow-up
* Continuously identify repetitive tasks that can be automated

### 🖥️ Digital Office Requirement

This position requires **U.S. working hours** and real-time availability during agreed working periods.

**Zoom or Google Meet will function as our digital office.**

When working, you should be available in the designated Zoom/Google Meet workspace so we can communicate, collaborate, review priorities, and execute tasks in real time.

This is **not a "check in and disappear" VA position.** We are building a highly organized operating rhythm where communication, accountability, and execution happen continuously.

### 🚀 Growth Opportunity

The initial position is **Virtual Assistant**, but the objective is to identify someone who can grow into a **full-time Executive Assistant / Operations role**.

The right person will eventually be trusted with increasingly important responsibilities, including:

* Managing calendars and priorities
* Coordinating personal and business operations
* Managing follow-up systems
* Preparing meetings and information
* Coordinating people and projects
* Building processes and SOPs
* Using AI to multiply productivity
* Becoming a trusted extension of the executive

**We're looking for someone who doesn't simply wait for instructions, they see what needs to be done, organize it, execute it, and communicate the result.**

items.title: AI UGC Fashion Video Creator – Jeans / Shapewear Ads
items.description:
We are looking for a talented **AI video creator** to produce short UGC-style fashion videos for our women’s clothing brand.

The style we want is similar to the short product demonstration videos used by brands like **H alara** — casual, believable vertical videos showing how the jeans fit, move and stretch.

The main focus will be demonstrating things like:
- Stretchy waistband and fabric
- Comfort and movement
- Front, side and back fit
- Walking, bending or light squat movements
- Close-up product details
- Natural TikTok / Instagram UGC style

We will provide the original product images. The jeans must remain visually accurate throughout the video — **colour, waistband, stitching, pockets, fit and construction must not morph or change.**

### Paid Pilot
**3 finished videos for $100 total**

Each video should be:
- 8–15 seconds
- 9:16 vertical
- Photorealistic
- AI generated
- Ad-ready
- No obvious AI distortion or product morphing

We want to test different concepts, especially videos that clearly demonstrate **fabric stretch and comfort**.

If the pilot is successful, we expect ongoing work of approximately **15–20 finished videos per month**.

Please apply with:
- Examples of AI fashion / UGC videos you have created
- The AI tools you normally use, e.g. Kling, Veo, Seedance, Higgsfield, Runway etc.
- Confirmation that you can maintain the original clothing design accurately while generating movement

**Please do not apply if your experience is only traditional video editing. We specifically need someone experienced in AI-generated fashion video.**

Looking for a reliable freelancer to transcribe an approximately 13-hour online video course into accurate, well-organized text.

The course is divided into 260 short video lessons of approximately 1–10 minutes each. Access to the course will be provided to the selected freelancer.

AI transcription tools may be used and are encouraged if they improve efficiency. However, the freelancer must personally review and correct all transcripts to ensure the final text accurately reflects the video content.

- Your estimated turnaround time for approximately 13 hours of video.
- Your fixed-price quote for the complete project.
- A brief description of how you check AI-generated transcripts for accuracy.
- A small sample may be requested before awarding the full project.

items.title: IICRC Water Mitigation & Xactimate Estimate Review Specialist
items.description:
Precision Estimates is seeking a highly qualified Water Mitigation Specialist to assist with occasional freelance/as-needed projects.

We need an experienced professional with strong knowledge of IICRC standards, Water Damage Restoration, mitigation documentation, Xactimate, estimate reviews, and comparative estimate analysis.

PRIMARY PURPOSE
The specialist will technically review Water Mitigation estimates. Drying logs, moisture records, photos, invoices, scopes, equipment records, carrier estimates, and other supporting documents must be evaluated to determine whether the estimate scope, quantities, equipment, labor, duration, and charges are supported.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Review Water Mitigation estimates, invoices, scopes, drying logs, moisture documentation, photos, equipment records, and supporting claim documents.
• Review drying logs and moisture records for readings, monitoring dates, equipment placement/usage, drying duration, and consistency with the estimate.
• Compare contractor/restoration estimates against carrier or third-party estimates on a line-item basis.
• Identify missing scope, unsupported reductions, quantity discrepancies, pricing differences, duplicated or omitted items, and technical inconsistencies.
• Determine which estimate line items should remain, be revised, be added, be removed, or require additional support.
• Review Category/Class classifications, equipment, drying duration, monitoring, demolition, cleaning, antimicrobial applications, labor, and related mitigation charges.
• Review mitigation procedures for consistency with applicable IICRC S500 standards and accepted industry practices.
• Prepare written findings and clear observation notes by estimate line item or section.
• Provide technical explanations supporting disputed or questioned mitigation charges.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Current or verifiable IICRC certification(s) relevant to Water Damage Restoration.
• Direct professional experience in Water Mitigation / Water Damage Restoration.
• Experience reviewing mitigation estimates, invoices, drying logs, moisture documentation, and equipment records.
• Strong understanding of IICRC S500 standards and documentation requirements.
• Experience with estimate comparisons / comparative estimate analysis.
• Ability to explain and defend technical recommendations in writing.
• Fluent professional English, written and spoken.

STRONGLY PREFERRED
Experience with Xactimate, insurance property claims, contractor and carrier estimates, estimate reconciliation, scope disputes, water mitigation invoice audits, desk reviews, and technical claim documentation.

COMPENSATION
Fixed fee per file review. Base budget: $75 per assignment. Final pricing may vary based on file size, documentation volume, and complexity. The fee will be agreed upon before each assignment begins.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
A completed assignment must:
• Review the estimate against all available supporting documentation.
• Clearly identify missing, duplicated, unsupported, excessive, or technically inconsistent line items.
• State which line items should remain, be revised, be added, be removed, or require additional support.
• Review Category/Class, equipment, drying duration, monitoring, demolition, cleaning, antimicrobial, labor, and other relevant charges when applicable.
• Prepare a comparative estimate analysis against carrier or third-party estimates when available, including line-item scope, quantity, pricing, and technical differences.
• Provide organized written findings and observation notes by line item or estimate section.
• Include applicable IICRC S500 / industry-practice reasoning when relevant.
• Clearly state when the available documentation is insufficient to support a conclusion.
• Meet the agreed turnaround time.

Please do not apply unless you have direct Water Mitigation experience and verifiable IICRC credentials. We are seeking technically sound, defensible estimate reviews—not general administrative assistance.

items.title: Paid Video Editing Test — Turn Raw Real Estate Footage Into a Great Reel
items.description:
I’m an experienced real estate investor in the Philadelphia area. I’ve purchased 1,200+ houses over 17+ years and regularly post videos showing actual deals, renovations, problems, numbers, and behind-the-scenes stories from the business.

I'm looking for a talented video editor/content producer for a one-time paid project.

If the project goes extremely well, there may be an opportunity for significant ongoing work. I'm currently evaluating several editors for a longer-term content role.

The project
I will provide you with raw footage from one of my actual real estate videos.

Your job is to turn it into the best short-form social media video you can.
I'm deliberately not giving overly specific editing instructions. Part of what I'm evaluating is your editorial judgment.

I want to see whether you can:
- Find the most interesting story in ordinary raw footage
- Identify a strong opening hook
- Remove unnecessary material and improve pacing
- Add captions/on-screen text where useful
- Use B-roll, graphics, zooms, etc. when they genuinely improve the video
- Keep the video authentic rather than making it feel overly produced
- Hold the viewer's attention
- Understand what would appeal to serious real estate investors

The finished content should be appropriate for Facebook Reels, Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

What I'm NOT looking for

I don't want flashy editing just for the sake of flashy editing.
I also don't want generic "guru" content, fake enthusiasm, excessive effects, or something that feels like an advertisement.

My existing audience responds to authenticity, actual houses, real numbers, real problems and stories about what actually happens in the real estate business.

Your job is to make that more compelling—not make it look fake.

Deliverables

Please provide:
1. One finished vertical video
2. Your recommended opening hook/on-screen headline
3. A suggested caption for the post
4. A suggested CTA, if you think one is appropriate
5. A short explanation of the major editing/storytelling decisions you made
Potential ongoing work
I'm currently building a much more intentional social-media operation across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok.
Current audience is approximately:
Facebook: 6,600
Instagram: 1,600
YouTube: 750
TikTok: 200

For the right person, the ongoing role could involve editing and repurposing multiple videos per week, longer-form YouTube content, posting/scheduling, analytics, and helping identify what content is working.
But this posting is only for the one-time paid test project.

To apply

Please send me 3 examples of short-form videos you've personally edited.
At least one should demonstrate your ability to turn relatively ordinary raw footage into an engaging story.

Also answer this in 2–3 sentences maximum:
When you receive 5–10 minutes of unscripted footage, how do you decide what the first 3 seconds of the finished video should be?
Please begin your application with “ACTUAL DEALS” so I know you read the posting.

items.title: YouTube Video Editor for NHL Trade Tree Documentaries | Sportsnet/Steve Dangle-Inspired Editing
items.description:
Upwork Job Title

YouTube Video Editor for NHL Trade Tree Documentaries | Sportsnet/Steve Dangle-Inspired Editing

Job Description

Puck Pulse is a growing hockey-focused YouTube channel producing documentary-style videos about NHL history, trades, players, and franchise decisions.

We are looking for a long-term video editor to edit our Trade Tree series: deep-dive videos that trace an NHL trade through every player, draft pick, subsequent trade, and downstream asset—sometimes across 20–30+ years.

These are not basic talking-head videos. The editor needs to turn a completed voiceover, detailed script, custom trade-tree graphic, and highly detailed visual kit into a polished hockey documentary.

The production style is inspired by the clarity and storytelling structure of Sportsnet’s Trade Trees / Steve Dangle content, while maintaining Puck Pulse’s own darker, forensic documentary identity.

Our goal is to make complicated NHL transactions extremely easy—and entertaining—to follow.

⸻

What We Provide

You will not be starting from a blank page.

For each episode, Puck Pulse provides:

* Final voiceover
* Complete master trade-tree graphic
* Brand assets
* Puck Pulse logo and graphics
* Previous episodes/style references

Your job is to execute at a professional level while using your own editing judgment to improve pacing, transitions, motion, and storytelling where appropriate.

⸻

What You’ll Be Editing

Typical Trade Tree episodes are approximately 10–30+ minutes.

A single episode may contain dozens of transactions and hundreds of individual assets.

For example:

Player A
↓
Traded for Player B + Draft Pick
↓
Draft Pick becomes Player C
↓
Player C is traded
↓
Return includes another first-round pick
↓
That pick eventually becomes a franchise player

The audience needs to understand this entire chain without getting lost.

That makes visual communication and information hierarchy just as important as traditional editing.

⸻

Core Editing Responsibilities

1. Trade-Tree Animation

This is the most important specialized skill for the position.

You must be comfortable taking our master trade-tree graphic and turning it into an animated visual storytelling system.

We use three primary levels:

Micro Tree — one transaction.

Branch Tree — the specific asset chain currently being discussed.

Master Tree — the complete trade tree.

The editor will animate:

* Branches drawing onto the screen
* Player nodes
* Draft-pick nodes
* Team-to-team transactions
* Branch splits
* Branch convergence
* Active asset highlighting
* Completed branches
* Dead ends
* Free-agent departures
* Expansion-draft losses
* Draft-pick transformations
* Championship outcomes
* Multi-decade asset chains

The complete tree should not simply sit on screen while the narrator explains it.

It should progressively reveal itself alongside the story.

⸻

2. Archival NHL Footage

You’ll integrate historical hockey footage such as:

* Game highlights
* Goals
* Saves
* Fights
* Playoff moments
* NHL Draft footage
* Trade deadline coverage
* Interviews
* Press conferences
* Stanley Cup celebrations
* Award ceremonies
* Historical broadcasts
* News reports

The ability to work efficiently with footage from many different eras—from VHS-quality 1980s footage to modern HD broadcasts—is important.

You should use the specified section unless a better editorial choice is discussed.

You should also be comfortable finding an appropriate replacement when specified footage is unavailable.

⸻

3. Historical Photos and Newspaper Material

Many stories predate readily available HD video.

You’ll need to make still images visually interesting using:

* Parallax
* Camera pushes
* Cropping
* Masking
* Layer separation
* Depth
* Subtle animation
* Newspaper/headline compositions
* Archival texture
* Film grain
* Light motion

We do not want a slideshow of static photographs.

⸻

4. Player Cards

The series uses recurring player cards containing information such as:

WADE REDDEN
Defense
Ottawa Senators

838 GP | 101 G | 410 PTS

These need to feel like part of one consistent broadcast-quality graphic package.

Cards may also contain:

* Draft position
* Age
* Team
* Position
* Statistics
* Playoff statistics
* Awards
* Contract information
* Trade value
* Career milestones

⸻

5. Trade Cards

Every major transaction should be immediately understandable.

Example:

JULY 1, 2018

BUFFALO → ST. LOUIS

Buffalo Sends
Ryan O’Reilly

Buffalo Receives
Tage Thompson
Patrik Berglund
Vladimir Sobotka
2019 1st
2021 2nd

Assets should often be revealed sequentially, synchronized with the narration, rather than displaying the entire answer before the voiceover gets there.

⸻

6. Draft-Pick Reveals

Draft picks are an important storytelling mechanism.

Example:

1991 NHL DRAFT

3RD OVERALL

Hold.

Then reveal:

SCOTT NIEDERMAYER

The editor needs to understand when withholding information creates suspense and when immediate clarity is more important.

⸻

7. Forensic Asset Graphics

Puck Pulse uses recurring visual classifications including:

VALUE EXTRACTED

ASSET APPRECIATED

ASSET DEPRECIATED

ASSET LOST

items.title: Editorial Designer Needed for New Independent Nature & Culture Magazine
items.description:
We are launching a new independent digital magazine exploring nature, culture and science, and we are looking for an experienced editorial designer to develop the publication's visual identity and design its inaugural issue.
The first issue will be approximately 30-35 pages and centered on a nature/culture theme. Content will include several feature articles, invited contributions, an interview, shorter editorial pieces, photography, pull quotes, contributor information, and visual/educational elements.
This is not intended to look like a corporate brochure or conventional newsletter. We are looking for a sophisticated independent-magazine aesthetic: strong editorial typography, excellent use of photography, thoughtful white space, compelling opening spreads, and a clear but distinctive editorial identity.
Scope of work
We are looking for a designer who can help with both the visual identity of the publication and the layout of the inaugural issue.
The project will likely include:
•	Masthead/title treatment
•	Cover design
•	Overall editorial art direction
•	Typography and color system
•	Table of contents
•	Feature article layouts
•	Interview layout
•	Short-form editorial layouts
•	Pull quotes, sidebars, and captions
•	Contributor profiles
•	Photo-led/visual spreads
•	Page numbers, headers, footers, and recurring publication elements
•	Back cover
•	Approximately 28–32 finished pages
The publication will initially appear as an interactive digital flip magazine, but we want the underlying design to be professional enough for high-quality PDF distribution and future printing.
Deliverables
We would like to receive:
•	Complete design of the inaugural issue
•	Editable source files, preferably Adobe InDesign
•	Print-quality PDF
•	Optimized digital PDF
•	Masthead/title treatment and associated design assets
•	Typography and color specifications
•	Reusable page styles/templates for future issues
We would also be interested in discussing a simplified Canva template or adaptable Canva design system based on the final publication so that we can create or modify recurring elements independently between issues.
Experience I'm looking for
Strong experience with editorial design, magazine layout, publication design, typography, and Adobe InDesign is preferred.
Experience designing publications involving nature, culture, science, travel, food, arts, museums, environmental subjects, or long-form editorial storytelling would be particularly relevant.
How we will work
We are the founders/editors and will provide the written content, editorial direction, and available photography/assets. The designer will work directly with us and will have room to propose creative solutions and help establish the visual language of the publication.
We value clear communication and welcome a designer who is comfortable recommending approaches. Once the content is assembled, we anticipate the design phase taking approximately 2–4 weeks, including revisions. The broader project window is flexible as some contributed content is still being finalized.
When applying
Please send 2–4 examples of your strongest editorial or publication-design work. We are particularly interested in seeing magazine spreads, long-form editorial layouts, photo-led publications, journals, books, or similar work.
Please also briefly tell me:
1.	What interests you about this project.
2.	How you would approach developing the visual identity for a new publication.
3.	Whether you work in Adobe InDesign and provide editable source files.
4.	Whether you can create a simplified reusable Canva template/design system based on the final design.
5.	Your estimated number of hours or fixed-price range for a 30-35 page inaugural issue.
This is the first issue of a publication intended to continue with future themed issues. If the collaboration is successful, there may be opportunities to work together on future issues.

items.title: Email & SMS Retention Lead for E-Commerce Supplement Brand
items.description:
We're BioSource Nutra, a well-established DTC supplement and wellness brand. Our customers are mostly women aged 40–70. Email drives 30–40% of our Shopify revenue, but engagement has declined over the past year and we need to rebuild it.

After working with a few different agencies, we need someone who can step in to own email and sms strategy and execution, including all copy, design, building, and analysis. This role is open to individuals or small agencies.

What we need to fix:
•	Too much of our email lands in Gmail's Promotions tab.
•	Click-through rates are low, and our engaged segment is shrinking.
•	Copy and design structure needs a fresh approach to help reenergize the list.
•	Split testing has been minimal and hasn't produced meaningful learnings.
•	Quality control has been inconsistent. Emails reach our review with clear typos and errors.

What you'll own:
•	Deliverability: an inbox-placement audit, sending strategy, list hygiene and sunset policy, and moving us toward the Primary gmail tab.
•	Reactivating our dormant customer list: a phased, targeted plan to bring tens of thousands of past customers back without damaging sender reputation or running up Klaviyo active-profile costs.
•	Re-engaging subscribers who are still active but no longer engaging.
•	A full retention strategy audit and execution plan: post-purchase, replenishment, win-back, and lifecycle flows. (These are in place but not performing well)
•	Auditing and rebuilding existing flows for the biggest impact.
•	Building our SMS program. SMS is set up in Klaviyo but underutilized and almost dormant.
•	Campaign strategy and production across email and SMS, including copy, creative, and the monthly calendar. Promotions should have deliberate reminder cadence, and the calendar should balance value content with offers.
•	Segmentation optimization, plus pop-ups and opt-in forms. 
•	A structured testing roadmap, with each test tied to a hypothesis and a documented result.
•	Monthly reporting on clicks, conversion, revenue per recipient, reactivation, and engaged-list growth, with recommendations for improvement rather than just numbers.
•	Coordinating email content with different channels: email should introduce new content and support or pull content published on other channels.

How we want this structured:
You are the single point of contact and you are accountable for results. You write all copy yourself or closely oversee it, because copy is the core of this role. Design can be done by you or by a designer you manage, as long as it's included in your quote. We will not coordinate multiple vendors.

The standard we expect:
•	Every email is proofread and QA'd before it reaches us. We approve strategy and direction. We are not your editor.

items.title: Freelance Video Editor
items.description:
Type: Contract, project to project
Location: Remote

About the role:
We're a US based marketing agency hiring freelance video editors to join our contractor network. Video is one of the fastest growing parts of what we do for clients, and we are adding editors to the roster to keep up with it.

This is contract work, project to project. You accept the edits that fit your schedule and skill set, pass on the ones that don't. The more reliable and versatile you are, the more work comes your way.

We lean toward editors who are dialed in on the advanced side, strong on motion graphics, color, and the craft of a real cut, but we are open across skill levels. What we are not looking for is someone who only cuts where they're told. Most projects come with footage and a brief, and we need an editor who can read what the client is trying to say, pick the soundbites that matter, and make the calls on structure, music, and pacing.

What you'll typically be editing:
Most projects come in as batches tied to a shoot or content session, not one-off clips. A single assignment often means multiple deliverables from the same footage.

The bulk of the work is:
-Talking head videos
-Content sessions filmed in our studio
-Social media content with motion graphics, captions, and on-brand treatment

Alongside the regular work, you'll see:
Website header videos
Commercials and ads, often cut into multiple versions for testing
Event recaps
Project progress videos, before and afters, and walkthroughs built from multiple shoot days

How it works:
Edits come in through our Media Manager, who assigns them based on fit, availability, and project type. Once you're onboarded, you'll see incoming projects and can accept the ones that work for you.

What we are hiring for:
We want a mix of skill sets across the roster. That means we are open to editors who are strong in different areas, including:

Interview and soundbite-driven edits where context and tone matter
Short-form social content for vertical formats
Motion graphics, masking, and clean on-screen text
Color correction and grading
Audio cleanup and mixing
Ads and commercials
Event recaps that capture what the day felt like.

You don't need to do all of it. Tell us what you're strongest at, and what you want to grow into. The more you can do well, the more projects fit you.

What you provide:

Your own setup. A computer that can handle professional editing, your own editing software (Premiere Pro preferred), and an internet connection fast enough to download footage and upload exports.

Strong English and good judgment. You'll be cutting interviews where the meaning of what someone says matters, so you need to know the difference between a good line and the right one.

On-time delivery. Hit the deadline you agreed to. If something is going to take longer, tell us before the deadline, not after. Revisions come through Frame.io and need to be turned around quickly.

How to apply:
When applying, please link to some of your work. A reel, portfolio, or a few recent projects is what we care about most, especially recaps, ads, or commercial work. Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a short paid test edit.

items.title: Web Image Protection Specialist Needed
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced web developer or digital asset specialist to help us better protect original photography displayed publicly on our company website.

Our goal is to continue showcasing our work online while making it significantly more difficult for third parties to download, modify, remove identifying information from, or republish our images as their own.

We are looking for someone with experience in areas such as:

• Professional visible watermarking
• Invisible or forensic digital watermarking
• Image fingerprinting and ownership verification
• Image provenance / authenticity technologies
• Content Credentials / C2PA or similar technologies
• Metadata preservation and image ownership documentation
• AI-resistant or tamper-resistant watermarking techniques
• Website/CDN image security and delivery

We understand that any image displayed publicly can ultimately be screenshotted or copied. We are not looking for someone to simply disable right-click or claim that images can be made impossible to steal.

Instead, we want someone who understands modern image-protection technology and can recommend a layered approach that:

1. Discourages casual image theft.
2. Makes removing our branding more difficult.
3. Limits public access to original/high-resolution assets.
4. Helps us establish or verify that we are the original source of an image.
5. Continues to provide evidence of ownership even if an image is downloaded, modified, recompressed, screenshotted, or processed using AI, where technically feasible.
6. Can be incorporated into an easy workflow for future website uploads.
7. Potentially lock our images to only legitimate potential customers.

We are particularly interested in speaking with candidates familiar with newer approaches to digital provenance, invisible watermarking, image fingerprinting, Content Credentials/C2PA, and technologies designed to remain detectable after common image manipulation.

At this stage, we are primarily looking for the right specialist and recommended approach, rather than prescribing a specific solution.

Please briefly describe:

• Your experience with image protection and digital provenance.
• Technologies or methods you would consider for this type of project.
• Your experience with invisible/forensic watermarking or image fingerprinting, if applicable.
• Your familiarity with Content Credentials/C2PA or similar standards.
• How you would approach proving ownership of an image after it has been copied or altered.
• Examples of similar work.

Additional information about our company, website, existing image library, and website platform will be provided privately to qualified candidates.
