items.title: Content Strategist & Performance Analyst for Construction Media Brand
items.description:
Janser Works is an established Florida home builder and developer building a serious media operation around real construction projects, builder expertise, and long-term brand growth.

We are looking for an experienced Content Strategist & Performance Analyst to work directly with our Head of Content & Creative.

This is not a social media posting or community-management role. We need someone who can study performance data, audience behavior, competitors, successful content formats, and emerging opportunities, then turn those insights into clear recommendations for what we should create next.

You will analyze Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and eventually long-form content. We want to understand why content performs, not simply whether it received views.

Responsibilities include reviewing watch time, retention, shares, saves, engagement, profile actions and growth patterns; researching construction, real estate and adjacent creators; identifying repeatable formats and content gaps; developing hooks, concepts and content hypotheses; helping build weekly filming plans; and producing concise performance reports with actionable recommendations.

You will not replace the Head of Content & Creative. Your role is to provide the research, analytics and strategic intelligence that helps our creative team make better decisions.

Janser Works already has real projects, consistent access to footage, an established construction operation and a growing creative team. We are looking for someone who can help turn that access into a measurable and repeatable content system.

Please provide relevant case studies or examples showing how your strategy or analysis improved content performance. Explain what metrics you used, what you changed and what happened afterward.

We value analytical thinking, creative judgment, clear communication and long-term fit over generic social media experience.

items.title: Shopify E-Commerce Website & Catalog Completion
items.description:
Performance Archery is an established archery pro shop in San Diego. We are looking for an experienced Shopify professional or agency to take full ownership of completing our website and product catalog so we can launch a professional, fully functional online store.

Our current Shopify website supports class bookings and event inquiries. We need to build out the online shopping experience while preserving those existing functions. The entire website can change, we just need to make sure the online scheduling is set up to book lessons. 

We are currently using Shopify for both online and Shopify POS Pro for our in store sales. Our in store sales will be the main revenue generator and primary focus. Our product catalog is pretty accurate with Vendors, Product Name, Pricing. I would guess half of the products have the associated SKU, or UPC codes assigned already. 

**We want one accountable project lead to manage the entire project**, including website development, product content, images, catalog organization, shipping setup, testing, and launch.

**Current Catalog**
- Approximately **1,800 products**.
- Item names, vendors, costs, and retail prices are generally accurate.
- Products currently do not have images.
- Estimated **5,400–7,200 images** needed, including applicable color and variant images.

**Scope of Work**

**1. Website Development and Shopping Experience**
- Assess our current website and recommend what to retain, improve, or rebuild.
- Develop a polished, easy-to-use shopping experience on desktop and mobile.
- Complete navigation, collections, search, product filters, product pages, and cart functionality.
- Establish consistent product-page layouts suited to technical archery equipment.
- Preserve and test our existing class-booking and event-inquiry functions.
- Keep unfinished products unavailable for online purchase until approved.

**2. Product Images**
- Independently source, verify, prepare, and upload accurate product images.
- Match images to the correct model, color, and applicable variant.
- Standardize sizing, cropping, backgrounds, positioning, and image order.
- Optimize file sizes while maintaining quality and add descriptive alt text.
- We have image-bank access for a small number of vendors and can share those resources. You are responsible for sourcing the remaining images; we will not be finding individual images or providing product-by-product links.
- Flag unavailable or uncertain images rather than substituting an incorrect product.

**3. Product Descriptions and Catalog Organization**
- Research, create, or improve descriptions using verified product information.
- Use consistent formatting for features, specifications, compatibility, and package contents.
- Accurately distinguish options such as handedness, draw weight, length, spine, color, and pack quantity.
- Complete product categories, product types, tags, collections, and relevant attributes.
- Organize product information to support useful navigation and filtering.
- Identify potential duplicates and inconsistent variant information.

**4. Shipping Setup**
- Review and complete product weights and applicable shipping dimensions using verified information.
- Distinguish product measurements from shipping package measurements.
- Provide a consolidated list of items our staff needs to physically weigh or measure.
- Configure shipping based on our approved fulfillment policies.
- Test shipping calculations for representative products, long or oversized items, and orders containing multiple products.
- Identify any limitations or additional costs before implementation.

**5. SEO**
- Complete or improve product SEO titles, meta descriptions, and image alt text.
- Use relevant search terms naturally in product content.
- Address basic storefront SEO as part of the build.
- Obtain approval before changing existing URLs and implement redirects where necessary.

**6. Testing, Launch, and Handoff**
- Test product selection, variant images, inventory behavior, cart, checkout, shipping, payments, and order notifications.
- Verify the fulfillment and refund workflow.
- Confirm class bookings and event inquiries continue to function correctly.
- Resolve identified issues before launch.
- Provide staff instructions and a defined post-launch support period.

**Working Expectations**

We need someone who can own this project with minimal day-to-day direction from us.

- Provide one primary contact responsible for the complete result.
- Coordinate any team members or subcontractors internally.
- Use efficient bulk research, automated matching, and batch processing with careful human quality control.
- Research independently and consolidate questions for efficient review.
- Flag missing or conflicting information instead of guessing.
- Preserve accurate existing costs, prices, inventory, SKUs, barcodes, and product/variant IDs unless changes are approved.
- Back up relevant data and provide regular progress updates.
- Disclose any proposed recurring expenses before approval.

We will provide business decisions, available supplier access, necessary account access, and feedback on agreed milestones. We are hiring you to manage execution.

**Project Structure**

We expect milestone-based work covering:
1. Assessment, project plan, and agreed scope.
2. A working storefront sample with 20–30 fully completed representative products.
3. Website development and completion of the agreed catalog.
4. Testing, approval, and launch.
5. Handoff and post-launch support.

If categories are launched in phases, the remaining agreed catalog must still be completed within the project.

**Ideal Candidate**
- Proven experience delivering complete Shopify stores.
- Demonstrated experience with large catalogs and complex product variants.
- Strong product research, image sourcing, and written English.
- Experience with technical products or sporting goods; archery knowledge is a plus.
- Reliable project management and quality control.

**Please Include in Your Proposal**
1. Examples of complete Shopify stores you have delivered and your role in each.
2. A comparable large-catalog project, including approximate product count.
3. Who will handle development, catalog content, images, and final quality review.
4. Your approach to completing this project with limited owner involvement.
5. Your estimated total price, milestone breakdown, and timeline.
6. What is included, excluded, and potentially subject to additional charges.
7. What you need from us to confirm a firm scope and quote.
8. Your post-launch support terms.

**Please quote for the complete project, including product research and catalog completion—not website design alone.**

items.title: AI Video Creator Editor For Ongoing 90 Second Comedy Social Media Videos
items.description: So I'm looking for an experienced AI video creator editor to help me produce a series of short funny videos for my insurance business. This is not just a one-time project. If I find the right person at the right price, I'd like to produce these videos regularly and give that person ongoing work. Each finished video will be 90 seconds or less. I am Andy the Insurance Guy and in every video I'll be giving useful insurance advice to contractors, but there is a comedy twist. In every episode, I'll be working as a different type of food vendor while trying to give my insurance advice. Here are three examples. Hot dog vendor, peanut vendor, ice cream vendor. These are only examples. I plan to make many videos, so the food, outfit, and location will change in every episode. What I provide for each episode will be a video recorded on an iPhone of me speaking my complete part of the script, the complete written script, Instructions explaining the food vendor for that episode and the dialogue for the angry customer. Because I will record myself speaking, you will already have my real voice, facial expressions, timing, and lip movements. What you will create. Your job is to use AI and video editing tools to transform my simple iPhone recording into the finished video. For example, I may record myself at home in ordinary clothes. For the hot dog episode, you would transform that into a video where I appear to be a hot dog vendor at a hot dog cart. For another episode, you might make it appear that I'm selling peanuts inside a football stadium. You'll create the appropriate clothing, setting, background, and other visual elements needed for each episode. The videos should look professional and entertaining, but they are also intentionally supposed to be funny. Very important, the recurring angry customer. Every video will have a second character, an AI-generated angry customer who interrupts me while I try to give my advice. I'm open to creative ideas for this character. When you apply, please tell me how you would create this character. Once we have created the angry customer, I want the same recognisable angry customer to appear in every future video. The complaint will change each time, but the character stays the same. Skills needed. Experience with AI video tools, video editing software, ability to create consistent recurring characters with AI, good communication in simple international English. When applying, please tell me your price and what AI and video software you use. Confirm you can create a recurring AI character for the angry customer and include examples of similar work if possible.

items.title: Video Creator Needed for Criminal Defense & DUI Commercial
items.description:
We’re looking for a creative video editor or producer to create a professional commercial promoting criminal defense and DUI legal services.

The video should build trust, communicate urgency, and encourage viewers to contact a law firm for a consultation. We want a generic commercial that can be customized with a firm’s name, logo, contact information, and call to action.

Project Scope
- Create a 30–60 second video commercial.
- Help develop a compelling script and clear call to action.
- Source appropriately licensed stock footage and background music.
- Include professional voiceover, captions, and polished graphics.
- Use a serious, reassuring tone without exaggerated claims or guaranteed outcomes.

Deliverables
- Final video in MP4 format.
- Versions formatted for vertical social media (9:16) and widescreen (16:9).
- Editable source files so branding and contact details can be updated.
- At least two rounds of revisions.
- Confirmation that all footage, music, and voiceover are licensed for commercial advertising.
Ideal Freelancer
- Experience creating commercials for law firms or professional services.
- Strong storytelling, editing, and motion graphics skills.
- Ability to create an engaging opening and a clear message.
- Reliable communication and timely delivery.

To Apply

Please include:
- Two or three examples of relevant video commercials.
- Your proposed approach, including whether you use stock footage, AI-generated visuals, or original production.
- Your fixed-price quote and estimated turnaround time.
- Whether scriptwriting and voiceover are included in your quote.

Budget: Open to proposals based on experience and quality.

items.title: California licensed structural engineer needed to produce package from my personal home
items.description:
Licensed structural engineer needed for contemporary modern home addition, La Mesa

This is a single-story contemporary modern home in La Mesa, built with flat and low-slope roof planes stacked at different heights, stone veneer accent walls, deep overhangs, and glass openings across the great room and dining area. The project brings the house to roughly 2,100 square feet total, and about half the existing walls are staying in place, so this isn't a full teardown and rebuild, it's an addition and remodel layered onto a structure that's already mostly there. Although the entire roof will have to be removed...The new work adds a primary suite wing, laundry room, an expanded kitchen and great room, with the existing detached garage, newly attached by an addition

Roof fall is achieved with manufactured tapered trusses so it's actually the roof that pitches in there isn't any loss of heights on the interior, so I need you to handle the bearing wall, foundation, and shear design and coordinate loading requirements with the truss manufacturer, not engineer the trusses themselves. Foundation scope is limited and well-defined: an interior footing under the wall separating the primary bedroom from the closet and bath, with a perpendicular footing along the laundry room and hallway wall, plus two small interior footings for posts at a post-and-beam opening between the kitchen and living room. The rest of the house sits on standard single-story footings already adequate for the loads involved.

Altogether this is a straightforward job for someone who does contemporary residential work regularly, not a complex or open-ended one. Architectural drawings are already developed, so this is calcs and a stamped package for permit submittal, not design from scratch.

I need someone actively licensed as a PE in California who can stamp residential construction documents and who has real experience with single-story wood-frame residential work.

I'm getting quotes from a few engineers on this and want your most competitive number, hourly with the specified amount of hours not to exceed or flat fee, whichever you'd rather propose. To apply, include your California PE license number, a couple examples of stamped single-family residential structural packages you've completed, and your estimated turnaround time, and time is definitely of the essence, urgency is appreciated

 worth knowing if it affects your pricing: I own a design-build firm here in San Diego 32 years that do more than 25 room additions a year. If this goes well, there's a l chance of doing all my structural engineering work beyond this one project. The house looks grand, but I've designed it to be easily buildable the existing house is about 1500 ft.²so added square footage is roughly 650 ft.

items.title: Lifestyle Photographer Needed: Natural Dating-Profile Photos
items.description:
Natural looking dating-profile photos of people for a new dating app launching soon. Our look is warm, natural and understated.

What this job is
We need natural photos of people that look like genuine dating profiles photos. We'll use them as sample profiles inside the app, on the App Store and in our marketing and ads. They should look like the photos someone would choose for their own profile, not like stock or studio work.

What we need
People: 8 adults. 2 men and 2 women aged 22 to 35, and 2 men and 2 women aged 36 to 60, with ages spread across each range. 

Photos: 6 finished photos per person, in different settings and clothing.
1. Head and shoulders, warm expression, looking at the camera
2. Full length, standing or walking etc
3. Candid, laughing or relaxed etc
4. Doing an everyday activity, such as coffee, cooking, reading or music etc
5. Outdoors, such as a park, street or riverside etc
6. Any 
Style: natural light, warm tones, smart casual clothing, light retouching only. No heavy filters, no AI editing and no visible logos.

What you'd handle
Finding and booking the people. I'm happy to approve them from photos first.
Planning the shoot and the locations.
Shooting, selecting and lightly editing the photos.
Getting a signed model release from every person before the shoot (We can supply the form).

Rights (essential)
Copyright: full assignment of copyright in all delivered photos.
Model releases: each person signs one that explicitly covers use by the company as sample profiles and in advertising, perpetual, worldwide and in all media including print.
Exclusivity: no reuse or resale of the images. Portfolio use only, and only once we've launched.
Consent: each person gives written consent to being shown in connection with the company.

Timing: to be discussed

Budget: to be quoted

Please include in your quote
Total price, with the people's fees itemised.
Whether you accept a full copyright assignment.
How you'd find the people.
Example work in a natural lifestyle or portrait style.
Your availability.

items.title: Commission-Based B2B Sales Closer — $250–$500 Per New Recurring Customer
items.description:
The Flow Standard helps growing service businesses turn everyday processes into clear, professional standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ongoing process support.

We are looking for an experienced B2B sales closer who can identify, engage, and convert qualified U.S.-based service businesses into paying recurring clients.

This is a performance-based sales opportunity. We are not paying for leads, appointments, or activity alone. Compensation is earned when a new client becomes a paying recurring customer.

Our ideal customers are U.S.-based service businesses with approximately 10–100 employees, especially companies that are growing, hiring, onboarding employees, expanding locations, dealing with inconsistent work quality, or relying heavily on undocumented tribal knowledge.
Primary buyers include owners, founders, presidents, operations leaders, customer experience leaders, and other decision-makers responsible for how work gets done.

What you’ll be selling:
New clients begin with a $750 Starter Package that includes 5 SOPs.

They can then continue with one of our recurring plans:

Maintain — $349/month
Build — $599/month
Scale — $999/month
Compensation is paid once per new recurring customer:
Maintain client — $250
Build client — $400
Scale client — $500

Commission is earned after the new customer successfully pays for the $750 Starter Package and begins the recurring subscription.

The $500 project budget shown on this posting represents the maximum payout for one successful new recurring customer. This is not intended as the total earning ceiling. Additional successful customers can be handled through additional milestones or continued contract work.

No salary, hourly compensation, or ongoing residual commission is currently offered.

We are especially interested in sales professionals who:

- Have experience selling B2B services
- Are comfortable selling to small and midsize business owners
- Understand consultative or solution-based selling
- Can move a prospect from pain point to purchase
- Can source and engage qualified prospects, not just wait for inbound leads
- Already have relationships with business owners, consultants, agencies, or operations leaders
- Are comfortable working independently and being compensated based on results

The Flow Standard already has its service structure, pricing, website, and customer intake flow in place.

We care about closed, collected revenue — not appointment volume.
This may become a longer-term or full-time opportunity for someone who proves they can consistently bring in profitable recurring customers.

items.title: App creation
items.description:
DIGGY HQ

Cross-Platform Franchise Operating System — Developer Wanted

About the Project

Diggy Donuts is developing Diggy HQ, a proprietary operating platform for our growing mobile food franchise system.

Our long-term vision is simple:

Diggy HQ will be the single source of truth for everything Diggy and the primary tool our franchisees use to operate, market and grow their businesses.

We are looking for an experienced but cost-conscious individual developer or small team to build the first MVP and potentially continue developing the platform as our franchise system grows.

Platforms

We need:

* iOS mobile app
* Android mobile app
* Web-based administrative dashboard
* Central cloud database/backend

We prefer a cross-platform architecture such as Flutter, although we are open to recommendations.

MVP Functions

The first version should include:

Calendar & Events

* Book events
* Event calendar
* Assign trailers
* Event categories
* Scheduling conflict alerts

Customer CRM

* Business/organization
* Contact name
* Phone/email
* Event history
* Notes
* Follow-up reminders
* Repeat customer tracking

Employees

* Employee profiles
* Employee scheduling
* Event assignments
* Basic notifications

Sales Reporting

* Event sales
* Cash
* Credit card
* Hours
* Mix/batches used
* Sales per hour
* Sales per batch

Inventory

* Inventory quantities
* Usage
* Low-stock alerts
* Reorder levels
* Inventory variance

Dashboards

Franchisees see their own performance.

Diggy Corporate sees all franchisees, territories, trailers and system-wide performance.

Reporting

* Missing report alerts
* Historical records
* Audit trail for financial changes
* CSV/Excel data export

Future Vision

The MVP must be designed so Diggy HQ can eventually expand into:

* Automated marketing
* Social-media scheduling/posting
* Customer email/SMS automation
* AI business coaching
* AI marketing/content generation
* Training videos
* Operations manuals
* Searchable Diggy knowledge base
* Corporate/franchisee communication
* Recognition and motivation
* POS integration
* Accounting integration
* Employee timekeeping
* Advanced analytics
* Inventory ordering

These future capabilities are not part of the initial MVP unless separately quoted. We want an architecture that allows them to be added later without rebuilding the system.

Ownership

This is non-negotiable.

Diggy Donuts must own and control:

* 100% of source code
* Git repository
* Database and data
* Cloud/hosting accounts
* Apple/Google developer accounts
* Domains
* Design files
* Documentation
* API/integration credentials

Another qualified developer must be able to take over the project in the future.

What We Want From You

Please provide:

1. Your recommended technology stack and why
2. Examples of similar applications you personally built
3. Estimated MVP development time
4. Fixed-price MVP estimate
5. Milestone/payment breakdown
6. Estimated monthly hosting/technology costs
7. Post-launch maintenance cost
8. How you would structure the system for future AI and marketing integrations

We strongly prefer milestone-based development beginning with architecture and a clickable prototype.

Please begin your response with “DIGGY HQ” so we know you read the complete posting.

Our priority is not simply finding the lowest bidder. We are looking for a capable developer who understands the long-term vision, communicates well, builds clean/documented software, and can help us economically develop Diggy HQ as our franchise system grows.

items.title: Sourcing Agent / Supply Chain Specialist for Adult Novelty & Wellness Brand
items.description:
We are an established adult novelty and wellness brand looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Sourcing Agent / Supply Chain Specialist. In this role, you will take over existing supplier relationships, manage ongoing manufacturing and quality control, and actively source new reliable factory partners for our upcoming product lines.

Working Hours: While you may be based globally near manufacturing hubs, we require candidate availability with overlap during US Pacific Standard Time (PST) business hours for seamless team communication and updates.

If you are proactive, comfortable working in the adult novelty industry, and an expert in supplier communication, contract negotiation, and production tracking, we would love to work with you.
Key Responsibilities

 Manage Existing Suppliers: Serve as the primary point of contact for our current manufacturers. Oversee purchase orders, production timelines, and delivery schedules.

 New Product Sourcing: Identify, vet, and negotiate with new factories for high-quality adult novelty products, body-safe silicone items, electronic components, and custom packaging.

 Sample Management & Quality Control: Coordinate product samples, arrange pre-shipment inspections, and enforce strict quality assurance standards.

 Cost Negotiation & Terms: Negotiate competitive pricing and standard shipping or payment terms without compromising on quality or compliance.

 Organization & Logistics: Maintain an organized internal system tracking supplier directories, product specs, compliance certificates, and order statuses. Oversee freight forwarding coordination when needed.

Qualifications & Requirements

 Proven Experience: 3+ years as a sourcing agent, product manager, or supply chain specialist in e-commerce or consumer goods (experience in adult products, body-safe silicone, electronics, or personal care is a strong plus).

 Schedule Flexibility: Ability to maintain regular operational overlap with US PST business hours for syncs, team updates, and urgent communications.

 Industry Comfort: Fully comfortable communicating openly about and handling adult novelty products, body-safe materials, and intimate accessories.

 Supplier Vetting: Deep experience using factory directories and trade resources to vet compliant, reputable manufacturers.

 Languages: Native or fluent English. Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese (verbal and written) is strongly preferred.

 Organization: Exceptional organizational skills, high attention to detail, and proficiency with standard digital project management tools.

How to Apply

Please submit your proposal directly through the platform with the following:

 A brief introduction outlining your sourcing experience (highlight any experience with adult products, silicone, or wellness goods).

 Confirmation of your ability to work or overlap with US PST hours, along with your current time zone.

 Examples or brief case studies of factories or products you have sourced in the past.

 Your current location and weekly availability.

items.title: Looping Lottie Animation for App
items.description:
I'm looking for a motion designer to produce one looping Lottie animation for a mobile first-aid reference app aimed at farm and station workers in remote Australia. This first piece is for a clickable prototype we're using to apply for funding. If the application succeeds, the full build will need a series of animations in the same style, and whoever does this one well will be our first consideration for that work.

The scene - Breathing check part of DRSABCD flow

A simplified side-on view: an unresponsive adult lies on their back. A rescuer kneels beside them, one hand keeping the casualty's head tilted back and chin lifted. The rescuer's head is turned sideways - ear and cheek facing down toward the casualty's mouth, hovering above it - so that their eyes look along the casualty's body toward the chest and stomach. This posture is the clinically correct one and must be clear in the wide shot: the rescuer is not looking at the casualty's face. The casualty's chest and upper abdomen rise and fall in a slow, calm, normal breathing rhythm - one breath every 4 seconds - for the whole loop.

Camera and stages

12-second seamless loop, structured as a wide shot plus three zooms, one breath each. Camera moves are slow eases, never cuts:

Time
Shot
Cue (apricot)
0–2 s
Wide: whole scene, rescuer posture readable
-
2–5 s
Zoom to chest and stomach (LOOK)
soft filled highlight band sweeps up the chest and stomach as they rise
5–8 s
Zoom to the rescuer's ear over the mouth (LISTEN)
two or three curved sound-wave arcs pulse from the casualty's mouth/nose to the rescuer's ear
8–11 s
Zoom to the rescuer's cheek (FEEL)
a faint air-wisp drifts from the mouth/nose onto the cheek and fades
11–12 s
Ease back out to the wide shot, chest at rest, ready to loop
-

Each zoom should frame only what that cue is about, and the breathing motion must stay visible in every shot.

Look and feel
Flat 2D vector, 2–3 px rounded strokes, minimal shading, no gradients or textures. Calm and reassuring — the viewer is stressed and possibly in bright sunlight, so it must read instantly at about 120 px wide on a phone.
Both figures simplified and gender-neutral, no facial detail beyond what's needed to show the rescuer's ear and cheek in the close-ups, single flat mid-tan skin fill.
Light agricultural setting so it feels local: rescuer in a wide-brimmed bush hat (brim must not hide the ear/cheek in close-up — tilt it back or lift it) and long-sleeved work shirt; a low horizon behind with two or three simple props from — dry grass tufts, a wire fence with a single post, a distant windmill or water tank, the rear wheel of a ute or quad bike partly in frame. Thin low-opacity outlines only; context, not subject. The setting stays still apart from an optional very slow heat-shimmer or a single drifting dust mote in the wide shot.
Colours (exact)
Background: transparent (the screen behind is cream #FAF7F2)
All outlines (people, setting): #2C5537
Ground fill: flat red-brown #B5654A at 30–40% opacity — must not read as red
All animated cues (highlight band, arcs, wisp, labels): apricot #FAA966, full saturation, fading 0–100%. Apricot appears nowhere else so it always means "look here"
Secondary neutral for hat, shirt, fence: #6B625A
No red or orange-red anywhere — reserved in the app for emergency buttons
Technical spec
1:1, 400×400 px, 12 seconds, seamless loop returning to frame 0 (wide shot, chest at rest — we use frame 0 as the reduced-motion still)
Shape layers only — no raster images, no effects, no expressions; camera moves as parented null/transform animation
Target file size under ~80 KB; must play cleanly in lottie-web / dotLottie inside a PWA
Deliverables: .json (and .lottie if you can), the After Effects or source project file, and a PNG of frame 0. Full commercial rights to us.
What NOT to do

This is an assessment animation only. No chest compressions, no mouth-to-mouth, no signs of distress. Nothing on the casualty's head or chest other than the breathing and the LOOK cue. No text other than the LOOK / LISTEN / FEEL labels, and no other medical wording.

Process

Please send a still style frame of the wide shot first so we can confirm the rescuer's posture and the look before you animate. I'd expect one round of revisions after the first animated draft.

If you have character based Lottie work in your portfolio, especially anything flat-vector, instructional or medical - please include a link. Happy to answer questions before you quote.

items.title: n8n + OpenAI Developer Needed: AI Customer Service Automation for Shopify / LiveAgent
items.description:
We run an established e-commerce business and want to automate a significant portion of customer service using AI while keeping our existing LiveAgent help desk and Shopify store. We are looking for an experienced n8n/OpenAI automation developer to build a production-ready Phase 1 system—not just a chatbot demo.
The workflow should receive/read LiveAgent tickets, classify the request, retrieve relevant answers from our product manuals/policies/website knowledge base, look up Shopify order information when needed, draft a customer response, and either route it for human approval or automatically send only approved low-risk reply types.
We want the system built with n8n + OpenAI API + Shopify Admin API + LiveAgent API/MCP where appropriate. We prefer n8n Community Edition/self-hosting to keep recurring costs low. Shopify must be read-only in Phase 1.
Initial automation examples include order status/tracking, manuals/instruction links, documented product specifications, basic compatibility questions, published policies, and simple well-documented setup questions. Refunds, cancellations, warranty approvals, replacements, safety questions, ambiguous technical support, and low-confidence cases must go to a human.
Deliverables must include the working workflows, exported n8n JSON, error handling, 15–20 test cases, documentation showing how to maintain/update the system, and a handoff session. All accounts and credentials must remain owned by us; the finished system cannot depend on the freelancer’s personal accounts.
We have a large historical customer-service email archive, but full historical-email processing is not part of the first milestone. The architecture should allow a curated historical Q&A/troubleshooting knowledge base to be added later.
Required experience
•	n8n production workflow automation
•	OpenAI API / AI agents / RAG or vector search
•	Shopify API / GraphQL
•	REST APIs and webhooks
•	Reliable error handling and human-in-the-loop automation
•	JavaScript or Python when needed
To apply, please answer these questions:
1. Please send a screenshot and/or short video of an n8n AI automation you personally built. Explain what you built yourself.
2. Describe one production workflow where an AI model retrieved data from an external API before answering or acting.
3. How would you prevent this system from hallucinating order status, product specifications, or warranty information?
4. How would you structure the LiveAgent → n8n → OpenAI → Shopify flow?
5. How would you implement human approval first and later enable auto-replies only for selected ticket categories?
6. Have you implemented OpenAI File Search, another vector database, or a RAG knowledge base? Which would you use here and why?
7. Can you complete the Phase 1 scope for a fixed price? State your price and expected deliverables.
Budget: We prefer a fixed-price proposal. Expected range for Phase 1 is approximately $600–$1,000 depending on demonstrated experience and proposed architecture. Please quote the complete Phase 1 scope rather than an artificially low starting price.

items.title: Lead Generation & Client Outreach Specialist for Career Services
items.description:
I run a career-services business that helps job seekers with:

Professional resume/CV writing
Cover letters
LinkedIn profile optimisation
Job-search support and guidance

I’m looking for a reliable freelancer who can help me identify and professionally reach out to genuine job seekers or professionals who may be interested in these services.

This will begin as a small paid trial. If the work is high quality and the process works well, there may be an opportunity for ongoing work. And could also go long term

What I need you to do
Research and identify relevant job seekers/professionals who may genuinely benefit from career services.
Find prospects through appropriate public or professional channels.
Assess whether each person is genuinely relevant before contacting them.
Send respectful, personalised outreach rather than generic spam.
Explain that you work with a career-services professional who provides resume/CV writing, cover-letter, LinkedIn optimisation and job-search support.
Do not pretend to be me or misrepresent who you work for.
Do not make false promises or guarantee that someone will get a job.
Do not spam people.
Do not use purchased, fake or scraped contact lists.
Keep a clear record of prospects contacted, the outreach sent, responses and follow-up status.
What counts as a qualified prospect?

I am looking for quality rather than a large number of names or contact details.

A qualified prospect should:

Be relevant to the career services I provide.
Have been contacted appropriately and respectfully.
Have shown genuine interest in learning more about the services.
Have given permission to be introduced to me.

Simply finding someone's email address or social-media profile does not count as a qualified lead.

The freelancer is not expected to guarantee that a prospect will purchase. Your responsibility is to find relevant people, conduct appropriate outreach, qualify genuine interest and facilitate the introduction.

How communication and introductions should work

All communication between you and me before the contract and during the project should take place through Upwork.

When a prospect responds positively:

Record the prospect and their response in the agreed tracking system.

items.title: Monitoring Service Testing
items.description:
ABOUT THE PRODUCT
PingForce is a SaaS network monitoring platform with two features:
- Monitor Feature: continuous uptime monitoring of websites, APIs, ports and ping targets, with incidents, alerts and status pages.
- Ping Feature: on-demand ping and traceroute tests run from a global network of probes, plus the option for customers to install their own probe on a Linux server.

We need an experienced manual tester to do a full end-to-end pass on our staging environment and report everything that is broken, confusing or inconsistent.

WHAT YOU'LL TEST
1. Accounts: sign up, email verification, login, password reset, phone verification, team member invites, account settings. If you ever receive a duplicate verification email, capture the DevTools Network tab when it happens.
2. Plans and billing: upgrade/downgrade with Stripe test cards (provided). Check that plan limits shown in the app match what it actually enforces.
3. Monitor Feature: create, edit, pause, resume and delete every monitor type (HTTP/HTTPS, Keyword, Ping, Port, Threshold). Exercise the options: HTTP methods, headers, auth, request body, status codes, redirects, intervals. Include targets that are down, slow or have bad SSL.
4. Incidents and alerts: incidents open and close correctly; alerts arrive by email, Slack, Microsoft Teams and webhook (SMS: a few tests only).
5. Status pages and maintenance windows.
6. Ping Feature: ping and traceroute tests across multiple probes, test settings, WHOIS/IRR/RPKI lookups, share links, JSON/CSV exports. Check that reports agree with themselves (counts, locations, times).
7. Bring-your-own probe: install a probe on your own Linux VPS or Raspberry Pi using our install flow, then remove it. (Preferred, not required.)
8. Input validation: empty, malformed, oversized and odd inputs in every form.
9. Browsers: latest Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, plus one iPhone and one Android phone.

LIMITS
- Use up to 25 monitors.
- Only test against targets you own or well-known public test endpoints (httpbin.org, badssl.com, etc.).
- Light/dark theme issues are already known. Skip them.

DELIVERABLES
- Google Sheet bug log, one row per issue: ID, Area, Priority, Title, Steps to Reproduce, Expected, Actual, Test Data Used, Browser/Device, Screenshot or Video link.
  Priority: P0 = blocks a core task or shows wrong data; P1 = broken but has a workaround; P2 = cosmetic/minor.
- Final summary: your top 5 issues and your honest first-time-user impression.
- A 2-3 line progress update in Upwork messages each day you work.

REQUIREMENTS
- 3+ years manual QA on web apps; SaaS experience strongly preferred
- Comfortable with browser DevTools (Network tab, Console errors)
- Basic networking knowledge: ping, traceroute, DNS, HTTP status codes
- Can SSH into a Linux server (for the probe install)
- Clear written English and reproducible bug reports

ENGAGEMENT
- Estimated 15-25 hours, completed within 7-10 days
- Test accounts and the staging URL are provided after hire
- Paid trial first: about 2 hours on accounts/sign-up. If the reports are solid, we continue.

TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE
1. Paste one real bug report you have written (redact client details).
2. A monitor shows "Up" but the site is actually returning an error page. Name two things you would check.
3. Have you installed software on a Linux server over SSH? Briefly describe.
4. Which browsers and devices do you have available?
Start your proposal with the word TRACEROUTE so I know you read the whole post.

1. What Shopify can do natively.
2. What requires an app.
3. What requires custom coding.

22. How will you transfer ownership and credentials to us?

24. What support is included after launch?

items.title: Subject: Schematic and PCB Layout for an Automotive Signal Injector (100% PTH)
items.description:
Project Description:
I need a professional schematic design and PCB layout for an Automotive Synchronization Signal Injector (simulating Crankshaft/CKP and Camshaft/CMP sensors). The project is a modified/upgraded version of a classic circuit (WR Kits ECU 2.0) but migrated to a new microcontroller and adding Bluetooth connectivity.
Key Requirements:
1. Components Technology: 100% PTH (Pin Through-Hole) for manual soldering. No SMD components.
2. Main MCU: PIC18F46K22 (DIP-40 package). Please include a footprint for a DIP-40 socket.
3. Bluetooth Module: Include a female pin header socket (4 or 6 pins) for a standard HC-05 Bluetooth Module.
4. Bluetooth Power & Logic:
	• Add a dedicated 3.3V Linear Regulator (e.g., LF33CV or LM1117-3.3v in TO-220 package) fed by the 5V line to power the Bluetooth module safely.
	• Include a resistive voltage divider (1kΩ resistor in series and 2.2kΩ resistor to GND) on the line coming from the PIC’s RC6/TX1 (Pin 25) to the HC-05 RXD pin to drop the 5V logic to 3.3V.
	• The HC-05 TXD pin connects directly to the PIC’s RC7/RX1 (Pin 26).
5. Clock & Reset: 16 MHz Crystal Oscillator (PTH) placed as close as possible to pins 13 (OSC1) and 14 (OSC2) of the PIC, with two 22pF ceramic capacitors to GND. Include a 10kΩ pull-up resistor from MCLR (Pin 1) to +5V, and a tactile reset switch shorting MCLR to GND.
6. Analog/Inductive Signal Stage (Based on WR Kits):
	• Keep the dual-rail power supply circuit using an ICL7660 charge pump to generate +5V and -5V.
	• Use two NE5532 operational amplifiers (DIP-8) to filter and shape the analog/inductive (sine wave) signals.
	• Include a 5V Dual Relay to switch the outputs physically between Hall (0-5V digital square wave) and Inductive (analog sine wave) modes.
7. In-Circuit Programming: Include a dedicated 5-pin linear header (2.54mm pitch) for ICSP programming connected to: MCLR (Pin 1), VDD (Pin 11), VSS (Pin 12), PGD (Pin 40), and PGC (Pin 39).
8. Robustness & Traces: This board operates in a harsh automotive environment. Power tracks (12V, 5V, -5V, GND) and signal output tracks must be wide (at least 1.0mm to 1.5mm) with a solid ground plane to handle noise and transients.
Deliverables Expected:
• Complete Schematic (PDF)
• Gerber files for manufacturing (with clear silkscreen labels for manual soldering)
• Bill of Materials (BOM)
• 3D view render of the board (Optional but preferred)

items.title: German Children’s Song Localization & Vocal Production Specialist
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced German music localization professional to localize children’s songs for an established preschool music brand.

This is not a standard translation job. We need complete German song localization and vocal production.

For each song, we will provide:

* Original lyrics and their meaning/context
* Original instrumental track
* Original vocal/reference track
* Original video for context

We are looking for someone who can provide:

* Native-level German lyric adaptation
* Singable German lyrics that fit the existing melody, rhythm, syllable structure and phrasing
* Natural, age-appropriate language for preschool children
* Professional native German singing vocals
* Vocal direction, recording and editing
* Final vocal mix over our existing instrumental

The original melody, arrangement, tempo and overall musical structure must remain unchanged.

We are looking for professional-quality localization — the German version should feel as though the song was originally written and produced in German, rather than translated from another language.

We would initially like to produce a small paid test/pilot. If the quality is right, this can become a long-term collaboration covering approximately 60 songs, with a regular production volume of around 4–6 songs per month.

Experience in children’s music, animation, dubbing, musical localization or German song adaptation is highly preferred.

Please send us:

* Relevant examples of German songs you have localized/produced
* Details about your vocalists and recording setup
* Your price per completed song
* Your pricing for ongoing volume production

We are particularly interested in professionals or small teams who can handle the entire process from German lyric adaptation through final German vocal production.

items.description:
AutoCAD Residential Drafter – Reorganize & Update Existing Drawing Set
Seeking an experienced AutoCAD residential drafter to reorganize and clean up an existing drawing set for an approximately 1,000 sq. ft. residential remodel.
Most drawings already exist in DWG/PDF format and original as-built information and do not need to be redrawn from scratch.
Work includes:
•	Move existing plans, elevations, foundation drawings, schedules and details to the appropriate new sheets/layouts
•	Relabel and clean up existing drawings
•	Make provided minor edits/corrections
•	Implement provided CAD standards, including layers, ByLayer properties, working colors and lineweights

•	Plot using monochrome.ctb

Final delivery: PDF drawing set, fully editable DWGs and complete AutoCAD eTransmit package.
Experience with U.S. residential construction drawings is required; California experience is preferred.
Please provide your AutoCAD version and an example of a U.S. residential drawing set you personally prepared.
Fixed-price/project pricing preferred. Before agreeing on the fixed price, I will provide selected candidates with additional screenshots, sample drawings and project information so the scope can be reviewed and priced accurately.

items.title: Seeking a long-term short-form video editor for photography content
items.description:
Seeking a long-term short-form video editor for photography content.

For each session or elopement, I will provide the full final photo gallery along with behind-the-scenes video footage. Your job would be to turn that material into polished TikTok/Reels-style videos that combine the BTS footage with the finished photographs.

BTS footage may come from multiple sources, most commonly Insta360 cameras or Meta glasses, with occasional cellphone footage. You should be comfortable working with mixed footage sources, different aspect ratios, stabilization needs, reframing, and basic color/exposure matching as needed.

I am looking for BTS-style storytelling that shows what the session actually felt like, not just a montage of pretty clips. The content should showcase my personality, how I interact with clients, my photography style, and the overall experience clients receive when working with me.

Hooks, concepts, and captions can be provided, but the ability to recognize strong moments in the footage and develop your own hooks, video ideas, on-screen text, and captions based on the content is a major plus.

A key part of the format is incorporating finished photographs into the BTS footage, including showing images at or around the moment it was created.

This would be ongoing work across sessions, proposals, engagements, and elopements. I am looking for someone who can learn my content style over time and eventually require very little direction from me.

Please include examples of short-form storytelling edits you have created, especially content that combines BTS footage with finished photography or highlights the personality and client experience behind a brand.

We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented TikTok creator based in Slovakia to manage daily slideshow content for our mobile app.

Experience with ATS, HRIS, payroll, or onboarding systems.

items.title: Interior Designer for New House
items.description:
We’re looking for an interior designer to help create a cohesive look and feel for the interior of our new home in Seattle. The project includes planning the overall design direction, selecting finishes, and developing a clear vision that brings the space together. We want someone who can guide the process, make thoughtful recommendations, and help us achieve a polished, functional interior that reflects our style and needs.

We're a family of four (two girls under 2) and a dog moving into an updated mid-century modern home in Seattle, about 2,440 sq ft across two levels, with partial lake views and lots of trees. We're installing a new kitchen (design provided) and refinishing the wood with a lighter oak stain. We need a cohesive whole-house design so every room feels intentional. Move-in is November 15 and we know finding pieces takes time and what to have thoughtful and meaningful pieces too - so don't need to rush the process but at least want to have main pieces and the layout done before moving in. 

Furnishing budget is limited: mostly mass-market brands (IKEA, West Elm, Article, CB2, 
Crate and Barrel, Arhaus (for select items, Target, etc.) with a few select bespoke or vintage statement pieces. Also open to FB marketplace and open to finding cool new objects and decor via Instagram too. 

Style direction
Earthy, neutral base with pops of rich color and texture throughout
Wood, metals, and retro touches (we love music: vinyl, records) that feel modern and fresh, not a period piece
Bring the outdoors in (trees, lake) - want to have the house feel seamless with nature 
Comfort is non-negotiable. Beautiful seating, bedding, etc. that we can actually sink into and live on, and that's durable with kids
Lighting is a top priority: layered floor lamps, sconces, and table lamps throughout
Love ceramic, and textures - love velvet, chenille
Need to think of ways to integrate the kids into the space while making their rooms and the den downstairs designated play areas

Main floor (Phase 1)
- Open living, dining, kitchen, and breakfast nook: must complement the new kitchen and flow as one space
- Living room: optimized for hosting and conversation; kid-friendly without toy clutter (hidden storage is a must), thinking we put a buffet table against one of the wall there for hosting
- Dining: expandable table, with room to add a second table side by side for large dinners, no room for anything really but a table and chairs and rug 
- Primary bedroom
- Nursery: may convert to a temporary office later, so design flexibly
- Toddler girl's room
- Two bathrooms: we're keeping existing tile and fixtures and need to elevate them with paint, hardware, towels, rugs, mirrors, and lighting
- Two hallways and a short entryway

Lower level
Den (TV and playroom): we have an existing L-sectional that may be too large. Assess the fit, then source rugs and kids' storage and design the layout.
Guest room: make it feel like a boutique hotel. We have a king bed and IKEA Hemnes nightstands to keep. Elevate it with lighting, bedding, rugs, and art.
Small bathroom: light-touch refresh only (it will be fully remodeled later), so keep spend minimal

Deliverables
Whole-home concept and palette (paint colors with brands and codes)
Room-by-room mood boards and 2D furniture layouts to scale
Shoppable sourcing list with links, prices, and budget or splurge options
Lighting plan per room
Phased purchase priority list (what to buy first and longest lead times for delivery)

this is the house: https://www.redfin.com/WA/Seattle/6425-Hampton-Rd-S-98118/home/489290
Floors and kitchen will change. once we decide to work together, we'll send more photos of the space.

items.title: Kalshi Bitcoin Trading Bot
items.description:
I’m looking for an experienced Python developer to build a fully automated Bitcoin trading bot for Kalshi’s 15-minute BTC Up/Down markets.

Trading Strategy:

Exactly 2 minutes and 31 seconds into each 15-minute market (12:29 remaining), the bot checks Bitcoin’s current price against that market’s official opening reference price.

* If Bitcoin is $15 or more ABOVE the opening price, bet UP.
* If Bitcoin is $15 or more BELOW the opening price, bet DOWN.
* If Bitcoin has moved LESS than $15 in either direction, SKIP that market entirely.
* Only execute one trade per eligible 15-minute market.
* Do not enter late if the conditions aren’t met at the specified time.

Bot Requirements:

* Operate automatically 24/7.
* Use Kalshi’s official API and reference price data.
* Allow adjustable bet sizes and risk limits.
* Account for fees, spreads, slippage, and liquidity.
* Prevent duplicate trades.
* Include historical backtesting and paper trading.
* Track profits, losses, win rates, and performance.

Exactly 2 minutes and 31 seconds into each 15-minute market (12:29 remaining), the bot checks Bitcoin’s current price against that market’s official opening reference price.

* If Bitcoin is $15 or more ABOVE the opening price, bet UP.
* If Bitcoin is $15 or more BELOW the opening price, bet DOWN.
* If Bitcoin has moved LESS than $15 in either direction, SKIP that market entirely.

items.title: Video Editor
items.description:
We are seeking an experienced individual video editor to support an ongoing healthcare podcast, video, and social media program.

This role is for the person who will personally perform the editing work. We are not looking for agencies, teams, account managers, or freelancers who subcontract editing to others.

You should be comfortable editing full-length multi-camera podcast episodes and turning long-form conversations into polished short-form social content.

Responsibilities:

Podcast & Long-Form Video
- Edit full-length podcast episodes from raw footage through final delivery.
- Synchronize multi-camera footage with externally recorded audio.
- Edit conversations for pacing, clarity, and flow while preserving intended meaning.
- Perform audio cleanup, leveling, synchronization, and quality control.
- Apply consistent color correction and branded visual elements.
- Review final exports for audio, video, captions, branding, and synchronization.

Short-Form & Social Content
- Identify strong moments from long-form content and turn them into short-form videos.
- Edit for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms.
- Create accurate, professionally formatted captions.
- Adapt pacing, framing, aspect ratios, graphics, and calls to action by platform.
- Maintain a consistent visual and editorial standard.

Production & Quality Control
- Preserve clinical accuracy and intended meaning in physician, guest, and educational content.
- Apply feedback accurately and efficiently.
- Maintain organized project files, assets, exports, and version control.
- Provide complete editable project files and associated assets.
- Manage multiple deliverables and communicate early if an issue may affect timing.

Qualifications
- 3+ years of professional video editing or post-production experience.
- Strong experience editing podcasts, interviews, educational content, or similar dialogue-driven video.
- Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable professional software.
- Strong multi-camera, audio cleanup, synchronization, color correction, and captioning skills.
- Experience producing both long-form and short-form content.
- Excellent attention to detail and reliable follow-through.
- Healthcare, science, education, or professional-services experience is a plus.

Engagement
This is an ongoing freelance opportunity based on production needs, performance, and project volume.

Compensation will depend on experience, portfolio quality, and scope of work.

When applying, please include:
- Examples of long-form podcast or interview edits.
- Examples of short-form content you personally edited.
- Your primary editing software.
- Your typical turnaround time for a 45–60 minute multi-camera podcast episode.
- Confirmation that you personally perform all editing work and do not subcontract it.
- Confirmation that you can provide organized, editable project files upon completion.

Please apply only if you are the editor who will personally complete the work. Agencies, teams, and subcontracted arrangements will not be considered.

items.title: Blockchain/Web3 Data & National Market Research Specialist (Barbados)
items.description:
About BlockData Consultants

BlockData Consultants is a blockchain analytics and compliance consultancy. We help AML providers, financial institutions and investigators understand how crypto moves through regional markets, so illicit activity can be spotted and traced. We're building a network of on-the-ground specialists to deepen our coverage of key jurisdictions.

The Role

We're looking for two specialists based in Barbados to map the local crypto ecosystem and turn public information into structured, usable intelligence. It's project-based and remote, with an expected engagement of around 12 months, and suits students or professionals who want real exposure to blockchain investigations. It can count as practicum or internship credit, subject to your university's approval.

What You'll Do

- Ecosystem mapping: Track the exchanges and digital asset businesses active in Barbados (and whether they're licensed under the Digital Assets Business Act), P2P and OTC activity, crypto ATMs, community channels, and the fiat on/off-ramps people use, such as mobile money apps and bank transfers.
- Regulatory tracking: Summarise public developments from the Central Bank of Barbados, the Financial Services Commission (FSC) and the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), including digital asset licensing and AML/CFT obligations.
- Market intelligence: Identify local influencers, forums, Telegram and WhatsApp groups, and the narratives driving adoption and risk, such as remittances, international business activity and stablecoin use.
- OSINT sourcing: Collect open-source data in Google Sheets, with a source link and a short reliability note for every entry.
- Reporting: Deliver short, actionable summaries and datasets our tracing team can use straight away.

Requirements

- Based in Barbados, with fluent English
- Spanish is not required, but it's a plus
- Some awareness of or familiarity with the blockchain and crypto industry is helpful, but not essential
- Comfortable with online research and Google Sheets
- Self-directed and reliable with deadlines
- University students are welcome to apply
- Knowledge of crypto markets in neighbouring Caribbean countries, or the ability to research other jurisdictions, is a plus
- Additional languages are a plus
- Nice to have: familiarity with Central Bank of Barbados/FSC public materials, knowledge of local P2P and exchange mechanics, or a background in AML/compliance

What We Offer

- Flexible remote work, 10–20 hrs/week, project-based
- Hourly or project pay, depending on location and experience
- Training, mentorship and exposure to real Web3 investigations
- A path into broader tracing and research work

items.title: Facebook & Instagram Lead Generation VA – Luxury Auto Buyers
items.description:
We are looking for a reliable, motivated Facebook/Instagram Lead Generation Virtual Assistant to help generate vehicle-seller leads for WeBuyLuxuryAuto.com.
This is a hands-on outreach position. We are starting manually, measuring results, and plan to scale the system significantly once we determine what works.
Your primary responsibility will be finding people who are interested in selling luxury, exotic, performance, and high-value vehicles.
Daily responsibilities will include:
- Search Facebook Marketplace for luxury/high-value vehicles being sold by owners
- Identify relevant Facebook Groups and participate according to group rules
- Find public posts/comments from people considering selling their vehicles
- Send personalized Facebook/Instagram messages to prospective sellers where appropriate
- Respond to interested prospects and gather basic vehicle/contact information
- Create and publish approved posts on Facebook Pages, Groups, and Instagram
- Follow up with people who express interest
- Submit qualified/interested prospects through our website, WeBuyLuxuryAuto.com
- Record the original Facebook/Instagram source or listing URL
- Maintain a simple daily activity/results report
We are not looking for spam, fake accounts, fake listings, bots, or mass copy/paste messaging. We want real conversations with real vehicle owners.
Vehicles
Examples include Porsche, Mercedes-Benz/AMG, BMW/M, Range Rover, Cadillac Escalade, Corvette, Audi, Bentley, Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Aston Martin and similar vehicles.
Ideal Freelancer
You should have experience with Facebook Marketplace, Facebook Groups, Instagram, Messenger, lead generation, appointment setting, or social-media prospecting.
Good written English is important. You should be comfortable starting conversations and following simple scripts while still sounding like a real person.
This can become a long-term position. We will initially hire one person, test the process, and increase hours/team size if the economics work.
When applying, please tell me:
1. Your hourly rate
2. Country/time zone
3. Facebook/Instagram lead-generation experience
4. Marketplace experience
5. How many hours per week you can work
6. Briefly explain how you would find our first 10 vehicle sellers

The initial engagement begins with a 2–3-hour technical walkthrough. Following the handoff, you will document the environment, perform scheduled rotations, and establish procedures another qualified engineer can maintain independently.

Responsibilities
Review the existing infrastructure, credential rotation procedures, and deployment workflows.
Inventory approximately ten keys and credentials, including their dependencies and rotation schedules.

items.title: Autonomous French-speaking Social Media Manager, full time, online drawing courses
items.description:
Dessindigo is an online drawing and painting course platform. Courses are in French, with subtitles in other languages. We are looking for a French-speaking Social Media Manager, full time (40 hours a week, long term), to run Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and Facebook. Written French must be flawless: all content is published in French.

You have nothing to film. We have hundreds of hours of courses, masterclasses and behind-the-scenes footage. Your job is to select, cut, edit and repurpose: one source piece becomes a Reel, a TikTok, a Short, a carousel, stories and Pinterest pins. You find the hooks, write the captions and calls to action, schedule in Metricool, publish, answer comments, and every Friday you report with numbers: clicks, newsletter signups, linktree clicks, sales.

The role is autonomous. Content is validated only at the very beginning. After that you decide the topics and the calendar, and you propose what to change when the numbers do not follow. If you expect to be told what to do every morning, this role is not for you.

What you must be able to do on your own:
- edit a vertical video
- add subtitles with good pacing in CapCut or Premiere
- create clean visuals in Canva
- write French without a single mistake
- produce AI voice-overs
- read statistics and turn them into a decision
- answer comments and engage the community

A link published without UTM, a spelling mistake or an AI-generated image are three things we do not accept: our audience is made of artists, they spot AI instantly.

Expected pace at cruising speed: one video a day repurposed on three platforms, two carousels a week, stories every day, five to eight Pinterest pins a day. It is a lot, and it is doable full time with good batch organisation.

Process: a 40-minute written questionnaire, then a paid 2-hour practical test based on one of our videos, then an hourly contract with time tracking and a fixed monthly fee after the first month. Start as soon as possible.

Please answer the screening questions in French.

items.title: Research verified decision-maker contacts for a real estate fund
items.description:
About the job
I'm a commercial real estate owner in Spain. I'm preparing outreach to a short list of companies and need someone to find and verify the right decision-maker at each one. You will not contact anyone. This is research only.

What you'll do
I'll share a spreadsheet of 30 target companies (hospital groups, veterinary groups, diagnostic imaging providers, gym operators and real estate advisors). For each company you will find:

The person most likely to decide on new premises (head of expansion, real estate, property or business development; for agents, the head of healthcare or retail advisory). Give their name and exact job title.
Whether they are based in Spain, or are the Iberia or Spain lead.
A direct phone number if findable, plus the main switchboard.
A work email, verified with a verification tool (Hunter, NeverBounce or similar). Mark it Verified, Pattern-guess or Not found.
Their LinkedIn URL, where you found the information (link or tool), and the date.

Rules that matter most

"Not found" is an acceptable answer. A guessed answer is not. The spreadsheet already contains unverified names and emails from an earlier list. Some are wrong. Check them, don't copy them.
If the named person has left, find the current one.
Use only public and professional sources.
Treat everything I share as confidential. Do not contact anyone, and do not mention this project to any company or third party.
Work in the amber columns only. Don't change anything else.

items.title: K-Beauty Expo Korea – Sourcing Representative
items.description:
Hello,

We are looking for a motivated and knowledgeable **Sourcing Representative** to attend K-Beauty Expo Korea in Goyang and identify promising Korean beauty brands, manufacturers, and products for potential sourcing and business partnerships.

The ideal candidate has a strong interest in **K-Beauty, cosmetics, skincare, beauty devices, or consumer products** and is comfortable approaching exhibitors, asking questions, collecting business information, and identifying products with strong commercial potential.

Key Responsibilities

* Attend K-Beauty Expo Korea in Goyang and actively engage with exhibitors.
* Identify Korean beauty brands, manufacturers, OEM/ODM companies, and emerging products.
* Research and evaluate products based on quality, innovation, pricing, packaging, and market potential.
* Speak with brand representatives and collect:

 * Company and contact information
 * Product catalogs and samples
 * Wholesale/MOQ information
 * OEM/ODM capabilities
 * Pricing and distribution terms
 * Export experience and target markets
* Take photos and notes of relevant products and booths.
* Identify products that may be suitable for international distribution, retail, e-commerce, or private-label opportunities.
* Maintain an organized sourcing spreadsheet/database with all relevant information.
* Provide a post-event report summarizing the most promising sourcing opportunities.
* Follow up with selected exhibitors when requested.

Ideal Candidate

* Strong interest in Korean beauty and consumer products.
* Familiarity with **K-Beauty trends, skincare, cosmetics, or beauty brands**.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable initiating conversations with exhibitors and business owners.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Able to evaluate products from a commercial and sourcing perspective.
* Fluent English is required; **Korean language ability is a strong advantage**.
* Previous experience in sourcing, purchasing, merchandising, sales, importing, exporting, or trade shows is preferred.
* Must be comfortable walking and working on the exhibition floor for extended periods.

 What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who can identify **lesser-known Korean brands and manufacturers with international growth potential**, rather than simply focusing on established brands.

Experience identifying **OEM/ODM manufacturers, private-label opportunities, innovative skincare ingredients, beauty devices, packaging solutions, and emerging K-Beauty trends** is highly desirable.

 Deliverables

The successful candidate will be expected to provide:

1. A list of qualified brands/manufacturers contacted.
2. Contact names and business information.
3. Product catalogs, pricing, MOQ, and sourcing information where available.
4. Photos and notes from relevant booths/products.
5. A shortlist of the most promising sourcing opportunities.
6. A concise post-expo sourcing report.

Compensation

Compensation: $250

Additional compensation for exceptional sourcing leads or successfully qualified supplier opportunities may be considered.

How to Apply

Please send:

* Resume or brief professional profile
* Relevant sourcing, beauty, retail, or trade-show experience
* Korean/English language proficiency
* Availability during K-Beauty Expo Korea
* Your proposed daily rate or project fee
* A short explanation of why you are a good fit for this sourcing assignment

items.title: PCB Engineer for a wearable gadget prototyping with UWB and BLE Technology
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced PCB (Printed Circuit Board) Engineer for our next generation start up project. We will be focusing on the development of prototypes for state-of-the-art wearable gadgets that use technologies such as Ultra-Wideband (UWB), Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and the ability to achieve optimized pairing of gadgets using both technologies. We have already developed the PRD (product requirement document) and also have the preliminary designs for the product. We are looking for a talented individual who shares our passion for creating groundbreaking products that enhance people's lives through technology.

As a PCB Engineer, you will play a critical role in the entire product development lifecycle, from finalizing initial components to prototype testing and refinement. The ideal candidate will possess a robust background in electronic design principles, with specific experience in the rapidly evolving field of wearable technology. You should be well-versed in industry-standard design tools and methodologies, capable of producing high-quality schematics and layouts that meet the unique requirements of wearable devices. We will require our product to meet the FCC certification standards.

In this position, your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

1. Development: Creating detailed schematics and layouts for PCB designs that incorporate UWB and BLE technologies, ensuring that all designs meet performance specifications and regulatory requirements.

2. Prototyping: Constructing and assembling prototypes to test and validate the functionality of the designs. This includes troubleshooting any issues that arise during the testing phase and making necessary adjustments to optimize performance.

3. Documentation: Maintaining thorough documentation of design processes, revisions, and test results to ensure clarity and facilitate future iterations of the product.

5. Innovative contribution: Contributing innovative ideas that can lead to a product with better features and improvements.

6. Problem-Solving: Utilizing strong analytical skills and creative thinking to troubleshoot any technological setbacks and develop effective solutions that align with project timelines and objectives.

The ideal candidate will have a degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field, along with a proven track record in PCB design, especially within the wearable tech sector. Proficiency in relevant design software, such as Altium Designer or Eagle, is highly desirable. 

If you are passionate about cutting-edge technology, thrive in a collaborative environment, and possess a keen ability for problem-solving, we want to hear from you! Join us in our mission to create innovative wearable gadgets that redefine how technology integrates into our daily lives. Apply today and become part of a team that values creativity, innovation, and excellence in engineering.

items.title: Google Sheets Dashboard and Form Development
items.description:
I'm looking to develop a streamlined, reusable client check-in system, preferably in Google Sheets, although I'm open to other solutions.

My PRIMARY objective is to create a shared, ongoing coaching record that serves as the weekly conversation between myself and each client, eliminating the need to separately document nutrition prescriptions, weekly goals, coaching recommendations, and client progress in another chart.

Each 12-week section should display consecutive weeks in one continuous, easily navigable view. Every week contains three components:

Coach's Plan: Nutrition prescription (or meal plan PDF), individualized action goals, and instructions.

Client Check-In: Progress data, adherence, biofeedback, wins, struggles, and reflection questions.

Coach's Response: What to keep, adjust, and focus on moving forward.

Both coach and client should be able to easily scroll through previous weeks and reference the complete coaching history without opening separate forms or records.

I'd also like a simple Progress Dashboard that automatically pulls relevant weekly data into useful averages, trends, and visualizations, along with a private Master Coach Dashboard to monitor check-in submissions across clients.

Additional functionality such as repeating a previous week's plan, jump-to-week navigation, dropdowns, and automated calculations would be helpful.

My priorities are ease of use, an attractive/intuitive design, minimal duplicate documentation, and preservation of the entire coaching conversation. I'm willing to simplify more complex automations to achieve this without unnecessarily increasing development costs.

My clients already use a separate coaching application for workouts and daily activities. This is specifically intended to streamline our weekly coaching communication and documentation—not replace that application.

items.title: Recreate Existing Café Brand Identity as Professional Vector / EPS Artwork
items.description:
I am looking for an experienced graphic designer / vector illustrator to professionally recreate an existing café branding concept for Taste Texture.
This is NOT a new logo design project.
The visual direction has already been developed and reference images will be supplied. I need the designs professionally redrawn from scratch in Adobe Illustrator as clean, accurate, production-ready vector artwork.
The brand uses:
White + Golden Yellow + Black
Main brand elements:
- TASTE TEXTURE primary wordmark
- TT monogram/icon
- “FLAVOUR WITH A POINT OF VIEW.”
- “YOUR LOCAL. SINCE 2021.”
- Drip graphic elements
- Simple food/mascot illustration where required
- Repeating TT / drip pattern for greaseproof paper
- Supporting typography and colour specifications
Required deliverables
1. Primary Taste Texture logo
2. Horizontal and stacked versions
3. TT monogram separately
4. Black, white and golden-yellow logo versions
5. Drip artwork separately
6. Mascot/illustration separately
7. Repeat pattern artwork
8. Round sticker artwork
9. Coffee cup branding artwork
10. Sandwich bag branding
11. Greaseproof/sandwich wrapping paper artwork
12. Large Uber-style takeaway paper bag artwork — no handles
13. Colour palette with CMYK / RGB / HEX and suitable Pantone references
14. Typography specification
Final files required:
AI, EPS, SVG, vector PDF and transparent PNG
Production requirements
- Artwork must be genuine vector artwork
- Do NOT simply place or embed the supplied JPEG/PNG inside an EPS file
- Do NOT use basic automatic image tracing as the finished artwork
- Wordmark should be carefully recreated/redrawn so all letters are consistent
- Fonts to be identified where possible and converted to outlines in production files
- All artwork must remain editable in Adobe Illustrator
- CMYK colour setup for printing
- Separate organised layers for logo, typography, patterns and illustration
- Packaging artwork will later be placed onto supplier dielines
- Full source files and commercial usage rights required upon completion
I will provide the existing branding reference image showing exactly the style and direction I want.
Please do not redesign the brand into something completely different. The objective is to professionally reproduce and refine the supplied concept.
When bidding, please send examples of previous vector logo recreation, brand identity or packaging artwork.
Please start your proposal with “YELLOW TT” so I know you have read the brief.
