items.title: Experienced Architectural CAD Designer — Commercial Building Elevations and City Review Corrections
items.description:
We are developing a commercial storage/industrial project in Greeley, Colorado, and need an experienced architectural CAD professional to complete accurate exterior elevations, material calculations, and matching color presentation views for our City resubmittal.

We will provide the existing CAD files, current planning drawings, City reviewer comments, material information, and reference renderings. Our architect will remain involved in directing and reviewing the work.

The project includes four buildings. Buildings 1–3 share a typical design, while Building 4 has a different configuration. Please account for this repetition when preparing your proposal.

Scope of work

Review the CAD files, submitted elevations, and City comments. Identify drawing inconsistencies and questions requiring clarification.

Revise the north, south, east, and west elevations for each building. Clearly identify any shared typical elevations.

Accurately show building geometry, roof slopes, heights, overhead doors, pedestrian doors, trim, wainscot, and material transitions.

Prepare a material-area calculation table for each individual elevation, showing square footage, the calculation denominator, and percentages.

Separately identify doors, openings, and trim so their treatment can be confirmed against the City’s instructions. Identify unresolved material classifications before finalizing calculations.

Adjust the proposed material layout to address the reviewer’s comments while considering panel dimensions, installation practicality, waste, and budget.

Produce matching color elevations from the coordinated CAD/model geometry. Door counts, proportions, and material boundaries must agree with the technical drawings.

Coordinate revisions with our architect and provide a concise response matrix showing where each City comment was addressed.

Final deliverables

Editable AutoCAD DWG files with organized layers and all required references.

Coordinated elevation sheets in PDF, following the existing project format and City requirements.

Editable material-area calculations in Excel.

Matching color elevations and any editable model files used to create them.

A comment-response matrix and a list of any remaining architect or engineer decisions.

Changes affecting structural components, anchors, or wall-support requirements must be identified for review by our architect and structural/building supplier team.

Required experience

Demonstrated experience preparing U.S. commercial architectural elevations and municipal submittals.

Strong AutoCAD drafting and drawing-quality-control skills.

Experience calculating façade material areas and percentages.

Ability to interpret reviewer comments and coordinate with an architect.

Metal-building, warehouse, or self-storage experience strongly preferred.

Colorado municipal experience is a plus.

Please include with your proposal

Two relevant examples of commercial elevation or permit-submittal work.

An example of a material-area schedule, or an explanation of how you calculate and verify façade percentages.

Your proposed fixed price, turnaround time, availability, and included revision rounds.

Confirmation that editable source files are included.

Your professional qualifications

Stanford Seed is seeking a web performance specialist, an experienced back-end developer, to ensure that our marketing landing pages perform at the best possible speed for our audiences, while also maintaining tracking and bot defense. Specifically:
1. We need to re-create our existing marketing landing page designs in a format that is very lightweight, as the majority of our users arrive via mobile, often with weak connections, e.g. 3G (plus easy to edit).
2. We need to move our landing pages to a faster CDN (Cloudflare) that caches each page, no matter what UTM parameters or ad click IDs are attached to the URL, so the pages load quickly.
3. As part of this redesign and CDN change, we need a new process for deploying and maintaining marketing landing pages (4 main pages, up to 10 thank you pages), implementing changes, tests, and security as well as preventing bot traffic
4. We need the option to write custom rules to ensure the tracking parameters are retained on our pages so our attribution is accurate and conversion events flow back to each ad platform, giving their algorithms the info they need to optimize for the preferred actions.
This role will also help us monitor performance of our sites, identify issues and creatively solve problems as they arise. 

Deliverables

Platform and process migration, create page templates
Move off WordPress/Pantheon and collaborate with the Seed team to design the new process for website deployment, editing, and management using Cloudflare as the host/CDN. 
Start with one optimized marketing page, that we can convert into a template with reusable components, so regional variants inherit the performance work, instead of reintroducing the problem. Then we’ll deploy and test regional pages for South Asia, Indonesia, and Africa, as well as post-form completion “thank you” pages.
Add cookie consent bar/opt-in to all pages
Compile a guide of best practices for the content design to ensure we are designing the pages with performance in mind from the start.
Help us identify the necessary apps/tools to maintain this process.

Performance optimization
Reduce load time on the current test page (per below targets with consistent test settings, e.g., 3G Fast (1.6 Mbps/768 Kbps 150ms RTT), Android One from Jakarta, Mumbai and Cape Town), managing JavaScript and implementing tag-loading cascade (in collaboration with our tracking specialist): deferring and asynchronously loading non-critical assets so the page becomes interactive before trackers finish. Recommend asset/element reductions.
Image optimization strategy, serving via Cloudflare Images rather than from Cloudflare Pages, with sizing and format decisions documented.
Identify method for optimal performance while maintaining tracking: Work with the tracking specialist on data-layer sequencing so analytics data is collected and sent back while the user is interacting, not on initial load.
Identify if Cloudflare can host the container directly and move to server-side tracking
Identify other areas for optimization as needed.

Caching and campaign tracking
Configure caching so every visitor is served the same cached page, regardless of the UTMs or ad click IDs (fbclid, li_fat_id, gclid, and any we add later) attached to the URL. These parameters should be ignored for caching but never stripped, rewritten, or lost through redirects, so they arrive intact in the visitor's browser.
Capture those parameters into a first-party cookie at the edge, via a Worker or Zaraz, so we retain each visitor's traffic source across pages and return visits. Agree on the cookie's name and contents with the tracking specialist at the start. This will replace the current UTM Grabber tag in GTM, which should stay in place until the new setup is tested.
The tracking specialist owns the conversion events sent to Meta and LinkedIn (browser pixels and Conversions APIs, with deduplication). If those server-side events run through Cloudflare, you may build what they specify.
Sign-off, tested jointly with the tracking specialist: cache HITs across URLs with different parameters, parameters surviving every redirect, the cookie storing values correctly, and test conversions appearing once in Meta and LinkedIn with the correct traffic source.

Testing
Baseline and ongoing measurement using GTmetrix (global endpoints, Lighthouse scoring, asset waterfall, time-to-first-byte, filmstrip) for statistical asset-level analysis.
Real-device / real-network validation for actual usability such as BrowserStack, or ideally a Seed staff member located in-market on a typical network. Contractor has already whitelisted GTmetrix IPs against the test site firewall; extend the same approach to any new tool.
Report format: before/after numbers per change, per region. Brief methodology of what/how you’re testing, and interpreted results. Keep a running list of all tests and be prepared to report on the overall testing timeline/outcomes. 

Security & Monitoring
Security has not been a priority in past cycles beyond bot protection. It should be this cycle. The Stanford brand is a target, and our markets have sophisticated bad actors who know those ecosystems well.
Cloudflare plan recommendation: Pro, Business or enterprise tier for the web application firewall as a minimum. Confirm cost and get Tiffany's approval.
WAF, bot protection, custom security rules, cache controls. Research, test, and identify the best options to maintain high site performance.
Third-party script monitoring via Cloudflare's script-monitoring tooling — visibility into every JavaScript asset loading on the page.
Repository-side scanning if we move to GitHub: such as Dependabot for dependency vulnerabilities, secret/credential scanning, 2FA and SSH key discipline on publishing access.
API security: if we add APIs for tracking purposes, we’ll need to ensure this information stays secure.

Project management info
Bill hourly, invoiced weekly, through Upwork.

Communication
Ask questions and provide regular updates/status check-ins on Slack, especially between meetings. There is also a project checklist in slack for task management.
Weekly check-ins: might start with two 30 min check-ins per week as we confirm the process and start to build the new landing pages, then move to weekly meetings.

Roles/collaboration: The Seed team will focus on providing the design of the pages and the content, and hand-off the static html. From there, you will be responsible for optimizing the content, version control, deployment, etc. You will also work closely with a separate Google Tag Manager specialist on tracking implementation to make sure we are able to track UTMs and events while also balancing site performance. 

Documentation: Maintain a running log of what was changed, why, and the measured effect — image placement, image size, asset location, caching config, load sequencing, etc. The goal is to have a documented and repeatable process. Add all assets/reports to our shared google drive folder.

Timeline
The goal is to build and deploy all pages and test them before the mid-December holiday, live test window in February, campaign ramp up from March-May.

Phase 1
Optimize & decide
Sept – mid Oct 2026
Get the existing test page to its best achievable load time and run baseline tests. Add cookie bar. Recommend and lock the static site generator and editing process. Configure caching and Zaraz. Document testing process: what moved the numbers and by how much. 

Phase 2
Templatize & build regional pages
mid Oct – mid Nov 2026
Convert the optimized page into a reusable template. Start to build regional pages. Explore bot prevention solutions and start to work with tracking specialist on tracking options.

Phase 3
Test & Optimize all pages
mid Nov – Dec 19, 2026
Add tracking and bot prevention. Test and optimize separate pages for South Asia, Indonesia, and Africa. Everything done before the holiday break.

Phase 4
Campaign support
Jan – Feb 2027
Initial live ad testing and troubleshooting in January. Prepare monitoring plan. Feb 1-15 is the hard test window: live test ads, full-funnel validation, tracking verification. Fix what breaks.

Phase 5: On-call
Mar -May 2027 
Provide monitoring reports, incident response, and performance regression checks as the campaign scales.
Phase 6: Post campaign analysis
May 2027 
Post-campaign review, lessons learned and improvement recommendations.

Hard deadline: all regional pages built, tested, and tracking-validated by December 19, 2026.

items.title: Product and Lifestyle Photographer for Luxury Skincare, Monthly Shoots (City of Industry, CA)
items.description:
We're an online retailer of medical grade and luxury skincare, carrying well known premium brands.

We're looking for a photographer in the LA area for ongoing monthly work. We need about 10 to 15 finished images a month for Instagram, website banners, our blog and email.

What we're looking for:
• Styled still life and group product shots on soft, light backdrops with clean, high end lighting
• Some lifestyle images with hands or a model, plus texture and swatch shots
• Retouching included, delivered in web and social sizes

How it works:
• One half day shoot a month at our office in City of Industry, CA. Products stay on site.
• We get full commercial rights to all images (web, social, paid ads, email)
• Turnaround within 7 to 10 days after the shoot

We'll share our brand and reference images with shortlisted photographers.

To apply, please share 3 to 5 beauty or skincare images you've shot, your monthly rate for 10 to 15 images, any travel fee to City of Industry, and when you're available to start.

items.title: Senior Magento 2 Developer Needed for Ongoing Ad-Hoc Support
items.description:
We are a long-established UK ecommerce retailer running Magento Open Source 2.4.8 and are looking for an experienced senior Magento 2 developer to provide ongoing backup and ad-hoc development support.
We already have a primary Magento developer. This role is intended to give us additional cover when required, provide extra capacity for individual projects, and occasionally give us a second technical opinion.
The work will be occasional rather than a guaranteed number of hours each week, but we are looking to build a long-term relationship with the right developer.
Typical work may include:
Diagnosing Magento 2 frontend and backend issues
Magento upgrades, patches and compatibility work
Third-party extension/module troubleshooting
PHP, JavaScript and MySQL development
Cron, indexing, caching and performance issues
Checkout/payment and third-party integration troubleshooting
Frontend fixes and Core Web Vitals/performance work
Git/GitHub-based development and deployment
Our site has been established for many years and contains a number of third-party extensions and integrations. We use a separate development environment and expect changes to be properly tested before production deployment.
Experience with Magento 2.4.x is essential. Familiarity with areas such as Mirasvit extensions, Cloudflare, ecommerce integrations and Magento performance optimisation would be useful, but is not mandatory.
We are particularly looking for somebody who can investigate an existing Magento installation, identify the root cause of an issue and make targeted changes rather than recommending unnecessary rebuilds or large-scale redevelopment.
Good written English and clear communication are important. Some overlap with UK working hours is preferred.
Please include:
How many years you have worked specifically with Magento 2
Examples of Magento 2 projects or stores you have supported
Your experience with Magento 2.4.x
Your usual availability and working hours
Whether you work independently or as part of an agency
We expect to start with a small paid task on our development site so that we can assess technical ability, communication and working style before assigning further work.
Independent freelancers are preferred rather than agencies.

items.title: Kinco plc ladder
items.description:
Develop a modular, parameter-based ladder logic application for a Kinco K6S PLC controlling a small process installation with two adjustable actuators, five PT100 temperature inputs (RTU remote IO), Modbus RTU with 1 pressure sensor, an emergency input, alarms, safety trips, status lamps, HMI control and Modbus TCP communication.
DO1 controls the reflux solenoid from 0–100% using adjustable time-proportional control. DO2 controls the heater SSR using the same principle. Both require adjustable cycle time. DO1 and DO2 must immediately switch to 0% during a trip. DO3 is a red warning lamp and DO4 a green normal-operation lamp.
The emergency input is a safety condition. When active, both actuators must go to 0%, the red lamp turns ON, the green lamp turns OFF and a latched Trip_Active status is set. A deliberate reset is required before operation can resume.
Five independent PT100 on the RTU 1 (T1–T5) shall provide temperature, offset correction, filtering. Each channel requires adjustable HH/LL limits, enable and optional delay/filter time. An HH temperature condition shall create a latched safety trip, stopping both actuators. The trip must remain active until the initiating condition has cleared and a deliberate reset is performed.
The pressure and Temperature sensors communicates via Modbus RTU. Its address, communication settings, register, data type, scaling, offset, range and filtering shall be configurable. Pressure HH/LL trips.
A central Trip_Active structure shall handle Emergency, Temperature HH, Pressure HH and configured sensor faults. During any trip: Reflux = 0%, Heater = 0%, Red = ON and Green = OFF. No automatic restart is permitted.
The HMI shall provide all relevant process values, parameters, alarm states, communication status and a dedicated trip-reset command. All normal operating parameters must be adjustable without changing the PLC program. I will programm the HMI myself.
All relevant process data, alarms, status information and writable parameters shall be available through Modbus TCP. A complete register map must specify address, variable, data type, scaling, access, unit and description.
The software shall use reusable logic for actuator control, temperature channels, alarms, sensor monitoring and time-proportional outputs. Testing shall cover all control functions, trips, faults, communications, reset logic and lamp status.
Deliverables: complete PLC ladder program, PLC configuration, variable/register list, Modbus TCP

items.title: Senior Information & Visual Designer – Healthcare Provider Guide
items.description:
We are seeking an exceptional senior information/visual designer to redesign a provider-facing Access & Expertise Guide for a healthcare organization.

This is not a traditional brochure-design project. We are looking for someone who can transform complex clinical, referral and access information into a visually distinctive, intuitive and highly functional resource for physicians, advanced practice providers and other healthcare professionals.

The finished guide should help a busy provider quickly understand:

What does my patient need, and how do I connect them to the appropriate care?

We have an existing draft, content framework and strategic direction. We need a designer with exceptional visual judgment who can simplify the experience, develop original visual solutions and create a polished interactive PDF that functions as a practical provider-access tool.

The anticipated guide is approximately 8–10 pages.

The Design Challenge

The organization includes multiple care settings, clinical specialties, locations and access pathways. The guide needs to make that complexity feel simple and connected without requiring users to understand the organization’s internal structure.

The experience may include pathways such as:

* Transfer a patient
* Talk to a clinician
* Refer for outpatient care
* Access a rapid clinical pathway
* Find the right expertise
* Find an appropriate location
* Patient scheduling
* Navigation/support when the appropriate pathway is unclear

The design should enable a provider to identify the appropriate next step within seconds.

Key Design Components

The project may include:

* Cover and overall visual identity
* Provider “Start Here” / access pathway
* Clinical network and location visualization
* Urgent/transfer access
* Provider-to-provider clinical access
* Outpatient referral pathways
* Navigation/referral support
* Specialty and expertise discovery
* Patient scheduling
* Quick-reference / Quick Connect resource
* Custom icons, diagrams and visual navigation
* QR codes and links to institutionally managed digital resources

A particularly important component will be developing a creative visual representation of a multi-site clinical network that may include hospitals, specialty services, outpatient practices and other access points.

We do not want a traditional map filled with identical location pins. We are looking for a thoughtful visual solution that communicates connectivity, different care settings and ease of access while remaining clean and intuitive.

Interactive PDF Experience

We would like the final guide to behave more like an intuitive provider-access tool than a traditional brochure.

The designer should thoughtfully incorporate interactive PDF functionality where appropriate, which may include:

* Tap-to-call telephone numbers and action buttons
* Large, fully clickable pathway buttons
* Clickable referral and access pathways
* Internal page navigation
* “Back to Start” functionality
* Persistent or intuitive navigation between major sections
* Clickable clinical network/location elements
* Links to institution-provided referral, scheduling, records/imaging and other resources
* QR codes paired with clickable digital links
* Clear pathways for different provider audiences where appropriate
* Visual treatment for institution-provided EHR/Epic launch links, if technically available

The experience should remain understandable and useful when viewed on desktop, tablet, mobile or in print, even when interactive functionality is unavailable.

Critical information should therefore never depend solely on a QR code, hyperlink or interactive feature.

EHR / Epic Functionality

There may be opportunities for selected actions within the guide to connect users to institutionally approved EHR/Epic referral workflows.

The designer will not be responsible for developing, programming or configuring EHR integrations.

If approved EHR launch destinations or links are available, the organization will provide them. The designer’s responsibility will be to create an intuitive visual interaction for those actions and incorporate supplied links appropriately.

Similarly, website or microsite design/development is not part of this project. Any related digital resources will be developed and maintained separately by the organization.

What Great Looks Like

The final product should feel:

* Sophisticated and contemporary
* Visually memorable and distinctive
* Intuitive within seconds
* Clinically credible and professional
* Clean without feeling generic
* Engaging without becoming overly promotional
* Appropriate for physicians, healthcare leaders and external professional audiences
* Highly functional in digital and print environments

We are particularly interested in original visual thinking: custom graphics, sophisticated information hierarchy, purposeful typography, network visualizations, diagrams, iconography and visual storytelling that make complex information easier to understand.

AI-assisted tools may be incorporated into a designer’s workflow. However, we are not seeking a template-driven or primarily AI-generated final product. The finished work should demonstrate exceptional human design judgment, originality, intentionality and production-level execution.

Scope & Deliverables

The selected designer will be expected to:

* Review the existing guide and recommend improvements to information hierarchy and visual navigation
* Develop 2–3 differentiated creative directions
* Develop a sophisticated clinical network/map visualization
* Design the complete approximately 8–10 page guide
* Develop custom graphics, icons and diagrams as appropriate
* Create an intuitive interactive-PDF experience
* Incorporate institution-provided QR codes, hyperlinks and digital destinations
* Incorporate supplied EHR/Epic links if available
* Refine the selected direction through stakeholder feedback
* Produce an accessible, interactive digital PDF
* Produce a high-resolution, print-ready PDF
* Provide organized, editable source files and reusable graphic assets
* Complete final usability/production QA

The finished guide should help a busy provider quickly understand:

What does my patient need, and how do I connect them to the appropriate care?

The organization includes multiple care settings, clinical specialties, locations and access pathways. The guide needs to make that complexity feel simple and connected without requiring users to understand the organization’s internal structure.

The experience may include pathways such as:

* Transfer a patient
* Talk to a clinician
* Refer for outpatient care
* Access a rapid clinical pathway
* Find the right expertise
* Find an appropriate location
* Patient scheduling

items.title: SEO + AEO/GEO Audit for Established Drone Services Marketplace
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced SEO specialist to conduct a one-time SEO + AI search visibility audit of Droners.io, an established nationwide marketplace connecting businesses with professional drone pilots.

This is an audit and strategy project, not an ongoing SEO retainer.
Droners.io is an established domain with significant historical authority and backlinks from major publications. The site was also recently rebuilt, so technical SEO, indexing, rendering, redirects, and preservation of existing rankings are especially important.

We have an in-house marketing specialist who will own SEO going forward, along with a development team that can implement technical changes. We need an expert to identify the highest-priority opportunities and give us a clear, actionable roadmap.

Our primary goal is more clients finding Droners.io through organic and AI-assisted search, posting jobs, and hiring drone pilots. We care much more about client acquisition and revenue than vanity metrics.

Scope of Audit:

- Technical SEO and indexability
- Google Search Console review
- JavaScript/rendering issues
- Raw HTML vs rendered content
- Canonical tags
- www vs non-www configuration
- Redirects and migration issues
- XML sitemap and robots.txt
- 404s and soft 404s
- Duplicate/thin pages
- Crawlability and internal linking
- Page titles, meta descriptions and H1 structure
- Core Web Vitals/page experience
- Structured data/schema opportunities
- Pilot profile indexation strategy
- Existing service + state landing pages
- Opportunities for city-level landing pages
- Blog/content opportunities
- Keyword research and keyword gaps
- Competitor analysis
- Backlink profile and broken/lost backlink opportunities
- Help Center SEO (help.droners.io)
- Google AI Overviews / AI Mode visibility
- ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity visibility/citations
- AEO/GEO opportunities
- Entity/brand authority and citation opportunities

Important questions we want answered

1. Are there any technical issues from our recent site rebuild that could hurt existing rankings or indexation?
2. Which existing pages should we improve first?
3. What high-intent keywords should Droners.io target?
4. What service/state/city landing pages should we create?
5. Which pages or page types should not be indexed?
6. What content should our marketing specialist publish over the next 3–6 months?
7. Where are competitors outperforming us?
8. What backlinks or historical authority are we failing to take advantage of?
9. How visible is Droners.io currently in Google AI results, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity for commercially relevant drone-service queries?
10. What specific changes would most improve both traditional SEO and AI-search visibility?
Deliverables

We do not want a generic automated SEO report.
We want:
- Written audit with findings
- Issues categorized by Critical / High / Medium / Low
- Specific recommended fixes
- Developer-facing technical recommendations where appropriate
- Keyword/content opportunity map
- Recommended landing-page architecture
- Competitor gap analysis
- AEO/GEO visibility baseline
- Prioritized 90-day action plan
- Clear distinction between tasks for our developer and tasks for our marketing specialist
- 30–60 minute call or Loom walkthrough explaining the findings

We can provide access to Google Search Console and Google Analytics as needed.
Experience with marketplaces, programmatic/location SEO, JavaScript sites, and AI-search/GEO optimization is strongly preferred.

When applying, please include:
- Examples of SEO audits you've completed
- Experience with JavaScript/Vue or similar sites
- Experience with programmatic/location SEO
- How you approach AEO/GEO audits
- Tools you would use
- Your fixed-price quote
- Expected turnaround time

items.title: Lightroom photo editor for adventure elopements and sessions
items.description:
Seeking a long-term Lightroom editor for outdoor elopements, proposals, and engagement sessions.

Work regularly includes harsh light, backlighting, full sun, mixed lighting conditions, varied skin tones, and complex outdoor environments. My editing style also relies heavily on masking, with masks used on roughly 80% of delivered images.

For each gallery, I will provide Lightroom Smart Previews and a selection of images I have already fully edited. You would use those finished edits as the reference for color, exposure, skin tones, masking, and overall consistency throughout the rest of the gallery.

Current volume is approximately 6+ sessions per month and around 2 elopements per month, with the potential for additional work.

Preferred turnaround time is within 7 days per engagement gallery and 10 days per elopement gallery. Please include your typical turnaround time and current capacity in your application.

My goal is to eventually find an editor who can learn my work closely enough that returned galleries require little to no additional editing from me. I understand that level of consistency takes time and familiarity with my work, but I am looking for someone interested in developing that long-term working relationship.

If you are also comfortable with more detailed Lightroom work or occasional Photoshop work beyond standard color correction and masking, please include that in your application along with examples of the types of retouching or additional editing you are comfortable handling.

I am looking for someone interested in an ongoing relationship rather than occasional one-off editing. Strong Lightroom skills, consistency across large galleries, and the ability to closely match an established editing style are essential.

Clear, friendly, professional phone presence
Comfortable with gatekeepers/voicemail, stays on script

items.title: Experienced Bubble / No-Code Developer Needed to Build a SaaS MVP
items.description:
I’m looking for an experienced No Code developer to help take an existing SaaS concept from product definition through a working MVP.

This is not just a UI-building project. The application has multiple user roles, fairly involved workflows, third-party integrations, and a backend that needs to be structured properly so we can continue developing after the initial launch.

The product will include:

User signup, authentication, and role-based access
Separate dashboards for different user types
Profiles and account management
A structured database with several related data types
Search, filtering, and reporting
Admin dashboard and internal management tools
Automated emails and notifications
Subscription/payment functionality through Stripe
External API integrations
File/document uploads
Background workflows and scheduled processes
Responsive web UI

We have the initial product requirements and some designs, but I expect the developer to help make technical/product decisions where the requirements aren't fully defined.

I'm open to Bubble, Xano, WeWeb, or other low-code tools if there is a strong reason to use them. The goal isn't to force everything into one platform, it's to get a reliable product live quickly while keeping the architecture maintainable. Mention "Bubble" on top of your proposal if you have read full job description.

A few things I care about:

Good Bubble architecture rather than everything being built on the page
Reusable components and workflows
Proper database structure
API/plugin decisions based on the actual requirement
Performance as the application grows
Clean handoff and documentation
Someone who can identify problems in the product rather than simply implement tickets

Please send examples of SaaS products or complex MVPs you've personally built, preferably showing the backend/workflow side as well as the UI.

items.title: HeyGen Video Production Specialist Needed ~ 40 Professional Training Videos
items.description:
# HeyGen Video Production Specialist Needed – 40 Professional Training Videos

We are seeking an experienced **HeyGen video production specialist or agency** to convert approximately **40 completed training scripts/documents into polished, professional training videos**.

This is **not a scriptwriting project**. The training content has already been developed. We need a production partner who can take our completed materials and efficiently turn them into engaging, consistent training videos using HeyGen.

## About the Project

The videos are part of the training and education library for a financial-services SaaS platform. The content is divided among three primary audiences:

- Consumers/Students
- Financial Advisors
- Financial Firms/Organizations

We have been producing these internally using HeyGen, but with approximately 60 videos to complete, we are looking to outsource the remaining production to someone who can complete the project much faster while maintaining a consistent professional standard.

## Scope of Work

You will be provided with the completed training documents/scripts.

For each training module, you will be responsible for:

- Creating the video in HeyGen
- Using an appropriate professional AI avatar/presenter
- Formatting the script for natural AI narration and pacing
- Breaking content into appropriate scenes
- Creating professional supporting visuals, graphics, text, icons, screenshots, or other on-screen elements where appropriate
- Highlighting important concepts visually rather than simply displaying large amounts of text
- Maintaining consistent branding and visual style across the entire video library
- Adding titles, section transitions, and closing screens where appropriate
- Reviewing pronunciation, timing, avatar delivery, and visual synchronization
- Correcting obvious AI narration or rendering issues
- Delivering completed videos ready to upload into our LMS

We want these to look like **professionally produced educational videos—not simply an AI avatar reading a document on screen.**

We have an AI Avatar called Owly that we would like to use in all of these videos. 

## Production Consistency

Because these videos will exist together within the same training library, consistency is extremely important.

We would like the selected freelancer/agency to establish a standardized production template at the beginning of the project, including:

- Avatar/presenter style/using Owly
- Intro/outro format
- Fonts and typography
- Branding
- Scene layouts
- Transitions
- On-screen text treatment
- Supporting graphics
- General pacing and presentation style

Once we approve the initial format, that style should be carried consistently throughout the remaining videos.

We will provide logos, branding guidance, scripts, and other available assets.

## Ideal Candidate

We are specifically looking for someone with demonstrated experience using **HeyGen for professional training, educational, corporate, or explainer videos**.

Experience with financial services, SaaS, LMS training, compliance-related content, or professional education is a plus but not required.

You should have:

- Strong HeyGen experience
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good visual design judgment
- Ability to turn written training content into engaging visual presentations
- Experience managing larger batches of videos
- Strong English-language comprehension
- Ability to maintain consistency across dozens of videos
- Capacity to complete the project on an accelerated timeline

## IMPORTANT – Please Include With Your Proposal

Please provide **2–3 examples of training, educational, or corporate videos you personally produced using HeyGen**.

Please also tell us:

1. Whether you are an individual freelancer or an agency/team.
2. Approximately how many HeyGen videos your team can produce per week.
3. Your estimated timeframe for completing approximately 40 videos.
4. Whether you recommend pricing this project per video, per finished minute, or as a fixed-price project.
5. Your estimated cost or pricing structure.
6. What you would need from us to begin production.

**Please do not apply without providing examples of previous HeyGen work.**


## Potential Ongoing Work

This initial project consists of approximately 40 videos, but our training library will continue to grow.

We are looking for a production partner we can potentially work with on an ongoing basis as new training modules, product tutorials, educational content, and other videos are developed.

**Project Type:** Fixed-price preferred
**Project Size:** Approximately 40 videos
**Platform:** HeyGen
**Timeline:** Immediate start / accelerated completion

items.title: WordPress Developer for Ongoing Website Development & Improvements
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress developer to help with ongoing development, improvements, and maintenance of an existing business website.

The website is already live, but we regularly need help implementing new pages and features, fixing frontend/backend issues, improving performance, and making sure everything works correctly across desktop and mobile.

What you may work on

* Build new pages from Figma or provided designs
* Modify existing WordPress templates and components
* Develop custom WordPress functionality
* Work with custom themes and plugins
* ACF and Gutenberg development
* WooCommerce changes when needed
* HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP development
* Fix responsive and cross-browser issues
* Improve website performance and Core Web Vitals
* Debug plugin/theme conflicts
* Implement animations and interactive frontend elements
* Work safely with staging and production environments

Requirements

* Strong WordPress development experience
* Good PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS knowledge
* Experience with custom WordPress themes
* Ability to work with an existing codebase
* Experience converting Figma designs into responsive pages
* Good understanding of WordPress hooks, filters, and APIs
* Attention to detail and clean implementation
* Ability to communicate clearly and work independently

Experience with WooCommerce, Gutenberg blocks, ACF, GSAP, React, or performance optimization is a plus.

This is not a project for someone who only installs themes and plugins. We are looking for a developer who is comfortable writing and debugging custom code.

To apply

Please include:

1. A short description of your WordPress experience.
2. 2–3 WordPress websites you have worked on and what you did on them.
3. Your experience with custom PHP/JavaScript development in WordPress.
4. Your experience with website performance optimization.
5. Your hourly rate.

We are initially looking for help with a few tasks, but this could become ongoing work for the right developer.

items.title: Forward Deployed Customer Success Manager (AI + Faith)
items.description:
Solace builds governed AI infrastructure for churches, denominations, and global ministries. We help faith leaders use AI in ways that are safe, trustworthy, and faithful to their mission.

We're not looking for a traditional account manager. We're looking for a hands-on, mission-driven builder who will work side by side with pastors and ministry teams to deploy Solace, configure it for their context, and make sure it actually changes how they serve their communities.

Lead onboarding and deployment for new ministry partners, from first call through live use
Design and configure AI workflows and assistants for each partner's needs and theological context
Train and equip pastors, staff, and volunteers to use Solace with confidence
Be the partner's trusted advisor, spotting new ways Solace can serve their ministry
Bring field insights back to our product team to shape what we build next
Track adoption and outcomes, and proactively fix what isn't working
Who you are

Energized by the intersection of faith and technology, and you see this work as a calling
Fluent in AI tools and workflows. You build with them daily, not just talk about them.
2+ years in customer success, implementation, solutions, or ministry operations roles
A clear communicator who can explain technical ideas to non-technical leaders
Comfortable working independently and moving fast in a startup environment
Familiar with church or ministry environments (strongly preferred)
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
If you want to put your technical and relational gifts to work for the Church, we'd love to hear from you.

items.title: Email Outreach (Real Estate Agents) — MUST Have Warmed Inboxes + Send 30,000+/Month (Your Own Infra)
items.description:
DO NOT call/text/email me. Do not contact me outside Upwork. I will reach out here on Upwork if I’m interested.
Overview
I’m building a nationwide Facebook Group for real estate agents focused on agent-to-agent referrals. I have a 1,000,000+ agent contact list and want aggressive growth using email invites (NO paid ads).
This job requires you to use YOUR OWN email infrastructure (your own warmed sending inboxes/domains/tools). I am not hiring someone to “set up infrastructure later.” I need sending capacity immediately.
Goal
Drive consistent, qualified agent to join my Facebook Group by sending 30,000+ emails/month with strong deliverability and clean list hygiene.
________________________________________
What You Will Do
•	Send email campaigns inviting agents to join my Facebook Group
•	Segment the list (state/brokerage preferred)
•	Manage deliverability and list hygiene: 
o	throttling/ramping (as needed)
o	bounce handling
o	suppression/opt-outs
o	complaint monitoring (if available)
•	A/B test subject lines and copy
•	Provide weekly reporting (see below)
________________________________________
HARD REQUIREMENTS (Non-Negotiable)
Email Infrastructure — MUST Have NOW (Your Own)
You MUST:
•	Be capable of sending 30,000+ emails/month right now
•	Use safe sending practices (no blasting from one inbox)
Proof Required (Must provide with application)
Provide screenshots (redact sensitive info) showing:
•	delivery rate
•	bounce rate
•	open rate
•	click rate (if tracked)
•	spam complaint rate (if available)
•	sample weekly/monthly sending volume
If you cannot provide proof, do not apply.
________________________________________
Reporting (Weekly)
You will provide a weekly report including:
•	emails sent / delivered
•	bounces (hard + soft)
•	open rate / click rate (if applicable)
•	spam complaints (if available)
•	unsubscribes/opt-outs + confirmation suppression list is applied
•	joins attributed (estimate + method)
•	what was tested + what changes next week
________________________________________
To Apply (Answer ALL)
1.	How many warmed inboxes do you have available right now?
2.	What’s your max safe daily send volume across your inboxes?
3.	Provide proof screenshots for the last 30 days: delivery %, bounce %, open %, click %, complaints (if available).
4.	What sending platform(s) are you using?
5.	Confirm you will use YOUR OWN warmed inboxes/domains/tools to send 30,000+ emails/month starting immediately.

items.title: Payments consultant for high-risk merchant account (prize competitions and collectible boxes)
items.description:
We are looking for someone who can connect us with a payment processor that accepts our type of business. If you have worked with companies in prize competitions, sweepstakes, mystery or collectible boxes, iGaming or a similar high-risk vertical, and you know which processors approve them, we want to hear from you.

We are open to compensating for the right introduction or referral. Past experience in this space is appreciated.

**Who we are**

We are a UK-registered company running an online platform for authenticated items. We sell two products: entries to prize competitions (with a skill question and a free postal entry route) and collectible boxes with published chances. All prizes are physical goods. There is no cash prize and no cash-out so far.

- UK limited company, live since July 2026
- Approx. $7,000 processed to date, around 650 transactions, average ticket $11
- International customers, billed in USD
- Cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay today, integrated by API (we have our own developer)

**Why now**

Our current processor has classified the business as restricted and will stop supporting us on 15 October 2026. We need a replacement for card payments, with global customer coverage, as fast as possible.

**What we are looking for**

- An introduction to the right person at an acquirer, PSP or ISO that openly accepts this vertical for a merchant of our size
- Guidance through the application and underwriting, if you have been through it with other companies
- Advice on what to adjust (product, Terms, country coverage, company structure) to get approved

**Compensation**

We are flexible: a referral fee on a successful approval, a fixed fee for the introduction, hourly consulting, or a mix. Tell us what works for you.

**One condition**

We only want fully disclosed set-ups where the processor knows exactly what we sell. We are not interested in processing through third-party accounts, misdescribed businesses or miscoded transactions.

**To apply, please tell us**

- Which companies or verticals you have worked with and what your role was
- Which processors you would introduce us to, and why you think they would approve us
- How you would like to be compensated

items.title: Appointment Setter / Inside Sales Representative (Remote)
items.description:
Appointment Setter / Inside Sales Representative (Remote)

Synergy Structures is a rapidly growing U.S. manufacturer of premium modular homes, storage buildings, and mobile office buildings. We generate a high volume of inbound Facebook and digital marketing leads every day from customers actively requesting information about our products.

We are seeking experienced, professional appointment setters to contact these leads immediately after they inquire, qualify their needs, answer basic questions, and schedule appointments with our sales team.

This is NOT cold calling.
Every person you contact has already expressed interest in one of our products.

What You'll Do
- Contact new inbound leads within minutes of their inquiry
- Call prospects using our GHL CRM system
- Build rapport quickly and professionally
- Ask qualifying questions
- Determine customer needs and buying timeframe
- Schedule qualified appointments for our sales consultants
- Accurately document every interaction in our CRM
- Follow established follow-up sequences until contact is made
- Help improve overall lead response times and conversion rates

Products You'll Represent
- Modular Homes
- Park Model Homes
- Storage Buildings
- Mobile Office Buildings

You will receive training on our products, pricing, and sales process.

Requirements
We are only interested in top performers.

Applicants must possess:
- Exceptional spoken and written English
- A neutral or American-sounding accent
- Outstanding communication and people skills
- Previous appointment setting or inside sales experience
- Experience calling warm inbound leads
- High-speed internet
- Quiet professional home office
- Quality headset and reliable computer
- Ability to work U.S. business hours
- Excellent organizational skills

Comfortable using CRM systems (GoHighLevel experience is a plus)

Compensation
We are open to several compensation structures, including:
Hourly
Hourly + bonuses
Per qualified appointment
Performance-based incentives

Tell us what has worked best for you.

Ideal Candidate
You are someone who:
- Responds immediately
- Sounds friendly and confident on the phone
- Can build trust within the first 30 seconds
- Doesn't sound scripted
- Can overcome simple objections
- Understands how to keep prospects engaged
- Loves talking with people
- Is highly dependable and accountable

To Apply
Please include:
- A brief introduction about yourself.  
- Your relevant appointment-setting or inside sales experience.
- Which CRM systems you've used.
- Your hourly rate or preferred compensation structure.
- Your available working hours (U.S. Eastern Time).
- A short audio recording (30–60 seconds) introducing yourself so we can evaluate your English proficiency and phone presence.
- Any sales metrics you can share (appointments set, conversion rates, etc.).
- Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

We are looking for long-term team members who can become an integral part of our growth. If you're a top performer who thrives on helping customers and setting quality appointments, we'd love to hear from you.

The content brief is sent every Monday.

Capacity. You can reliably deliver around 24 pieces of content per week.
Reliability. You hit deadlines consistently and communicate clearly.

What we offer

Steady, ongoing weekly work with huge opportunities.
A fixed rate per piece of content, to be agreed with the right candidate. 
Full flexibility on when and where you work
Creative freedom and a large audience for your work

Your portfolio, with specific motor industry examples (reels and static/carousel work)

Confirmation that you can handle around 12 reels and 12 posts per week on a Monday-to-Friday turnaround

items.title: Designer -Canva Templates for a Special Education Lesson Series (Teachers Pay Teachers)
items.description:
Description:

I'm a retired special education teacher with 31 years of experience, and I create social-emotional and life-skills lesson packs for Teachers Pay Teachers. The series features a lovable dog character, Murphy, and his friends. Every pack follows the same structure, and only the topic changes, the way a TV series keeps the same set and cast while each episode tells a new story.

I've already built draft packs using AI, and I'm happy to share them so you can see the content, page types, and structure I need. However, the AI drafts have too many problems to use as they are. They feel clinical rather than warm, the characters and icons aren't consistent from page to page, and text often doesn't fit properly in its boxes. I'm looking for a designer to create a fresh, warm, playful visual design for the whole series that feels fun and inviting for students while staying clear and easy for teachers to use. Please treat my drafts as a content guide, not as a design to copy.

Each topic will have four products:

Full color lesson pack: about 35 pages.
Black-and-white version of the same pack: a true black-and-white design with clean outlines and white backgrounds, so teachers can print it inexpensively. It shouldn't be just a gray copy of the color version.
Coloring page freebie: one black-and-white Murphy coloring page for the topic, plus a second page that invites teachers to the full pack and includes a clickable link to my Teachers Pay Teachers store.
Free mini sample: a few pages from the pack that work as a short, complete lesson on their own.

I'd like templates for all four, so that for each new topic I can duplicate them and swap in the new content.

What I need:

An original visual style for the series, including colors, fonts, card styles, borders, and page layouts, that feels joyful, friendly, and full of life.
Editable Canva templates for the page types in the full pack, including cover, comic/storybook pages, sequencing cards, sort/cut-apart page, strategy choice cards, worksheet, exit ticket, family letter, certificate, and teacher plan pages.
Designs that work for students with disabilities. That means large, clear picture symbols so nonreaders can understand choices, readable text (14 pt minimum for student text, 12 pt for teacher text), and plenty of space to respond.
Layouts that print well on standard letter paper, are reasonable on printer ink, and have clear cut lines.
A simple organized folder for character art and icons, so they're reused the same way every time.

Important:

The templates must be delivered to my own Canva account, and I must fully own all files and designs.
Please don't use my materials or characters in your portfolio without my written permission.
I'd like to start with a small paid test (1–2 pages) before continuing with the full set.

Ideal designer:

Strong Canva skills and a warm, playful, child-friendly design style.
Experience with educational resources, children's materials, or Teachers Pay Teachers products is a big plus.
Patient and detail-oriented, and comfortable working with a client who isn't highly technical.

To apply, please include:

Examples of children's or educational designs you've created.
Your rate, and an estimate for the test pages.
A sentence about how you'd make the materials feel fun and warm while keeping them clear for students with disabilities.

Accurately type handwritten English documents into editable Word files.

Preserve the original wording, spelling, punctuation, capitalization, and structure as closely as possible.

Native or highly proficient English reading and writing skills.

Excellent typing accuracy and attention to detail.

Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines.

Your current location in the United States.

Your experience with handwritten document typing.

Your approximate typing speed (WPM), if known.

Your availability and typical turnaround time.

Your rate per page or hourly rate.

This may lead to ongoing work for candidates who consistently provide accurate and timely results.

items.title: AI/ML Engineer for Medical Coding & Claims Denial Prediction
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML engineer to develop clinical coding and claims denial prediction capabilities for MedSynthea, a healthcare revenue cycle management platform.

You will build systems that understand clinical notes, recommend medical codes with supporting evidence, validate coding rules, and identify potential claim risks before submission.

Key responsibilities:

- Develop clinical note parsing and structured information extraction.
- Build medical code retrieval, ranking, and validation pipelines.
- Implement versioned knowledge graphs to support code updates and historical service dates.
- Train and evaluate rejection, denial, and underpayment prediction models.
- Prepare reliable training datasets and prevent data leakage.
- Implement confidence scores, human-review workflows, monitoring, and auditability.

Required experience:

- Healthcare machine learning or clinical NLP.
- LLMs, transformers, retrieval, and model training.
- Knowledge graphs and rule-based validation.
- US medical coding and claims data, including ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, and modifiers.
- Model evaluation, probability calibration, and secure handling of sensitive health data.

Preferred experience:

- LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning.
- SNOMED CT, LOINC, or RxNorm.
- 277CA acknowledgments, 835 remittances, and CARC/RARC denial reasons.
- MLOps, versioned terminology, and model drift monitoring.

Expected deliverables:

Working training and inference pipelines, validated coding outputs, calibrated claims risk models, evaluation reports, and clear technical documentation. Delivery will follow staged milestones with testing and review.

items.title: Lead Generation & Appointment Setter
items.description:
Electric Media Co. is a creative and growth agency that makes content, ads and marketing for brands. We're looking for a sharp, driven appointment setter to build targeted prospect lists, run personalized outreach and book sales calls onto our calendar.

This isn't spam-blasting. We want quality over volume: researched prospects, real personalization and steady follow-up. We provide the playbook and the offer; you run it and help us improve it.

What you'll do:

Build targeted prospect lists of businesses in our niches: car dealerships, home services, real estate, hospitality, retail and ecommerce brands
Find the decision maker and their contact info: email, Instagram, LinkedIn
Send personalized first messages using our approved scripts and templates
Follow up consistently across email, Instagram DM and LinkedIn
Book qualified sales calls directly onto our calendar
Keep our CRM updated daily
Hand interested leads to our team the same day
Share what's working and what isn't in a weekly review

What we're looking for:

Proven experience in B2B lead generation, cold outreach or appointment setting, ideally for agencies
Excellent written English; your messages need to sound human, not robotic
Experience with tools like Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Hunter, or similar
Organized, self-driven and comfortable working toward weekly targets
Bonus: experience booking calls for marketing, creative or social media agencies

Details:

Hourly, $8–12/hr depending on experience
8–12 hours per week to start; hours increase as calls book consistently
Upwork time tracker required
Long-term role, with performance bonuses for booked calls and closed clients

items.title: AI Chatbot Developer for Automotive Website
items.description:
AI Chatbot Developer for Automotive Website

We are an automotive company seeking an experienced AI Chatbot Developer to build and integrate an AI-powered chatbot into our website.

The chatbot will help visitors find accurate information about our vehicles and services, answer common questions, capture qualified leads, and improve the overall customer experience. It should provide natural, helpful, and professional responses while guiding potential customers toward booking a test drive, scheduling a service appointment, requesting a quote, or speaking with our sales team.

Responsibilities
Develop and integrate an AI-powered chatbot into our automotive website.
Train the chatbot using our company information, vehicle inventory, FAQs, service details, pricing, and policies.
Answer customer questions about available vehicles, specifications, pricing, financing options, warranties, trade-ins, maintenance, and repairs.
Capture leads by collecting visitor names, phone numbers, email addresses, vehicle preferences, and purchase requirements.
Integrate test-drive booking, service appointment scheduling, or sales consultation booking where required.
Connect the chatbot with our CRM or lead management system, if applicable.
Ensure the chatbot provides accurate, natural, professional, and user-friendly responses.
Test, troubleshoot, and optimize the chatbot before final delivery.
Ensure the chatbot works smoothly across desktop and mobile devices.

Required Skills
Proven experience developing AI chatbots using OpenAI, Botpress, Dialogflow, Voiceflow, or similar platforms.
Experience integrating chatbots with websites, APIs, CRM systems, or appointment-booking platforms.
Strong knowledge of prompt engineering and conversational AI.
Experience building lead-generation and customer-support automation.
Ability to deliver a clean, reliable, and well-tested solution within the agreed timeline.
Strong communication, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have
Previous experience working with automotive dealerships, vehicle marketplaces, car rental companies, repair shops, or automotive service businesses.
Familiarity with CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or automotive dealership CRM systems.
Experience integrating vehicle inventory databases or dealership management systems.
Experience with test-drive scheduling, service booking, trade-in inquiries, and automotive lead qualification.

Deliverables
A fully functional AI chatbot integrated into our automotive website.
Customized chatbot responses based on our business information, vehicle inventory, services, and FAQs.
Lead-capture functionality for sales, financing, trade-ins, and service inquiries.
Test-drive, consultation, or service appointment booking integration, if required.
CRM integration, where applicable.
Complete testing, optimization, and bug fixes.
Brief documentation or a short walkthrough explaining how to manage and update the chatbot.

How to Apply

Please include the following in your proposal:

Examples of AI chatbots you have previously developed.
Details of any automotive-related chatbot or automation experience.
The tools and technologies you recommend for this project.
Your relevant experience with website, CRM, and scheduling integrations.
Your estimated timeline for completing the project.

items.title: Landscape Designer for New Home
items.description:
We just bought a mid-century modern home in Seward Park, Seattle (6,480 sq ft lot, partial lake views, mature trees). We want a phased landscape design that local contractors and we (as DIYers) can execute (aside from the deck in the backyard and widening the entryway staircase, that we'll have professional help with). This is a remote design engagement. We will be doing most of the work with help from some gardeners but not hiring a team here, so will want to purchase items from US retail stores and local nurseries in Seattle.

Front yard & entry: the priority, needs a bigger "aha moment"
- grass is dead from no watering in the summer - now that we're entering the winter, there will be more rainy days and will help make it greener
- New planting plan (flowers, shrubs, possibly trees) using Seattle native or PNW-adapted plants available at local nurseries. we currently have an apple tree, black walnut tree, persimmon in the front and a fig tree in the back
- Stone and hardscaping accents

items.title: B2B Lead List Research & Categorization – 100 Lead Test Project
items.description:
I’m looking for a detail-oriented virtual assistant to help research and organize an existing B2B lead list.

I already have the leads and company information from ZoomInfo. I am NOT looking for someone to generate new leads, cold call, or book appointments.

Your job will be to research each company on my existing list and make sure the information is accurate and properly categorized so the list is ready for me before I make my calls.

For each company, I will need you to research and/or verify:

- Company industry/type (Construction, Manufacturing, Engineering, Real Estate, etc.)
- More specific company category when applicable (Electrical Contractor, Mechanical Contractor, Metal Fabrication, General Contractor, etc.)
- Current owner, founder, or highest-level principal
- Owner/principal's current title
- Approximate annual revenue
- Company location
- Whether the company is privately/owner-operated
- Whether the company has been acquired or is owned by a larger company
- Whether it is employee-owned/ESOP, private-equity owned, publicly traded, or a subsidiary
- Any important notes that would be useful before contacting the company

Accuracy is very important. I do not want information simply copied from ZoomInfo. Information should be verified using company websites, LinkedIn, reputable business sources, and other available sources.

If ownership or another piece of information cannot be confidently verified, please mark it as uncertain rather than guessing.

**Initial Project**

I would like to start with a paid test of **100 companies**.

If the work is accurate and the process goes well, I have a much larger existing lead list and would be interested in ongoing work.

Please include:

1. Your experience with B2B/company research and data enrichment
2. Tools you have experience using (ZoomInfo, LinkedIn/Sales Navigator, Apollo, Google Sheets/Excel, etc.)
3. How long you estimate 100 companies would take
4. Your price for researching and categorizing the first 100 companies

Thank you!

items.title: Senior UI/UX Web Designer — Redesign Telehealth Website, Checkout Funnels & Patient Portal
items.description:
Our site takes real orders from real patients every day. It was designed by engineers, and you can tell.

Affinity Direct is the online arm of Affinity Whole Health — a Midwest clinic network founded in 2012, four clinic locations, 10,000+ patients treated. Online we offer weight loss (GLP-1), ED treatment and peptide therapy through licensed providers, plus an over-the-counter supplement line. Coverage varies by product and by state.

The business works. What's missing is design that matches the quality of the operation. We want it to look like a brand you'd trust with your health and your card.

This is design only. You work in Figma, our dev team builds it. No code, no backend, no CMS.

WHAT WE'RE REDESIGNING, IN ORDER

1. Weight loss page — the page we are least happy with and most want fixed. Dense, hard to scan, too many numbers fighting each other. We start here on purpose: it is the hardest page we have, and a component system that survives it will survive everything else.

2. Homepage — generic today. Should read premium, clear and obviously legitimate in three seconds. Harder than it looks, because we sell four product lines, not one.

3. Intake flows — the multi-step eligibility questionnaires. These are medical screenings and every question stays in. The job is to make them clear, calm and easy to answer accurately on a phone. Better comprehension, not fewer questions.

4. Patient portal — orders, refills, subscriptions, messages, profile.

Product pages, comparison pages, location pages and the blog come after those, as later phases.

TWO HARD RULES

Real copy, real numbers, not lorem ipsum. Our product names are long, our price tables have a lot of rows, and we carry disclosure copy that cannot be cut. A layout that only works with placeholder text is not finished.

Do not invent trust. Use only the claims already on our live site. No certifications, trust badges, star ratings, review counts or press logos that we have not given you. Same rule for photography: no stock or generated image may be presented as our clinic, our staff or our patients, and no image may imply we have an office in a city where we do not. We are a regulated healthcare business, and a badge or a photo that looks good in a mockup gets built for real and becomes a legal problem. If a section needs a trust element, or a person or a place in it, ask me first and I will tell you what we are allowed to say and show.

HOW WE WOULD WORK

- You work in our Figma team from day one. We provide the seat, and the master file stays in our workspace.
- What you design is ours on payment of each milestone, source files and components included. Use only assets we give you or ones you can license. You are free to show the work in your portfolio once it is live.
- Two rounds of revisions per milestone, inside the agreed scope. New scope is a new milestone, priced before it starts, never mid-milestone.
- A Loom walkthrough and a link to the working file once a week. I would rather see it rough on Wednesday than perfect in three weeks. I reply within one business day.
- Mutual NDA before any assets or portal screens change hands. Quick and standard — we are a healthcare business.
- All work and payment stays on Upwork.

REFERENCE POINTS

- lumimeds.com — clarity and hierarchy
- joinmochi.com/medications — how they present medications and pricing
- directmeds.com — polish and restraint

Not asking you to clone them. Our brand stays: deep navy, primary blue, warm cream, Montserrat and Poppins. We want that level of craft applied to our own identity.

WHAT YOU GET

- Our brand system: color, typography, logo files and voice guidelines. The logo is attached to this post so you can see what you would be working with.
- A library of product and lifestyle imagery we hold the rights to, plus video. Released after contract, and I will tell you which files are ours to use and how.
- The live public site, real copy and real pricing to design against.
- For the patient portal: annotated screens with every patient detail replaced before they reach you. You will not get a live login. No real patient information leaves our systems, and that is a constraint you will be designing around.
- Direct access to me, the founder. Async over Upwork messages and Loom. Fast decisions, no committee, no agency layer.

DELIVERABLES

- Organized Figma files with a real component library, not 40 disconnected frames
- Desktop and mobile for every screen. Most of our traffic is phone, so mobile is not the afterthought version.
- Clickable prototype for the intake flow
- Handoff ready: spacing, type scale, color tokens, and every state — default, hover, focus, error, loading, empty
- A short note on the conversion reasoning behind your choices

WHO THIS IS FOR

- Portfolio with DTC ecommerce, subscription or telehealth work. Not corporate brochure sites.
- You have designed a multi-step checkout or intake flow and can talk about where people dropped off and what happened to that number after you shipped.
- You think in components, because "the whole site" is 50+ page types.
- Strong opinions on hierarchy, form design, trust signals and mobile.
- Comfortable working in written English. We run async over Upwork messages and Loom.

THE MILESTONE LADDER

1. Design system foundations plus the weight loss page, desktop and mobile
2. Homepage plus a reusable product page template
3. Intake flow — one component system across three product lines. The flows share most steps but not all: one adds ID capture, one adds pack selection, and the weight loss screening pulls additional questions from our provider network at runtime, so the step count is not fixed. You are scoping a system, not a fixed number of screens.
4. Patient portal
5. Remaining templates — comparison, location, blog, about, contact

COMPENSATION

Upwork makes me put something on the job card, so there is an hourly range up there. Treat it as a range and not an offer. I have not fixed the shape of this engagement and I would rather hear your number than have everyone design to mine.

Tell me what Milestone 1 would cost, since it is the bounded piece and I want comparable numbers from people who have actually scoped it, then give me a rough sense of the rest so we know we are in the same universe. Hourly, or fixed per milestone — tell me which you would rather work and why. I am open to either. This is phase one, not a one-off: the funnels, the portal and the remaining templates are the next thing we build, and I would rather keep going with whoever nails Milestone 1 than run this search twice.

TO APPLY

I read every proposal myself. Generic ones get archived. Start your proposal with the single word NAVY, so I know you read to the end. Then three things:

1. Send a 2-minute Loom, and paste a view-only link to the same file. Open a real project's Figma file on screen with the layers panel and your published styles and variables visible, and walk me through one component and its variants — a form field with its error and disabled states is perfect. Then tell me what the developers who built from that file still got wrong. If the work is under NDA, blur the client name and walk me through the structure anyway. I care how the file is built, not who it was for. No Loom and no file link, no read.

2. Go to affinitydirect.com, open the weight loss page and start the "Check whether I qualify" flow. Go far enough in to see how the questions are actually asked. Then tell me the one step you would redesign first — name it by what it asks you — and in three or four sentences, what is wrong with it and what you would do instead. No screenshot or mockup needed; I want your read, not free work. If you name the step and what it asks, I know you opened it. If the site will not load where you are, say so in your proposal and I will send you screens.

3. What Milestone 1 would cost, and your realistic calendar time for it.

One more thing. If you are currently working with, or have worked in the last year with, another DTC telehealth or GLP-1 brand, say so up front. It is not automatically disqualifying. Undisclosed is.

I review proposals within 48 hours and reply either way. Looking to start within two weeks.

items.title: 🚀 Looking for a Telegram Bot Developer
items.description:
🚀 Looking for an Experienced Telegram Bot Developer

I’m looking for an experienced developer to build a Telegram Video Downloader Bot that supports downloading videos from multiple platforms.

This project is intended to be the beginning of a long-term collaboration. If the initial project is completed successfully and the quality of work meets expectations, there will be opportunities for additional projects and ongoing development.

🔧 Requirements

Telegram Bot development

Download videos from multiple supported platforms

Support video and audio downloads

Multi-language support

Backend using Python or Laravel/PHP

Integration with GitHub

Clean, organized, and maintainable code

Proper error handling

Download progress/status when technically possible

FFmpeg integration where needed

Database integration if required

Admin commands/panel for basic bot management

Easy deployment on a Linux VPS

Full source code delivered through GitHub

Installation and deployment documentation

🌐 GitHub

The entire project should be properly organized on GitHub, including:

Source code

README

Installation instructions

.env.example

Configuration instructions

Deployment instructions

👨‍💻 Preferred Skills

Experience with:

Python or Laravel/PHP

Telegram Bot API

yt-dlp or similar technologies

FFmpeg

Git & GitHub

Linux/VPS

APIs

Databases

💰 Budget

$120 USD

Please apply only if you can complete the project within this budget.

🤝 Long-Term Collaboration

This project is the first step toward a long-term working relationship.

I’m looking for a developer who is interested in continuing to work on future features, improvements, maintenance, and other Telegram bot projects.

Good communication, reliability, clean code, and meeting deadlines are important.

📩 To Apply

Please send the following:

Your CV / Resume

Your previous Telegram bot projects

Your GitHub profile

Your preferred backend: Python or Laravel/PHP

Estimated development time

Confirmation that you can work within the $120 budget

Your availability for potential long-term collaboration

The complete source code must be delivered through GitHub.

Only serious developers with relevant experience, please.

items.title: Mobile App Deployment Specialist – Android, iOS & Twilio Verification
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced mobile app deployment specialist to help us publish an already-developed application on both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
The application is designed for compliance-regulated products and includes an age-verification process to confirm that end consumers are 21 years of age or older.
Project Status
The application development is already completed.
We now need someone who can handle the complete deployment process from developer account setup through final app publication on both Android and iOS platforms.
Scope of Work
The selected freelancer will be responsible for:
Assisting with or completing Google Play Console account setup
Assisting with or completing Apple Developer account setup
Reviewing the application before submission
Preparing all required store settings, certificates, signing keys, provisioning profiles, and related configurations
Creating and configuring the Android production release
Creating and configuring the iOS production release
Uploading and submitting the application to both app stores
Handling App Store Connect and Google Play Console requirements
Resolving any submission errors, warnings, or compliance-related issues
Supporting the app review process
Addressing store reviewer feedback or rejection issues when required
Completing the process through successful publication on both platforms
Twilio Experience Required
Our application uses Twilio as part of the user verification process for confirming eligible users.
The freelancer must have previous experience with:
Twilio account setup and verification
Twilio business/account verification
Phone/SMS verification workflows
Twilio Verify
Troubleshooting Twilio verification or compliance issues
Configuring production credentials and settings correctly
Experience working with Twilio in applications involving age verification, identity verification, or regulated industries is highly preferred.
Compliance Experience
Because this application is related to regulated products and 21+ consumers, we strongly prefer someone who has experience publishing applications involving:
Age-restricted products
21+ verification
Regulated industries products
Identity or age verification
Google Play and Apple App Store compliance policies
You should be comfortable reviewing store policies and helping us structure the submission correctly to minimize the possibility of rejection.
Required Experience
Please apply only if you have hands-on experience with:
Google Play Console
Apple Developer Program
App Store Connect
Android app publishing
iOS app publishing
Certificates and provisioning profiles
Production builds and signing
App review/rejection troubleshooting
Twilio verification/account approval
Mobile app compliance requirements
When Applying
Please include:
Examples of Android and iOS apps you have successfully published.
Your experience with Twilio account/business verification and Twilio Verify.
Whether you have previously published apps involving 21+, age-restricted, or regulated products.
Examples of App Store or Google Play rejection issues you have successfully resolved.
Confirmation that you can support the project from account creation/setup through successful publication.
Project Goal
We are not looking only for someone to upload a build.
We need someone who can take ownership of the complete publishing process, including developer account configuration, Twilio verification support, store compliance, submission, troubleshooting, and final publication on both Android and iOS.
Please apply only if you have real experience with both Apple App Store and Google Play Store deployments.
