items.title: CAD Drafter for Gross Floor Area (GFA) Verification – Energy Benchmarking
items.description:
Honeydew Energy Advisors is a small energy consulting company based in Washington, DC. We help commercial and multifamily building owners meet energy benchmarking and Building Energy Performance Standards (BEPS) requirements in DC, Maryland and Montgomery County. We are looking for a detail-oriented CAD drafter, ideally with an architectural background, to measure buildings from drawings and produce gross floor area (GFA) verifications. Some are third-party verifications and some are first- and second-party verifications, and regulators review all of them.

Responsibilities:
- Import building drawings into AutoCAD, including scanned PDFs, plats, surveys and permit sets that have no native CAD data.
- Calibrate each drawing to its stated scale (e.g., 1" = 20'), or to a known dimension when no scale is shown.
- Trace the exterior walls floor by floor and calculate total gross floor area.
- Apply ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager GFA rules: count basements and below-grade space; leave out balconies, open breezeways, exterior corridors and parking.
- Check the drawings against aerial and 3D map views so that every building, wing and floor is accounted for.
- Mark any documents that are incomplete or cannot be measured, and state exactly what is missing (no scale, missing floors, a section cut off, land area mistaken for building area).
- Put the results on our GFA verification template, with markups laid over the original plans.
- Record your measurement method clearly enough that a regulator can follow it.

Requirements:
- Strong AutoCAD skills and real drafting experience with building plans.
- An architectural background (degree, coursework or work experience) that lets you read floor plans, sections, plats and ALTA surveys with confidence.
- Ability to measure accurately from raster drawings using scales.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Clear written and spoken English for questions and documentation.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with energy benchmarking.
- Experience with ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager (property setup, GFA entry, space use breakdown).
- Familiarity with how BOMA, ANSI or ENERGY STAR measure floor area.
- Experience measuring multifamily, condominium, hotel or shopping center properties.

Nice to have

- Familiarity with Teams and Slack as working platforms

items.title: Community Engagement Specialist
items.description:
We’re looking for a Community Manager / Engagement Specialist to support daily engagement and community-building across Instagram and TikTok.

This role is focused on hands-on community management, proactive engagement, relationship-building, and identifying relevant audience opportunities.

You’ll work directly with a social media strategist, who will provide overall direction, priorities, and brand guidance. At the same time, we want you to bring your own expertise to the role by flagging patterns, identifying opportunities, and making recommendations based on what you’re seeing in the community day to day.

You’ll also be joining a fun, growing marketing agency, with opportunities to take on more responsibility over time and potentially support additional clients as the role grows.

 Responsibilities

Daily Engagement Execution
- Approximately 1.5 hours/day, Monday-Friday
- Manage inbound engagement across Instagram and TikTok
- Respond to comments and DMs
- Moderate and hide inappropriate or irrelevant ad comments
- Proactively engage with relevant users and smaller accounts
- Research and engage existing followers
- Identify potential community members, advocates, and creator opportunities
- Engage with comments on influencer and collaboration posts
- Build relationships through thoughtful DM outreach
- Follow, like, comment, and engage with relevant accounts
- Track useful audience and community insights
- Share recommendations with the strategist based on recurring questions, sentiment, engagement patterns, and opportunities you identify

Weekend Monitoring
- Light monitoring across Instagram and TikTok
- Respond to important comments or DMs when needed
- Reshare relevant mentions and user content to Instagram Stories

ManyChat
- Monitor and follow up on ManyChat conversations and automations
- Flag issues, questions, or opportunities that require manual follow-up

What We’re Looking For
- Experience managing Instagram and TikTok communities for brands
- Strong understanding of social media engagement and community-building
- Excellent written English
- Comfortable writing naturally in an established brand voice
- Strong judgment when handling comments, DMs, and sensitive conversations
- Proactive and able to identify engagement opportunities without waiting for detailed instructions
- Comfortable collaborating closely with a strategist while also contributing your own recommendations
- Organized and consistent with daily execution
- Experience with ManyChat is a plus

This is an ongoing role with approximately 7.5 hours/week, plus light weekend monitoring, with room to grow into additional client work over time.

Please include examples of accounts you’ve managed and briefly explain your approach to proactive community engagement.

items.title: Senior UI/UX Designer: video-led landing page for a voice-AI app
items.description:
ABOUT US

VoyceAI is a voice-first content engine. You speak one sentence out loud, and it writes the script, finds the footage, records the voiceover, scores it, captions it and publishes it to your social accounts. You approve once. That is the whole interaction.

We are a small team, pre-launch, with the product built and a patent pending on one part of it. We are opening early access shortly and we want the site to be the reason people sign up.

THE JOB

We have a working site at https://get.voyceai.io, built in HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with scroll-driven motion and an interactive product mock. Structure and copy are settled. It needs a designer's eye, and it needs one big new idea executed properly.

1. THE NEW HOMEPAGE (the main piece of work)

We want the landing page to be a wall of real people, from every walk of life, living their day while VoyceAI talks to them.

People walking, cooking, getting ready, working, dancing, on a shoot, behind a counter, in a car, between meetings. Their phone is nearby, or in their hand, or propped against something. And VoyceAI speaks to them, out loud, in short lines:

 "Your reel is ready."
 "You have not posted in three days. Your views are dropping."
 "I am reviewing your post now."
 "Your post is scheduled for 7:40."
 "You got a new message. Want me to draft a reply?"
 "Want me to pull up your calendar and build something?"
 "Want me to make one for you?"

The design problem: make that feel alive and legible rather than noisy. Many clips playing at once is easy to build and hard to make good. We need the composition, the pacing, how a line surfaces and resolves, how the eye is led, how it behaves on a phone, and how it degrades when motion is reduced or autoplay is blocked.

You are designing the system, not just a layout. We will produce the footage to your spec.

2. REFINING THE REST OF THE PAGE

Type scale, spacing rhythm, grid, hierarchy. It works today. It does not yet look like a studio made it.

3. THE PRODUCT MOCK

The page contains an interactive workspace with ten panels (dashboard, create, content library, repurpose, trends, inbox, analytics, automation, bio link, event director). It is functional and undesigned. Make it look like software people would want to use.

4. A SMALL DESIGN SYSTEM IN FIGMA

Tokens, type scale, spacing, components and their states (default, hover, focus, disabled, error), so the next ten screens stay consistent without you.

5. MOBILE

Designed for mobile, not squeezed from desktop. Most of our audience is on a phone.

6. ACCESSIBILITY

Contrast and focus states.

WHAT WE PROVIDE

- The live site and all source files
- Brand already decided: near-black, warm off-white, one burnt-orange signal (#FF4D1F). Space Grotesk, Instrument Serif, Inter.
- Logo direction in progress, several marks to choose from
- All video and audio produced to your spec

WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

- A template. The structure is deliberate and we are not restarting it.
- A rebrand. Colours and type are settled.
- Screenshots only. We need layered, organised Figma with components.

DELIVERABLES

- Figma file, organised, components and tokens
- Desktop and mobile for every section
- A spec for the homepage footage: how many clips, what each shows, framing, how they are arranged and sequenced
- A short handover note on anything needing engineering attention

BUDGET AND HOURS

This is hourly, and the rate is open to negotiation. If your rate sits outside the range we posted and you think you are right for this, apply anyway and tell us what you charge.

We would rather start small and extend. Propose a first phase you can show us something real from, tell us roughly how many hours it needs, and we will go from there. We would rather pay properly for work that lands than underpay for work that does not.

BRING YOUR OWN IDEAS

We are not looking for someone to execute a brief and stop.

We want this to be the app people send to their friends, and we know design is a large part of whether that happens. The homepage idea above is where our thinking has got to, not where it has to end.

So if you look at what we are building and think we have the wrong idea, or a smaller one than we should have, say so. If you have seen something work that we have not thought of, tell us. We will take a strong opinion over a safe one.

TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic proposal, we will not read it. Instead:

1. Two links to product or landing pages you designed, and one sentence on what problem you were solving on each.
2. Open https://get.voyceai.io and tell us the single weakest thing about it visually, and what you would do instead.
3. In two or three sentences: how would you stop a page full of simultaneous video from becoming visual noise?
4. One thing we have not thought of. Something you would add, cut, or do differently to make people share this. One paragraph, and be specific.

Points 2, 3 and 4 are the ones we actually read.

items.title: Modern WordPress Website Build — Block Theme, Performance & SEO Optimized (5 Pages)
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress specialist to design and develop a high-quality, modern 5-page website using current WordPress best practices and performance-focused workflows.

This is not a basic template setup. We want a clean, scalable build using modern WordPress architecture, strong UX, and technical quality suitable for long-term maintenance.

Project overview

Design and develop a fully responsive WordPress website with 5 core pages, built for speed, SEO, accessibility, and easy content editing.

Pages

1. Home
2. About
3. Services
4. Portfolio / Case Studies
5. Contact

Technical requirements
1) WordPress architecture
- Prefer a modern block theme (FSE) or a lightweight custom theme using Gutenberg blocks
- Use reusable patterns/templates for consistent layout and branding
- Implement flexible content sections with ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) or native block patterns
- Clean, maintainable structure (no bloated multipurpose theme setups)

2) Design & frontend
- Modern, professional UI with strong visual hierarchy
- Fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile
- Semantic HTML and accessible components (WCAG-minded)
- Smooth micro-interactions where appropriate (without hurting performance)

3) Performance & Core Web Vitals
- Optimize for LCP, CLS, and INP
- Image optimization (WebP/AVIF where suitable), lazy loading, and caching setup
- Minimize unused CSS/JS and avoid unnecessary plugins
- Target fast load times on mobile

Requirements for applicants
- Proven experience with modern WordPress (Gutenberg / block themes / custom theme work)
- Portfolio showing clean UI and strong technical execution
- Clear communication and structured delivery process

We value clean code, modern WordPress practices, and a polished final product more than heavy page builders or plugin-heavy setups.

items.title: Shopify SEO Expert: Technical Fixes, Collection & Product Pages
items.description:
We are a DTC brand on Shopify, about 400 SKUs across 22 collections. Paid acquisition is carrying almost all of our revenue and the cost per order keeps climbing, so we need organic to start pulling its weight.

Where we are now:

- Collection pages rank for our brand name and almost nothing else
- Product pages are using manufacturer copy, so large parts of the catalogue are duplicated across the web
- Filtered and tagged URLs are being indexed, and we think they are competing with the collection pages we actually want ranking
- No internal linking strategy between blog content and collections

What we want done:

- Keyword research at the collection level, mapped to how buyers in our category actually search, not how we name things internally
- Technical cleanup: canonicals, faceted navigation, index bloat, sitemap hygiene
- Rewritten collection and product page copy for our top 30 revenue drivers
- Product and review schema implemented correctly across the catalogue
- Internal linking that connects existing blog posts to money pages

Please tell us which of these you expect to move revenue first and why. We are more interested in your reasoning on sequencing than in a list of deliverables.

Shopify experience is required. We are not looking to replatform.

items.title: Adobe InDesign / Prepress Specialist Needed to Correct Print-Ready Book Cover PDFs
items.description:
I am looking for an experienced Adobe InDesign / print prepress specialist to correct an existing print-ready hardcover book cover PDF for commercial printing through Lulu.
The book has already been designed and I do not need any creative redesign or changes to the artwork. The original Adobe InDesign source files are unfortunately no longer available, but I have the completed high-resolution print-ready PDF.
Recent copies of the book have been printing significantly darker and less vibrant than previous copies. Lulu reviewed the file and identified issues involving the embedded RGB/ICC color profile and transparency/layer handling.
Lulu has confirmed that the existing cover PDF can be corrected by placing it into Adobe InDesign and re-exporting it according to their specifications.
Lulu has specifically instructed that the corrected file should:
- Be exported using PDF/X-1a:2001
- Use the appropriate color profile for Lulu printing
- Maintain the existing correct dimensions and full bleed
- Have transparencies properly flattened
- Be checked in Adobe Acrobat Pro for transparency/prepress issues
- Preserve the existing artwork, typography, placement, and overall appearance
Initial Project
I would like to begin with ONE hardcover cover PDF as a paid test.
The goal is to receive a technically corrected, print-ready PDF that I can upload to the existing Lulu project and order a physical replacement copy.
If the corrected cover prints successfully, I have several additional book/journal covers that will need the same type of prepress correction, so there is potential for additional work.
Ideal Freelancer
I am specifically looking for someone with experience in:
Adobe InDesign • Adobe Acrobat Pro • Commercial Print Prepress • PDF/X-1a:2001 • ICC/Color Profiles • Transparency Flattening • Print-Ready PDF Preparation
Please include in your proposal:
1. Your experience preparing PDF/X-1a:2001 files for commercial printing.
2. Your experience working with ICC/color profiles and transparency flattening.
3. Whether you are comfortable working from an existing finished PDF when the original InDesign source file is unavailable.
4. How you would verify/preflight the corrected PDF before returning it.
This is a technical prepress/file-correction project, not a book-cover redesign.
Thank you!
Kylie
Rare Bird Journals & Gifts

items.title: Remote Assistant Property Manager | AppFolio | Commercial & Multifamily
items.description:
Coastline Equity is seeking a dependable remote Assistant Property Manager to help our property management team keep communication, maintenance coordination, leasing follow-up, and property records organized for our commercial and multifamily portfolio.

You'll help move requests through to resolution, keep accurate records, and ensure the team knows what needs attention.

This role is fully remote. Work is completed through AppFolio, email, phone, and online collaboration tools. All deliverables are digital. Onsite inspections, physical repairs, and in-person showings are handled by local personnel; this role does not require onsite services or in-person attendance.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Respond professionally to resident, tenant, vendor, and prospective renter inquiries.
• Track maintenance requests, coordinate with approved vendors and local staff, and follow up on scheduling and completion.
• Support leasing by responding to inquiries, coordinating showings with local staff, and tracking application documents.
• Maintain accurate AppFolio notes, digital property files, task records, and correspondence.
• Coordinate move-in, move-out, and renewal paperwork under the property manager's direction.
• Gather invoices and supporting documents for accounting review.
• Flag urgent issues, missing information, overdue tasks, and matters requiring management approval.
• Provide clear updates identifying progress, unresolved issues, and next steps.

QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience supporting a property management team, preferably with U.S. commercial or multifamily properties.
• Strong organization and consistent follow-through.
• Clear written and spoken English, including confidence handling phone calls.
• Experience managing competing requests while maintaining accurate records.
• AppFolio experience strongly preferred.
• Comfort using Microsoft Office and online collaboration tools.
• Reliable internet, a computer, and a quiet workspace for calls.
• Sound judgment with confidential information and established approval procedures.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Requests receive timely responses. Records are accurate. Follow-ups happen when promised. Property managers receive clear updates and early notice of issues requiring their decisions.

ENGAGEMENT
Hourly, ongoing remote engagement. Budget: $10–$15 per hour, depending on relevant experience. Expected workload: 40 hours per week, for more than six months. Required work schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT), with a one-hour break. After-hours availability and participation in on-call coverage are required to respond to urgent property management issues, coordinate with approved vendors and local staff, and escalate emergencies under established procedures. The on-call schedule, response expectations, and compensation for additional work will be agreed before engagement.

TO APPLY
Please include:
1. Your property management experience and the types of properties you supported.
2. Your AppFolio experience and the tasks you performed.
3. An example of how you tracked a maintenance issue through resolution.
4. Your hourly rate and time zone, confirmation that you can work 40 hours per week Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time, and your availability for required after-hours and on-call coverage.
Please keep examples free of confidential client information.

Coastline Equity is seeking a dependable remote Assistant Property Manager to help our property management team keep communication, maintenance coordination, leasing follow-up, and property records organized for our commercial and multifamily portfolio.

You'll help move requests through to resolution, keep accurate records, and ensure the team knows what needs attention.

This role is fully remote. Work is completed through AppFolio, email, phone, and online collaboration tools. All deliverables are digital. Onsite inspections, physical repairs, and in-person showings are handled by local personnel; this role does not require onsite services or in-person attendance.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Respond professionally to resident, tenant, vendor, and prospective renter inquiries.
• Track maintenance requests, coordinate with approved vendors and local staff, and follow up on scheduling and completion.
• Support leasing by responding to inquiries, coordinating showings with local staff, and tracking application documents.
• Maintain accurate AppFolio notes, digital property files, task records, and correspondence.
• Coordinate move-in, move-out, and renewal paperwork under the property manager's direction.
• Gather invoices and supporting documents for accounting review.
• Flag urgent issues, missing information, overdue tasks, and matters requiring management approval.
• Provide clear updates identifying progress, unresolved issues, and next steps.

QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience supporting a property management team, preferably with U.S. commercial or multifamily properties.
• Strong organization and consistent follow-through.
• Clear written and spoken English, including confidence handling phone calls.
• Experience managing competing requests while maintaining accurate records.
• AppFolio experience strongly preferred.
• Comfort using Microsoft Office and online collaboration tools.
• Reliable internet, a computer, and a quiet workspace for calls.
• Sound judgment with confidential information and established approval procedures.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Requests receive timely responses. Records are accurate. Follow-ups happen when promised. Property managers receive clear updates and early notice of issues requiring their decisions.

ENGAGEMENT
Hourly, ongoing remote engagement. Budget: $10–$15 per hour, depending on relevant experience. Expected workload: 40 hours per week, for more than six months. Required work schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT), with a one-hour break. After-hours availability and participation in on-call coverage are required to respond to urgent property management issues, coordinate with approved vendors and local staff, and escalate emergencies under established procedures. The on-call schedule, response expectations, and compensation for additional work will be agreed before engagement.

TO APPLY
Please include:
1. Your property management experience and the types of properties you supported.
2. Your AppFolio experience and the tasks you performed.
3. An example of how you tracked a maintenance issue through resolution.
4. Your hourly rate and time zone, confirmation that you can work 40 hours per week Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time, and your availability for required after-hours and on-call coverage.
Please keep examples free of confidential client information.

items.title: Zapier + Clustdoc Webhook Expert Needed to Fix Existing Automation
items.description:
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Zapier automation/API developer to modify an existing production Zap that integrates with Clustdoc.
This is a specific troubleshooting/implementation project—not a full automation build from scratch.
The Problem
Our existing Zap uses Clustdoc's “New Application Created” trigger. The automation previously worked successfully, but the polling trigger now times out after 30 seconds when attempting to retrieve active applications.
We have already spent approximately two weeks troubleshooting this directly with Zapier Support and Clustdoc Support.
Both vendors are aware of the issue, and Clustdoc has provided a webhook-based workaround.
Confirmed Solution
Clustdoc has confirmed that we can use its webhook system instead of the native polling trigger.
The proposed flow is:
Clustdoc application_created webhook → Zapier Catch Hook → Application ID → Clustdoc lookup/action if necessary → Existing Zap workflow
Clustdoc has confirmed:
- Webhook event: application_created
- The webhook payload includes the Application ID
- This approach will work for our use case
Zapier has also confirmed that using a Catch Hook/Webhooks trigger is an appropriate workaround.
Clustdoc documentation:
https://app.clustdoc.com/api-docs/v2/#section/Webhooks
Scope of Work
We need someone to:
1. Review the existing Zap and Clustdoc configuration.
2. Configure the Clustdoc application_created webhook.
3. Configure the appropriate Zapier Catch Hook/Webhook trigger.
4. Capture the Clustdoc Application ID.
5. Ensure the automation only processes applications from the appropriate onboarding process/template.
6. Retrieve additional Clustdoc application information if required.
7. Connect the new webhook trigger to the existing downstream Zap steps, preserving as much of the current automation as possible.
8. Prevent duplicate or unintended executions.
9. Perform complete end-to-end testing with new test applications.
10. Deploy and verify the automation in production.
Important
We do not want to rebuild or duplicate our existing Clustdoc onboarding process.
We also want to preserve the existing Zap and downstream automation wherever possible. The objective is primarily to replace the failing polling trigger with the webhook solution.
Current Environment
- Zapier workflow: Existing production automation
- Clustdoc template/process: Welcome to Kev's Gym! - New Instructor On-Boarding
- Clustdoc Process ID: 299137
- Active applications: Approximately 21
- Existing Clustdoc action steps: Working
- Problem: Native Clustdoc polling trigger exceeds Zapier's 30-second timeout
Ideal Freelancer
You should have strong experience with:
- Zapier
- Webhooks by Zapier / Catch Hook
- REST APIs
- JSON/webhook payloads
- Trigger filtering
- Debugging existing automations
- Modifying production Zaps without unnecessarily rebuilding them
Experience with Clustdoc is a plus but not required if you are comfortable working from API/webhook documentation.
When Applying
Please answer these questions:
1. Have you built Zapier automations using Catch Hook/webhook triggers before?
2. Based on the description above, briefly explain how you would approach this implementation.
3. Do you anticipate needing to rebuild the existing Zap, or should the downstream steps generally be reusable?
4. Approximately how many hours do you estimate this will take, including testing?
5. What is your total estimated cost?
6. How soon can you complete it?
We can provide the selected developer with the existing Zap configuration, Clustdoc access/information, support correspondence, and additional technical details needed to complete the project.
We are looking to hire quickly.

For each song, deliver an .xtiming file with just the lyrics. 

Download xLights (its free)

Phrases — aligned to when the vocal line is actually sung


Instrumental sections stay empty. Vocals-only 

Songs: Enter Sandman, Ghostbusters, Monster Mash, Somebodies Watchin me, Spooky scary skeletons, Bloody Mary & The Dead Dance. 

Thank you

items.title: Smartphone & YouTube Study in Germany
items.description:
We are looking for a freelancer with access to participants in Germany to help us recruit for a 12-month market research study about smartphone and YouTube usage.

- Candidates must:

* Live in Germany and plan to remain there for 12 months
* Be fluent in German
* Currently own and use an Android smartphone
* Have an active mobile data plan
* Have a personal Gmail account used for YouTube
* Be willing to use a Samsung Galaxy A56 provided by the study throughout the 12-month period
* Meet the remaining screening criteria

- Participant incentive:

* Samsung Galaxy A56 128 GB (approx. €300 value)
* €5 after the initial questionnaire
* €5 at 6 months
* €15 at 12 months

**Total value: approximately €325.**

- Your role as a recruiter:

You will identify and screen potential participants, ensure they meet the requirements and understand the 12-month commitment, and submit qualified candidates to our team for final validation.

- Recruiter payment:

Payment is made to the recruiter after the participant has been approved, received the phone, and completed the first questionnaire.
Rejected, duplicate, or incomplete profiles are not paid.
We are especially interested in recruiters with strong access to people aged 44+ in Germany and the ability to consistently provide qualified participants.

If you’re interested, please tell us briefly about your recruitment experience and how you would reach potential participants in Germany.

items.title: Fractional CMO Start Up Saas
items.description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Fractional CMO / Growth Marketer to help launch and scale RoofQuoter.com, a SaaS platform built specifically for roofing contractors.

RoofQuoter combines roof measurement tools with a simple roofing CRM, allowing contractors to measure roofs, organize jobs, manage customers, and run more of their business from one platform.

We are bootstrapped and currently at the beginning of customer acquisition. Our goal is to go from 0 → 10 → 100+ paying subscribers while developing a repeatable, low-CAC growth engine.

We want to start primarily with Facebook/Meta.

Responsibilities may include:

- Develop and execute our Facebook/Meta growth strategy
- Identify opportunities within roofing Facebook groups
- Help build our own branded roofing contractor Facebook community
- Create and test organic posts, offers, DMs, and outreach strategies
- Test Meta advertising after identifying messaging that converts
- Improve the funnel from first contact → trial → paid subscriber
- Track CAC, conversion rates, activation, retention, and channel performance
- Identify additional growth channels once Facebook is working

We already have Instagram content/outreach and are developing n8n-powered outbound marketing, so you will not be starting from zero.

We want someone who thinks strategically but is also willing to execute. This is not a role for someone who simply creates marketing plans and hands them off.

Experience growing SaaS, contractor/home-service software, or B2B products is strongly preferred.

Please include specific examples of companies/products you’ve helped grow, what you personally handled, and measurable results.

items.title: Influencer Sourcing & Outreach Manager – Astrology / Instagram + TikTok
items.description:
About us
We're a fast-growing AI astrology app with a small, tight-knit remote team. Creators are one of our main growth channels, and we're looking for someone to own the top of that funnel: finding the right creators, starting the conversation, and getting them onto a call with our founder.

The role
This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role. You'll spend most of your day scrolling with a purpose, spotting creators who fit, messaging them, following up, and keeping the pipeline clean. You won't be starting from zero. Our outreach system is already built and converting well: message templates, a voice-note step, a follow-up sequence, a tracking sheet with daily follow-up queues, and a sourcing account that already follows hundreds of creators in the niche. Your job is to run it at volume, run it well, and over time improve it.

What you'll do

- Find and contact 50 new creators every day in astrology, manifestation, spirituality, tarot, energy work and related niches, on Instagram and TikTok (TikTok is new ground for us, so you'll help open it up)
- Qualify every creator against our criteria:
 **10K–100K followers
 **10K–500K views per post, consistently, not one viral outlier
 **English-speaking audience
 **Real engagement and content that fits our style
- Send personalised first messages, voice notes and follow-ups using our process
- /Reply to creators fast. Speed is one of the biggest drivers of conversion in this role
- Keep the tracking sheet updated every day: new contacts, replies, follow-ups, calls booked
- Over time, look at the numbers, spot what's working, and suggest improvements

Who we're looking for

- An eye for content. You can scroll a profile for 30 seconds and tell whether a creator is good, on-brand and actually engaging, or not. This is the most important skill for this role
- Honest, genuine and reliable. We care a lot about team culture
- Hardworking and self-motivated, with real agency: you don't wait to be told what to do next
- A strong, natural communicator in English, writing casual, human DMs
- Organised and consistent with daily volume and follow-ups
- Experience in influencer sourcing, creator outreach, UGC or social media is a strong plus
- Familiarity with the astrology / spirituality / wellness space is a big plus

This is a long-term collaboration with lots of place for growth.

items.title: Label Designer Needed – Recreate Premium Fertilizer Label
items.description:
I need a designer to recreate an existing product label for a liquid fertilizer called Black Root Elixir, and to design a matching back label in the same style.

What I need:

Front label: an exact recreation of my reference image (attached). It has a dark cracked-soil background, glowing gold roots, a droplet with sacred geometry, a tree-of-life emblem, a crown, a thin arched gold border, a cracked-stone title, and 8 small circular icons with captions. The look, colors, layout and feel must match the reference as closely as possible.

Back label: a new design in the exact same style and visual language, so the two labels look like one set. I'll provide the text (directions, ingredients/analysis, safety, company info, etc.).

Label size: 7" wide × 7.5" tall. Please include 0.125" bleed and safe margins.

Key requirement: all text must be fully editable. The product title can stay a vector. 

Do not deliver flattened images with the text baked in.
All text must be live type in the final files, with fonts either included or named so I can install them.
Artwork (background, roots, droplet, emblem) should be on separate layers from the text.
Icons should be vector or on their own layers.

Skills I'm looking for:

Experience with AI image tools (Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or similar) to generate the artwork
Proficiency in Photoshop and/or Illustrator
Background in product label or packaging design, and an understanding of print production (300 dpi, bleed, CMYK, print-ready PDFs)
Strong attention to detail. I want a near-identical match, not a "similar style."

Deliverables:

Print-ready PDF (front and back, CMYK, with bleed)
Layered, editable source files (.PSD, .AI or .INDD) with live text
High-resolution PNG previews
List of fonts used
2 rounds of revisions

To apply, please include:

2–3 examples of product labels or packaging you've designed

items.title: Native French Literary Editor – Style, Rhythm & Polish of Novel Sample (3,500 words)
items.description:
I am seeking a native French literary editor or experienced translator for a style polish, rhythm adjustment, and proofread of a ~3,500-word French sample (Prologue & Chapter 1) for an upmarket contemporary literary novel.

About the Project:

The novel is a piece of voice-driven contemporary literary fiction exploring themes of identity, belonging, and social compliance in modern Southeast Asia. The prose balances dark humour, intense psychological interiority, and sharp social critique (comparable in tone and style to authors like Édouard Louis, Brandon Taylor, or Sunjeev Sahota).

The Scope:

A complete French baseline draft is prepared. I need a native literary eye to perform a thorough editing and polishing pass to ensure the text reads as organic, high-art French prose.

Key Tasks:

Rhythm & Cadence: Vary sentence lengths, refine sentence structures, and ensure a natural literary flow with an authentic human voice.

Vocabulary & Tone: Ensure the dark humor, rhythm, and emotional weight land naturally in European French.

Cultural Terms: Preserve localized cultural terms without converting them into Western approximations or over-explaining them.

Requirements:

Native French (France / European French) speaker with experience in literary fiction editing or translation.

Familiarity with contemporary, voice-driven, high-art literary prose.

Deliverable: Polished, submission-ready French text in Word or Google Doc format.

To Apply:

Please provide a brief proposal in French outlining your literary editing background, your fixed-price rate for a ~3,500-word editing pass, along with 2–3 sentences on your approach to polishing literary prose.

items.title: Outbound Sponsorship Sales Specialist — Lead Prospecting & Closing | Remote
items.description:
**Outbound Sponsorship Sales Specialist — Lead Prospecting & Closing | Remote**

**$20–$35/hour + commission | 15–20 hours per week | Ongoing opportunity**

Open Future Forum is hiring a proactive salesperson to **find new sponsor leads, contact decision-makers and turn cold prospects into paying sponsors** for our executive communities and events.

**You will be responsible for building your own sales pipeline. This is a hands-on prospecting and sales role—we are not providing a ready-made list of qualified leads or booked appointments.**

Our communities bring together CFOs, CMOs, CEOs, CISOs and YC founders in Silicon Valley and San Francisco. We are launching our General Counsel forum this month, with a Private Equity forum coming next.

Learn more: https://openfutureforum.com

**What you’ll do**

- **Hunt for new leads:** research companies that want to reach our executive audiences.
- **Build targeted prospect lists:** identify suitable companies, find the right decision-makers and source accurate business contact details.
- **Start conversations:** conduct personalized cold outreach through email, LinkedIn and calls.
- **Follow up consistently:** manage outreach sequences and keep prospects moving toward a decision.
- **Qualify opportunities:** establish audience fit, budget, timing and who approves sponsorship.
- **Run sales meetings:** book and lead Zoom calls to present relevant sponsorship packages.
- **Close deals:** prepare proposals, negotiate within approved terms and secure paying sponsors.
- **Own your pipeline:** keep prospect records, next steps and sales forecasts up to date.

Our standard sponsorship packages are typically $3,000 per month per forum, with additional opportunities for private dinners, custom events and packages across multiple communities.

Potential sponsors include banks, law firms, accounting firms, insurers, technology companies and other businesses serving senior executives.

**Who we’re looking for**

- Proven success **sourcing your own leads through outbound prospecting and closing the resulting deals**.
- Experience in sponsorship sales, B2B events, media, executive communities or comparable B2B services.
- Ability to research prospects using LinkedIn, company websites and relevant sales tools.
- Strong written and spoken English, including effective cold emails.
- Confidence speaking with senior marketing, business development and company leaders.
- Persistence, sound judgment and organized follow-up.
- Availability during agreed US Pacific business hours.

**What we provide**

You will work directly with our founder, Murray Newlands. We provide sponsorship materials, audience and event information, approved pricing and support on important closing calls.

**You own lead sourcing, outreach and sales follow-up.** Our local team handles event delivery. This role is fully remote, with no event attendance required.

**Compensation and schedule**

- $20–$30 per hour, depending on relevant experience.
- Initially 15–20 hours per week.
- Paid four-week trial, with potential for an ongoing engagement.
- 10% commission on sponsorship revenue collected from new accounts you source and close, for the first 12 months of each account. Pass-through event costs are excluded; full commission terms will be agreed before starting.

We will review the quality of your prospect lists, outbound activity, qualified meetings, proposals and collected sponsorship revenue.

**To apply, please answer:**

1. Describe a deal you personally sourced through cold outreach and closed. What was its value?
2. How would you build a prospect list for sponsorship of a Silicon Valley CFO or CISO community?
3. Which tools do you use to find companies, decision-makers and business contact details?
4. What results have you achieved from outbound sales, including meetings booked and revenue closed?
5. What is your hourly rate, availability and overlap with US Pacific time?

**Please make clear which results came from leads you found yourself.**

items.title: SEO + Technical Website Audit & Optimization
items.description:
SEO Specialist - Technical SEO, Website Audit & Off-Page SEO

I am looking for a SEO specialist to help optimize three websites associated with my businesses and personal brand:

* The Christian Social Hub - a Christian community, events, retreats, trips and membership organization
* The Christian Singles Hub - a Christian matchmaking/dating coaching business

I am looking for someone who can take a strategic, comprehensive approach to SEO rather than simply working on on page SEO or building backlinks.

The goal is to improve the technical health of our websites, increase organic search visibility, identify growth opportunities, and build a sustainable SEO strategy.

What I Need
I am looking for someone who can conduct a full SEO audit and then implement the highest-priority improvements.

 1. Technical SEO Audit
Please audit the websites for:
* Broken links
* Broken images
* 404 errors
* Redirect issues and redirect chains
* Duplicate content/pages
* Indexing and crawlability issues
* XML sitemap
* Robots.txt
* Canonical tags
* Page titles and meta descriptions
* H1/H2 structure
* Image alt text
* Website speed and Core Web Vitals
* Mobile usability
* Schema/structured data
* Internal linking
* Google Search Console issues
* Google Analytics/GA4
* Any other technical SEO issues you identify

2. Website Cleanup & Optimization
I would also like you to review the actual websites and identify opportunities to improve:

* Unnecessary/outdated WordPress plugins
* Plugin conflicts or redundancies
* Outdated website components
* Broken or outdated pages
* Broken images
* 404 pages
* Redirects
* Pop-ups
* Forms
* CTAs
* Navigation
* User experience issues that could negatively impact SEO or conversions

Where appropriate, I would like you to make the fixes, not simply give me a list of problems.

3. On-Page SEO
Please review existing pages and identify opportunities to improve organic search visibility through:

* Title tags
* Meta descriptions
* Headings
* Content structure
* Internal linking
* Image optimization
* Search intent
* Content gaps
* Page consolidation
* Identifying pages that should be expanded or rewritten

I would also like recommendations for new pages/content that could realistically bring qualified organic traffic.

4. Off-Page SEO & Link Building
I am specifically looking for high-quality, sustainable off-page SEO not low quality backlinks you can buy off a website. 

Please:
* Audit our existing backlink profiles
* Identify potentially harmful/spammy backlinks
* Research competitor backlink profiles
* Identify legitimate backlink opportunities
* Identify relevant Christian websites/directories
* Identify relevant community/event/travel websites
* Identify partnership opportunities
* Identify podcast/PR/guest-post opportunities
* Develop a realistic link-building strategy

**Important: I do NOT want black-hat SEO, link farms, PBNs, automated spam links, purchased low-quality backlinks, or hundreds of irrelevant directory links.**

Quality and relevance are much more important to me than the number of backlinks.

5. Keyword & Competitor Research

For each website, I would like you to identify:

* Primary target keywords
* Long-tail keyword opportunities
* Local SEO opportunities
* Content gaps
* Competitor keywords
* Competitor backlinks
* Pages currently ranking that could be improved
* Keywords where we are close to ranking well but need optimization

Please prioritize **qualified traffic and business relevance**, not vanity traffic.

6. Reporting & Strategy
At the end of the project, I would like a clear report showing:

**What is wrong → What was fixed → What should be done next → Why it matters → Priority level**

Please categorize recommendations as:

* High Priority
* Medium Priority
* Low Priority

I would also like a recommended **3–6 month SEO roadmap**.
### Ideal Candidate
You should have demonstrated experience with:
* Technical SEO
* WordPress
* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics/GA4
* Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz or similar SEO tools
* Keyword research
* On-page SEO
* Off-page SEO/link building
* Website audits
* Local SEO

Experience with **Christian organizations, nonprofits, community organizations, membership businesses, events, travel, dating/matchmaking, coaching, or personal brands** would be a major plus.

What I Am Looking For

I am NOT looking for someone who simply sends me an automated SEO report.

I want someone who can:
1. Audit the websites
2. Explain what they find in plain English
3. Prioritize the issues
4. Make appropriate fixes
5. Identify SEO growth opportunities
6. Build a sustainable off-page strategy
7. Communicate clearly throughout the project

I am open to continuing with the right person on a monthly basis after the initial audit and cleanup.

Deliverables
The initial project should include:
* Full technical SEO audit of 2 websites
* Keyword research
* Competitor research
* Backlink audit
* Website health/SEO report
* List of technical issues
* Implementation of agreed-upon high-priority fixes
* Broken link/image/404 cleanup
* Plugin review
* Pop-up/CTA review
* On-page SEO recommendations and improvements
* Off-page/link-building strategy
* List of backlink opportunities
* 3–6 month SEO roadmap
* Final summary of work completed and recommendations

To Apply
Please include:
1. Examples of websites you have personally optimized
2. Before/after SEO results from previous projects, if available
3. Your experience with technical SEO and link building
4. Which SEO tools you use
5. How you approach backlink building
6. What you would NOT do when building backlinks
7. Your estimated timeline for auditing and optimizing 3 websites
8. Your proposed price for the initial project
9. Whether you are available for ongoing monthly SEO work

**Please do not send a generic SEO proposal.** Tell me specifically how you would approach this project and what you would look at first.

I am looking for someone who can become a long-term SEO partner if the initial project goes well.

items.title: Webflow Developer/Designer for marketing website
items.description:
1. Clean, modular Webflow development
We want the site built using a scalable system such as Client-First, with reusable components, variables and well-structured CMS collections.
Our team should be able to easily create new service pages, industry pages, case studies and blog posts without needing a developer each time.


2. SEO-safe migration: this is our #1 priority
Our existing WordPress site has a substantial amount of blog content and existing organic rankings. We need to preserve that SEO value during the move to Webflow.


This includes preserving existing URLs wherever possible, redirect mapping where necessary, metadata/canonicals/schema, internal links, blog migration, sitemap/indexability, analytics/tracking, and pre/post-launch QA.

SEO requirements:
Migrate the website without losing existing SEO value.
Keep all important existing URLs/slugs unchanged or follow our instructions.
Block the staging website with robots.txt.
Preserve existing SEO titles, meta descriptions, H1s, content, and canonical tags.
Ensure canonical tags point to the correct indexable URLs.
Implement required Schema/JSON-LD markup or create functionality to add schema later.
Add existing tracking codes such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Search Console, Google Ads etc.
Configure robots.txt for the new website.
Configure auto-generated sitemap.xml and create a scope to exclude any URL from the sitemap.
Add functionality to implement 301 redirects.
Implement 301 redirects for old URLs or 404 URLs.
Optimize website speed and Core Web Vitals.

items.title: Pipedrive CRM Specialist
items.description:
We already use Pipedrive, but I want to make sure we're using it as an effective CRM rather than just a place to store contacts.

I'm looking for a hands-on Pipedrive specialist who can review our current setup, improve the way everything is organized, build the workflows and automations we actually need, and then train me and my team so we can confidently manage the system ourselves.

This is not just a configuration project. I want someone who can work with us, explain the reasoning behind the setup in straightforward language, and help us build a CRM process that is practical for our day-to-day business.

What I'd Like Help With

The project may include:

* Reviewing our existing Pipedrive account and identifying areas that need improvement
* Building simple dashboards and reports for visibility into our sales activity
* Creating useful automations, reminders, and recurring workflows
* Connecting email and other relevant tools when appropriate
* Recommending a CRM structure that fits our business and sales process
* Configuring pipelines, stages, contacts, organizations, activities, and custom fields
* Cleaning up, organizing, and importing existing contacts and leads
* Improving lead tracking and follow-up processes
* Creating useful automations, reminders, and recurring workflows
* Connecting email and other relevant tools when appropriate
* Creating a reliable process that helps prevent leads and follow-ups from being missed
* Identifying features or processes we're currently overlooking
* Training me and/or my staff on how to use Pipedrive effectively

How I Want to Work

The training and collaboration aspect is very important.

I don't want someone to disappear into the account, make a bunch of changes, and then simply hand the system back to us.

I'd prefer to work through the setup together, understand why certain decisions are being made, and learn how to maintain and use the system properly afterward.

I'm a business owner, not a CRM specialist, so the end result should be simple, practical, and easy for a real team to use every day.

Ideal Background

I'm looking for someone with substantial hands-on Pipedrive experience, particularly with:

* CRM implementation and customization
* Pipeline and workflow design
* Pipedrive automations
* Lead management and follow-up systems
* Email integrations
* Reporting and dashboards
* Contact and database organization
* Training business owners and internal teams

Experience supporting small businesses, service companies, consulting businesses, or owner-operated companies would be especially helpful.

I'm looking for someone who can initially help us get Pipedrive structured and working correctly, with the possibility of continuing together as we refine the system, add automations, and improve our processes over time.

items.title: Film a 50-sec vertical video ad from our script
items.description:
We are looking for UGC creators to film short vertical videos for a consumer fintech app. We provide the script and a short filming brief; you film yourself and send us the raw footage. No editing is needed — our team does all post-production.

What you deliver per script
- Main text read to camera, up to 40 seconds (2–3 full takes)
- Three alternative opening lines, up to 5 seconds each, as separate files
- 6–10 short B-roll clips: your hands scrolling the app on your phone, reactions, a few everyday shots
- Clean audio from an external or lavalier microphone

Technical
- Vertical 9:16, 4K or 1080p, phone on a tripod, good light, tidy background
- Original files only: no cuts, filters, text or music
- Delivery via Google Drive or a similar file-sharing service

Requirements
- Native LANGUAGE speaker
- Experience filming yourself on camera (please share 2–3 samples)
- Smartphone with a good camera, external microphone, tripod
- Able to follow a script word for word; questions before the shoot

The first script is a paid test. For creators we continue with, this becomes ongoing work of 2–4 scripts per month. Turnaround is 3–4 days per script.

In your proposal, please include your country and city, the languages and accents you speak natively, 2–3 links to on-camera samples, your equipment, and your rate for one script package (main text + 3 openers + B-roll).

items.title: Spine 2D Animator for BJJ App
items.description:
We’re looking for a skilled Spine 2D animator/rigging artist to create a paid prototype for TapTheory, a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu mobile app.
We want to prototype a reusable two-character skeletal animation system that can accurately communicate detailed BJJ positions, reactions, and transitions. The first prototype will focus specifically on Mount Top, with realistic grappling movement and a game-ready Spine export.
The goal is NOT to create the entire app or animation library yet. We want one genuinely high-quality vertical slice that demonstrates what this system could look and feel like long-term.
We will provide the BJJ reference material and clearly define the movements/reactions we want demonstrated. We are looking for someone who can help with the character rigging, animation, movement design, and Spine implementation.
If the prototype works well, there is potential for substantially more work creating additional positions, reactions, and transitions.

items.title: PPC & Paid Media Specialist (Contractor)
items.description:
Description

Position Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Hours: Approximately 5 hours per week, with a maximum of 20 hours per week. This is an expectation, not a guaranteed minimum, and neither party is obliged to offer or accept a given volume of work.

Availability: You set your own working days and hours. Response time to messages is one business day. Occasional meetings are arranged by mutual agreement.

Experience: Minimum 5 years of highly relevant experience

About 1UP Digital

Here at 1UP, our purpose is to help good organizations grow online while creating one of the best places to work. We believe that digital marketing is not just about KPIs and search engine algorithms; it's also about relationships. Since 2013, we've been forming lasting relationships with our clients by caring about their goals and blending technical skills with creative thinking to achieve them. Our clients grow to think of us as an extension of their teams as we prove ourselves with hard work, creativity, and great results. Our diverse team knows that we must always innovate, evolve, and are passionate about helping to take our services to the next level through mentorship and training. This helps to ensure that we bring the best digital marketing strategies to every project.

We're a group of enthusiastic individuals who enjoy helping to shape the industry and taking the initiative to bring our ideas to life. We share a desire to make a positive impact and take the opportunity to celebrate each other's success along the way. We're growing and looking to add more excellent team members to our world-class marketing team.

Overview

Do you like running creative experiments and have a passion for effective advertising?

As a PPC & Paid Media Specialist Contractor at 1UP, you will use your critical thinking and creativity to create new campaigns and ads, run experiments, and solve campaign challenges on client accounts.

Our ideal candidate will have 5+ years of Google Ads and Facebook Advertising experience, the ability to drive greater performance out of a paid campaign, be able to communicate complicated ideas clearly, and have a burning desire to be challenged and to grow.

The Job

SEM/PPC – This is the area we'll need your expertise in. You will be aligning clients with the correct channels to deliver highly qualified traffic at a competitive cost per click, and of course, you need to deliver amazing ROAS. Some of the tasks will include:

Keyword research, competitive analysis, account structuring and optimization
Identify ways to drive more performance and value from existing campaigns
Audit client accounts to identify opportunities across multiple platforms
Campaign management and optimization across multiple platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn ads and more.
Paid social campaign build and optimization
Negative keyword, audience and bid management, and budget pacing
Ad copy production
Performance analysis and troubleshooting on paid campaigns
PPC analysis and commentary for client reports prepared by the account manager

Not in scope

Account management or client relationship ownership
Client communication outside a meeting 1UP has asked you to join
Line management or performance oversight of 1UP personnel or other contractors

Separately scoped

Internal process documentation and AI skill development, agreed as its own piece of work with its own scope and fee

How it works

Work is requested through ClickUp, or by email where ClickUp is unavailable. You accept or decline each request within two business days. You determine the manner, method, sequence and hours of performance for any work you accept.

Access and equipment

1UP provides access to ClickUp, Google Workspace, and the client advertising, analytics and reporting platforms required for the work. You provide your own equipment and software.

Conditions of access: multi-factor authentication on every account; credentials stored in 1UP's password manager only and never shared; no client data on personal storage, personal email or removable media; notify 1UP within 24 hours of any lost device, compromised credential or suspected account compromise.

Rate

$70 CAD per hour plus applicable sales tax.

Skills Requirements & Qualifications

5+ years of active Google Ads & Facebook Ads management
Strategic high-level picture mindset
Extensive experience in PPC campaign optimization
Can pull knowledge bombs from data
Impeccable written and spoken English
Demonstrate strong attention to detail
Able to communicate effectively
Data analysis and problem-solving mindset
Strong working knowledge of Google Docs
Must have the ability to multitask and work within firm deadlines
Post-secondary education specializing in business/marketing/computer science

items.title: Salesforce Expert Needed – Contact-Centric Data Model Restructure, Data Cleanup & Migration
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce consultant/developer to help restructure and clean up an existing Salesforce environment.

Our goal is to move toward a more Contact-centric data model, reduce reliance on Person and Business Accounts, update Lead conversion behavior, and clean/deduplicate our existing CRM data.

The current scope includes approximately 4,900 Contacts/Person Accounts, 18,000 Leads, and 18,000 Prospect records. A large percentage of existing Person Account records do not have email addresses, so matching and deduplication will need to use multiple fields such as name, phone, address, company, and email where available. 

Key responsibilities will include:
- Review and validate the proposed Salesforce architecture
- Reconfigure the environment around Contacts
- Restrict future Person/Business Account creation
- Update Lead conversion behavior using Flow/Apex as appropriate
- Clean, match, and deduplicate existing records
- Migrate/convert Person Account data while preserving historical activity where possible
- Import net-new records
- Perform reconciliation, QA, and regression testing

The existing proposal specifically calls for a Contact-focused model, changes to Account creation and Lead conversion, Person Account cleanup, deduplication, bulk import, and validation. 

We are looking for someone with strong experience in:
- Salesforce architecture and administration
- Person Accounts
- Contacts, Accounts, and Leads
- Salesforce Flow and/or Apex
- Data migration and deduplication
- Bulk API / Data Loader
- Production migration planning and testing


Please include examples of similar Salesforce cleanup or restructuring projects, your experience with Person Accounts, your hourly rate, and your estimated effort for a project of this size.
We are looking for someone who can both recommend the right technical approach and execute the work.

items.title: Phone Closer for US Law Firm - Warm Leads, No Cold Calling
items.description:
Every lead you call already raised their hand. No cold calling, ever.

This is a CLOSING job, not a consulting job. You will not explain the law to anyone. You qualify, you quote, you close. Legal questions go to the attorney.

We are a Los Angeles law firm representing landlords whose tenants have stopped paying rent. The landlord fills out our form, it lands on your screen, and you call within five minutes.

WHAT A GOOD CALL LOOKS LIKE HERE
- Under 12 minutes, start to finish
- You find out fast whether they are the property OWNER. If they are the tenant, you politely end the call in 30 seconds. We only represent owners.
- You confirm the problem in one line. You do not re-tell them their own story.
- You state the price plainly. We start at $500. You do not apologize for it and you do not discount it.
- You send the signing link while they are still on the phone
- You ask for the card. On every qualified call. Every time.
- Before you hang up there is a signature, a payment, or a booked appointment with a date on it. Never "I'll call you back."

WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY
- Call and text every new lead within 5 minutes of it arriving
- 40+ dials a day plus text follow-up
- Handle objections without folding: "that's too expensive," "another attorney quoted me less," "let me talk to my wife," "let me think about it"
- Chase every lead at least 7 times over 10 business days before letting it go
- Log every lead in our CRM (Lawmatics) the same day, with the fee entered
- Send one short numbers report every Friday

WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO
- Cold call
- Explain notices, timelines, court procedure, or what a judge will decide. That is the attorney's job. People who try to become the legal expert do not last in this role.
- Give discounts
- Call yourself a paralegal or a manager. You are intake.

WHAT YOU NEED
- Excellent spoken English. Clear, warm, neutral accent, easy for an American landlord to understand. This is tested first, before we read anything else.
- 2+ years on the phone in sales, collections, or a US-account BPO
- You have carried a quota and hit it, and you can quote the actual numbers
- Thick skin on price. The most common reason people fail this role is that they get uncomfortable asking for money and start explaining instead.
- Discipline with a CRM. If it is not logged, it did not happen.

items.title: Short Form POV Video Editor
items.description:
# Short Form POV Video Editor for Contractor / Jobsite Content

We are looking for a skilled short form video editor who has experience editing **POV, talking head, and real world jobsite content** for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook.

This is intended to become an ongoing position with consistent weekly content.

## THE CONTENT

Our raw footage typically comes from two sources:

**Talking Head Footage**

I record myself talking in my vehicle while traveling to and from jobsites.

Before the job, I may explain:

• What we're doing that day 
• The customer's situation 
• What we expect to find 
• What makes the project interesting 
• Problems we may encounter

After the project, I may record another segment explaining:

• What happened 
• What we found 
• How the problem was handled 
• The final result 
• Lessons homeowners can take from the project

**POV Jobsite Footage**

While onsite, I wear Meta smart glasses and record first person POV footage.

This may include:

• Excavation 
• Underground oil tank removals 
• Soil contamination 
• Soil testing 
• Equipment operating 
• Workers performing the project 
• Unexpected problems 
• Before and after footage 
• Roofing projects 
• Construction details 
• Conversations and explanations from the field

Some POV clips will also contain me explaining what is happening while I'm working.

## YOUR JOB

You will receive the raw footage from the entire project.

Your job is to **find the story inside the footage and turn it into compelling short form content.**

We do NOT want someone who needs exact timestamps and instructions for every edit.

You should be able to review the footage and determine:

• What the strongest hook is 
• Which talking head sections matter 
• Which POV clips support the story 
• What should be removed 
• Where the video becomes boring 
• How to maintain viewer attention 
• Where captions or text should emphasize an important point 
• How to build toward a payoff or conclusion

Think of the footage as raw ingredients. We need you to build the final story.

## EDITING STYLE

We want the videos to feel:

**Authentic 
Fast paced 
Educational 
Professional 
Interesting 
Jobsite driven**

We do NOT want overly edited "TikTok" content filled with unnecessary animations, memes, emojis, sound effects, or constant zooming.

The actual work happening on the jobsite should be the entertainment.

The viewer should feel like they are **coming to the job with us.**

A typical video might look something like:

**HOOK**

Start with the most interesting moment from the project.

Example:

"This was supposed to be a simple oil tank removal until we saw what was underneath it."

Show POV footage immediately.

**CONTEXT**

Use a short talking head clip explaining why we're at the property and what we're doing.

**THE JOB**

Move into Meta glasses POV footage.

Show the excavation, removal, testing, discovery, problem, equipment, etc.

Use my onsite explanations when they add value.

**PROBLEM / DISCOVERY**

If something unexpected happens, build the story around it.

Don't reveal everything immediately if maintaining some curiosity will improve retention.

**EXPLANATION**

Cut back to talking head footage when necessary to explain what the viewer just saw.

**RESULT / PAYOFF**

Show what happened and how the project ended.

**TAKEAWAY**

Finish with a useful lesson, conclusion, or short call to action.

## CAPTIONS

Videos should have clean, easy to read captions.

Do not overload the screen.

Important words, numbers, prices, measurements, or discoveries can receive additional emphasis.

Examples:

$15,000 REMEDIATION

FAILED INSPECTION

CONTAMINATED SOIL

550 GALLON OIL TANK

The viewer should still be able to understand what is happening without the captions becoming the main focus of the video.

## SOUND

Natural jobsite sound is important.

Excavators, equipment, tanks being removed, roofing tear offs, tools, etc. should occasionally be heard to make the viewer feel like they are actually there.

Background music can be used when appropriate but should never overpower the voice or natural jobsite audio.

## MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT

You need to understand **storytelling and retention.**

Knowing Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve is not enough.

I am looking for someone who can take 20 to 60+ minutes of miscellaneous footage and recognize:

**"This is the story."**

Then turn it into a compelling 30 to 90 second video.

There may also be opportunities to turn one project into multiple short form videos when the footage contains multiple useful stories or educational topics.

## TO APPLY

Please send:

1. 3 examples of short form videos you personally edited.

2. At least one example involving POV, construction, trades, automotive, real estate, behind the scenes, documentary, or similar real world content if available.

3. Tell me what software you edit with.

4. Tell me approximately how long it would take you to review 30 to 60 minutes of raw footage and produce a polished 30 to 90 second video.

5. Tell me your pricing per completed video or your hourly rate.

6. Start your application with the words **"POV EDITOR"** so I know you actually read the entire post.

### PAID TEST EDIT

Final candidates will be given the same batch of raw footage and paid to create one short form video.

I will intentionally provide limited editing direction.

I want to see how you identify the hook, build the story, use the POV footage, maintain retention, and decide what should be cut.

This is an ongoing opportunity for the right editor.

We're a Toronto-based custom software development company (paracon.ca) looking for genuine, editorially-earned backlinks to improve our search visibility.

What we need:
- Links from real, actively-maintained websites with genuine organic traffic — not PBNs, link farms, or expired-domain networks
- Topically relevant placements: technology, software development, business, SaaS, or startup-focused publications

- Links from PBNs, expired-domain networks, or sites that exist only to sell links

1. 3-5 examples of backlinks you've placed for other clients (live URLs, not screenshots)
2. Your process for finding/pitching placements
3. Typical domain authority range of sites you work with

We verify every placement independently before paying, and compensation is per published, verified link, not a lump sum upfront.

items.title: Google Ads Specialist – Local Lead Generation for US Construction Business
items.description:
Overview

We are a growing construction business based in the United States specializing in high-ticket residential and commercial projects (including custom builds, major renovations, roofing, and general contracting). We are seeking a results-driven Google Ads Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale our pay-per-click (PPC) campaigns to generate high-quality phone calls and qualified form submissions from local property owners.

Our primary goal is to lower our Cost Per Lead (CPL) while increasing lead quality in competitive local markets.

Key Responsibilities

+ Campaign Setup & Strategy: Audit existing accounts (or structure new ones) utilizing local Search, Google Local Services Ads (LSA), and targeted Performance Max campaigns.
+ Keyword & Competitor Research: Perform in-depth research to target high-intent search terms (e.g., "commercial contractor near me," "home remodeling company") while maintaining strict negative keyword lists to prevent wasted budget.
+ Conversion & Call Tracking: Set up and maintain precise conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager, GA4, and call-tracking tools (e.g., CallRail) to measure real-time lead acquisition and ROI.
+ Ad Copywriting & Extensions: Draft compelling, localized ad copy and utilize all relevant assets (sitelinks, callouts, structured snippets, call extensions) to maximize Click-Through Rates (CTR).
+ Landing Page Recommendations: Review existing landing pages and provide actionable feedback on messaging, layout, and trust factors to improve conversion rates.
+ Ongoing Optimization & Management: Conduct regular bid management, A/B testing on ad creative, geo-targeting adjustments, and weekly search term audits.
+ Reporting: Provide clear, bi-weekly/monthly performance reports highlighting ad spend, impression share, cost per lead (CPL), and lead volume.

Qualifications & Requirements

Proven Track Record: Minimum 3+ years managing successful Google Ads accounts specifically for construction, home services, or trade industries (roofing, remodeling, HVAC, etc.).
US Market Familiarity: Experience targeting local metro areas, ZIP codes, and radiuses within competitive US markets.
Certifications: Active Google Ads Search and Measurement certifications preferred.
Tech Stack Mastery: Deep proficiency in Google Ads Manager, Google Tag Manager, GA4, and call-tracking software (CallRail, WhatConverts, etc.).
Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to translate performance metrics into clear business insights and quick strategic pivots.
Communication: Strong communication skills in written and spoken English, with prompt response times.

How to Apply
To be considered for this role, please include the following in your proposal:

Relevant Experience: Briefly outline your experience running Google Ads for construction or home services businesses.

Case Studies/Results: Provide 1–2 examples or metrics from previous campaigns (e.g., starting CPL vs. final CPL, conversion rate improvements).

Approach: Briefly state what call-tracking and management tools you recommend for local lead generation.

Pricing Structure: Outline your rate (hourly rate or flat monthly management fee per account).

Please start your proposal with the word "BUILD" so we know you read the full job post.

items.title: FastAPI Engineer Needed to Fix Async Performance and PostgreSQL Connection Issues
items.description:
We have an existing FastAPI backend that works normally under light traffic but becomes unstable when several requests arrive at the same time.
The service receives API requests, calls an external HTTP service, processes the returned data, and stores the results in PostgreSQL.
Under normal usage, responses are reasonably fast. Under bursts of concurrent traffic, we are seeing a combination of:
- request latency increasing sharply
- PostgreSQL connections being exhausted or waiting too long
- occasional request timeouts and 5xx responses
- some requests remaining open much longer than expected
- performance recovering slowly even after traffic drops
The backend currently uses Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x async sessions, asyncpg, PostgreSQL, and httpx.
We need someone who can review the existing request flow, identify the actual bottleneck, and correct the implementation rather than simply increasing connection-pool limits.
Areas that may need attention include async session lifecycle, transaction duration, connection pooling, blocking work inside async endpoints, outbound HTTP concurrency, timeout handling, and query behavior. We do not want to assume which one is responsible before the code is reviewed.
The goal is to make the existing service behave predictably under concurrent load without unnecessarily redesigning the application.
Expected work includes reproducing the issue, identifying the root cause, implementing the necessary changes, and adding regression or load coverage that demonstrates the improvement.
Please keep the solution practical. We are not looking to introduce Celery, Kafka, Kubernetes, or additional infrastructure unless the existing architecture genuinely requires it.
When applying, please describe how you would begin diagnosing this type of FastAPI issue. In particular, we are interested in how you would distinguish between an async application problem, database connection pressure, slow queries, and an external-service bottleneck.
Experience troubleshooting real FastAPI/PostgreSQL applications under concurrent load is especially relevant.
There may be additional backend work after this issue is resolved.

items.title: RedTrack Tracking & Attribution Specialist
items.description:
# RedTrack Tracking Specialist

We’re looking for an experienced **RedTrack Tracking Specialist** to set up accurate tracking between our advertising platforms, funnels, and payment platforms.

## Responsibilities

- Set up RedTrack across our funnels and checkout flows
- Connect platforms such as Meta, Taboola, Newsbreak, MGID, Google Ads, Digistore24, Clickfunnel, Explodely
- Configure pixels, postbacks, webhooks, UTMs, click IDs, and conversion tracking
- Track purchases, upsells, downsells, and revenue correctly
- Make sure conversion data is sent back accurately to advertising platforms
- Troubleshoot attribution and tracking discrepancies
- Test the full flow from ad click to purchase

## Requirements

- Proven hands-on experience with **RedTrack**
- Strong understanding of S2S tracking, postbacks, pixels, webhooks, UTMs, and attribution
- Experience with Direct Response or affiliate marketing funnels
- Ability to troubleshoot tracking issues independently
- Basic HTML/JavaScript knowledge is a plus

To apply, please include your RedTrack experience, platforms you’ve worked with, availability, and rate.

items.title: Marketing Operations | Technical Project Manager — AI Production & Automation
items.description:
1 · The engagement
You build and run the technical backend of the growth system: landing pages, tracking, integrations, publishing, lead capture and reporting. You take approved strategy and approved creative and turn them into things that are live, measurable and repeatable.

The work runs in weekly cycles. Each Monday we agree that week’s run; at the end of the week you deliver it and it is reviewed against what we agreed.


2 · Scope changes week to week
The scope of a weekly run is set each Monday and can change from week to week. Some weeks will be five prospect sets. Others will be the website, the funnel sheet, the CRM wiring, the tracking rebuild, or a mix. The hours and the weekly amount stay the same; what they buy is agreed at the start of each week.

3. Reporting
The operating record is one continuous Google Doc, and it is the system of record. A short daily entry, the Monday run agreement, and a Friday report covering what shipped, what is open and what is blocked.

4 · Review
The arrangement is month to month. We review at the end of each month: whether the weekly runs are landing, whether the shape of a run still fits, and whether the volume or the rate should change. Either side can raise a change at that point.
