items.title: Expert Needed: GTM, GA4 + Ad Pixel Tracking Setup (Google, Microsoft, TikTok, Meta, StackAdapt)
items.description:
We're a Miami-based nonprofit that runs creativity and education programs for kids, families, and adults.

We need full consumer-journey tracking (ad clicks, through website behavior, through ticket purchase or registration) implemented rapidly and correctly on the first pass. This post defines the scope, the expertise required, and the timeline.

PROJECT SUMMARY
- We're launching paid ad campaigns across Google, Microsoft, TikTok, Meta, and StackAdapt to drive donations and sell tickets and registrations for local community programs centered on creativity and education. Prices for programs range from free to $50. 
- We need every ad click, every website interaction, and every ticket button click across all program pages tracked end-to-end through to purchase or registration.
- We need ads to launch in just a few days. Conversion tracking must be live first, with the rest completed right after.
- Priority: speed and correctness. We need someone who can execute this without a learning curve.

SCOPE OF WORK
1. Install one Google Tag Manager (GTM) container site-wide (or audit and consolidate our existing one).
2. Configure Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for full-site behavior tracking, including a custom event fired every time a "Donate" or "Get Tickets" button is clicked, tagged with the specific page it fired from.
3. Deploy and verify conversion pixels/tags for Google Ads, Microsoft (Bing) UET, TikTok Pixel, Meta, and StackAdapt, each firing correctly on the confirmation page. Track three conversion types:
 • Donations
 • Ticket purchases
 • Free Registrations or Form Fills (contest entries, contact forms, and free tickets)
4. Install a Meta Pixel through GTM and leave it paused. Our Meta ad account is offline right now, and we want it ready to switch on when access returns.
5. Set up cross-domain tracking where ticket purchases completed on a separate platform (Zeffy or Funraise), so purchases still attribute back to the originating click.
6. Link GA4 to Google Ads. Our Google Ad Grants application is pending; once approved, link GA4 to that account too and import our conversions there.
7. Implement and document a standardized UTM parameter convention across all ad platforms.
8. Build a Looker Studio (or equivalent) dashboard visualizing the full funnel: ad platform → landing page → ticket button click (by program) → completed purchase or registration. 
9. QA every tag and event live: verified firing with real test clicks and purchases, not just "installed."
10. Deliver written documentation of every event, parameter, and pixel so our team (or a future vendor) can maintain it without starting over.

EXPERTISE WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- Demonstrated hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager and GA4 event tracking.
- Direct experience implementing ad pixels for Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and TikTok Ads specifically. StackAdapt experience is a plus, not a requirement.
- Comfortable working directly in website code and WordPress to place tags, or able to work efficiently with our Senior Art Director if access is restricted.
- Experience building funnel/attribution dashboards in Looker Studio or a comparable BI tool.
- Nonprofit or education-sector experience is a plus, not a requirement.
- Able to work at a fast pace with proactive, near-daily communication during setup.
- Bonus: experience building, launching, and monitoring campaigns in Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, Meta, and StackAdapt.

TIMELINE EXPECTATIONS
Given the urgency, this will run as a fixed, rapid-turnaround engagement:
- Day 1: Kickoff call, access confirmed, technical audit of current site/tagging state.
- Day 2: Priority setup. GTM, GA4, and conversion tracking for Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and TikTok live and tested, so ads aren't running untracked.
- Days 3–4: StackAdapt, the paused Meta Pixel, cross-domain tracking, and Google Ad Grants linking. UTM convention documented and applied across live campaigns.
- Day 5: Full QA, dashboard delivered, documentation handed off.

Target: finished, QA'd, and documented within 5 business days, including kickoff. Flag immediately if any part of this timeline is unrealistic given our current site setup.

WHAT WE WILL PROVIDE
- GA4 property access: admin access to our GA4 property
- Google Tag Manager access: admin access to an existing container, or approval to create one
- Ad platform access: admin/standard access to Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, StackAdapt, and Meta
- Website access: WordPress access + direct line to our Senior Art Director
- Ticketing platform details: where tickets are sold (our site, Zeffy, and Funraise) and access
- List of program pages: every page with a ticket button that needs click tracking
- List of confirmation/thank-you pages: every thank-you page that loads after a purchase or registration
- Full brief: full context on campaigns, goals, and platforms in play

DELIVERABLES CHECKLIST
- Fully configured GTM container, all platform pixels installed (Meta paused)
- GA4 custom event tracking every ticket button click, by program page
- Verified, tested conversion tracking for Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, TikTok, and StackAdapt (paid purchases and free registrations)
- GA4 linked to Google Ads (and Google Ad Grants once approved)
- Standardized UTM convention documented and in use across all live campaigns
- Looker Studio (or equivalent) dashboard showing the full consumer journey and drop-off points
- Written tracking documentation handed off to our team
- Live QA confirmation: actually tested and verified firing, not just installed

FOLLOW-UP PROJECT (BONUS)
Once tracking is complete, our next project is building and uploading all of our ad campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, TikTok, Meta, and StackAdapt. All copy, targeting, budgets, and links are already written and organized in campaign workbooks. Artwork is being finalized. If you can handle this too, that's a big plus, and we'd love to keep working with the same person.

items.title: Appointment Setter for Inbound Coaching Leads (Text and Phone Follow-Up)
items.description:
The SMB Solution is a business coaching company that helps small business owners build more profitable, better-run companies. Leads come in through our marketing funnel, and we need a reliable appointment setter to own the first touch and get every good lead booked on our closer's calendar.

The closer is our founder and lead coach, so your work directly feeds his calendar. This is a performance-based role, so your earnings grow with the appointments you set.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Contact new leads quickly by text and phone as soon as they come in
Ask a short set of qualifying questions to confirm they're a fit
Book qualified leads onto the closer's calendar
Keep following up with a consistent cadence until the lead books or opts out
Keep lead notes and statuses updated so nothing falls through the cracks
Flag common questions, objections or issues you hear so we can improve the funnel

TOOLS AND SETUP
We run everything in GoHighLevel (GHL). You'll get your own login, and we'll have lead info, scripts, follow-up templates and the calendar ready to go. If you haven't used GHL, we'll show you around. Experience with it is a plus, not a requirement.

PAY

Paid per appointment set
Bonuses when you hit monthly appointment thresholds
We're open to your proposed rate per booked appointment. Please include it in your proposal.
Payment will be handled through Upwork

VOLUME
Right now we receive about 5 to 10 new leads per week. We can increase lead volume at any time, so there's room to grow as we see results.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Prior experience with inbound lead follow-up, appointment setting or a similar sales support role
Excellent spoken and written English. You'll be calling and texting US-based business owners.
Warm, professional and confident on the phone. You build trust quickly without being pushy.
Fast and consistent response times. Speed to lead matters a lot in this role.
Organized, self-managed and dependable
Comfortable following a script while sounding natural
Reliable phone and internet access during US business hours (Eastern time)

NICE TO HAVE

GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience
Experience with coaching, consulting, B2B services or small business owners
Experience working with a closer or sales team

HOW TO APPLY
Please answer these in your proposal:

Tell us about your experience with inbound lead follow-up or appointment setting. Which industries?
What would you charge per booked appointment, and are you open to a performance-based model with bonuses?
What hours are you available, and how quickly can you typically respond to a new lead?
Do you work solo or with a team?
Have you used GoHighLevel or another CRM? Which ones?

WHAT TO EXPECT
We'll start with a short call to talk through the role, followed by a paid trial period of 1 to 2 weeks. We'll track speed to first contact and booking rate, then move into an ongoing arrangement if it's a good fit for both sides.

We value clear communication, accountability and people who take pride in their results. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

items.title: Appointment Setter - Call leads when they come in and book them in, only 4-6 leads expected per day.
items.description:
Spanish-Speaking Appointment Setter — Consultations for a Med Spa

Compensation: $200-300 (negotiable) per month base (paid in weekly payments of $50), plus $10 per booked and deposit-collected appointment. For example, 10 appointments in a month brings total pay to $300.

About the role:
We run Meta ads for a med spa offering RF Microneedling consultations. When a Spanish-speaking lead fills out our form, you will get notified by text or email right away. Your job is to call that lead, answer their questions, and book them into a consultation using our booking software, Vagaro. Full training on Vagaro will be provided.

What the work looks like:

Leads come in throughout the day, any time between 8 AM and 10 PM.
Expect roughly 2 to 4 Spanish-speaking leads per day.
Speed matters most in this role. Leads must be called within 5 minutes of coming in.
Each lead needs a $25 deposit collected over the phone to hold their consultation spot. You will be trained on exactly how to do this.
This is a flexible, remote, contract position, not hourly. You are paid for availability and results, not a set schedule, since leads can come in at any point during the day.

What we're looking for:

Fluent Spanish speaker, comfortable on the phone
Available to respond quickly throughout the day
Comfortable learning a simple booking system (Vagaro)
Friendly, clear communicator who can explain a service and handle basic questions

Getting started:
We will hop on a call to onboard you, walk through Vagaro, and get you set up before your first leads come in. Looking to fill this as soon as possible.

NOTE: This is a Monday-Sunday role

items.title: B2B LinkedIn Sales & Business Development Manager – Commission/Performance Based
items.description:
BenchEval is looking for an experienced B2B business development and LinkedIn sales professional who can identify prospects, start conversations, generate qualified opportunities, and help bring new clients to our business.

items.title: Video Editor Needed: 4 Videos for SaaS Conference (Due 10/13)
items.description:
We're a B2B SaaS company preparing for an upcoming conference and need an experienced video editor to polish four videos:

• Three short-form videos (1 minute or less each)
• One product demo (8-10 minutes) edited to align with our brand and the conference's technical video requirements

Demo video requirements:

• Export in 16:9, 1920 x 1080
• No burned-in captions. The conference organizer adds captions in post-production.
• Keep the bottom of the frame clear. Reserve the bottom 80px for captions, with no important visuals, UI, or presenter video there.
• Any on-screen text or lower thirds must sit within a 220px lower-third zone, above the caption area, per the organizer's pixel map (we'll provide it).
• No background music and no unnecessary animations or transitions.

What we're looking for:

• A strong portfolio of SaaS, tech, or software demo video
• Skill with pacing, tight cuts, screen recording cleanup, zooms, and callouts
• Ability to follow brand guidelines (we'll provide colors, fonts, and logos)
• Attention to detail on technical specs, since non-compliant files get sent back
• Clear communication and reliable turnaround

Timeline: Final deliverables are due by 10/13. Please confirm you can meet this deadline before applying.

To apply, please include:

• Links to 2-3 relevant samples, ideally SaaS or product demo videos
• Your estimated turnaround and rate for this project
• The editing software you use

We'll share raw footage, brand assets, and the full spec sheet once we've selected an editor.

items.title: Editor de vídeo de marca ecommerce de belleza
items.description:
Busco 1 Editor de vídeo con IA para marca de belleza de ecommerce
El último Q4 hicimos 7 cifras, y este año vamos a por mucho más. Busco 1 editor de vídeo con IA, con hambre, de hablahispana perfecto (si eres de España es un plus) para trabajar directamente conmigo. Te compartiré todo lo que sé para ayudarte a hacer ads ganadores, y quiero que ganes aquí más de lo que hayas ganado nunca. Cursos, mejoras, actualizaciones de IA.
Por qué este puesto
Acceso directo al fundador. Sin managers. Yo.
Entras como editor y creces más allá de eso. No me guardo nada en la parte de estrategia: por qué un ad imprime durante seis meses y por qué el siguiente no pasa ni del presupuesto de test. A medida que asumes más del pensamiento estratégico, el pago sube contigo.
Qué distingue al editor que voy a contratar
Eres deliberado con los visuales que eliges para cada línea del guión. No una que "encaje más o menos".
Mejorarás un brief y me dirás por qué. Prefiero un "he cambiado la segunda escena, aquí está el motivo" antes que la ejecución limpia de una escena que iba a rendir mal.
Experiencia real lanzando ads de Meta para marcas DTC.
El trabajo
Editar 8–12 ads de Meta por semana en los principales formatos de direct response: ads de formato corto, ai ugc, mini vsls, storytelling emocional, animación estilo pixar, etc.
Iterar rápido según el feedback de rendimiento. Cada semana juntos en la cuenta de ads: qué ganó, qué murió y por qué.
Bonos sin techo: un ganador te sigue pagando mientras siga gastando de forma rentable
Todas las herramientas de IA pagadas por nosotros
Comenta “A Player” si has leído el post, para evitar personas aplicando de forma masiva sin leer las indicaciones.
No apliques si…
Necesitas que te describan cada imagen en el brief
No sabes explicar por qué tus ediciones deberían mejorar el rendimiento
Tu referencia de "bueno" es cómo se ve el ad, no lo que consiguió
Nunca has trabajado en ads con spend significativo en Meta
Te pones a la defensiva con el feedback
Necesitas plazos lentos y que te lleven de la mano siempre

items.title: Graphic Designer Needed for Holiday Event Series-Posters, Social Media & Web Graphics
items.description:
Graphic Designer Needed for Holiday Event Series — Posters, Social Media & Web Graphics

Mooreland Productions is seeking a graphic designer to create a cohesive promotional package for Holiday After Dark, our three-week December live entertainment series in Dallas.

The branding should feature “Mooreland Presents” as the presenter line above “Holiday After Dark,” with individual show titles beneath it:

Bur-Less-Q Nutcracker — an award-winning holiday comedy celebrating its 18th season, blending small-town scandal, outrageous laughs, and festive burlesque.

Tinsel & Tease — a holiday burlesque show

You Know the Old Slaying — an interactive holiday murder mystery

What we need

One main Holiday After Dark graphic promoting the full series

Three coordinating graphics promoting the individual shows

Adaptations for Instagram/Facebook posts, stories, event covers, and our website

Print-ready poster/flyer files

Editable source files so we can update dates, ticket details, and sponsor information

We want the shows to feel connected while giving each its own personality.

Creative direction

Festive, theatrical, polished, and a little sultry—with strong typography and clear, easy-to-read event information. Think holiday nightlife, cabaret, and live entertainment. We’re open to your creative ideas and want something distinctive that will catch attention and help sell tickets.

We will provide show descriptions, event details, our company logo, and available photos or reference materials.

Please include in your proposal

Relevant samples, especially entertainment, theater, nightlife, or event graphics

Your fixed-price quote for the package above

Your estimated turnaround time

The number of concepts and revision rounds included

The design software and editable file formats you will provide

Any additional costs for fonts, stock images, or other licensed assets

Please also let us know whether you’re available for additional graphics as the series approaches, such as vendor announcements, sponsor features, and ticket promotions. Those can be quoted separately.

We’re looking for someone collaborative, responsive, and comfortable creating a cohesive campaign across several related events.

Holidays After Dark main graphic	
Bur-Less-Q Nutcracker graphic	
Tinsel & Tease graphic	
Vendors graphic
You Know the Old Slaying graphic	
Matching size adaptations

For each design, I need a social post, story, and horizontal event image. A print-ready version of the same artwork too—these are adaptations, rather than separate concepts.

I do have descriptions and images for these graphics as needed.

items.title: Vapi Voice Agent Implementation Specialist
items.description:
We build and manage AI voice agents for small and mid-size businesses: home services, fitness studios, transportation companies, coaches, and more. We're growing and need a part-time specialist to take over building and deploying Vapi agents for new clients.

This is not a "write me a ChatGPT prompt" job. You'll be building production voice agents that book real appointments, create contacts in CRMs, transfer live calls, and send alerts to business owners. If an agent double-books a slot or sends a broken tool call, a real business loses a real customer. We need someone who tests like that matters.

What you'll do:

Build new client agents in Vapi from our base templates and a completed client intake form
Configure tools (GoHighLevel, Cal.com, knowledge base search, transfers, webhooks)
Run scripted test calls and fix failures before anything goes live
Make client-requested changes to existing agents, always in staging first
Document anything new you run into so our playbook keeps improving

You must have:

Shipped at least 2 to 3 live voice agents on Vapi (Retell or Bland experience is a plus, but Vapi is required)
Experience with tool/function calling: reading JSON responses, debugging webhook payloads, tracing why a tool call failed
Built at least one appointment booking flow that integrates with a real calendar
An understanding of what voice models are bad at (date math, multi-step arithmetic, remembering IDs across turns) and how to design around it
Strong written English and clear async communication
Discipline around process: you test in staging, you don't touch live agents without sign-off, you follow naming conventions

Nice to have:

GoHighLevel experience (workflows, custom fields, API)
Cal.com API experience
Basic JavaScript or Python for reading middleware logs
Background in sales or customer service (you understand how a good receptionist actually talks)

I’m looking for an experienced, reliable, and tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to provide ongoing administrative and operational support for a small professional practice.

This is not simply a task-based assistant role. I’m looking for someone who can become familiar with how the business works, help keep things organized, notice what needs attention, and work with me to improve systems over time.

The position is approximately 6-8 hours per week, with a rate of $25/hour depending on experience.
This could be an excellent fit for an experienced VA or administrative professional who enjoys supporting a small business, prefers a steady long-term client relationship, and likes combining day-to-day administrative work with problem-solving and systems improvement.

How We’ll Work Together
I work best collaboratively and am looking for someone who enjoys that style as well.
Some work can be completed independently, but a significant part of the role will involve scheduled Zoom co-working sessions, usually in two- to three-hour blocks. During those sessions, we may work through administrative tasks together, troubleshoot systems, organize information, and communicate as questions arise.

Because some of the work involves confidential client and business information, discretion and professionalism are essential.

Schedule
Availability during morning hours in the Eastern Time Zone, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, is strongly preferred.

The interview process will include an initial conversation followed by a 90-minute paid working interview for candidates who appear to be a strong fit.

What You’ll Help With
Your responsibilities will vary and may include:
Calendar and scheduling support
Email and client administration
Basic invoicing and payment tracking
Tracking client billing and administrative follow-up
Creating and maintaining forms, documents, and spreadsheets
Organizing digital files and records
Formatting reports and professional documents
Updating administrative systems and workflows
Maintaining accurate business information across platforms
Assisting with ongoing business projects
Researching and implementing better administrative processes
Helping automate repetitive tasks where appropriate
Using AI and other technology to improve efficiency
Identifying areas where organization or systems could be improved
I don’t expect you to already know every program I use.
What matters more is that you are comfortable with technology, curious, resourceful, and willing to learn new systems.
Experience with tools such as Google Workspace, Zoom, Excel or Google Sheets, QuickBooks, scheduling or practice-management software, Canva, and ChatGPT or other AI tools is helpful.

You May Be a Great Fit If You:
Have professional VA, executive assistant, or administrative support experience
Are highly organized and attentive to details
Follow through reliably without needing frequent reminders
Communicate clearly and comfortably ask questions
Learn new technology and software quickly
Enjoy figuring out better ways to organize systems and information
Are proactive and notice when something needs attention
Handle confidential information with discretion
Are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively
Enjoy working directly with a business owner
Are comfortable spending scheduled work periods together on Zoom
Would like to become familiar with a small business rather than simply complete isolated assignments
Are interested in a stable, long-term working relationship

This position includes scheduled Zoom co-working sessions, sometimes lasting two to three hours. Does that working style appeal to you? Please tell me why.
What does being proactive as a virtual assistant mean to you?

Please begin your proposal with the word “Coworking” so I know you have read the full posting.

I’m hoping to find someone who enjoys becoming part of a small business, takes pride in keeping things organized, likes improving how things work, and wants to build a comfortable and productive working relationship over time.

items.title: Podcast Post-Producer | Video Editing, Distribution & Social Content
items.description:
About the Podcast

I'm launching during intermission, a new video-first podcast exploring identity, relationships, ambition, life transitions, and the questions we don't always make time to ask.

The show combines honest, thoughtful conversations with humor, curiosity, and a little irreverence. Episodes will include interviews, conversations, and occasional solo reflections.

The goal is to create something that feels authentic, engaging, and visually polished without feeling overly produced or formulaic.

What I'm Looking For:

I'm seeking an experienced, creative, and highly organized podcast post-producer to own the end-to-end post-production and distribution process.

I will lead the creative vision, episode concepts, guest conversations, and hosting. I'm looking for a partner who can independently manage everything that happens after recording, from editing through publishing and social content creation.

Ideally, this becomes an ongoing working relationship as the podcast grows.

Scope of Work

1. Full Episode Production

- Edit long-form video and audio episodes (approximately 20–50 minutes).
- Clean and enhance audio, remove unnecessary pauses or distractions, and maintain a natural conversational flow.
- Incorporate branded intros, outros, graphics, and transitions as appropriate.
- Deliver polished, platform-ready episodes.

2. Publishing & Distribution

- Prepare and publish episodes to Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and YouTube.
- Develop episode titles, descriptions, show notes, and timestamps where appropriate.
- Manage uploads, formatting, scheduling, and publishing requirements.
- Maintain an organized production calendar and workflow.

3. Short-Form Content & Repurposing
- Identify the most compelling, funny, thought-provoking, or relatable moments from each episode.
- Create approximately 3–5 short-form video clips per episode for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
- Add engaging captions, subtitles, and branded visual elements.
- Format content appropriately for each platform.

4. Creative & Operational Partnership

- Help establish a repeatable, efficient post-production workflow.
- Maintain consistency with the podcast's established brand identity and creative direction.
- Proactively recommend improvements to editing, pacing, content packaging, and distribution.
- Manage deadlines, file organization, and review cycles with minimal oversight.

Ideal Candidate
Demonstrated experience producing and distributing video-first podcasts.
Strong video and audio editing capabilities.
Experience creating engaging short-form social content.
Good editorial instincts and an understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience engagement.
Familiarity with Riverside and major podcast distribution platforms.
Highly organized, proactive, responsive, and comfortable working independently.
An appreciation for conversational, personality-driven content that balances depth with humor.

Creative judgment is just as important to me as technical expertise. I'm looking for someone who understands how to preserve a host's personality and recognize moments that will genuinely resonate with an audience.

Engagement Details
Initial cadence: Approximately 2 episodes per month.
Episode length: 30-50 minutes.
Format: Video and audio.
Relationship: Ongoing freelance partnership, beginning with a paid trial episode.
Budget: Open to proposals based on experience, scope, and deliverables.

To Apply

Please include:

Links to 2–3 podcasts you've personally worked on, including your specific responsibilities.
Examples of short-form clips you've created from long-form podcast content.
A brief overview of your workflow from receiving raw footage to publishing.
Your estimated pricing for two episodes per month, including editing, publishing, and 3–5 clips per episode.
What you would need from me to manage the process independently.

I'm especially interested in finding someone who can become a trusted long-term creative and production partner as during intermission develops.

items.title: Create YouTube videos 7-10 minutes long that are very great detail, storylines and visuals.
items.description:
I am looking for high-quality, professionally produced YouTube videos that are approximately 7–15 minutes long. The videos should feel like premium documentary-style content rather than basic slideshow videos or videos made primarily from repetitive stock footage.

Video Length and Structure

Each video should be approximately 7–15 minutes, with enough visual variety and storytelling to maintain the viewer’s attention throughout the entire video.

The video should have a strong structure:

* An attention-grabbing opening within the first few seconds
* A compelling introduction that immediately establishes the topic
* A clear and engaging narrative throughout
* Frequent visual changes to prevent the video from feeling static
* Smooth transitions between sections
* Strong pacing that matches the narration
* A satisfying conclusion that brings the main points together

The goal is to make the viewer feel like they are watching a professionally produced documentary or premium YouTube feature, not a simple automated video.

Real-Life Video Footage

Use a significant amount of high-quality real-life video footage that directly relates to what is being discussed.

Whenever possible, footage should show:

* Real cities and locations
* People and everyday life
* Buildings and architecture
* Landscapes and environments
* Streets and transportation
* Restaurants, hotels, businesses, and attractions
* Local culture and activities
* Aerial/drone-style establishing shots
* Close-up detail shots
* Wide cinematic shots

The footage should feel authentic and visually interesting. Avoid relying on the same clips repeatedly or using generic footage that does not directly support the narration.

The visual material should constantly reinforce what the narrator is saying.

High-End Graphics

The videos should include professional graphics throughout the video.

Graphics can include:

* Animated maps
* Country and city maps
* Location markers
* Statistics
* Charts and graphs
* Comparisons
* Timelines
* Rankings
* Infographics
* Labels
* Text animations
* Icons
* Geographic overlays
* Population and demographic visualizations
* Cost comparisons
* Distance measurements
* Currency comparisons
* Data visualizations

Graphics should be clean, modern, easy to understand, and visually consistent with the channel’s branding.

3D Graphics and Animation

I also want high-quality 3D elements and animations where appropriate.

Examples include:

* 3D buildings
* 3D city environments
* Animated geographic terrain
* 3D maps
* Animated globes
* 3D objects
* Camera movements through virtual environments
* Animated travel routes
* Zooming from a global map into a specific country or city
* Exploded or layered visualizations
* Cinematic 3D transitions
* Realistic environmental animations

The 3D elements should not be added simply for decoration. They should help explain the subject or make important information more visually engaging.

Animation Quality

Animations should feel smooth, professional, and intentional.

Avoid basic PowerPoint-style animations or simple text appearing on screen.

Instead, use:

* Smooth camera movements
* Motion graphics
* Kinetic typography
* Animated transitions
* Parallax effects
* Object movement
* Zooms and camera pushes
* Layered compositions
* Dynamic maps
* Animated statistics
* Visual reveals
* Cinematic transitions

The animation should complement the narration rather than distract from it.

Visual Variety

The video should constantly give the viewer something new to look at.

For example, the video could transition between:

Real-life footage → cinematic establishing shot → animated graphic → 3D map → real-life footage → infographic → 3D animation → aerial footage → text animation → real-life footage.

The viewer should not be staring at one image or one video clip for an extended period unless there is a deliberate storytelling reason.

Synchronization With Narration

The visuals should be carefully synchronized with the voiceover.

If the narrator says something about a particular city, the viewer should see that city.

If the narrator discusses a statistic, display the statistic visually.

If the narrator describes a geographic location, show an animated map.

If the narrator compares two countries, show the comparison visually.

If the narrator explains a process, use animation or graphics to demonstrate it.

The editing should make the visuals feel like they are actively telling the story alongside the narration.

Cinematic Editing

The overall editing should feel polished and cinematic.

Use:

* Professional pacing
* Smooth cuts
* Appropriate transitions
* Cinematic establishing shots
* Interesting camera movements
* Strategic zooms
* Layered graphics
* Sound effects
* Music that matches the mood
* Subtle visual effects
* Professional color grading

The final product should feel like something viewers would expect from a large, professionally produced YouTube channel.

Audio

Audio quality should also be professional.

The narration should be:

* Clear
* Natural sounding
* Well paced
* Properly mixed
* Easy to understand

Background music should support the story without overpowering the narration.

Use subtle sound effects when appropriate to make animations, maps, transitions, and visual elements feel more immersive.

Overall Production Standard

The most important requirement is that the finished video should not look cheap, generic, repetitive, or obviously automated.

I want the final product to have the visual quality of a premium documentary-style YouTube video, combining real-world footage with sophisticated motion graphics, 3D animation, maps, data visualization, and cinematic editing.

Every visual should have a purpose.

The goal is to create videos that are:

Cinematic + Informative + Visually Dynamic + Professionally Animated + Story-Driven + High Retention.

The finished 7–15 minute video should feel like a complete, professionally produced piece of media that is capable of competing visually with established high-quality YouTube channels.

items.title: Creative Video Editor Needed for Cinematic 5-Minute Film Pitch
items.description:
I’m looking for a creative video editor to shape a polished, cinematic 5-minute pitch video for an independent feature film.

This is not just an assembly edit. I want someone with strong storytelling instincts who can look at all the material and help make the piece better through editorial decisions, pacing, music choices, sound design, transitions and visual structure.

The material will include:

- Primary on-camera footage
- Cinematic B-roll and detail shots
- AI concept images (already created)
- Selected reference/archive clips
- Career footage and photographs
- Simple text/graphics

items.title: B2B Communication, PR & Events Manager — French & English Fluent
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced B2B Communication, PR & Events Manager to help increase the visibility and authority of Buy Made Easy, a company specialized in procurement outsourcing, tail spend and Class C purchasing.
This is a highly relationship-driven role. We are not looking for a traditional content writer or social media manager. We are looking for someone who can represent the company, build relationships, organize events, interview executives and create visibility through human interaction.

Main responsibilities
•	Organize and coordinate physical and virtual B2B events
•	Host and moderate webinars, roundtables and online events
•	Act as a speaker or moderator when needed
•	Launch and manage a podcast interviewing Procurement Directors, CPOs and business leaders
•	Develop relationships with journalists and specialized B2B media
•	Identify speaking opportunities, conferences, awards and industry events
•	Build relationships with procurement leaders, associations, partners and influencers
•	Coordinate customer interviews, testimonials and case studies
•	Support the creation of industry surveys, reports and thought leadership initiatives
•	Help position Buy Made Easy as a reference in procurement outsourcing and tail spend management

Profile we are looking for

You must be:
•	Fluent in French and English
•	Very comfortable speaking in public and on camera
•	Able to host interviews, webinars and events
•	Excellent at building professional relationships
•	Confident contacting senior executives, journalists and partners
•	Strong in written communication
•	Independent, proactive and highly organized

Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:
•	B2B communication
•	Public relations
•	Corporate events
•	Podcasts / media
•	SaaS
•	Consulting
•	Procurement / Supply Chain
•	Industrial B2B markets

Important
This is not primarily a content production role.
We already use AI extensively for content creation, SEO, research, transcription and repurposing.
Your main value will be in areas AI cannot easily replace:
human relationships, networking, interviewing, public speaking, events, media relations and influence.

Initial projects
Your first projects may include:
•	launching a procurement-focused podcast
•	organizing executive roundtables
•	building a media and journalist contact network
•	identifying relevant conferences and speaking opportunities
•	coordinating customer case studies
•	helping prepare an annual Tail Spend / Class C Procurement report

Location
Preference for candidates based in Lyon or nearby, as our headquarters are located in Lyon.
However, we are open to strong remote candidates who can travel regularly to Lyon and other locations in France or Europe when required.

When applying
Please include:
•	examples of B2B events you have organized or hosted
•	examples of interviews, podcasts or webinars you have conducted
•	any PR / media relations experience
•	links to videos where we can see you speaking or presenting, if available
•	your availability and expected hourly or monthly rate

items.title: Appointment Setter — $25 per Qualified Demo (US Small Businesses)
items.description:
Pulsework AI (pulseworkai.com) sells AI phone answering to US small service businesses: plumbers, HVAC shops, dental offices, auto repair. The AI answers every call and text, even after hours.

Your job: call shop owners, play them a 40-second recording of what their OWN phone line sounds like after hours (we provide the recording for every prospect), and book them a 15-minute demo with our founder.

You are not cold pitching blind. Every call starts with real proof about their business.

Pay: fixed $25 per qualified demo that shows up. No hourly wage and no cap on earnings. A qualified demo means the owner or decision maker booked a 15-minute call and attended it. We provide the prospect list, the recordings, the script, and the booking link. You work your own hours, as many calls as you want.

Close bonus: $125 for every demo you booked that becomes a paying Pulsework client within 30 days of the demo call, paid as a bonus on top of the $25 per demo. Book demos with real decision makers and this is where the real money is.

What you will do:
- Call US small businesses from a provided list (we give you the numbers, the recordings, and the script)
- Open with the prospect's own after-hours call recording
- Ask 3-4 short qualification questions (script provided)
- Book qualified owners into a 15-minute demo (calendar link provided)
- Log every call outcome in a shared sheet

Requirements:
- Fluent English with a clear, neutral accent (you will be on the phone with US business owners)
- Quiet workspace and a good headset
- Reliable internet
- Prior US cold-calling or appointment-setting experience strongly preferred (tell us what dialer and CRM you have used)

How we start: a 4-demo paid trial ($100). Book 4 qualified demos that show up, get paid $100, and we scale you up from there with weekly demo targets funded as new milestones.

items.description:
I am building a long-term trading research and operations team around a specific trading methodology and am looking for serious individuals who want to grow with the project rather than simply complete a one-time freelance assignment.

The initial focus will be on studying, documenting, testing, and operationalizing an existing trading methodology, including its entries, confirmations, risk management, trade management, and signal execution process.

I will provide qualified team members with appropriate access to the educational/trading material needed to learn the methodology. The goal is to turn that knowledge into a structured back-office operation, research process, trading documentation system, and repeatable workflow.

This is intended to develop into a long-term working relationship/partnership for the right person.

What You Would Do

* Study and thoroughly document the trading methodology and educational material provided
* Attend/observe live trading sessions where permitted
* Study how trade setups, entries, exits, confirmations, and risk management are handled
* Track and organize trading signals and outcomes
* Maintain detailed trade journals and performance records

items.title: Unreal Engine 5 C++ Developer – Legacy Metin2 MMORPG Migration & Asset Pipeline
items.description:
We are looking for an Unreal Engine 5 C++ Developer to migrate an existing classic MMORPG project into Unreal Engine 5.

The project is based on a classic 2008-style Metin2 experience. We want to preserve the original old-school visual identity, gameplay feel, camera, proportions, animations and atmosphere.
This is NOT a full remake from scratch.
We already have:
- Existing client/server source code
- Original game assets and data
- Maps
- Characters
- NPCs
- Monsters
- Bosses
- Textures
- Animations
- Existing gameplay/server logic
Our target platforms are:
- Windows PC
- Android
- iOS
The first POC can be demonstrated on Windows, but the project architecture must be suitable for Android and iOS from the beginning.
The developer should avoid unnecessary desktop-only solutions and keep the project suitable for future mobile builds, touch controls, scalable UI and mobile performance optimization.
We want to preserve the classic 2008 Metin2 feeling:
- Original character and monster proportions
- Classic combat timing
- Original animation feeling
- Old-school camera
- Simple materials
- Low/medium-poly style
- Classic map atmosphere
- Classic MMORPG UI philosophy
We do NOT want:
- Photorealistic graphics
- Heavy post-processing
- Generic Unreal Marketplace visuals
- Excessive bloom
- Visual changes that destroy the original old-school identity
The main goal is:
Modern Unreal Engine technology underneath, classic 2008 MMORPG feeling on top.
The developer will be responsible for:
- Analyzing the existing client/server architecture
- Building a reusable asset migration/import pipeline
- Importing characters, NPCs, monsters, bosses and maps
- Handling meshes, textures, materials, skeletons and animations
- Animation retargeting where required
- Rebuilding required client-side gameplay systems in Unreal
- Working with Unreal C++ and Blueprints
- Integrating with the existing server architecture where practical
- Building reusable tools instead of manually converting every asset
- Fixing conversion and compatibility issues
- Optimizing performance
- Keeping the project suitable for PC, Android and iOS
Important:
We are NOT looking for a 3D artist who manually converts hundreds of assets one by one.
We need someone who can create a hybrid workflow:
- Automated/batch processing for repetitive work
- Manual fixes only where necessary
The ideal person is:
Unreal Engine Developer + C++ Programmer + Tools/Asset Pipeline Developer.
First paid POC:
We want a small proof of concept before continuing with the full project.
The POC should include:
- 1 map or representative map section
- 1 playable character
- 1 NPC
- 1 monster
- 1 boss or quadruped monster
- Textures/materials
- Skeletons
- Animations
- Basic movement
- Basic attack
- Basic interaction
- Working inside Unreal Engine 5
POC target:
3–5 days
The purpose of the POC is to prove that the workflow can be reused for the remaining game assets and systems.
Initial project target:
3–5 weeks
Main priorities during this phase:
- Establish the migration pipeline
- Import the major assets
- Build the core Unreal client
- Implement the basic gameplay loop
- Connect major systems
- Fix conversion issues
- Prepare the project for continued development on PC, Android and iOS
Required skills:
- Unreal Engine 5
- C++
- Blueprints
- Multiplayer/game networking
- Skeletal meshes
- Animation systems
- Retargeting
- Materials
- Asset importing
- Custom Unreal tools
- Editor scripting
- Batch processing
- Performance optimization
Strong advantages:
- Legacy game engine migration
- MMORPG development
- Custom/proprietary game formats
- Reverse engineering
- Existing C++ game engines
- Metin2 development/modding
- Unreal Android/iOS development

When applying, please answer these questions clearly:
1. Have you previously migrated a legacy game or custom game assets into Unreal? If yes, please show an example.
2. Can you build an automated/batch migration pipeline instead of manually converting everything?
3. Can you deliver the POC described above within 3–5 days?
4. Are you comfortable working with Unreal C++, Blueprints, multiplayer systems and future Android/iOS builds?

Please send short and technical answers. Generic proposals are not useful for this project.

items.title: Social Media Operations + Community VA for Small Business Brands
items.description:
I’m looking for a reliable, organized Social Media Operations + Community VA to support two small-business brands and a Facebook community for small-business owners.

This is primarily an EXECUTION + SUPPORT role, not a strategy role.

I already have the brand direction, content strategy, much of the copy, and many of the graphics handled. I need someone who can take approved content and make sure it gets scheduled, published, organized, and followed through consistently.

Initial scope:
• Approximately 5 hours per week
• 30-day paid trial
• Potential for ongoing work if we’re a good fit
• US-based preferred

Primary responsibilities:
• Schedule and publish approved content to Facebook and Instagram
• Help manage and maintain a Facebook Group/community
• Monitor comments, questions, and activity
• Flag anything that needs my personal response rather than guessing
• Maintain content calendars and posting queues
• Work from existing Google Sheets and established systems
• Use Canva for light edits, resizing, or simple support when needed
• Help keep content organized and on schedule
• Follow brand-specific instructions carefully
• Keep two separate brands completely separate in content, files, voice, and workflow

Platforms/tools may include:
• Facebook Pages
• Facebook Groups
• Instagram
• Meta Business Suite
• Canva
• Google Sheets
• Social scheduling tools

What I am NOT looking for:
• Someone to completely reinvent my content strategy
• Paid ads management
• A full-service marketing agency
• Someone who needs to create every post from scratch
• Someone who mixes brands, misses details, or requires constant follow-up

The right person will be:
• Very organized
• Reliable and responsive
• Comfortable following established systems
• Strong with written communication
• Able to work independently
• Good at knowing when to handle something and when to escalate it
• Comfortable supporting an active online community
• Detail-oriented enough to keep multiple brands separate

When applying, please tell me:
1. Tell me about a Facebook Group or online community you have personally helped manage.
2. What social scheduling tools do you use most often?
3. Are you comfortable working from an existing Google Sheet/content calendar and following an established strategy?
4. If a community member asks a question you aren’t sure how to answer in the owner’s voice, what would you do?
5. Are you comfortable supporting multiple brands while keeping their content, files, and voices completely separate?
6. Are you available for approximately 5 hours per week to begin with?

I’m looking for someone who can help keep the machine running consistently, not come in and rebuild the machine.

items.title: React Native Developer Needed to Review & Finish Existing iOS Beta App
items.description:
## Senior React Native Developer — Review, Stabilize & Improve Existing iOS App

We are looking for an experienced **React Native developer** to review, stabilize, and continue improving an existing mobile application that is preparing for private iOS beta testing.

**The application is already substantially built. This is NOT a rebuild or a project starting from scratch.**

We are looking for someone who is comfortable inheriting an existing codebase, understanding another developer's work, identifying problems quickly, fixing bugs, improving performance, and potentially continuing development after the initial review.

### Current Technology

The application currently includes:

- React Native mobile application
- Supabase backend/database
- Stripe / payment integrations
- AI-powered functionality
- AI image/design functionality
- Multiple user roles and workflows
- iOS/TestFlight deployment
- Admin functionality
- GitHub repository

Experience with **React Native is required**.

Experience with **Supabase, Stripe, OpenAI/AI APIs, image-generation APIs, and TestFlight** is highly desirable.

### First Milestone — Paid Technical Review

We want to begin with a small, paid, fixed-price technical review before assigning additional development work.

**Budget: $100 USD fixed price**

The purpose of this milestone is to understand the current condition of the application and determine exactly what remains before beta.

You will receive access to the relevant codebase and existing project information after being selected and appropriate access is arranged.

For the first milestone, we expect you to:

- Review the existing React Native codebase
- Review the Supabase/backend implementation
- Review the current application flows
- Review the existing known bug/issues list
- Test the application where appropriate
- Identify incomplete or broken functionality
- Identify significant performance issues
- Identify obvious security or architecture concerns
- Review relevant payment/integration functionality
- Review AI/image functionality at a technical level
- Determine the highest-priority items preventing a stable beta

### Deliverable

Provide a concise written report showing:

1. What is currently working
2. What is incomplete or broken
3. The most important bugs/issues
4. Any significant security, performance, or architecture concerns
5. What needs to be completed before beta
6. A prioritized repair plan
7. Your proposed fixed-price milestones for completing the remaining work

We are **not looking for an expensive or lengthy discovery phase**. The application has already been developed substantially, and the first milestone is intended to be a focused technical assessment.

### Potential Follow-On Work

If the first milestone goes well, we would like to continue with the same developer to:

- Fix remaining bugs
- Improve application stability and performance
- Improve existing features
- Improve AI and image-generation functionality
- Complete unfinished integrations
- Strengthen security where necessary
- Prepare the application for private TestFlight beta
- Support beta testing and bug resolution
- Potentially develop additional features afterward

Follow-on work will preferably be structured as **clearly defined fixed-price milestones** rather than an open-ended rebuild.

### Who We're Looking For

You should be comfortable taking ownership of an existing application without immediately recommending that everything be rewritten.

Strong candidates will have experience with:

- React Native
- Debugging inherited mobile applications
- Supabase or comparable backend platforms
- API integrations
- Stripe/payment integrations
- AI APIs
- Generative image or image-processing APIs
- iOS/TestFlight deployment
- GitHub/version control
- Mobile application security
- Performance optimization

We value developers who can **diagnose first, prioritize correctly, communicate clearly, and improve what already exists**.

### When Applying

Please answer the following:

1. How many years of professional React Native experience do you have?
2. Have you taken over an existing React Native application from another developer before? Briefly describe one example.
3. What experience do you have with Supabase?
4. What experience do you have with Stripe or payment/webhook integrations?
5. Have you implemented AI or generative-image functionality inside a React Native application? Please describe the technology used.
6. Please provide links or examples of React Native applications you personally worked on.
7. Are you comfortable completing the initial technical review for **$100 USD fixed price**?
8. If the review goes well, are you interested in continuing on a milestone-by-milestone basis?

Please begin your proposal with the words **“React Native Review”** so we know you read the complete posting.

We are looking for someone who can potentially become a reliable long-term development partner, but we will start with the technical review before committing to additional milestones.

items.description:
About Us

My Solar Claim is a fast growing consumer advocacy company. We help homeowners who were sold underperforming or misrepresented solar systems recover money on their behalf. We run a direct response model with media buyers, a sales team, and operations, and we move fast.

About This Role

We are hiring a builder who lives in Replit and AI coding tools every day and ships fast, working interfaces, not internal plumbing. You care how a screen feels, not just whether the data is correct. You would rather ship something rough today and iterate tomorrow than spend a week getting it perfect before anyone sees it. You can also wire GoHighLevel, Zapier, or n8n automations when the tool needs a backend, but design and speed come first.

What You Will Build

Fast, clean interfaces for internal tools and candidate facing pages that people actually enjoy using
Rapid prototypes that go from idea to something clickable in days
Polish passes on existing tools that make them feel less like internal software and more like a real product
Lead routing and automation across GoHighLevel, Zapier, and n8n when the work calls for it

Who We Are Looking For

You ship fast and you have real taste, you can look at a screen and say exactly what is wrong with it
You use Replit and AI coding tools as your daily way of building, not a novelty
You have a portfolio of things you actually launched, not just started
Strong with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind
Native or near native English, this is a hard requirement
Based in the US, Canada, or Australia
Available 30 plus hours a week, this is not a side gig role
Independent freelancer, we do not work with agencies or staffing teams on this role

How To Apply

Send us 2 to 3 things you have shipped, live links or screenshots, and tell us what took the longest to get right on each one. Existing work only please, we are not asking for anything built new for this application.

items.title: Short video editing with a purpose.
items.description:
I want an understandable, informative short video. I’m a Tetraplegic with a goal to help people with severe mobility issues more independent so they are not always waiting for someone (family or a caregiver) to get them out of bed or into their wheelchair or something as simply as turning on a light. 

I’ve invented a coordinated ecosystem that combines AI, robotics, engineering and personal systems monitoring into one platform. Technology today is fragmented- an electric wheelchair is helpful for mobility, a mechanical lift is great for transferring a person from the bed to their wheelchair, but the wheelchair doesn’t communicate with the lift to put someone in or out of their bed. 

With the advances in technology and AI, I’ve invented a way for fragmented pieces of equipment to become a ecosystem to help people be more independent and less dependent, so they can live their lives safely without always waiting for someone else.

items.title: Arabic-Speaking Salesperson — Warm Student Enquiries (Part-Time)
items.description:
Spain University Office is looking for one Arabic-speaking salesperson to follow up students who have already enquired about studying in Spain.

We need someone who listens carefully, explains clearly and follows through. You will work with existing enquiries supplied by us.

YOUR WORK
• Speak with students by telephone and WhatsApp voice to understand their study goals, situation and timing.
• Explain our agreed services and prices, answer questions using the brief we provide, and help suitable students take the next step toward payment.
• Follow up with interested students and handle objections professionally.
• Keep clear notes in our browser-based CRM: what the student needs, the conversation outcome and the next follow-up date.
• Hand over confirmed customers and their context to our fulfillment team.

WHAT GOOD WORK LOOKS LIKE
Each assigned enquiry has an accurate conversation record and a clear next action. Students understand the service being offered and the agreed payment step. Follow-ups happen when promised. Our team handles service delivery; the salesperson must stay within the agreed offer and avoid unsupported admission or visa promises.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Fluent, clear Arabic and a professional, friendly phone manner.
• Experience in telephone sales, warm-lead follow-up or consultative closing.
• Reliable CRM notes and follow-up habits.
• English is helpful for working with our team.

HOW WE WILL START
Hourly budget: $6–$10 USD.
We will begin with a small paid trial and limited hours as needed. The trial scope, schedule and payment terms will be agreed before a contract starts. Continued work will depend on fit and enquiry volume.

We are recruiting now for onboarding as our CRM and office calling setup is completed. We will supply the assigned enquiries, service/pricing brief, CRM access and business calling tools.

Please tell us about a relevant Arabic sales example, your hourly rate and minimum hours, and your availability with timezone.

A/B test subject lines, offers, creative, timing, and messaging

Continuously optimize our automated flows, including:

Welcome

Swatch nurture

Abandoned cart

Abandoned checkout

Browse abandonment

Strong copywriting and strategic thinking are more important to me than overly complicated email designs.

I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of the channel. I will provide brand direction, promotions, product information, and assets, but I do not want to have to develop every campaign idea myself.

items.description:
#Bilingual English/Spanish Virtual Assistant | Operations & Customer Experience

Industry: Premium Residential Cleaning / Home Services 
Position: Bilingual Virtual Assistant – Operations & Customer Experience 
Location: Remote - CST / EST
Commitment: Part-Time to Start, With Opportunity to Grow 
Language Requirement: Fluent English & Spanish — Written and Spoken


Growing premium residential cleaning company. We provide high-quality recurring and deep cleaning services and are building a company known for professionalism, reliability, exceptional customer service, and a consistently high standard of care.

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented **bilingual English/Spanish Virtual Assistant** to support the day-to-day operations of the business.

This person will communicate with both customers and cleaning professionals, so you must be able to **speak, read, and write professionally in both English and Spanish.**

This is not a role for someone who simply waits for instructions. We want someone who can learn our systems, anticipate what needs attention, follow established processes, communicate confidently, and help keep the business organized as we grow.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities may include:

- Managing incoming customer inquiries via phone, text, email, and our booking system
- Communicating professionally with customers in English
- Communicating with cleaning professionals in both English and Spanish
- Translating basic operational instructions, messages, and company communication between English and Spanish when needed
- Scheduling, rescheduling, and confirming cleaning appointments
- Managing and updating customer profiles and bookings inside **BookingKoala**
- Reviewing the daily and weekly schedule for conflicts, open jobs, cancellations, and scheduling issues
- Following up with leads who request quotes but have not yet booked
- Following up with existing clients regarding appointments or service questions
- Assisting with recurring customer scheduling and retention
- Coordinating cleaner availability and job assignments
- Communicating schedule changes, job details, and client instructions to cleaning professionals
- Supporting cleaner recruiting, applicant screening, interviews, and onboarding
- Communicating with Spanish-speaking cleaner applicants
- Collecting and organizing contractor documents, references, insurance information, and onboarding records
- Updating spreadsheets, checklists, SOPs, and internal company records
- Managing company inboxes and internal communication
- Assisting with BookingKoala forms, settings, customer information, and service updates
- Identifying operational issues and bringing them to management's attention before they become larger problems
- Supporting additional administrative and operations projects as the company grows

## Required Qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must:

- Be **fluent in both English and Spanish**
- Speak English and Spanish confidently and professionally
- Write clear, grammatically correct messages in both languages
- Be comfortable making and receiving phone calls in both English and Spanish
- Be extremely organized and detail-oriented
- Have strong customer-service skills
- Be comfortable managing multiple priorities at once
- Be proactive rather than needing constant direction
- Be reliable and responsive during agreed-upon working hours
- Be comfortable learning new software and systems
- Be a strong problem-solver
- Be able to follow SOPs and recognize when an issue needs to be escalated
- Be comfortable working in a growing small business where responsibilities may evolve

Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is highly preferred:

- Residential cleaning companies
- Home-service businesses
- BookingKoala
- Customer service
- Dispatching or scheduling
- Virtual receptionist work
- CRM management
- Cleaner or contractor recruiting
- Google Workspace
- Slack or similar communication platforms
- Indeed or Upwork recruiting
- Creating or maintaining SOPs

**Direct experience with BookingKoala or another home-service scheduling platform is a major plus.**

items.title: Florida Bar Attorney: Review Money Transmission Question for Marketplace Payment Flow (Ch. 560)
items.description:
Does our creator marketplace's payment flow count as money transmission under Fla. Stat. § 560.103? We need a Florida-admitted attorney to answer that in writing.

We already hold a written legal memo from an out-of-state attorney concluding the structure works. It brackets every Florida conclusion because the author is not admitted here. We need a Florida attorney to review that memo and confirm or correct its Florida conclusion. This is a review, not a new analysis.

About the platform

Pre-launch two-sided marketplace where brands hire content creators for sponsored content
Based in Florida, launching in Florida first
Built on Stripe Connect and Stripe Financial Connections
USD only, deals capped at $5,000, paid in two milestones
The creator is merchant of record. Funds settle to the creator's Stripe connected account and are paid out as each milestone is approved.
Funds never enter a company bank account

What we need

Review the existing memo and our payment flow summary
A short written answer on whether this flow is money transmission under § 560.103, given that Florida has no agent-of-payee exemption
Anything in the structure you would change to keep it outside the definition

Requirements

Active Florida Bar membership in good standing (we will verify)
Experience with money transmitter, payments or Florida OFR matters

Budget: Fixed price, up to $1,000. Estimated one to two hours of review.

Timeline: Within one week of engagement.

To apply, answer these two questions in your proposal:

Have you advised on whether a business falls under § 560.103, or worked with the Florida Office of Financial Regulation?
Florida has no agent-of-payee or payment processor exemption. Do you agree the analysis must rest on whether the platform "receives" funds under § 560.103?

carefully built document will be shared if we're a match.

Thanks

items.title: SharePoint Online Cross-Tenant Migration & Power Automate Specialist
items.description:
Job description
Rainplan is seeking an experienced SharePoint Online and Power Automate specialist to relocate one existing administrative site from one organization’s SharePoint Online environment to another organization’s SharePoint Online environment.
Our priority is to understand the existing setup, migrate it safely, and preserve its reporting and operational functionality. This is a single-site transition—not an entire Microsoft 365 tenant migration.
The engagement will also involve working directly with the client’s subject-matter expert to understand, maintain, and improve existing Power Automate workflows.
Responsibilities
- Assess the site’s lists, libraries, lookup relationships, permissions, and customizations.
- Identify connected Power Automate flows and reporting dependencies, including Excel/Power Query where applicable.
- Recommend a migration method, required access, tools, effort, risks, and any additional licensing costs.
- Carry out the agreed migration, including necessary connection and configuration changes.
- Validate data, relationships, permissions, reports, and automations before completing the handoff.
- Document the setup and collaborate with the client during live working sessions.
Required skills
- SharePoint Online migration between Microsoft 365 organizations.
- SharePoint lists, lookup relationships, permissions, and site configuration.
- Power Automate troubleshooting, authentication, connections, and ownership.
- Clear communication and comfort working collaboratively with a nontechnical subject-matter expert.
Engagement
Hourly, beginning with a bounded assessment whose scope and hours will be agreed in advance. Potential ongoing engagement of approximately 3–6 months. Weekly hours and implementation scope will be agreed after assessment.
Please include
1. A brief proposed migration approach. Explain how you would assess and relocate the site, your proposed tools or method, prerequisites from both organizations, and how you would validate functionality and manage cutover or recovery. Identify any anticipated tool or licensing costs. A high-level outline is sufficient.
2. Your hourly rate and availability: earliest start date, weekly availability, and overlap with US Eastern business hours.
3. An indicative estimate for the initial assessment, including assumptions and information needed to refine it. We do not expect a firm migration estimate before you review the site.

items.title: Accounting Specialist for Commercial & Multifamily Property Management
items.description:
Coastline Equity is seeking a remote Accounting Specialist to support the accounting team for our commercial and multifamily property management portfolio.

This role is fully remote. All services and deliverables are completed digitally using AppFolio, Microsoft Excel, email, and online collaboration tools. No onsite work, physical mail handling, or in-person attendance is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Support the Controller and AP/AR Manager with day-to-day property accounting.
• Review invoices and supporting documents for accuracy, correct property and vendor identity, coding, and potential duplicates; prepare entries for approval.
• Support accounts receivable by recording approved transactions, reviewing tenant and resident ledgers, and flagging discrepancies.
• Assist with account reconciliations and month-end close, including researching differences and organizing supporting documentation.
• Compile financial reports and schedules for the accounting team's review.
• Maintain accurate digital accounting records and an organized audit trail in AppFolio and shared files.
• Respond professionally to accounting-related questions from colleagues, vendors, clients, tenants, and residents; escalate issues requiring approval.
• Track open items, meet agreed deadlines, and provide clear status updates.

QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience in bookkeeping, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or accounting support.
• Strong Microsoft Excel skills and careful attention to detail.
• Ability to reconcile records, identify errors, and explain discrepancies clearly.
• Clear written and spoken English and reliable remote communication.
• Ability to handle confidential financial information and follow documented approval procedures.
• AppFolio and commercial or multifamily property accounting experience are strongly preferred.
• Reliable computer, internet connection, and a quiet space for online calls.

ENGAGEMENT
Hourly, ongoing remote engagement. Current budget: $10–$15 per hour, depending on relevant experience. Expected workload: more than 30 hours per week, with a duration of more than six months. Working hours and team overlap will be agreed before engagement.

TO APPLY
Please describe your property accounting experience, the accounting systems you have used, and your specific AppFolio experience. Include an example of a reconciliation discrepancy you resolved, your hourly rate, and your availability with time zone. Do not include confidential client records.

items.title: Sony A7 IV + iPhone Video Workflow Expert Needed for Content Creator
items.description:
Sony A7 IV + iPhone Expert Needed to Build Simple, Repeatable Video Content Workflow

About the Project

I’m a physician building a health education/public health media platform and creating regular short-form and long-form video content.

I currently use an iPhone 17 Pro Max and recently purchased a Sony A7 IV.

I’m looking for someone experienced with Sony cameras, iPhone filmmaking, lighting, audio, and content production to help me build a simple, repeatable filming workflow using BOTH cameras.

I am NOT primarily looking for someone to film or edit my videos on an ongoing basis.

I want someone who can help me build the system so that eventually I can decide:

“This is an iPhone video.”

or

“This deserves the Sony.”

…and immediately know exactly how to shoot it.

The ultimate goal is:

Build the production system once so I can use it repeatedly.

What I Want to Accomplish

I want two levels of content production.

LEVEL 1 — iPhone: Fast Content

This will be used for frequent short-form content, physician commentary, quick educational videos, social media, behind-the-scenes content, and situations where speed matters more than maximum production quality.

I want the iPhone workflow to be extremely fast:

Tripod → mic → correct settings → record.

I currently have the iPhone 17 Pro Max and have experimented with the Blackmagic Camera app.

I would like help determining whether I should primarily use the native Camera app, Blackmagic Camera, or another setup.

LEVEL 2 — Sony A7 IV: Premium Content

The Sony will be used when I want a more cinematic look, higher-production-value educational content, interviews, documentary footage, YouTube content, and intentional B-roll.

I want the Sony setup to remain simple enough that I can operate it myself.

Standardized Filming Setups

I would like to create approximately 2–3 repeatable filming environments, with an iPhone and/or Sony configuration for each.

1. Outdoor / Rooftop Talking-Head Setup

Conversational physician commentary, health education, and short-form “doctor rant” style videos.

This needs to be extremely easy to reproduce.

I would like to know when the iPhone is sufficient versus when using the Sony would meaningfully improve the result.

2. Indoor Talking-Head Setup

A repeatable setup for filming educational videos indoors.

This should include:

* Camera placement
* iPhone placement
* Lens/focal length
* Lighting placement
* Exposure
* White balance
* Autofocus
* Audio
* Framing
* Background positioning

3. Cinematic / Documentary Setup

Primarily using the Sony A7 IV for higher-production-value content, B-roll, interviews, documentary footage, and longer-form content.

Sony A7 IV Setup

I would like help configuring the Sony specifically for my use case, including:

* Resolution
* Frame rates
* Shutter speed
* Aperture
* ISO / Auto ISO
* Autofocus
* Eye autofocus
* White balance
* Picture profiles
* S-Cinetone / Log recommendations
* Exposure tools
* Zebra settings
* Audio levels
* Stabilization
* Custom buttons
* Custom memory modes / presets

The goal is NOT for me to become a professional cinematographer.

I want saved configurations that dramatically reduce the number of decisions I need to make while filming.

Ideally:

Sony Preset 1 → Outdoor talking head

Sony Preset 2 → Indoor talking head

Sony Preset 3 → Cinematic / B-roll

iPhone 17 Pro Max Setup

I also want the iPhone configured as a legitimate part of the production system rather than simply being my backup camera.

I would like recommendations/configuration for:

* Native Camera vs Blackmagic Camera
* 4K settings
* Frame rates
* HDR vs SDR
* Apple Log, if appropriate
* Exposure
* White balance
* Focus
* Stabilization
* External microphone
* Tripod/mount
* ND filters, if useful
* Storage/file management
* Color consistency with Sony footage
* Fast transfer into my editing workflow

The iPhone setup should prioritize speed and consistency.

I want to be able to have an idea, put the phone on a tripod, and begin recording within a few minutes.

Matching Sony + iPhone Footage

An important part of this project is creating reasonable visual consistency between the two cameras.

I understand they will not look identical.

However, I would like a workflow where Sony and iPhone footage can coexist within the same brand without looking like completely different productions.

That includes recommendations for:

* Resolution
* Frame rate
* Color profiles
* White balance
* Exposure
* Lighting
* Export settings
* Basic color correction / grading

Physical Filming Setup

I would like help determining:

* Best camera distance
* Camera height
* Best angles
* Lens/focal length
* How tightly or widely I should frame myself
* Tripod positioning
* iPhone positioning
* Lighting placement
* Background positioning
* Subject-to-background distance
* Outdoor lighting considerations
* ND filters if necessary

I am open to purchasing additional equipment if there is a clear reason for it.

However, I strongly prefer a minimal setup rather than accumulating unnecessary gear.

Audio

I want a simple, reliable audio system that ideally works across both the Sony and iPhone.

Please help me determine the appropriate microphone setup and configure audio so recording requires minimal adjustment.

Audio quality is important, but the workflow needs to remain fast.

Editing / File Workflow

I also want to create a simple workflow for everything that happens AFTER recording.

Ideally:

Sony / iPhone → files → computer/storage → organized folders → CapCut / AI editing → export → social media

I currently use or am exploring CapCut and AI-assisted editing.

My long-term goal is to make the editing process increasingly automated.

The footage coming out of both cameras should therefore be standardized enough that I can eventually create templates/presets for:

* Color
* Audio
* Captions
* Graphics
* B-roll
* Aspect ratios
* Social media exports

Experience with AI-assisted video editing workflows is a major plus.

Deliverable

At the end of the project, I want to be able to film without another person present.

I would like a simple Camera & Content Production Playbook / Cheat Sheet documenting everything we establish.

For example:

QUICK IPHONE VIDEO

App: ___
Resolution: ___
Frame rate: ___
Camera/lens: ___
Tripod position: ___
Mic: ___
Lighting: ___
Where I stand: ___
What I check before recording: ___

ROOFTOP — SONY

Camera preset: ___
Lens/focal length: ___
Camera position: ___
Tripod height: ___
Mic: ___
ND filter: ___
Where I stand: ___
What I check before recording: ___

INDOOR — SONY

Camera preset: ___
Camera position: ___
Light position: ___
Light intensity: ___
White balance: ___
Mic: ___
Where I stand/sit: ___
What I check before recording: ___

Ideal Person

You may be a:

* Videographer
* Cinematographer
* Content creator
* Sony camera specialist
* iPhone filmmaker
* YouTube production consultant
* Video production workflow specialist

You should have significant hands-on experience with the Sony A7 IV or similar Sony Alpha cameras and modern iPhone video production.

Experience building systems for solo creators who need to produce a high volume of content efficiently is particularly valuable.

Location

Atlanta, Georgia

Strong preference for someone who can work with me in person for the initial setup.

I want the actual camera, iPhone, lighting, framing, audio, and filming environments configured rather than receiving generic recommendations over Zoom.

Follow-up work can be remote.

Potential Structure

Session 1: Sony + iPhone configuration, framing, lenses, and audio

Session 2: Indoor + outdoor setups and lighting

Session 3: Shoot test footage, build file/editing workflow, make adjustments, and finalize the cheat sheet

I am also open to accomplishing most of this during an intensive 3–4 hour setup session if you believe that is realistic.

Important

I am NOT looking for someone to simply tell me what settings to use or what equipment to buy.

I can find generic camera recommendations online.

I want someone who can look at my Sony A7 IV, my iPhone, my actual filming environments, my lighting, my framing, and the type of content I am creating and help me build a customized production system.

The most important outcome is speed, repeatability, and quality.

Eventually, I want my role in the process to be:

Idea → choose iPhone or Sony → turn on camera → record → send footage into the editing system.

If you are interested, please include examples of content you have shot with Sony Alpha cameras and/or iPhone, describe your experience creating workflows for solo creators, and briefly explain how you would approach this project.
