* Shutter speed
* Aperture
* ISO / Auto ISO
* Autofocus
* Eye autofocus
* White balance
* Picture profiles
* S-Cinetone / Log recommendations
* Exposure tools
* Zebra settings
* Audio levels
* Stabilization
* Custom buttons
* Custom memory modes / presets

The goal is NOT for me to become a professional cinematographer.

I want saved configurations that dramatically reduce the number of decisions I need to make while filming.

Ideally:

Sony Preset 1 → Outdoor talking head

Sony Preset 2 → Indoor talking head

Sony Preset 3 → Cinematic / B-roll

iPhone 17 Pro Max Setup

I also want the iPhone configured as a legitimate part of the production system rather than simply being my backup camera.

I would like recommendations/configuration for:

* Native Camera vs Blackmagic Camera
* 4K settings
* Frame rates
* HDR vs SDR
* Apple Log, if appropriate
* Exposure
* White balance
* Focus
* Stabilization
* External microphone
* Tripod/mount
* ND filters, if useful
* Storage/file management
* Color consistency with Sony footage
* Fast transfer into my editing workflow

The iPhone setup should prioritize speed and consistency.

I want to be able to have an idea, put the phone on a tripod, and begin recording within a few minutes.

Matching Sony + iPhone Footage

An important part of this project is creating reasonable visual consistency between the two cameras.

I understand they will not look identical.

However, I would like a workflow where Sony and iPhone footage can coexist within the same brand without looking like completely different productions.

That includes recommendations for:

* Resolution
* Frame rate
* Color profiles
* White balance
* Exposure
* Lighting
* Export settings
* Basic color correction / grading

Physical Filming Setup

I would like help determining:

* Best camera distance
* Camera height
* Best angles
* Lens/focal length
* How tightly or widely I should frame myself
* Tripod positioning
* iPhone positioning
* Lighting placement
* Background positioning
* Subject-to-background distance
* Outdoor lighting considerations
* ND filters if necessary

I am open to purchasing additional equipment if there is a clear reason for it.

However, I strongly prefer a minimal setup rather than accumulating unnecessary gear.

Audio

I want a simple, reliable audio system that ideally works across both the Sony and iPhone.

Please help me determine the appropriate microphone setup and configure audio so recording requires minimal adjustment.

Audio quality is important, but the workflow needs to remain fast.

Editing / File Workflow

I also want to create a simple workflow for everything that happens AFTER recording.

Ideally:

Sony / iPhone → files → computer/storage → organized folders → CapCut / AI editing → export → social media

I currently use or am exploring CapCut and AI-assisted editing.

My long-term goal is to make the editing process increasingly automated.

The footage coming out of both cameras should therefore be standardized enough that I can eventually create templates/presets for:

* Color
* Audio
* Captions
* Graphics
* B-roll
* Aspect ratios
* Social media exports

Experience with AI-assisted video editing workflows is a major plus.

Deliverable

At the end of the project, I want to be able to film without another person present.

I would like a simple Camera & Content Production Playbook / Cheat Sheet documenting everything we establish.

For example:

QUICK IPHONE VIDEO

App: ___
Resolution: ___
Frame rate: ___
Camera/lens: ___
Tripod position: ___
Mic: ___
Lighting: ___
Where I stand: ___
What I check before recording: ___

ROOFTOP — SONY

Camera preset: ___
Lens/focal length: ___
Camera position: ___
Tripod height: ___
Mic: ___
ND filter: ___
Where I stand: ___
What I check before recording: ___

INDOOR — SONY

Camera preset: ___
Camera position: ___
Light position: ___
Light intensity: ___
White balance: ___
Mic: ___
Where I stand/sit: ___
What I check before recording: ___

Ideal Person

You may be a:

* Videographer
* Cinematographer
* Content creator
* Sony camera specialist
* iPhone filmmaker
* YouTube production consultant
* Video production workflow specialist

You should have significant hands-on experience with the Sony A7 IV or similar Sony Alpha cameras and modern iPhone video production.

Experience building systems for solo creators who need to produce a high volume of content efficiently is particularly valuable.

Location

Atlanta, Georgia

Strong preference for someone who can work with me in person for the initial setup.

I want the actual camera, iPhone, lighting, framing, audio, and filming environments configured rather than receiving generic recommendations over Zoom.

Follow-up work can be remote.

Potential Structure

Session 1: Sony + iPhone configuration, framing, lenses, and audio

Session 2: Indoor + outdoor setups and lighting

Session 3: Shoot test footage, build file/editing workflow, make adjustments, and finalize the cheat sheet

I am also open to accomplishing most of this during an intensive 3–4 hour setup session if you believe that is realistic.

Important

I am NOT looking for someone to simply tell me what settings to use or what equipment to buy.

I can find generic camera recommendations online.

I want someone who can look at my Sony A7 IV, my iPhone, my actual filming environments, my lighting, my framing, and the type of content I am creating and help me build a customized production system.

The most important outcome is speed, repeatability, and quality.

Eventually, I want my role in the process to be:

Idea → choose iPhone or Sony → turn on camera → record → send footage into the editing system.

If you are interested, please include examples of content you have shot with Sony Alpha cameras and/or iPhone, describe your experience creating workflows for solo creators, and briefly explain how you would approach this project.

items.title: Looking for Pinterest ads expert to scale a dropshipping store
items.description:
We’re looking for a Pinterest Ads expert to help us launch and scale an e-commerce/dropshipping store.

We’re experienced with Meta Ads, but Pinterest is a new channel for us. We need someone who knows Pinterest Ads inside and out and can guide the strategy from day one.

Role Responsibilities

* Set up Pinterest Business Manager, tracking, and conversion events
* Recommend the right starting budget and campaign structure
* Launch and manage campaigns focused on purchases
* Test products, audiences, creatives, and ad angles
* Analyze performance and identify what’s driving sales
* Optimize for CPA and ROAS
* Scale profitable campaigns while controlling costs
* Recommend what to test, stop, and scale

We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of the Pinterest strategy, not just follow instructions.

To Apply

Please include:

1. Your experience with Pinterest Ads
2. 2–3 examples of e-commerce stores you’ve worked with
3. Approximate ad spend and results (ROAS/CPA)
4. How you would approach launching a new store on Pinterest
5. What starting daily budget you would recommend and why

We’re looking for someone interested in a long-term relationship if we can build a profitable Pinterest channel together.

items.title: Redesign and Polish Real Estate Flyer/Card, Font and Back
items.description:
We are looking for a creative graphic designer to refine and redesign a two-sided promotional flyer/card for Afrik Abitat, a real estate platform connecting the African diaspora with real estate opportunities in Africa.

We already have a design draft for both the front and back. Your job is to take the existing concept and make it look more polished, professional, visually balanced, and ready for printing and digital distribution.

What we need
Redesign/refine the front and back of the existing flyer.
Maintain the overall Afrik Abitat branding, colors, messaging, and concept, while improving the visual execution.
Improve typography, spacing, alignment, hierarchy, and overall composition.
Make sure the flyer looks professional and appealing to an African diaspora / international real estate audience.
Properly incorporate our QR code on the back.
Ensure the QR code is clearly visible and has enough space around it to scan easily.
Make the contact information and call-to-action easy to read.
Ensure the final design works well both printed and digitally shared.
Make reasonable design adjustments based on our feedback.
Deliverables

Please provide:

Final front and back flyer design
Print-ready PDF
High-resolution JPG or PNG
Editable source file (AI, PSD, or Canva, depending on what you use)
Final version with the working QR code
Budget

Fixed price: $25

This project includes reasonable revisions to the design based on our feedback.

Ideal designer

We're looking for someone who:

Has experience designing flyers, postcards, promotional cards, or real estate marketing materials
Has a strong eye for clean, modern typography and layout
Can improve an existing design rather than starting completely from scratch
Pays attention to details such as spacing, alignment and print quality
Communicates clearly and can turn around revisions quickly
To apply

Please send:

2–3 examples of similar flyer/postcard designs you've created
A brief note explaining how you would improve the attached design
Confirmation that you can work within the $25 fixed budget
Your estimated turnaround time

The attached design is the starting point. We are looking for someone who can make it look more polished, professional and compelling while preserving the Afrik Abitat identity and message.

Note: Please do not completely redesign the concept from scratch.

BAR SHOP - $40 shop fee. You may complete alone or bring 1 adult guest. Reimbursement for 2 rounds of drinks up to $65, including 20% tip. Complete between 4pm - 6pm any day of the week.

items.title: Texas based LLC Ownership Reformation Support Needed
items.description:
We are seeking professional legal and compliance assistance to add a new owner/member to an existing Limited Liability Company (LLC) registered in the State of Texas.

The LLC currently has one owner in the United States. We intend to add a second owner who resides outside the United States. Following the ownership change, each member will hold 50% ownership of the LLC.

The scope of work includes:

* Prepare the appropriate agreement/documentation to formally add the new member and establish the 50/50 ownership structure.
* Prepare or amend the LLC Operating Agreement/Company Agreement to reflect the new ownership structure, management responsibilities, voting rights, profit/loss allocation, distributions, and decision-making authority.
* Determine whether any amendment or filing is required with the Texas Secretary of State.
* Identify and complete any necessary ownership or governing-person updates with the Texas Comptroller or other applicable Texas authorities.
* Review any required updates with the IRS resulting from the LLC changing from one owner to two owners.
* Determine the federal tax classification and reporting implications of adding a second member.
* Review tax and compliance requirements associated with the new 50% member residing outside the United States.
* Identify any applicable foreign-member documentation, withholding, tax identification, or reporting requirements.
* Establish appropriate provisions for a 50/50 ownership structure, including decision-making, deadlock resolution, transfer of ownership, withdrawal, and other important member protections.
* Provide guidance on any additional state or federal compliance requirements resulting from the ownership change.

The objective is to ensure that the addition of the new 50% owner is properly documented and that the LLC’s ownership, governance, state records, and applicable federal requirements are appropriately updated.

items.title: SEO & Content Growth Specialist — B2B Medical Technology
items.description:
We're a Canadian medical technology distributor. We sell specialized medical devices and scientific technologies to hospitals, clinics and other healthcare organizations across Canada.

Our audiences include cardiology, anesthesia, biomedical engineering, procurement, operating rooms, environmental services, private clinics, veterinary medicine and sports/performance testing.

We have an established WordPress website and are looking for an experienced SEO and content growth specialist to help turn it into a stronger source of qualified traffic and leads.

We are not looking for someone to simply produce SEO reports or generate large volumes of generic AI content. We want someone who can understand specialized B2B markets, identify search opportunities, create useful content, publish it, measure the results and continuously improve what is working.

What you'll own
Your primary responsibility will be to grow qualified organic traffic and inbound opportunities through content, SEO and increasingly AI-driven search/discovery.

The work will include:
- Develop and execute an organic search/content strategy.
- Research search demand, keywords, competitors and buyer intent across our product markets.
- Identify content opportunities based on how healthcare and technical buyers actually search.
- Create and optimize product, solution, application and industry landing pages.
- Develop case studies from customer stories and source material we provide.
- Improve existing pages for SEO, clarity, conversion and AI discoverability.
- Optimize titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, structured content and other on-page elements.
- Build content structures that are useful to both traditional search engines and AI assistants.
- Identify appropriate backlink, manufacturer, association and industry-directory opportunities.
- Publish and maintain content directly in WordPress/Elementor.
- Work with our existing developer when deeper technical changes are required.
- Use Search Console, GA4 and other appropriate tools to measure performance and recommend priorities.
- Provide a concise monthly report showing what was completed, what changed, what is producing results and what should happen next.

Content is a major part of this role
We currently have significant subject-matter expertise but haven't consistently turned it into website content.

Examples of the work may include:
- Canadian hospital case studies.
- Content supporting hospital-targeted ABM campaigns.
- Product/application pages for specialized medical technologies.
- A stronger sports/performance section targeting athletes, performance labs and clinics.
- Educational content answering real buyer questions.
- Pages supporting new products and market launches.

We'll provide access to internal product knowledge, manufacturers, sales information and subject-matter experts. We need you to turn that information into content people can actually find, understand and act on.

AI experience
We actively use AI internally and expect our partner to be comfortable doing the same.
We're interested in someone who understands how AI can accelerate research, content development, optimization and analysis without producing generic or poorly researched AI content.

Experience optimizing content for visibility/citation in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI search experiences is valuable.
We care more about a sound approach and measurable results than buzzwords around "GEO" or "AI SEO."

items.title: Remote AI Content Evaluator & Quality Assurance Specialist
items.description:
We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented freelancer to assist with AI evaluation, content analysis, and quality assurance.

Your primary responsibility will be to review AI-generated images, videos, and model responses, identify inaccuracies, compare outputs, and provide clear written feedback.

This position requires someone who can work independently, type quickly, follow detailed instructions, and consistently produce accurate evaluations.

Candidates must be comfortable completing onboarding assessments and learning new AI evaluation platforms.

Key Responsibilities

• Evaluate AI-generated images, videos, and model responses.
• Compare multiple AI outputs and identify which better satisfies the provided instructions.
• Identify visual inconsistencies, rendering errors, hallucinations, and missing details.
• Assess instruction following, visual quality, audio synchronization, and overall output consistency.
• Write clear, detailed explanations supporting evaluation decisions.
• Identify errors involving object placement, text accuracy, anatomy, reflections, and movement.
• Follow project-specific guidelines and evaluation rubrics.
• Complete assigned tasks accurately and within established deadlines.
• Maintain consistent quality across repetitive evaluation assignments.

Required Qualifications

• Excellent written English and reading comprehension.
• Fast, accurate typing and efficient computer navigation.
• Exceptional attention to detail.
• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
• Ability to follow complex written instructions.
• Experience with remote work and online task-management platforms.
• Reliable computer and internet connection.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
• Willingness to complete and pass required onboarding assessments.

Preferred typing speed: 50–70+ words per minute with at least 95% accuracy.

Preferred Experience

Previous experience in any of the following is beneficial:

• AI model evaluation or AI training.
• Data annotation and labeling.
• AI response ranking and comparative analysis.
• Image and video quality assurance.
• Content moderation or content evaluation.
• Prompt evaluation and instruction-following assessments.

Previous AI evaluation experience is preferred but not mandatory. Candidates with strong analytical abilities and excellent written communication are encouraged to apply.

Onboarding Requirements

Selected candidates must demonstrate their ability to:

1. Understand and apply detailed evaluation guidelines.
2. Complete a typing and written communication assessment.
3. Accurately compare AI-generated responses.
4. Identify visual and technical errors.
5. Provide well-structured written explanations.
6. Successfully complete any required platform onboarding assessments.

All assessments must be completed independently and in accordance with the applicable platform’s rules.

How to Apply

Please include the following information in your proposal:

1. Your experience with AI evaluation, data annotation, or similar remote work.
2. Your average typing speed and accuracy.
3. Any AI evaluation platforms you have previously worked with.
4. Your weekly availability.
5. Your proposed hourly rate.
6. Your experience completing AI-related qualification assessments.

Important: Begin your proposal with the phrase “AI QUALITY SPECIALIST” so we can confirm that you have read the entire job description.

We are looking for dependable freelancers interested in consistent, long-term opportunities who can maintain high standards of accuracy and efficiency.

items.title: Custom Website Redesign with Technical & Local SEO Foundation for Established Local Service Business
items.description:
We are an established, well-reviewed local professional service business in a major U.S. metro area. Our current website is outdated, slow, and not bringing in enough new clients. We need an experienced web designer/developer to build a modern, high-converting website with a strong SEO foundation from day one.

This is a serious project. Only apply if you meet every requirement below and can provide verifiable proof. Generic or copy-paste proposals will be declined.

Scope of work
•	Fully custom, modern, mobile-first design. No generic template look.
•	Built on WordPress (preferred) or another platform we fully own and can edit ourselves
•	90+ mobile PageSpeed score and passing Core Web Vitals
•	ADA / WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance
•	Migrate, rewrite and reorganize about 50 pages of existing content, with a full 301 redirect plan so we keep current rankings
•	Online appointment request and secure intake forms with privacy-compliant data handling
•	Before/after results gallery, testimonials page and integrated Google reviews
•	Clear calls to action on every page (call, book, contact)
•	Technical SEO: site structure, meta tags, schema markup (LocalBusiness and service schema), XML sitemap, image optimization
•	On-page SEO for each service page, based on keyword research
•	Setup of Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, conversion tracking and call tracking
•	SEO audit report before launch and 30 days after launch
•	Training video or session so our staff can update content

Strict requirements
•	5+ years of experience in custom web design and development
•	At least 3 live websites you built for local service businesses, with links
•	Proven experience with site migrations without losing rankings
•	Upwork Job Success Score of 90%+ and at least $50K earned on Upwork, or verifiable references
•	Fluent written English. All communication through Upwork messages.
•	Willing to sign an NDA
•	Written confirmation that we own all design files, code, content, domain and accounts

Project structure
•	Milestones: sitemap and wireframes → design approval → development → launch → 60-day post-launch support
•	Timeline: 4–5 weeks
•	Please give a fixed-price quote with the cost broken down by milestone

Business details and our current website will be shared only with shortlisted applicants after an NDA is signed.

To be considered, begin your quote proposal with the word "BLUEPRINT" and answer the screening questions.

Screening questions
1.	Share links to 3 websites you built for local service businesses. For at least one, show its PageSpeed score and tell us what it ranks for on Google today.

2.	Describe a website migration you handled. How did you protect the existing search rankings, and what happened to traffic in the 3 months after launch?

3.	Which platform and tools would you use for our site, and how will we be able to update content ourselves without calling you?

items.title: Commission Sales Rep: Sell an Exclusive Septic Lead Source to Kawartha Lakes, ON Contractors (Recurring Commission)
items.description:
I own kawarthaseptic.ca, a septic website on page 1 of Google in Kawartha Lakes, Ontario. It gets real homeowner calls, and I rent it to ONE local septic company, so the calls ring their phone. The spot is open. I need someone to phone septic contractors, get one onto a free trial, and turn that into a paying deal.

THE NUMBERS (Google Search Console and the call log, 30 days to 24 Sept 2026):
- 1,730 visits from Google, up 30% on the month before
- 86 calls from 71 different people
- about 50 real enquiries, roughly 12 a week
- page 1 for "septic pumping kawartha lakes" and "septic tank pumping cost ontario"

THE HONEST HISTORY, BECAUSE YOU'LL ASK:
Four local companies have tried the calls. None became paying. Two said Kawartha Lakes was outside their area, one doesn't do pump-outs, and one dropped out. The calls are real. The hard part is finding the company that covers the area and wants the work. That's the job.

WHAT THE CONTRACTOR GETS:
- First 5 calls free: no contract, no card
- Then $1,500 a month flat, or pay per lead
- Exclusive: one company only
- Cancel any month

WHAT YOU EARN (commission only, paid once the client pays):
- Flat-rate client: $750 when they pay their first month, then 10% of every monthly payment for months 2 to 12 ($150/month, up to $2,400 from one deal)
- Pay-per-lead client: 50% of their first month's lead fees, then 10% of their lead fees for months 2 to 12
- Paid as fixed-price milestones through Upwork, released once the client's payment clears

WHAT I GIVE YOU:
- The sales page (kawarthaseptic.ca/partners) with a 45-second pitch video
- A list of about 20 septic contractors serving the area, with locations
- Live dashboard screen-shares for your prospects on request
- A list of companies already contacted, so you don't double up

WHO I'M LOOKING FOR:
Fluent English, confident cold-calling trades and contractors, able to call between 8 am and 4 pm Eastern time.

DEFINITION OF DONE (per deal):
- Flat-rate: the client signs and pays the first $1,500; $750 released once payment clears. The 10% follows each later payment for months 2 to 12 while the client stays.
- Pay-per-lead: the client signs and completes 30 days; 50% of that month's paid lead fees released once payments clear, then 10% of each later month's paid fees for months 2 to 12.

TO APPLY: answer the screening questions, including a link to a 60-second voice recording of how you'd open a cold call to a septic company owner.

items.title: B2B Appointment Setter – Dental Industry
items.description:
Company: Dental Revenue Recovery (DRR)
Position: B2B Appointment Setter
Schedule: Part-Time
Industry: Dental / Healthcare
Target Market: U.S. Dental Practices

About Dental Revenue Recovery

Dental Revenue Recovery helps dental practices recover revenue that is already sitting inside their patient database.

We help practices reconnect with overdue hygiene patients, unscheduled treatment plans, cancellations, no-shows, and other missed revenue opportunities.

We are growing our sales team and are looking for a confident, professional Appointment Setter who can connect with dental Office Managers and schedule short 10-minute ROI meetings for our sales team.

What You'll Be Doing

Your primary responsibility is simple: start conversations with dental Office Managers and book qualified appointments.

You will:

Make outbound calls to U.S.-based dental practices using leads provided by DRR

Ask to speak with the Office Manager or Practice Manager

Follow our proven call script while sounding natural and conversational

Briefly explain how Dental Revenue Recovery helps practices reactivate patients and recover lost revenue

Handle common objections professionally

Schedule qualified 10-minute ROI meetings

Accurately update call results and appointment information in our CRM

Follow up with interested prospects who aren't ready to schedule immediately

Meet weekly activity and appointment-setting goals

You will NOT be responsible for closing sales. Your job is to generate interest, qualify the opportunity, and get the Office Manager onto a scheduled meeting with our sales team.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

Confident and comfortable making outbound cold calls

Professional, energetic, and friendly on the phone

Fluent in English with clear, easy-to-understand communication

Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based business professionals

Able to build rapport quickly

Persistent without sounding aggressive

Comfortable handling rejection and objections

Reliable and consistent

Coachable and willing to improve

Goal-oriented and motivated by performance incentives

Previous experience in B2B appointment setting, cold calling, dental, healthcare, SaaS, insurance, or professional services is strongly preferred.

Experience calling dental practices is a major plus.

Compensation

Hourly Base Pay + Appointment Bonuses

Compensation will include:

Competitive hourly rate

Bonus for qualified appointments booked

Opportunity for additional performance incentives

Opportunity for increased hours and responsibility based on performance

This position can grow into a long-term opportunity as Dental Revenue Recovery expands.

Performance Expectations

We care about both activity and appointment quality.

Performance will be measured based on:

Outbound calls completed

Conversations with decision-makers

Qualified appointments booked

Appointment show rate

CRM accuracy

Reliability and attendance

Ability to improve based on coaching

We are looking for appointment setters who want to become excellent at the role—not simply make calls and collect an hourly paycheck.

Requirements

You must have:

Reliable high-speed internet

Quiet professional work environment

Quality headset with clear audio

Reliable computer

Ability to work designated U.S. business hours

Experience using a CRM or dialer is preferred

Excellent spoken English

How to Apply

Please submit the following:

A short introduction about yourself and your appointment-setting or cold-calling experience

Your previous B2B sales or appointment-setting experience

Any experience working with dental or healthcare businesses

Your current availability

Your desired hourly rate

A 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a strong fit for this position

Please start your application with the words “DRR Appointment Setter” so we know you read the entire job posting.

We are looking for people who are confident, competitive, dependable, and interested in growing with our company.

If you enjoy talking to people, aren't afraid of the phone, and know how to turn cold conversations into scheduled meetings, we'd like to hear from you.

items.title: Google Ads Expert Needed – Fix Conversion Tracking & Optimize Local Barbershop Ads via Screen Share
items.description:
I own a barbershop in California, and I’m looking for an experienced Google Ads and conversion tracking specialist to work with me live through screen sharing.
I already have Google Ads campaigns running, along with Google Analytics and my website. My booking system is Vagaro, and we have been working on tracking completed online appointments through a booking confirmation page.
Currently, Google Ads is showing my Book Appointment conversion as “Misconfigured/Inactive,” even though we have already created the booking confirmation page and have seen the booking event register in Google Analytics.
I do not want someone to simply take over the account and make changes without explaining them. I want to screen share and have you guide me step-by-step so I understand what is being fixed.
The main goals of the project are:
- Diagnose and fix Google Ads conversion tracking
- Properly track completed Vagaro appointments
- Verify Google Tag / GA4 / Google Ads are communicating correctly
- Clean up duplicate or unnecessary conversion actions
- Make sure Google Ads is optimizing for real booked appointments, not just clicks or page visits
- Verify phone-call conversion tracking
- Review my existing campaigns and conversion goals
- Make sure bidding is using the correct primary conversions
- Test everything before we finish
I’m looking for someone who has strong experience with Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag, conversion tracking, local service businesses, and ideally Vagaro or similar appointment-booking platforms.
Time & Payment
I am hiring for up to 8 hours of work.
If we solve the problem in less than 8 hours, that is completely fine — you will be paid for the solution fixed.
This is primarily a live screen-share troubleshooting and consulting project, so you must be comfortable explaining what you're doing as we work through the account together.
When applying, please tell me briefly about your experience fixing Google Ads conversion tracking problems, especially for appointment-based/local businesses.
Please do not apply if your main solution is simply rebuilding my campaigns. The priority is fixing the tracking and making sure Google Ads receives accurate booking data first.

Currently, Google Ads is showing my Book Appointment conversion as “Misconfigured/Inactive,” even though we have already created the booking confirmation page and have seen the booking event register in Google Analytics.

- Review my existing campaigns and conversion goals
- Make sure bidding is using the correct primary conversions
- Test everything before we finish
I’m looking for someone who has strong experience with Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag, conversion tracking, local service businesses, and ideally Vagaro or similar appointment-booking platforms.

Customer service mindset and experience

Growth-minded and eager to learn

High energy and positive attitude
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Proactive problem-solver who doesn't wait to be told what to do
Detail-oriented with strong QA skills
Collaborative team player who can also work independently

items.title: eBay Virtual Assistant – Product Research & Listing Specialist
items.description:
Hi! 

Here are the following for request!

eBay Listing & Product Research VA — $1.50 Per Completed Listing

I am looking for a reliable and detail-oriented eBay Virtual Assistant to help me research and list approximately 50 items per week on my eBay store.

💰 Pay

$1.50 per completed and published eBay listing

I expect to have approximately 50 listings per week, which would be approximately $75 per week.

There is potential for ongoing work and additional listings if the work is accurate and the working relationship is a good fit.

📦 What I Will Provide

I will provide:

* Clear photos of each item
* The physical products/inventory
* Any information I already have about the item

🔎 What You Will Do

For each item, you will be responsible for:

* Identifying the product from the photos/information provided
* Researching the brand, model, part number, size, color, condition, and other relevant information
* Researching eBay sold/completed listings
* Researching current market prices and comparable listings
* Determining a reasonable selling price
* Creating an accurate, keyword-optimized eBay title
* Selecting the correct eBay category
* Completing all applicable item specifics
* Writing an accurate and professional description
* Optimizing the listing for eBay search
* Creating and publishing the listing through eBay Seller Hub
* Making sure the listing is accurate before publishing

📌 What I Will Handle

I will personally handle:

* Buyer messages
* Customer service
* Orders
* Packing
* Shipping
* Returns

Your main responsibility is researching and creating accurate eBay listings.

⭐ Experience Required

You should have previous experience with:

* eBay Seller Hub
* eBay listing creation
* eBay Product Research/Terapeak
* eBay sold-item research
* Product identification
* Pricing research
* eBay SEO
* Item specifics
* Writing eBay titles and descriptions

Experience with used merchandise, collectibles, electronics, tools, car parts, household items, or miscellaneous inventory is a plus.

English Communication Requirement

Good written English is required for this position. You do not need to be a native English speaker, but you must be able to understand my instructions, communicate clearly with me, and write professional and accurate English for eBay titles and descriptions.

Because the listings will be for U.S. customers, strong English writing and comprehension are important.

🧪 Paid Trial

Before committing to the full 50 listings per week, I would like to start with a paid trial of 5 listings.

The trial will be paid at the same rate:

5 completed listings × $1.50 = $7.50

I will provide the photos and product information.

I will evaluate the listings based on:

* Accuracy of product research
* Accuracy of pricing research
* Quality of the title
* Correct category
* Complete item specifics
* Description quality
* Attention to detail
* Overall quality of the finished listing

If the trial goes well, I would like to continue with approximately 50 listings per week.

📝 Please Answer These Questions

1. How many years of eBay listing experience do you have?
2. Approximately how many eBay listings have you personally created?
3. Have you used eBay Product Research/Terapeak?
4. How do you research eBay sold prices?
5. Can you identify products from photos and research the correct model/part number?
6. Have you worked with used or miscellaneous inventory?
7. Approximately how many listings can you accurately complete per hour?
8. Have you worked directly inside eBay Seller Hub?
9. Can you provide examples of eBay listings you have created?
10. Are you comfortable working at $1.50 per completed listing?
11. Are you available to complete approximately 50 listings per week?
12. Are you interested in a long-term working relationship?

Please start your proposal with the words “EBAY LISTING” so I know you read the entire posting.

I am looking for someone who is reliable, honest, detail-oriented, and interested in long-term work.

Thank you!

items.title: 3D CAD Modeling for Folding Metal Speaker Stand
items.description:
Job Description
I need an experienced Mechanical Engineer or Sheet Metal/Tube CAD Specialist to create a manufacturing-ready 3D CAD model, technical drawings, and tube bend coordinate data for a 2-piece folding metal speaker stand based on an existing reference sample.

I will provide detailed physical measurements, high-resolution photographs of the original product, and the target scaled dimensions upon hire.

Project Overview
The design features two intersecting, bent-metal tubular frames (an Inner Frame and an Outer Frame) that pivot on a central binding screw/pin to fold completely flat. Because the frames nest together, the two parts are NOT identical flat pieces—one frame uses offset bends at the pivot point to clear the inner frame smoothly.

Key Deliverables

3D CAD Models: Native CAD file (Fusion 360 or SolidWorks) + exported STEP (.stp) files for both Inner and Outer frame sub-assemblies.

Tube Bend Coordinate Data: LRA (Length, Rotation, Angle) or XYZ coordinate bend tables for CNC tube benders (e.g., Jettron specification format).

2D Engineering Drawings (PDF): Dimensioned drawing detailing overall dimensions, centerline bend radii (CLR), and hole/flattening specifications at the central pivot point.

items.title: Create a Professional Video Tutorial
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced freelancer to create a clear, professional, and easy-to-follow video tutorial showing students and parents how to:
1. Create an account on the Copernicus Olympiad website
2. Complete the student/profile information
3. Select the appropriate Olympiad/exam
4. Complete the registration process
5. Proceed to payment
6. Successfully pay the examination fee
7. Confirm that registration has been completed

The tutorial will be published on our website and/or official social-media channels and will serve as an instructional video for participants from different countries.

What We Need
The freelancer should screen-record the complete registration process while providing clear instructions through voice-over or narration.

The final video should include:
- Professional screen recording in high resolution
- Clear English narration
- Zoom/highlight effects where necessary to show important buttons or fields
- Smooth transitions and clean editing
- Copernicus Olympiad logo/branding
- Intro and outro
- Background music only if appropriate and non-distracting
- Removal/blurring of any sensitive payment or personal information
- Subtitles/captions
- Final export suitable for YouTube and our website

We will provide the freelancer with the necessary instructions, website access/details, branding materials, and guidance regarding the registration process.

Preferred Freelancer
We are looking for someone who:
- Has experience creating software, website, or step-by-step tutorial videos
- Has excellent spoken English
- Can explain instructions simply and clearly
- Has experience with screen-recording and video-editing software
- Pays close attention to details
- Can produce a modern, professional result suitable for an international educational organization

Please include examples of tutorial or screen-recording videos you have previously created.

Deliverables
1 completed tutorial video, approximately 3–6 minutes, plus the final high-resolution video file. We would also prefer to receive the editable/source project file so that minor information can be updated later.

Important
Applicants should begin their proposal with the word “COPERNICUS” so we know they have read the full job description.

Please also tell us:
1. What software you use for screen recording and editing.
2. Whether you will provide the voice-over yourself.
3. Whether revisions are included.
4. Your estimated delivery time.
5. Examples of similar tutorial videos you have created.

items.description:
Project Overview
We need an experienced Filemaker Developer to work with internal development teams at our company to continue work on a business-critical solution. The file is based on an older working version of a Filemaker solution, but will be a ground-up rebuild to address tech debt, user experience, and modernizing our workflow. This file is used internally to manage project specifications and documents for our design firm.

The rebuild project has already been started, but we are looking for someone who can get acquainted with the expected functionality and our current progress and who can work with the internal team to finish the first phase of development. There will be regular meetings and check-ins with internal staff, but you should be comfortable working independently, familiar with developing and managing a Filemaker database, and delivering reliable a product on a regular schedule. Experience with similar projects is a plus.

The first deadline for this project is intended to be at the end of December 2026, so we would like someone to be available soon to jump in. We use Filemaker extensively within our business, so this is a project-based contract role with high potential for on-going contracted-work or permanent position.

Developer Experience
- Advanced familiarity with Filemaker layout building, scripting, script triggers, database/schema management, and file options. Training can be provided, if necessary, but preference will be given to someone who already has experience.

- Experience designing, discussing, and improving user experience and workflows is also a plus

Job Details
- 20-30 Hours a week

items.title: Cinematic Composer Needed for Historical / Urban Documentary
items.description:
We’re looking for a composer to create an original score for a documentary centered around Niagara Falls, New York — its history, decline as a city, and the people and stories that remain.

We are not looking for wall-to-wall music. The score would primarily be used during:

- Opening and closing sequences
- B-roll and establishing shots
- Archival/history sequences
- Voiceover-driven intros and transitions
- Select emotional or atmospheric moments

Most interviews and longer segments featuring our main character will remain relatively natural and unscored, so the music needs to be used intentionally rather than constantly.

The overall tone of the film is cinematic, reflective, atmospheric, and at times melancholic — dealing with the contrast between Niagara Falls as a world-famous destination and the decline of the city surrounding it. There are also moments of nostalgia, beauty, tension, and hope, so we want a composer who can develop a musical identity for the film rather than simply placing generic background music underneath footage.

We’re looking for someone comfortable scoring directly to picture and collaborating on where music should enter, build, resolve, or stay out entirely.

Please send examples of previous film, documentary, cinematic, or narrative scoring work. Work demonstrating restraint, atmosphere, and emotional storytelling is especially relevant.

Please also include your typical pricing structure and whether you handle final stems/mixes for the score.

items.title: Linear platform configuration expert
items.description:
We're a 5 person product team that just moved off Jira and picked Linear, but none of us have built out a Linear workspace before and want it done right from the start rather than configured piecemeal.

We already know exactly what we need. The structure is:

Four teams: Product, Engineering, Content & Workflow, and Client Requests.

Client Requests needs to run through a triage queue, not a standard backlog. Every incoming request should sit as untriaged until someone decides whether to resolve it directly, promote it to Engineering, promote it to Product, or escalate it. We want clear, documented promotion criteria built in so our Customer Success team can make that call themselves without guessing.

We also need Initiatives set up at the roadmap level, with the ability to link tickets and promoted requests from any of the four teams back to the initiative they support, so we can roll up progress across teams in one view.

Finally, when a request gets promoted out of Client Requests, we want that link preserved so status updates flow back to the original item, and we'd like a simple way for Product or Engineering to flag Client Requests when something ships that CS should tell clients about.

Scope of work:

Configure the four teams, workflows, and triage queue described above
Set up Initiatives and the cross team linking
Light documentation (a one pager is fine) we can hand to the team
A 30 minute walkthrough call with our team after setup so it actually gets adopted

We're looking for a fixed price quote, not hourly. This should be a few hours of focused work for someone who knows Linear well. Please share an example of a Linear workspace you've built, even a screenshot, and your estimated turnaround time.

items.title: US-Based Executive Assistant / Client Operations Coordinator
items.description:
We’re looking for a sharp, reliable U.S.-based operator who can move between client communication, lead follow-up, administrative support, and day-to-day business operations.

This is not a narrowly defined virtual assistant role. 

The right person is comfortable picking up the phone, talking to customers, managing business systems, details, following through on loose ends, and shifting priorities as the business changes.

You’ll work directly with the operating team and help keep client-facing and internal work moving without things falling through the cracks.

What You’ll Do
Your priorities will generally follow this order:
1. Client concierge
 - Respond to and follow up with leads
 - Make outbound calls
 - Qualify prospects and book appointments
 - Reschedule appointments and manage follow-up
 - Represent the company professionally on the phone

2. Lead follow-up
 - Respond to inbound prospects
 - Call interested leads
 - Move qualified prospects toward the appropriate next step
 - Schedule sales meetings and manage calendars

3. Client onboarding and operations
 - Coordinate onboarding tasks
 - Follow up on missing information or access
 - Keep setup work moving
 - Update CRM records and internal systems
 - Help make sure client requests actually get completed

4. Administrative support
 - Calendar management
 - Scheduling
 - Follow-ups
 - CRM cleanup
 - Documentation
 - Research
 - Vendor coordination
 - General operational support

5. Executive support
 - Take clearly delegated work off the team’s plate
 - Handle time-sensitive tasks
 - Chase loose ends
 - Help organize whatever is currently most important

Who We’re Looking For

You should be:
- Currently located in the United States
- Excellent on the phone
- Clear, professional, and easy to understand
- Highly responsive
- Organized without needing constant supervision
- Comfortable working from an ordered priority list
- Good at following through
- Able to communicate with business owners and customers naturally
- Comfortable learning new systems quickly
- Able to switch between customer-facing work and behind-the-scenes operations
- Comfortable working in a small, fast-moving company where priorities can change

Helpful Experience
Experience with any of the following is useful:
- Executive assistance
- Client success
- Customer service
- Appointment setting
- Inside sales
- Operations coordination
- CRM management
- HighLevel / GHL
- Slack
- Google Workspace
- Calendar management
- Lead follow-up
- Service businesses

You do not need to have done every part of this exact job before.

We care more about whether you can communicate well, execute reliably, and make good decisions than whether your previous title perfectly matches this one.

What This Role Is Not
This is not:
- A script-reading call center job
- A pure cold-calling position
- A traditional corporate EA role focused only on calendars and email
- A strategy-only Chief of Staff role
- A role where you spend the day waiting for someone to tell you what to do next

You will have clear priorities, systems, and responsibilities. The expectation is that once something is handed to you, it moves forward.
Schedule

Availability during normal U.S. business hours is required.

We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term part of the operating team as the company grows.

items.title: Loveable/AI build - website and app
items.description:
I am currently reviewing developers for the Beta development of Core16 Personalities, a personality assessment and AI-supported personal development platform.



A substantial amount of the product architecture has already been completed before development begins. I have developed a structured set of specifications covering the assessment architecture, scoring, interpretation, results, reporting, AI boundaries, data structures, governance and wider product requirements.



The project is intended to be built using a Lovable-first / AI-assisted development approach.



My objective is not to commission a conventional development project in which every component is manually coded from scratch where Lovable or other appropriate AI-assisted tools can reasonably produce it.



Instead, I am looking for a developer who can use the existing specifications to:



- translate the architecture into an effective Lovable/AI build strategy;
- create appropriate structured prompts and implementation instructions;
- allow Lovable/AI to perform as much of the implementation as reasonably possible;
- provide specialist development where custom work is genuinely required;
- review and correct AI-generated implementation;
- handle integration, security and technically sensitive elements;
- test and debug the system; and
- take responsibility for ensuring that the agreed Beta works properly from end to end.



For the initial review, I can provide the Core16 Steps 1–19, which describe the implementation architecture in considerable detail.



There is also a separate underlying documentation set, D01–D23, covering the wider product, scientific, governance, AI and architectural foundations. If, after reviewing summaries, you believe particular documents are required, please identify them and I can provide the relevant material.



What I would like from you



Before development begins, I would like you to review the material and recommend:



1. What should constitute a coherent, functioning Core16 Beta suitable for controlled real-world users.



2. What functionality should deliberately be deferred to the Full Version/Post-Beta.



3. Which elements can reasonably be produced using Lovable/AI.



4. Which elements genuinely require specialist developer intervention.



5. What you would expect me, as the founder/product owner, to handle directly using Lovable/AI.



6. What you would take responsibility for yourself.



7. Any technical dependencies, risks or missing specifications you identify.



I would then like us to agree a Beta vs Full Version Scope Matrix and objective Beta acceptance criteria before development starts.



Commercial structure



My preference is to commission the agreed Beta as a fixed-scope, fixed-price project, rather than purchasing an open-ended allocation of development hours.



Once the Beta scope and acceptance criteria have been agreed, I would therefore like a fixed quotation for bringing that defined Beta to completion.



Anything subsequently requested outside the frozen Beta scope can, of course, be separately scoped and quoted.



I am specifically looking for someone who is comfortable working in an AI-assisted/Lovable-first environment, where specialist developer time is concentrated on areas where professional technical expertise genuinely adds value.



If the Beta is successful and we work well together, there is a considerably larger Full Version/Post-Beta roadmap that I would expect to commission separately.

Please give me quote for this project

Kind regards



Luqmahn

items.title: Inside Sales Agent (Remote) – Booking Moving Jobs
items.description:
We’re a fast-growing marketing company that books residential moving jobs across the U.S.
Every day, homeowners request quotes through our ads — your job is to call these warm leads, confirm their details, price the move, and collect a deposit to lock it in.

We already have proven scripts, a working system, and live leads waiting.
Now we need hungry Inside Sales Agents (ISAs) who can close consistently and handle follow-ups professionally.

Your Role

- Call new inbound leads as soon as they come in our calling software
- Qualify the customer (pickup/drop-off, move size, date).
- Give a quote using our pricing guide.
- Secure a $100 deposit over the phone to confirm the booking.
- Log calls and results inside our CRM.
- Follow up with unbooked leads.

What We Provide

- Warm inbound leads — no cold calling.
- Full script, rebuttals, and pricing training.
- CRM access (GoHighLevel).
- Daily coaching and Slack support.
- Growth potential — top performers can move into leadership roles.

Requirements

- Excellent English and confident phone communication.
- Experience in sales or appointment setting
- Reliable internet + quiet workspace.
- Comfortable working U.S. hours (PST,MST,CST,EST)
- Motivated by performance pay (not hourly clock-in).

Pay Structure

- $30 USD per sale
- Weekly performance bonuses (20+ bookings = +$200).
- Top performers make $1,500–$3,500/month USD.

How to Apply

Please include:

- A short voice recording introducing yourself and your experience (use [vocaroo.com](http://vocaroo.com/) or Loom).
- A few sentences about your background in sales or customer service.
- Confirmation that you can work U.S. hours and have reliable Wi-Fi.

We’re hiring 2–3 ISAs immediately.
If you’re coachable, consistent, and motivated by results — you’ll thrive here.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales Hub Consultant
items.description:
Job Title:
1-on-1 Dynamics 365 Sales Hub Instructor & Power Automate Consultant
Job Description:
Overview:
I am looking for a single, independent Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant to help me navigate the Sales Hub application and build workflow automations for my company. I am currently the only person in my organization managing this system, and I need a dedicated expert I can connect with virtually to help me get up to speed quickly.
This role will be a mix of 1-on-1 hands-on training and direct system configuration/automation.
Key Responsibilities:
• Virtual 1-on-1 Training: Connect via screen-share to teach me how to efficiently navigate the default Sales Hub app, manage opportunities, customize views, and read dashboards.
• Workflow Automation: Utilize Power Automate to design and build background automations (e.g., automated email notifications, data tracking updates, and task creation rules) to streamline our sales pipeline.
• Process Consultation: Review our current workflows and suggest best practices for out-of-the-box tracking so I don't have to carry the technical burden alone.
Required Qualifications:
• Vetted experience as a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant (Certifications like MB-210 or PL-200 are a major plus).
• Strong, practical expertise building workflows inside Power Automate and configuring custom model-driven apps.
• Excellent communication skills with patience for 1-on-1 software training and coaching over video calls.
• Must be an individual freelancer (no agencies, please).
Project Type: One-time project (with potential for ongoing hourly support as new automation needs arise).
Budget: Hourly rate (Please provide your standard hourly rate and availability).

items.title: Data Engineer with ML Expertise
items.description:
Data Engineering & Pipeline Architecture
Scalable Data Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain high-throughput batch and streaming ETL/ELT data pipelines using SQL, Python, and modern data orchestration frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, dbt).
Relational & Analytical Data Stores: Write complex SQL queries, procedures, and transformations across data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL) to clean, aggregate, and stage raw business data.
Data Integration: Extract structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from transactional databases, APIs, and file systems to map into graph-ready schemas.
Knowledge Graph & Ontology Engineering
Graph Modeling: Build and optimize graph data schemas and property graph models (nodes, edges, labels) aligned with business domain ontologies.
WeAreDevelopers
Semantic Mapping & Ingestion: Translate semantic concepts (OWL, RDF, SKOS, SHACL) and relational SQL schemas into Graph Database models (Property Graphs or Triple Stores).
Siemens Jobs
Graph Database Management: Administer, query, and tune performance on graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune, Stardog, GraphDB) using languages like Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL.
Machine Learning & AI Integration
Graph ML & Feature Engineering: Generate node/edge embeddings (e.g., Node2Vec, PyTorch Geometric) and engineer graph-based features for ML pipelines.
ML Pipeline Support: Partner with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to operationalize ML models, enabling GraphRAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), entity resolution, link prediction, and vector/graph hybrid search.
Feature Store Integration: Maintain dataset versioning, lineage, and metadata catalogs for both ML training data and graph nodes/relationships.

Required Qualifications & Skills
Core Data Engineering: 3+ years of data engineering experience with expert proficiency in Python and advanced SQL (window functions, query tuning, complex JOINs).
Myworkdayjobs.com
Graph Databases: 2+ years of hands-on experience building, querying, and managing graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune, TigerGraph, Stardog) using query languages like Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL.
Ontology & Semantic Web: Familiarity with data ontologies, taxonomies, and W3C standards (RDF, RDFS, OWL, SKOS, SHACL).
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Practical experience deploying or supporting ML models, feature stores, and working with libraries such as PyTorch/TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, spaCy, or Hugging Face.
Cloud & Orchestration: Proven experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and pipeline orchestration tools (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or dbt).

Preferred / Good-to-Have 
SkillsExperience building GraphRAG solutions combining Knowledge Graphs with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant) and LLMs.
Experience with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph embedding algorithms (e.g., PyG, DeepWALK).
Exposure to streaming architectures (Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming) for real-time graph updates.
Knowledge of SHACL/ShEx for data quality validation in graph environments.

items.title: Fillable PDF and Word Templates Without Changing Original Formatting
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced PDF forms specialist to prepare a collection of existing forms for use in our document-management system.

The forms and their content already exist. However, some files are locked or cannot be properly completed within our system. We need the forms recreated or reformatted as unlocked, fillable PDFs that can be uploaded and completed electronically.

This is not a document-design or content-writing project. The completed forms must match the original versions as precisely as possible.

Scope of Work

For each form, the freelancer will:

Use the existing form as the source document
Recreate or reformat it as an unlocked, fillable PDF
Preserve all original wording, numbering, headings, and instructions
Match the original fonts, spacing, margins, borders, tables, lines, boxes, and page breaks
Add fillable fields in the correct locations
Properly format text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, date fields, and other applicable fields
Assign clear and consistent field names for system mapping
Set a logical tab order
Ensure entered information does not overlap the form’s text, lines, or borders
Test every fillable field before submission
Ensure the final document is suitable for system upload, electronic completion, and printing

Required Experience
Advanced Adobe Acrobat Pro experience
Demonstrated experience creating fillable PDFs
Experience recreating locked or restricted PDF forms
Strong document-formatting and quality-control skills
Experience assigning PDF field names for system mapping
Excellent attention to detail
Ability to handle confidential documents appropriately

items.title: Recruiter Project Coordinator Role
items.description:
Sourcing, Recruiting & Project Coordinator

Company: F2OnSite - USA

F2OnSite is seeking a HIGHLY organized, detail-oriented experienced offshore resource for a hybrid contractor sourcing and project coordination role supporting two nationwide IT service accounts. These accounts involve dozens to hundreds of technicians performing onsite services throughout the United States.

This position combines sourcing and screening independent contractors with coordinating site visits, training, and daily project administration. 

Sourcing will take place through independent contractor platforms; this role does not recruit W-2 employees.

Responsibilities

Source independent IT technicians through contractor platforms to support nationwide service needs.

Interview and screen technicians to assess their qualifications, communication skills, availability, and fit for each assignment.

Help schedule and coordinate onsite service visits.

Arrange technician training and communicate participation requirements.

Maintain accurate records of technician information, schedules, training, and assignment status.

Handle administrative tasks that support daily project operations.

Communicate clearly with technicians and internal team members, providing timely updates and flagging scheduling or staffing issues.

Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and following through on details.

Qualifications
Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
Strong organizational skills and close attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and shifting priorities.
Confidence interviewing technicians and assessing their fit for assignments.
Strong teamwork, responsiveness, and follow-through.
Experience in recruiting, contractor sourcing, scheduling, or project coordination is preferred.
Familiarity with independent contractor platforms and onsite IT services is a plus.
Opportunity

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both finding qualified technicians and keeping complex service schedules organized. The position offers the potential for a long-term opportunity.

items.title: Meta Ads Media Buyer for Premium Ecommerce Beauty & Wellness Brand
items.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We’re a media and marketing agency hiring an experienced Meta ads media buyer for a client in the premium beauty and wellness space.

The brand sells physical products directly to consumers through its website. We need someone who can own Facebook and Instagram advertising, build a structured testing strategy, and turn performance data into better campaigns and creative.

This role is exclusively for Meta ads. You must have hands-on experience driving ecommerce purchases—not just leads, traffic, or engagement.

The client’s name and website will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Audit the existing ad account, historical performance, tracking, creative, and purchase funnel.

• Develop a clear first-30-day plan based on the client’s budget, business economics, and available creative.

• Build, manage, and optimize Facebook and Instagram campaigns, including budget allocation, audience testing, and retargeting where appropriate.

• Establish realistic acquisition cost and ROAS targets using product margins, average order value, discounts, fulfillment costs, and returns.

• Create a structured testing plan for hooks, messaging, offers, formats, and audiences.

• Collaborate with our creative team on specific briefs for video ads, UGC, static ads, and product demonstrations. Explain what assets you need and why.

• Write and test ad copy that communicates value and addresses purchase objections.

• Audit Meta Pixel, Conversions API, purchase events, event deduplication, and UTMs. Identify tracking issues and coordinate any necessary technical fixes.

• Analyze the full purchase funnel and recommend improvements to product pages, offers, cart, and checkout.

• Monitor spend and performance consistently. Make informed decisions about when to scale, adjust, or pause campaigns within agreed budget limits.

• Provide concise weekly reporting covering results, changes made, creative learnings, and next steps.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• Proven success managing Meta ads for ecommerce brands selling physical products.

• Relevant experience with beauty, skincare, wellness, premium consumer products, or similar categories.

• Experience advertising products that require customer education and a considered purchase.

• Strong understanding of customer acquisition cost, conversion rate, average order value, contribution margin, and break-even ROAS.

• Ability to evaluate Meta-reported results alongside actual store revenue and new-customer acquisition.

• Strong creative judgment. You should be able to explain why an ad is working and what to test next.

• Practical experience with Meta tracking, attribution, and troubleshooting.

• Familiarity with Meta advertising requirements for beauty and wellness products, including avoiding unsupported claims.

• Clear communication, reliable follow-through, and proactive recommendations.

HOW WE’LL WORK

You’ll work directly with our agency and collaborate with our creative team. We need someone who can take ownership of paid media while giving clear direction on the creative needed to improve results.

Please specify what you handle personally, whether anyone else will work on the account, and what support you require from us.

We’re open to an ongoing relationship with the right person. Please include your monthly management fee or hourly rate, estimated time commitment, and any separate setup fees. Ad spend is separate from your fee.

TO APPLY

Please include:

1-2 relevant Meta ecommerce case studies. Include the product category, approximate product price, monthly ad spend, timeframe, starting performance, results, and your specific role. Anonymized examples are welcome.

Context behind those results. Include purchase volume, acquisition cost, and ROAS where available.

A brief explanation of your first-30-day approach for a premium beauty or wellness product. 

Your pricing, availability, time zone, current client load, and who will manage the account day to day.

We’re looking for relevant experience, clear thinking, and transparent results. Please keep your proposal specific to this role.

items.title: Local SEO Expert Needed: Schema Markup Implementation + Technical SEO Audit for Local Business
items.description:
We're a dental clinic in Detroit looking for an experienced SEO expert to implement schema markup and strengthen our local SEO. We want to rank higher in the SERP, show up in the map pack, and earn rich results.

Phase 1: Audit and SEO strategy

A technical SEO audit and site audit covering crawling, indexing, XML sitemap, canonical tags, and Core Web Vitals

A review of our current on-page SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, header tags, internal linking, and image SEO (alt text)

Light competitor analysis and keyword research to find local, hyperlocal, and long-tail opportunities

A simple SEO strategy that ties schema to search intent and topical authority

Phase 2: Schema markup implementation

LocalBusiness (with the correct subtype), Organization, Service, FAQ, Review, and BreadcrumbList schema in clean JSON-LD

Page-level markup for the homepage, service pages, location pages, and blog

NAP details consistent with our Google Business Profile and citations

Markup that supports voice search SEO, mobile SEO, semantic SEO, and AI SEO (GEO/AEO), plus E-E-A-T signals

Validation in Google's Rich Results Test and Google Search Console, with all errors fixed

Phase 3: Support for local rankings

Off-page SEO and link building advice, including local citations, review strategy, and digital PR

On-page SEO copywriting tweaks for service and location pages

Our setup: WordPress, mobile-first design, 24 pages.

You're a good fit if you:

Are an SEO freelancer or SEO consultant with proven local SEO and technical SEO experience

Follow white hat SEO practices only

Have used SEO tools and SEO software such as Screaming Frog, Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, or Semrush

Can share before/after examples of schema you've implemented

Explain your work in plain English

Deliverables: 

Implemented and validated schema, an SEO report covering what changed, why, and what to do next, and a short maintenance guide.

To apply, please include:

1. Links to 2-3 local business sites where you've implemented schema
2. Your testing and validation workflow

Independent SEO experts and small SEO agencies are both welcome. We're open to ongoing SEO services or an SEO retainer for the right fit. This is a test role, if you perform well, we'll work on retainer.

items.title: Xây dựng trang wed và ứng dụng về AI MÃ HOÁ HÌNH ẢNH VIDEO VỀ NGƯỜI ĐÃ KHUẤT
items.description:
KIẾN TRÚC ĐỊNH DANH KỸ THUẬT SỐ & BẢO MẬT WEB3 (SOULBOUND NFT)
Việc chuyển đổi sang mô hình Định danh Số thuần túy (Pure Digital ID) kết hợp với công nghệ Blockchain loại bỏ hoàn toàn các rào cản địa lý và chi phí gia công phần cứng vật lý. Đây là nền tảng giúp di sản số tồn tại vĩnh cửu và đạt cấp độ bảo mật tối đa.
PHẦN 1: QUY TRÌNH ĐỊNH DANH VÀ CẤP THẺ DI SẢN SỐ (USER FLOW)
Khi người dùng (hoặc gia đình) đăng ký tài khoản trên Website, hệ thống sẽ tự động thực hiện quy trình 4 bước:
1. Cấp Mã ID Duy Nhất (Unique Legacy ID)
￼ Mỗi người quá cố khi đăng ký sẽ được cấp một định danh độc bản duy nhất trên hệ thống (Ví dụ: ⁠ETN-VN-2026-88902⁠).
￼ Mã ID này đóng vai trò như một "Số Định Danh Di Sản", giúp người thân tìm kiếm trang tưởng niệm trực tiếp trên website mà không cần mã QR vật lý.
2. Đúc Soulbound Token (SBT - NFT Không Thể Chuyển Nhượng)
￼ Thay vì NFT thông thường (có thể mua đi bán lại), hệ thống sử dụng chuẩn Soulbound Token (SBT - ERC-5192) trên mạng lưới Blockchain (như Polygon hoặc Ethereum Layer 2).
￼ Đặc tính của SBT:
￼ Gắn chặt vĩnh viễn với địa chỉ ví/danh tính số của gia đình.
￼ Không thể chuyển nhượng, không thể mua bán hay đánh cắp.
￼ Chứa các thông số mã hóa (Cryptographic Hash) xác thực thời gian tạo, quyền sở hữu và tính toàn vẹn của dữ liệu ký ức.
PHẦN 2: LÝ DO TẠI SAO BLOCKCHAIN GIÚP BẢO MẬT TỐI ĐA THẾ GIỚI
1. Bất tử hóa dữ liệu với IPFS & Arweave (Decentralized Storage)
￼ Thực tế rủi ro: Nếu dùng máy chủ truyền thống (Amazon AWS, Google Cloud), khi công ty ngừng hoạt động, toàn bộ ảnh, video và AI sẽ mất hoàn toàn.
￼ Giải pháp Web3: Mọi file ảnh, video, dữ liệu huấn luyện AI được mã hóa và lưu trữ trên mạng lưới lưu trữ phi tập trung (IPFS / Arweave). Dữ liệu này tồn tại vĩnh viễn trên hàng ngàn máy chủ toàn cầu mà không ai có thể xóa hay thay đổi.
2. Tính Không Thể Thay Đổi (Immutability)
￼ Khi dữ liệu di sản đã được xác nhận (Mint) lên Blockchain, không một hacker, chính phủ hay chính công ty của bạn có thể chỉnh sửa, làm giả hay xóa bỏ mốc thời gian/tiểu sử đó.
3. Bảo mật Quyền Riêng Tư với Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP)
￼ Nhiều câu chuyện hay ký ức gia đình là riêng tư. Công nghệ ZKP cho phép xác thực: "Gia đình này có quyền truy cập trò chuyện với AI" mà không làm rò rỉ nội dung đoạn chat hay dữ liệu riêng tư ra bên ngoài internet.
PHẦN 3: PHÂN QUYỀN TRUY CẬP (ACCESS CONTROL)
Vì không có mã QR công khai tại nghĩa trang, bạn sẽ thiết lập 3 cấp độ bảo mật bằng Mã ID:
1. Chế độ Công khai (Public Legacy):
￼ Bất kỳ ai có Mã ID (⁠ETN-VN-2026-88902⁠) đều có thể tìm kiếm và xem tiểu sử công khai, dâng hoa, thắp nến.
2. Chế độ Riêng tư Gia đình (Private AI & Memories):
￼ Khung chat với AI và các video kỷ niệm riêng tư chỉ mở khóa khi người thân nhập Khóa Bí Mật (Family Passkey/Private Key) do người sở hữu NFT nắm giữ.
3. Quyền Chuyển Giao Di Sản (Legacy Inheritance):
￼ Quyền quản lý trang tưởng niệm có thể tự động chuyển giao cho con/cháu (dựa trên hợp đồng thông minh - Smart Contract) sau một thời gian xác định.
PHẦN 4: LỢI THẾ KINH DOANH VƯỢT TRỘI CỦA MÔ HÌNH NÀY
1. Biên lợi nhuận cực cao (High Margin): Chi phí cấp ID và đúc NFT trên Blockchain chỉ tốn vài cent (vài nghìn đồng), trong khi giá trị bán gói Web3 cho khách hàng có thể từ vài triệu đến hàng chục triệu đồng.
2. Khách hàng toàn cầu (Global Reach): Người Việt Nam ở Mỹ, Úc, Pháp... có thể đăng ký dịch vụ cho ông bà, tổ tiên ở quê nhà ngay tức thì mà không cần chờ vận chuyển bia mộ/thẻ QR kim loại.
3. Định vị thương hiệu cao cấp: Sản phẩm của bạn không còn là "dịch vụ làm web nghĩa trang", mà trở thành "Giải pháp Lưu trữ Di sản Bất tử trên Blockchain".
DIGITAL IDENTITY ARCHITECTURE & WEB3 SECURITY (SOULBOUND NFT)
Transitioning to a Pure Digital ID model combined with Blockchain technology completely eliminates geographical barriers and physical hardware manufacturing costs. This forms the foundation for a digital legacy to endure eternally while achieving maximum security levels.
PART 1: DIGITAL IDENTITY & LEGACY CARD ISSUANCE PROCESS (USER FLOW)
When a user (or family) registers an account on the Website, the system automatically executes a 4-step process:
1. Issuing a Unique Legacy ID
￼ Each deceased individual registered receives a unique identity code on the system (e.g., ⁠ETN-VN-2026-88902⁠).
￼ This ID acts as a "Legacy Identification Number", allowing relatives to search for the memorial page directly on the website without needing a physical QR code.
2. Minting Soulbound Tokens (SBT - Non-Transferable NFTs)
￼ Instead of traditional NFTs (which can be bought and resold), the system utilizes the Soulbound Token (SBT - ERC-5192) standard on a Blockchain network (such as Polygon or Ethereum Layer 2).
￼ Key Characteristics of SBT:
￼ Permanently tied to the family's wallet address / digital identity.
￼ Non-transferable, cannot be bought, sold, or stolen.
￼ Contains cryptographic hash parameters verifying creation timestamp, ownership, and integrity of legacy data.
PART 2: WHY BLOCKCHAIN ENSURES MAXIMUM SECURITY
1. Immortality of Data via IPFS & Arweave (Decentralized Storage)
￼ The Risk in Reality: If traditional servers (Amazon AWS, Google Cloud) are used, all photos, videos, and AI models will be lost completely if the company ceases operations.
￼ The Web3 Solution: All photo/video files and AI training datasets are encrypted and stored across decentralized storage networks (IPFS / Arweave). This data persists eternally across thousands of global servers, immune to deletion or tampering.
2. Immutability
￼ Once legacy data is verified (minted) on the Blockchain, no hacker, government, or even your company can alter, counterfeit, or erase those historical milestones or biographies.
3. Privacy Security via Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP)
￼ Many stories and family memories are private. ZKP technology allows verification of "This family has authorized access to chat with the AI" without leaking chat contents or private data to the external internet.
PART 3: ACCESS CONTROL
Since there is no public QR code required at the cemetery, you will establish 3 levels of security using the Legacy ID:
1. Public Legacy Mode:
￼ Anyone with the Legacy ID (⁠ETN-VN-2026-88902⁠) can search, view the public biography, offer flowers, and light candles.
2. Private Family Mode (Private AI & Memories):
￼ The AI chat interface and private memory videos unlock only when relatives input a Secret Passkey (Family Passkey/Private Key) held by the NFT owner.
3. Legacy Inheritance:
￼ Memorial page management rights can automatically transfer to children or grandchildren (based on a Smart Contract) after a specified timeframe.
PART 4: OUTSTANDING BUSINESS ADVANTAGES OF THIS MODEL
1. Extremely High Profit Margins: The cost to issue an ID and mint an NFT on the Blockchain is only a few cents, whereas the Web3 package value sold to customers can range from hundreds to thousands of dollars.
2. Global Reach: People living abroad (e.g., in the US, Australia, France) can instantly register services for grandparents or ancestors back home without waiting for physical tombstone or metal QR card shipping.
3. Premium Brand Positioning: Your product is no longer just a "cemetery website creation service," but evolves into an "Immortal Legacy Storage Solution on the Blockchain."
