items.title: Build a Telehealth Platform MVP from a Complete Spec
items.description:
This is an execution project, not a design project.

We have a complete, written specification for a direct-to-consumer telehealth platform: architecture, data model, API contracts, integration specifications with sandbox credentials, RBAC matrix, UI designs, acceptance criteria for all 14 milestones, and coding standards ready to drop into your agentic tooling.

We are not asking you to figure out what to build. We are asking you to build it accurately, quickly, and to a standard that survives an independent security review.
No healthcare or telehealth experience required. All domain knowledge is already translated into technical acceptance criteria. What we need is precision and speed.

What we are supplying on day one
•	Full MVP specification — 14 milestones, scope defined, in and out
•	Technical design document with system architecture and service boundaries
•	Complete data model with field-level sensitivity tagging
•	API contracts for every internal endpoint
•	Integration specifications and sandbox credentials for every third party
•	RBAC matrix — every role, every resource, every action
•	UI wireframes for the patient app, staff console and marketing site
•	Six invariant rules written as given/when/then test specifications
•	Per-milestone acceptance criteria, testable and binary
•	CLAUDE.md files, root and per-package, for your AI tooling
•	All vendor contracts and agreements already in place
Shortlisted candidates receive the specification under NDA before bidding, so your quote is informed rather than a guess.

How we want it built
AI-assisted development — Claude Code or equivalent — as the primary implementation method. The timeline assumes it. We want someone who works this way daily, not someone who has tried it once.

To be explicit: AI writes implementation, you own architecture adherence, review, testing and correctness. We review code. "The AI wrote it" is not an answer to a defect.

Scope — 14 milestones, approximately 22 engineering weeks
#	Milestone
1	AWS foundation — Aurora PostgreSQL, S3 with Object Lock, Cognito, Secrets Manager, EventBridge/SQS
2	Monorepo, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), environments, synthetic test fixtures
3	Six invariant tests written first, from our given/when/then specifications
4	Patient web app (Next.js) — signup, structured intake, consent capture, booking
5	Partner EHR integration — bidirectional, to our supplied interface specification
6	Lab ordering via Health Gorilla FHIR R4 — order placement, LOINC-coded result ingestion
7	RBAC and staff console — permissions enforced at the API layer, not the UI
8	Payments — Corepay authorize-then-capture, recurring billing via Recharge
9	Immutable audit logging
10	Freshpaint server-side analytics firewall
11	Twilio SMS/voice and Paubox secure email
12	Marketing site and enrollment funnel (Next.js), isolated from sensitive data
13	Remediation of independent security review findings
14	Handover, documentation, two weeks of launch support

Non-negotiable technical requirements

Supplied as formal test specifications. All six must pass before final milestone approval:
•	Sensitive personal data never written to application logs
•	Sensitive personal data never transmitted to any party outside an approved allow-list, and never to analytics or advertising platforms
•	Users in a non-clinical role are technically incapable of creating, modifying or transmitting a prescription record — enforced server-side, not by hiding UI
•	A payment cannot be captured before an approval event is recorded
•	Every read of patient data produces an immutable audit record with actor, subject, field, timestamp
•	No real patient data in any non-production environment — synthetic fixtures only

These are written first, before feature work.
Stack and vendors — already selected
These decisions are made. Proposals leading with "I'd recommend a different stack" will not be shortlisted.

Language:	TypeScript throughout, monorepo
Front end:	Next.js
Services:	Node / NestJS
Database:	Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, KMS customer-managed keys
Cloud:	AWS, us-east-1 primary
Patient auth:	AWS Cognito
Staff auth:	Okta or WorkOS, separate identity plane
Labs:	Health Gorilla — FHIR R4 Diagnostic Network
Clinical system of record:	Partner medical group's EHR — integration only
Payments:	Corepay (primary), PaymentCloud (backup)
Subscriptions:	Recharge
SMS and voice:	Twilio
Secure email:	Paubox — not Twilio SendGrid
Analytics firewall:	Freshpaint, server-side
Eventing:	EventBridge + SQS, DLQs, idempotency keys
Observability:	Datadog
CI/CD:	GitHub Actions, protected branches, required reviews

How this engagement runs:

Paid trial — 3 to 5 days, fixed price. You receive the full specification under NDA, stand up the repository and CI, implement milestone 1 (AWS foundation), and write two of the six invariant tests. You also return a written list of every gap, ambiguity or error you found in our specification. That list is a deliverable and we want it to be honest.

The build — fixed price, milestone-based. Awarded to the trial developer if the trial goes well.

Quote for the trial, and give your estimate for the full build based on the scope above. We will not hold you to the build number until you have seen the specification.

What we provide during the build
•	Daily asynchronous availability for questions
•	Milestone review within 3 business days, every time
•	A technical reviewer reading your pull requests weekly

Terms
•	All IP assigns to us; code lives in our repository from commit one
•	Mutual NDA and confidentiality agreement
•	Independent third-party security review; you remediate findings
•	Weekly written update plus a 30-minute call
•	Scope changes require written agreement and a separate milestone

Timeline: start within two weeks; build complete in 12 to 14 weeks.

items.title: Sales Development Representative
items.description:
A leader in franchising for the recruitment of executive talent is looking to hire a sales development representative for our franchise owners in the North American market. The position's primary responsibility is to get appointments for new business development and recruit candidates for the franchise's CEO and do research.

items.title: Vapi + Twilio AI Voice Agent Developer for Inbound & Outbound Calls
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced Vapi + Twilio AI Voice Agent developer to help us design and build a working business voice-agent system.
The initial project will be a pilot implementation, but we want the architecture and setup to be suitable for future business use. The agent should support both inbound and outbound calling.
Possible capabilities include:
- Answer incoming calls and provide information about the company
- Answer common customer questions
- Qualify potential leads
- Make outbound calls
- Transfer calls to a human representative when necessary
- Schedule appointments
- Send SMS or email notifications
- Integrate with CRM systems, calendars, webhooks, APIs, and automation platforms
WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU
In addition to building the voice agent, we would like your professional recommendation regarding the proper technical setup.
Please advise us on:
- Whether the business should create and own its own Vapi and Twilio accounts
- Whether separate accounts or subaccounts should be used when managing multiple business clients
- What phone-number setup you recommend for inbound and outbound calling
- Whether an existing business phone number can be used or whether a new number should be purchased
- What credentials, API keys, permissions, or account access you normally require from a client
- What company information, FAQs, scripts, documents, or knowledge-base material you need before development begins
- How you normally connect Vapi, Twilio, LLMs, CRM systems, calendars, SMS, email, APIs, and automation platforms
- What should be handed over to the client after project completion
- What ongoing maintenance or support is normally required
- What recurring platform, telephone, AI, or automation costs the client should expect
DELIVERABLES
We expect the project to include:
1. A working Vapi/Twilio AI voice-agent implementation
2. Inbound and outbound calling configuration
3. Basic testing and troubleshooting
4. Recommended account and phone-number architecture
5. A practical checklist showing what information, accounts, credentials, and access a new client must provide before development begins
6. Documentation explaining the main integrations and setup
7. Explanation of expected ongoing operating costs and maintenance requirements
WHEN APPLYING
Please include the following in your proposal:
1. Examples of Vapi/Twilio voice agents you have actually built
2. Your experience with both inbound and outbound AI calling systems
3. Your preferred technology stack
4. A brief description of what you normally request from a new client before beginning a voice-agent project
5. Your proposed fixed price or estimated price range and what is included
6. Your estimated delivery time
7. Any ongoing monthly maintenance or support you normally recommend
The project budget is currently open because we want to compare different technical approaches, scopes, and pricing structures.
Please focus your proposal specifically on Vapi/Twilio voice-agent development rather than general AI, chatbot, or machine-learning services.

items.title: Packaging designer for premium rigid box (dieline provided)
items.description:
We're a wellness brand launching a premium solid silicone massage ball and need a packaging designer to create print-ready artwork for the retail box and its contents.

Our manufacturer will supply the box dieline. We're working to a tight launch timeline, so we need someone who can start right away and turn the final files around quickly once the dieline arrives.

The packaging

A small rigid two-piece box with a lift-off lid, with a premium, minimal unboxing experience.

Our logo embossed on the lid, with a short tagline

A fitted insert that holds the ball, with a small slit behind it for a pull-out paper tab printed with our brand name

Inside the pull-out: a thank you card, a small instruction manual, and a sticker on a sheet of wax paper

Deliverables

Artwork for the box (lid and base) placed accurately on the supplied dieline
Artwork for the insert and pull-out tab
Designs for the thank you card, instruction manual and sticker
Final print-ready files as an outlined AI (Adobe Illustrator) file, set up correctly for the manufacturer

What we'll provide

Our logo
Reference mockups of the look we want
The dieline from our manufacturer

Additional details

Style: neutral, premium palette with a matte finish. Clean typography and a calm, high-end wellness feel.

Revisions: please include at least 2 rounds of revisions in your price.

Files and ownership: we'll need the editable source files, and full rights to the final designs.

Confidentiality: you'll need to sign an NDA before we share brand files.

Ongoing work: we have several more products launching soon, so there's potential for more packaging projects with the right designer.

Who we're looking for

Proven experience designing rigid box packaging on dielines
A clean, premium, minimal design style
Available to start immediately, with a fast turnaround

Fast, clear communication and good English
UK, US or EU-based preferred

To apply, please include

2 to 3 examples of rigid box or premium packaging you've designed
Your price for the full project
Your turnaround time once you receive the dieline

We’re looking for a Creative Growth Strategist who can turn insights into scroll-stopping ads that drive action.
This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Consumer Psychology, Performance Marketing and AI.

What You’ll Do

- Research audiences, competitors, products and market trends.
- Discover consumer pain points, motivations and buying triggers.
- Develop creative angles, hooks, scripts, headlines and CTAs.
- Create and edit high-performing short-form video ads.
- Develop multiple creative variations and test different angles, formats and messages.
- Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, scripting and production.

- Strong understanding of social-media and short-form advertising.
- Experience with tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Canva, Photoshop and AI tools.
- A strong portfolio matters more than a perfect academic background.

You’ll Thrive Here If You Are
Creative • Curious • Research-driven • Analytical • Fast • Experimental • A Great Communicator

We’re not looking for someone who simply makes ads.

We want someone who understands why people stop, watch, click and buy — and knows how to turn that insight into the next winning creative.

How to Apply

Send us:
CV
Portfolio / previous work
2–3 advertising creatives you’ve created
A short note explaining one creative that performed particularly well and why you think it worked

items.title: Video animation for website hero section
items.description:
**Hero Section Video Animation — Camera Lens Iris Reveal with Logo**

**Project Overview:**
We need a short (8–12 seconds) looping video animation for a website hero section. The animation features a photographic camera lens (DSLR/mirrorless) viewed straight-on (front view), with the iris diaphragm blades opening smoothly to reveal a company logo at the center.

**What We Need — Exact Specifications:**

1. **Camera Lens (Right Side of Frame):**
 - A realistic, high-quality DSLR/mirrorless camera lens seen from the front
 - The lens must be sharp and in focus, positioned on the RIGHT half of the frame
 - The background behind and around the lens body should be softly blurred (shallow depth of field / bokeh effect)
 - The lens details (ring grooves, glass reflections, concentric rings) must be clearly visible and photorealistic

2. **Iris/Diaphragm Animation:**
 - The iris blades start nearly closed (small aperture hole in the center)
 - They open slowly and smoothly (ease-in / ease-out motion) over approximately 3–4 seconds
 - The blade movement must feel organic and mechanically accurate — not abrupt or digital-looking
 - Behind the blades, as they open, the company logo is gradually revealed

3. **Logo Reveal:**
 - The logo sits on a dark/black background behind the iris blades
 - As the blades open fully, the logo becomes completely visible at the center of the lens
 - The logo file (vector/PNG) will be provided by us
 - The logo should appear naturally, as if you're looking through the lens and seeing it on the other side

4. **Lens Flare Effect (Final Phase):**
 - After the logo is fully revealed, a soft, cinematic lens flare effect appears
 - Light reflections on the glass rings of the lens, small bokeh orbs scattered softly
 - The flare should feel natural and cinematic — NOT over-the-top or sci-fi
 - The flare gently fades or stabilizes as the animation settles

5. **Stage / Background:**
 - The overall background/stage is WHITE (clean, bright)
 - The LEFT half of the frame must remain clear/empty (space reserved for text overlay — we will add this separately in HTML/CSS)
 - Aspect ratio 16:9 frame

6. **Technical Deliverables:**
 - Resolution: 1920×1080 (Full HD)
 - Frame rate: 30fps
 - Format: MP4 (H.264, high profile) — web-optimized, file size under 10MB if possible
 - Seamless loop OR clean start-to-end with a static final frame no audio
 - Alpha/transparent version of just the lens element is a PLUS (for flexible web integration)

**Reference:**
We have a demo/concept video that shows exactly what we want. We will share it with shortlisted candidates. The final product must match this reference closely in terms of composition, timing, and overall feel.

**Important Notes:**
- This is NOT a 3D product render of a generic lens — it should look like a real camera lens photographed/filmed macro
- The only animated elements are: the iris blades opening, the logo appearing behind them, and the lens flare. The lens body itself is static
- We value smoothness and cinematic quality over flashy effects
- The video will be used as a background element in a website hero section, so it must be lightweight and web-friendly

**Skills Required:**
After Effects, Cinema 4D or Blender (for realistic lens), Motion Graphics, Video Compositing, Lens/Camera Animation

**Budget:** Fixed price — please quote based on the description above.

-Real, verifiable experience managing paid ad spend, with actual numbers and outcomes you can speak to.

-Comfortable across Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads.

-Independent, not working through an agency.

-This is a full-time, in-house seat for one company, not a multi-client agency arrangement.

-Someone looking for steady, long term work, not a quick one-off project.

We screen hard on this role because it draws a lot of applicants who have not actually done the work. If you have real numbers and real platforms behind you, we want to hear from you.

items.title: Get Paid to Film Your Everyday City on Your Phone
items.description:
This is not a professional filmmaking job. 

 I’m looking for ordinary people around the world who can record natural everyday life in their city using a smartphone. If you already walk around your city, commute to work or school, go shopping, travel, or take regular walks, this can be a simple way to earn extra money while doing things you already do. 

You do NOT need to be a professional videographer. You do NOT need expensive equipment. You do NOT need editing skills. 

 A modern smartphone is completely fine.

 WHAT IS THIS FOOTAGE FOR? 

I’m building a long-term library of everyday B-roll from different countries for a Japanese YouTube channel. The footage will play in the background while narration, subtitles, illustrations and graphics are added on top. I’m interested in normal everyday life — not cinematic filmmaking.

 Useful footage could include: • City streets
 • Residential neighborhoods • Shopping areas 
 • Markets 
• Parks and walking paths
 • Office districts 
 • Coastal streets 
• Bus or train window views 
• Passenger-seat views 
 • Places you visit while traveling 
• Other normal everyday places around where you live You do NOT need to make a special trip just to film. 

You can record during your normal walk, commute, shopping trip, weekend outing, or travel. 

 FILMING STYLE

 Please record: • 16:9 landscape only 
 • 1920×1080 or higher
 • Natural continuous footage • Smooth, comfortable movement 
 • Minimal vertical bouncing 
 • No sudden camera swings 
 • Raw and unedited footage 

No music, captions, transitions, colour grading or watermark are needed. Audio quality does NOT matter. Wind noise, traffic, conversations, or your own voice are completely fine because I will not use the original audio. 

 IMPORTANT: YOU DO NOT NEED TO RECORD ONE VERY LONG VIDEO 

 The duration means TOTAL usable footage across all delivered clips. For example: 60 usable minutes could be six separate 10-minute continuous clips from different places. 60 usable minutes does NOT mean one continuous 60-minute recording. Several natural 5–15 minute continuous clips that add up to the total usable duration are ideal. You do not need to combine the clips into one video. Please keep the original camera files separate and unedited. 

 PAID TEST & ONGOING WORK We will normally start with a small: 10 usable minute paid test If the footage is a good fit, I may later order: 30 usable minutes total across multiple continuous clips or 60 usable minutes total across multiple continuous clips There may also be ongoing work once or twice per month. This can become simple recurring paid work if you regularly walk, commute, travel, or spend time around useful everyday locations. USAGE RIGHTS After payment, I need a worldwide, perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free commercial license. The footage may be used in multiple monetized YouTube videos, including: • Trimming • Cropping • Muting • Looping • Re-editing • Adding narration • Adding subtitles • Adding illustrations and graphics You keep the original copyright. The footage must be original and personally recorded by you. Please do not submit footage copied from YouTube, social media, stock websites, other creators, or AI-generated video. 

WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE TELL ME: 

 1. Your country and city 
2. The smartphone or camera you would use
 3. What kinds of places you can easily film during your normal routine 

4. Your price for: 

• 10 usable minutes 
 • 30 usable minutes TOTAL across multiple continuous clips

items.title: Virtual Assistant for Lending Company
items.description:
About Lendstra

Lendstra is a boutique debt procurement and advisory firm specializing in SBA financing for small and mid-sized businesses in the United States.

We help business owners navigate the SBA lending process and secure competitive financing by combining deep industry expertise, technology, and strong lender relationships.

Founded by a former top-producing SBA lender with more than 15 years of experience, Lendstra was built to represent borrowers rather than banks. We are a growing, specialized team that values organization, attention to detail, responsiveness, and excellent client service.



About the Role

We are looking for a full-time Virtual Assistant – Administrative & Operations Support based in the Philippines to become an important part of Lendstra's day-to-day operations.

This is more than a basic data-entry position. We are looking for someone who can learn our processes, take ownership of recurring responsibilities, stay organized, follow up on outstanding items, and help make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You will work closely with our U.S.-based team and assist with administrative support, client coordination, document management, CRM updates, application tracking, research, and general business operations.

As you learn our business, we want you to take increasing ownership of recurring processes and help our team operate more efficiently.



Key Responsibilities

• Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, and scheduling

• Monitor and organize emails and identify items requiring follow-up

• Maintain organized client folders, digital files, and internal records

• Enter and update client, lender, and transaction information in our CRM and internal systems

• Track active financing opportunities, applications, outstanding documents, deadlines, and next steps

• Assist with client onboarding and collection of required information and documentation

• Prepare and format documents, spreadsheets, reports, and client-facing materials

• Follow up on outstanding tasks and help keep transactions and projects moving forward

• Perform accurate data entry and maintain internal tracking spreadsheets

• Conduct online research on lenders, businesses, industries, SBA financing, and other topics

• Prepare summaries and reports for management and the advisory team

• Maintain checklists and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for recurring business processes

• Help identify ways to improve organization and make recurring processes more efficient

• Provide general administrative and operational support as needed



What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of their work.

You do not need previous SBA lending experience. We can teach you our industry and processes.

What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, follow procedures carefully, communicate clearly, stay organized, and consistently complete responsibilities without requiring constant supervision.



Qualifications

• Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Operations Assistant, or similar role

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Strong organizational and time-management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

• Professional email and business communication skills

• Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365

• Strong spreadsheet and data-entry skills

• Comfortable learning CRMs, project management platforms, cloud storage systems, and other business software

• Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and prioritize tasks effectively

• Ability to follow established procedures while recognizing when something requires attention or follow-up

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision

• Reliable internet connection and professional remote-work setup

• Ability to responsibly handle confidential client and business information

• Willingness to learn about SBA lending, commercial finance, and Lendstra's internal processes

Experience in banking, lending, finance, accounting, real estate, professional services, or another document-intensive industry is a plus, but not required.



What Success Looks Like

We want this person to become someone our team can depend on to keep the operational details of the business organized and moving forward.

A successful candidate will learn to understand:

• Where each project or financing request stands

• What information or documents are still needed

• Which items require follow-up

• What deadlines are approaching

• What needs to happen next

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of recurring responsibilities rather than waiting for instructions on every individual task.

As you become familiar with Lendstra, we want you to anticipate needs, improve processes, and take on greater responsibility.



Position Details

• Full-time

• 100% remote

• Location: Philippines

• Industry: SBA Lending / Commercial Finance

• Work with a small U.S.-based team

• Long-term position with opportunity for increased responsibility

Because Lendstra serves U.S.-based clients and lenders, candidates must be comfortable working hours that provide sufficient overlap with U.S. business hours. Specific working hours will be discussed during the interview process.



Why Join Lendstra?

This is an opportunity to become an important part of a growing financial advisory business rather than simply completing isolated VA tasks.

You will gain exposure to multiple areas of the company, learn about commercial lending and SBA financing, and have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as you learn our processes.

items.title: Bluebeam Revu Expert Needed – Build Standardised Construction Take-Off System
items.description:
Title: Bluebeam Revu Expert Needed – Build Standardised Construction Take-Off System

We are a UK construction estimating business looking for an experienced Bluebeam Revu specialist to help us build a standardised take-off system for our estimating team.

We specialise primarily in UK residential extensions, refurbishments and new-build projects.

The objective is simple: we want multiple estimators to be able to receive the same set of drawings, follow the same measurement methodology and produce consistent, auditable quantities and an unpriced BOQ.

We already have estimators and an Excel estimating/rate library. This project is specifically about standardising the take-off/measurement stage using Bluebeam.

We would like you to help us create:

* A standard Bancroft Bluebeam Profile
* Custom Tool Chest / Tool Sets covering typical UK residential construction
* Logical categories and subcategories for groundworks, concrete, masonry, floors, roofing, carpentry, drainage, internal finishes, M&E etc.
* Standard measurement types for area, length, volume and counts
* Consistent naming conventions and markup system
* Appropriate custom columns / measurement data
* A clean method of exporting completed quantities into Excel / an unpriced BOQ
* A simple written measurement methodology so every estimator follows the same process
* An easy way for us to expand the Tool Chest as new construction items arise

We will provide a genuine UK residential project including architectural/structural drawings and specifications. We want to use this as the test project when building the system.

The finished system should allow us to give the same project to multiple estimators and have them follow the same take-off methodology, with their measurements clearly visible and auditable within Bluebeam.

This is not simply a job to complete one take-off for us. We are looking for someone who understands how to design and standardise the Bluebeam estimating workflow itself.

Experience with UK construction estimating/QS work would be a major advantage.

When applying, please tell me:

1. How extensively you use Bluebeam Revu for construction take-offs.
2. Whether you have previously created custom Profiles, Tool Chests or standardised estimating systems for a team.
3. Whether you can structure/export Bluebeam take-off data into Excel/BOQ format.
4. Your experience with UK residential construction.
5. How you would approach this project.
6. Your fixed-price cost and expected turnaround.

Please include examples/screenshots of previous Bluebeam take-off systems or Tool Chests you have created if possible.

Potential for further work as our estimating system develops.

Thanks,
Jack

items.title: Ad Operations Specialist - Audio
items.description:
This role requires availability and responsiveness Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM Eastern Time, with occasional weekend support. This does not require eight hours of active work each day. Workload will vary, but you must monitor communications and respond promptly during these hours.

We are seeking an experienced Ad Operations Specialist to manage campaign execution across our growing digital audio and podcast advertising business. This role will own campaigns from setup through final reporting, working closely with clients and internal teams to ensure campaigns launch accurately, deliver as planned and are optimized throughout the flight.
This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the details of digital audio ad operations and is comfortable taking ownership of both the technical and client-facing sides of campaign management. You should be highly organized, responsive and able to troubleshoot delivery issues quickly and independently. Hands-on experience with DSP and/or Ad servers is required.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented and someone who takes ownership from start to finish. You understand that strong ad operations is about more than trafficking campaigns, it’s about making sure every detail is right, identifying potential issues before they become problems and keeping clients informed along the way. You’re comfortable managing multiple campaigns and priorities at once, communicating directly with clients and digging into delivery data to understand what’s happening and why. You’re proactive, responsive and know when to solve an issue independently and when to escalate.

Responsibilities: 

*Build, traffic and manage orders, campaigns, ads and creatives in AdsWizz AudioServe, including second-screen and companion display placements
*Configure and maintain campaign targeting, including zone groups, show inclusion and exclusion lists, state and DMA targeting, contextual and behavioral segments, pacing, priority and frequency caps
*Manage weekly creative swaps and re-trafficking, carefully verifying that targeting, show lists, zone groups and delivery settings remain intact after every change
*Monitor campaign health and delivery, using bid, win and impression data to identify and troubleshoot underdelivery
*Diagnose and resolve targeting, inventory, creative and ad-serving issues
Traffic and troubleshoot third-party VAST redirect tags, including Podscribe, and investigate no-fill and other delivery issues
*Monitor inventory quality and investigate suspicious inventory, adding flagged shows or feeds to blocklists when appropriate
*Manage day-to-day client communication related to campaign requests, creative changes, budgets, flight dates, delivery and reporting
*Clarify incomplete campaign instructions before making changes and proactively communicate potential delivery risks
Prepare accurate client reports based on individual client requirements and campaign objectives
*Reconcile monthly AdsWizz invoices against platform reporting and investigate discrepancies
Support AudioMax management as needed, including deals, supply packs, sales channels, floor CPMs and DSP connections
*Work closely with Sales and Account teams to ensure campaigns are executed accurately and clients receive a high level of service

Requirements:
*Hands-on experience with AdsWizz AudioServe, including campaign trafficking, targeting, pacing and delivery troubleshooting
*Experience managing digital audio, podcast or programmatic advertising campaigns
*Experience communicating directly with clients and managing multiple concurrent campaigns
*Strong attention to detail, particularly when making campaign changes and verifying targeting and delivery settings
*The ability to interpret campaign delivery data, investigate discrepancies and clearly explain findings
*Strong spreadsheet skills for campaign reporting, analysis and billing reconciliation
*Consistent availability and responsiveness during agreed working hours. Customer service is our highest priority. Client requests must be acknowledged promptly, even when resolution takes longer. If you cannot commit to this level of responsiveness, please do not apply.
*To confirm you've read the entire job description, include the word Mission at the beginning of your proposal. 
*The ability to work independently, follow through on requests and escalate issues when appropriate
*Familiarity with Podscribe, VAST tags and campaign reporting dashboards
*Experience with AudioMax or other SSP management is a plus
*A proactive, problem-solving mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
*A good sense of humor and entrepreneurial spirit

items.description:
Summary
*DO NOT CONTACT ME OUTSIDE OF UPWORK OR YOU WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.*

I'll keep this short and to the point.

I'm a former videographer and editor who now runs a video agency. I no longer shoot commercial projects myself and leave that to the team. However, I still enjoy filming personal content, particularly travel videos, but I don't have the time to edit these passion projects myself and prefer not to pass personal work to my agency editor.

As this is paid work, you'll be required to sign an NDA. The finished videos will be published under my brand, so there won't be any public editor credit.

To streamline the process, I will:

* Choose the music
* Select the clips for the final edit
* Organize the selects on a Premiere Pro timeline
* Colour grade the footage

This should save a significant amount of editing time.

Please review the Instagram profile below to get a strong sense of the editing style I'm looking for:

https://www.instagram.com/scoobafiles/

I'd like the final result to be approximately 75% inspired by the reference style and 25% your own creative interpretation.

The editing style relies heavily on masking, subject isolation, visual effects, and creative transitions similar to the reference account.

Videos will be approximately 30 seconds long, similar in length to the reference videos.
Rate: $50 USD per video.

I currently have 4-5 projects ready to go, with one project I would like to start immediately. Also looking to work with someone long term.

Lastly, I want to be upfront. I'm looking for work that matches the quality and standard of the reference content. If we're not the right fit after the first project, I'll move on to another editor.

If you apply, please include examples of work.

items.title: Appointment Setter / DM Sales Representative for Online Health Coach - $400 base + 2% commission
items.description:
We’re looking for a motivated, personable, and sales-oriented Appointment Setter to join our growing online health and wellness company.

This is not a cold-calling role.

You’ll primarily be working inside our Instagram inbox, having genuine conversations with warm inbound leads, new followers, and existing followers who are interested in improving their health.

Your job is to build rapport, understand what they’re struggling with, qualify whether they may be a good fit for our program, and sell the value of taking the next step: booking a free consultation with our founder.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll manage and actively cover our inbox from approximately 11 AM–6 PM Eastern Time, Monday–Saturday.

You’ll start and continue conversations with new and existing followers, respond to inbound leads, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, follow up with prospects, handle basic objections, and book qualified leads onto our consultation calendar.

This is a sales position, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable confidently moving conversations forward rather than simply answering messages.

Compensation

$400 USD/month base pay + 2% commission on closed deals.

You can earn up to $160 in commission per closed client in addition to your base compensation.

There is room to grow within the company for someone who consistently performs and takes ownership of the role.

What We’re Looking For

You’re a strong fit if you:

* Have previous appointment-setting, DM sales, or online sales experience
* Are confident having sales conversations and asking direct questions
* Write fluent, natural-sounding English
* Are warm, empathetic, personable, and able to make conversations feel human rather than scripted
* Are organized and consistent with follow-up
* Can work independently and take ownership of your numbers
* Are coachable and willing to implement feedback quickly
* Are comfortable working toward clear KPIs
* Are proficient with Google Workspace
* Can reliably cover 11 AM–6 PM ET, Monday–Saturday

Experience in health, wellness, coaching, or high-ticket sales is a bonus, but not required.

Training & Support

You will not be expected to figure this out alone.

We provide full training, scripts, systems, ongoing feedback, and support to help you get ramped up and consistently hit your KPIs.

We care about performance, but we also care about developing the right person into an excellent setter.

To Apply

Please include:

1. Your previous experience with appointment setting, DM sales, or high-ticket sales.
2. The types of offers you’ve previously set appointments for.
3. Your typical booking or show-up numbers, if you know them.
4. Confirmation that you can consistently work 11 AM–6 PM Eastern, Monday–Saturday.
5. A short explanation of how you would turn a friendly Instagram conversation into a booked sales call without sounding pushy or robotic.

Please start your application with the word “HUMAN” so we know you read the full job description.

We’re looking for someone who wants to become an integral part of the team, master the sales process, and grow with the company long-term.

items.title: Hiring U.S-Based Freelancer Mum for AI Training & Human Feedback Evaluation
items.description:
Listen Lab is looking for U.S-based freelancers to participate in an AI training and evaluation project. The goal of this project is to help improve AI systems by collecting accurate, consistent, and high-quality human feedback on how AI-powered platforms and digital experiences perform.

As a freelancer, you will interact with websites and digital platforms, complete assigned tasks, and provide structured feedback based on your experience. Your responses will be used as human-generated training and evaluation data to help improve the quality, accuracy, usability, and reliability of AI systems.

What You’ll Do
Complete assigned tasks on websites and digital platforms.
Evaluate how clearly and effectively different digital experiences work.
Follow detailed instructions and predefined evaluation criteria.
Provide accurate human feedback based on your actual experience.
Identify issues, inconsistencies, or areas where an AI system or digital workflow could be improved.
Review and evaluate AI-generated or system-generated outputs when applicable.
Submit structured responses and observations through our designated platform.
Maintain consistency and attention to detail across assigned tasks.

Why Your Feedback Matters:
AI systems learn and improve through high-quality data and human evaluation. Your role will be to provide the human perspective needed to help evaluate and improve AI-generated results and digital interactions.

The project is not simply about testing websites. Website and platform interactions are part of the data-collection and evaluation process used to support AI training and model improvement.

Requirements
Must currently be based in the U.S.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to follow written instructions accurately.
Good written communication skills.
Comfortable using websites, online platforms, and common digital tools.
Ability to provide objective and consistent feedback.
Reliable internet connection and access to a computer.
Previous experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content review, UX testing, or research is helpful but not required.

Project Structure
Tasks will be assigned through our project platform on a recurring basis. Each assignment will include instructions explaining what needs to be evaluated and what information needs to be submitted.

Compensation will be provided for completed and approved assignments according to the project terms.

If you are interested in contributing human feedback that helps train and improve AI systems, we would be happy to have you apply.

Note: Each freelancer will be required to provide a copy of their resume/CV and sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before beginning the project.

items.title: Remote Leasing Agent / Collections Agent
items.description:
About the role

We're seeking a remote leasing and collections agent to support Essa View Apartments, a 200-unit multifamily property in Lawton, Oklahoma. You'll handle leasing inquiries, assist with move-ins, manage resident communications, and drive our collections efforts, all working out of AppFolio. This is a long-term role for someone reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning day-to-day property management tasks independently.

What you'll do

On the collections side, you'll work through the delinquency report every day and reach out to residents with past-due rent by phone, text, and email. You'll make sure each resident's ledger is accurate based on their lease, apply and explain late fees, and work with residents on a path to bring their accounts current. When a resident skips or moves out with a balance, you'll prepare their file and send it to our collection agency.

On the leasing side, you'll answer calls that come into our leasing line, respond to emails and online inquiries, help prospects complete applications, schedule tours with our on-site team, and follow up to get units leased. You'll also help keep our social media and listings current to support leasing activity and occupancy.

What we're looking for

Clear, confident spoken and written English, since most of this job is talking with residents and prospects by phone. Experience supporting multifamily operations and handling tenant-related matters. Familiarity with AppFolio or similar property management software (Yardi, Buildium, RentManager, etc.). Strong organization and follow-through, with a knack for keeping accurate records. The ability to work independently and stay on task without close supervision.

Schedule and commitment

We're looking for a long-term commitment of at least 3-5 hours per day, 5-7 days a week, spread across various times of the day to cover resident calls and follow-ups. Lawton is on US Central Time, so most working hours will fall late in the evening or early morning your time. Please only apply if that schedule works for you.

How to apply

In your proposal, please tell us whether you've used AppFolio or similar property management software, describe any experience you have with rent collections or leasing, and let us know what hours you'd typically be available in your local time. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to submit a short audio recording so we can hear how you communicate with residents over the phone.

items.title: Logo Designer Needed for Marnel | E-Commerce & Clothing Brand
items.description:
We are looking for a creative and experienced logo designer to create a *modern, distinctive, and memorable logo for Marnel*, an e-commerce and clothing brand.

We want something that feels *clean, premium, modern, and fashion-forward*, while still being versatile enough to work across clothing, packaging, social media, website, labels, and other brand applications.

### Creative Direction

Our preferred color direction is:

*Black + Blue*

You are welcome to explore *2–3 shades of blue* alongside black to find a combination that gives the brand a strong and polished look.

We are open to different creative approaches and do not want the logo to feel generic or like a typical clothing/e-commerce logo.

### Concepts

We would like to explore two creative directions:

*Concept 1: M-Based Logo*

One concept should incorporate the letter *“M”* in a creative and distinctive way.

The M should not simply be typed in a standard font. We are looking for a thoughtful symbol or monogram that can potentially work independently as a brand icon.

*Concept 2: Designer's Creative Direction*

For the second concept, we want to give you creative freedom.

You can decide whether the strongest direction for Marnel is an abstract symbol, wordmark, monogram, fashion-inspired mark, or another original concept based on your design expertise.

### What We Are Looking For

* Modern and premium visual style
* Strong typography and composition
* Original and memorable concept
* Suitable for a clothing/e-commerce brand
* Works well on both light and dark backgrounds
* Scalable and recognizable at small sizes
* Strong standalone icon potential
* Professional color palette using black and blue
* No generic templates or stock logo concepts

### Deliverables

We expect the final selected logo to include:

* Primary logo
* Logo/icon mark
* Black and white versions
* Color version
* Source/vector files
* PNG files with transparent background
* Font information
* Color codes
* Basic logo variations for different applications

We would also like to see the logo presented in a few realistic applications such as *clothing, packaging, website, or social media*, so we can understand how the identity works in practice.

### Who We Want

We are looking for a designer who can *think creatively rather than simply execute instructions*.

Please share relevant examples of your *logo, branding, fashion, clothing, or e-commerce work* when applying.

We value originality, attention to detail, communication, and the ability to develop a strong concept from a simple brief.

If you think you can create a logo that makes *Marnel* feel like a recognizable and premium brand, we'd love to see your work.

*Please include your portfolio, estimated timeline, and your proposed budget in your application.*

items.title: Python AI Agent for Finance Evaluation Packs
items.description: Build a Python AI agent that creates finance evaluation packs from a one-line instruction and batch size. Each pack includes a data room, prompt, ground truth, and rubric. The agent posts packs, runs Claude on the prompt and data room, and evaluates results against the ground truth. Packs are kept only if filters pass and the score is under 60%. Failed packs are rebuilt with more records and tougher documents, then reposted. The agent saves every pack with its score and filter result, and returns only the kept packs. The trial requires one command, no input data, and outputs each pack marked keep or drop.

items.title: Automation Specialist
items.description:
We’re looking for an experienced Make.com and SmartSuite automation specialist to help us build and implement a project management automation for our company.
We currently manage project data in standardized Excel workbooks stored in OneDrive and use SmartSuite for project tracking and stakeholder dashboards. We want to connect these systems using Make.com so that project information stays updated in SmartSuite automatically while keeping Excel and OneDrive as our primary sources.
The project will include:
•	Syncing project and KPI data from Excel to SmartSuite
•	Syncing project milestones and change orders
•	Connecting approved OneDrive documents to the appropriate SmartSuite projects
•	Managing stakeholder access based on the project's surety partner
•	Setting up reliable error handling and safeguards to prevent duplicate or incorrect records
•	Testing the automation with one pilot project before rolling it out across our active projects 
We already have a detailed roadmap outlining the workflows, field mappings, requirements, and expected behavior, so we are looking for someone who can take the existing plan and handle the technical build, testing, and implementation.
Experience with Make.com, SmartSuite, Microsoft Excel, and OneDrive is important.
Please include examples of similar automations or integrations you have built and your estimated timeline for a project like this.

items.description:
Commercial Roofing Appointment Setter (Remote)

Location: Remote (United States)

Position Type: Independent Contractor / Commission-Based

About Us

We are a growing commercial roofing company specializing in roof inspections, repair programs, restoration solutions, maintenance plans, and replacement projects for commercial building owners and property managers.

We are looking for a motivated, self-directed Appointment Setter who can identify prospective commercial properties, find decision-makers, and schedule qualified appointments for our outside sales team.

This role is perfect for experienced cold callers, appointment setters, lead generation specialists, or business development professionals who enjoy prospecting and being rewarded for results.

Responsibilities
Research commercial buildings and property ownership information
Identify building owners, facility managers, property managers, and key decision-makers
Locate contact information through publicly available sources and prospecting tools
Conduct outbound cold calls
Introduce company services and generate interest
Schedule appointments for commercial roof inspections and consultations
Confirm appointments and document communication activity
Maintain accurate records within our CRM and tracking systems
Collaborate with the sales team to ensure smooth handoff of opportunities
Ideal Candidate
Comfortable making outbound cold calls
Strong verbal communication skills
Organized and detail-oriented
Self-motivated and able to work independently
Prior experience in appointment setting, telemarketing, lead generation, commercial services, roofing, construction, facility management, or B2B sales is preferred
Familiarity with LinkedIn, property ownership databases, CRM platforms, and internet research is a plus
Equipment Requirements

This is a remote position.

Contractors will provide:

Computer or laptop
Reliable internet connection
Headset

Company systems and training will be provided.

Compensation

Performance-based compensation designed to reward quality appointments.

Example structure:

$50 per confirmed appointment
+$100 per qualified appointment after initial sales meeting
+$250-$500 bonus for appointments resulting in a signed project
Monthly performance bonuses available

Top performers can substantially increase earnings through quality opportunities and project conversions.

What Success Looks Like:
Consistent outbound prospecting activity
Quality conversations with building owners and property managers
Accurate contact data collection
High appointment attendance rates
Strong conversion from appointment to opportunity
To Apply

Please submit:

Resume or relevant experience
Brief summary of your appointment-setting or sales experience
Availability
Any experience with roofing, construction, facilities, or commercial property prospecting

items.title: Real Estate Inbound Lead Specialist — Appointment Setter (Speed-to-Lead) | Full-Time, Remote
items.description:
I'm a growing real estate agent in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, and I'm hiring a phone professional to be the first voice my inbound leads hear. This is not data entry and not reading a script word-for-word. It's a consultative, conversation-based role: your job is to reach leads fast, have a genuine no-pressure conversation, and book qualified appointments onto my calendar. If you take pride in your connect and set rates, read on.

What you'll own
- Calling every inbound buyer/seller lead within 3 minutes during business hours. Speed is the whole game.
- Real, consultative conversations that uncover a lead's situation, timeline, and motivation — question-based (NEPQ or similar), never pushy. Our brand is honest, no-pressure guidance.
- Handling reflex objections ("just looking," "just curious what it's worth") calmly and naturally, without being salesy and without folding.
- Booking listing appointments and buyer consultations directly on my calendar, and working no-answers through a set follow-up sequence.
- Logging every call and outcome in the CRM (we use GoHighLevel).

Who you are

- Experience in real estate ISA, appointment setting, or consultative phone sales.
- You listen and ask follow-up questions — you don't recite. Familiar with or eager to learn question-based frameworks like NEPQ.
- Clear, neutral, warm English. Midwest sellers need to feel comfortable with you.
- Self-motivated, reliable, and unfazed by rejection. You can take a "no" and dial the next one.
- Reliable internet + quality headset. CRM experience (GHL a plus).

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8am–6pm Central Time.

Compensation: Competitive base salary. Performance bonuses for appointments set and closed deals will be added once you're established in the role and consistently converting. Pay is negotiable based on experience — include your rate in your application.

Growth path: Top performers grow into a Lead Manager role (managing comps, nurture, and a second caller) as the business scales.

To apply:
1. Tell me about a *specific* time you turned a hesitant lead into a booked appointment. What exactly did you say, and how did you handle their objection?
2. A seller tells you they're "just looking and not ready to do anything yet." How do you respond?
3. Have you worked in real estate before? If so, what CRM did you use?
4. Attach a 60–90 second voice memo introducing yourself as if you're leaving a voicemail for a seller lead named Sarah who just requested a home value.

items.title: Nonprofit website and startup website
items.description:
Website Designer & Developer Needed for Nonprofit Foundation + Biotech Startup

We are looking for a talented, creative website designer/developer to help us design and build two separate websites: one for a nonprofit foundation focused on patient advocacy and regenerative medicine, and another for an early-stage biotechnology startup developing regenerative solutions for nasal reconstruction.

While the organizations are connected through a shared mission, the websites need to have distinct identities, audiences, and purposes.

Website 1 — Nonprofit Foundation

Our nonprofit, Hopewell Foundation for Regenerative Medicine, works at the intersection of patient advocacy, regenerative medicine, craniofacial reconstruction, and access to emerging treatments.

We want this website to feel human, emotional, hopeful, credible, and mission-driven.

The site should communicate our mission through strong storytelling and beautiful visual design while highlighting patient experiences, research initiatives, collaborations, educational resources, advocacy efforts, and ways for people to get involved or support the organization.

We are looking for something that feels like a modern, established foundation rather than a traditional clinical or academic website. Strong photography, movement, thoughtful typography, storytelling, and an excellent mobile experience are important to us.

Website 2 — Biotechnology Startup

Our second website is for Rhinova Biotech, an early-stage regenerative medicine company focused on developing patient-specific solutions for nasal tissue reconstruction.

This website should have a very different feel: innovative, sophisticated, scientific, minimal, and investor/partner-ready.

It will need to clearly communicate the problem we are addressing, our technology and development strategy, the unmet need, our team and advisors, partnerships, and our broader vision.

We want the design to feel like a modern biotechnology company visually compelling and forward-thinking without becoming overly futuristic or looking like a generic AI-generated biotech website.

What We're Looking For

We would love to work with someone who can handle both design and implementation and who understands how to turn a mission and brand vision into a strong digital experience.

Ideally, you have experience with nonprofit, healthcare, biotechnology, life sciences, medical, or startup websites. Experience creating custom animations, interactive elements, responsive layouts, and strong visual storytelling is a major plus.

We currently have existing websites/content and brand direction to work from, so this is not starting completely from scratch. However, we are looking for someone who can significantly elevate the design, organization, storytelling, and overall professionalism of both sites.

We are particularly interested in someone who can bring creative ideas to us, rather than simply waiting for detailed instructions for every section.

When Applying

Please include examples of websites you have personally designed and/or developed, particularly any work in biotechnology, healthcare, nonprofits, science, or mission-driven organizations.

Please also let us know:

- What platform(s) you recommend for these projects
- Whether you handle both UI/UX design and development
- Your estimated timeline for completing two websites
- Your estimated cost or project structure
- Whether you would be available for ongoing updates after launch

We are building both organizations with a long-term vision and would love to find a designer/developer who understands what we are trying to create and can potentially continue working with us as we grow.

items.title: AutoCAD Drafter — Tile Shop Drawings (Immediate) + Roofing/Waterproofing — Long Term
items.description:
Hi! We're a small drafting group producing construction drawings for contractors on commercial and residential projects here in the US. The work is steady and it repeats, so we're looking to bring on a couple of drafters for the long haul rather than for one job.

Immediate need: tile shop drawings

Right now we have an immediate need for someone with tiling shop drawing experience — floor and wall tile layouts, starting points, pattern and joint layouts, cut tiles at perimeters and penetrations, transitions, movement joints, and setting/section details (substrate, membrane, mortar bed, tile). If you've drawn tile submittals for approval before, say so at the top of your proposal and show us a sample — we can put you to work right away. TCNA detail familiarity is a plus.

Beyond that, what we really want is someone with broad CAD experience. Someone who's comfortable with all sorts of construction drawings and doesn't panic when a new type lands on their desk. We'd rather have a drafter who can handle whatever we throw at them than a specialist in one narrow thing.

The main work:

Most of our ongoing work is roofing and waterproofing shop drawings. In short: we send you the architect's detail showing the condition, you pull the matching detail from the manufacturer's library, and you draw the two together into a finished sheet we can submit for approval. We'll walk you through our process properly once you're on board.

You'd also be drawing:

	•	Tile layouts and setting details — see the immediate need above
	•	Floor plans — existing conditions and proposed, often from field measurements and markups we send you
	•	Roof plans and layout plans — membrane plans, drain and slope layouts, tapered insulation
	•	Paver and deck layouts — pedestal pavers, amenity decks, joint layouts
	•	Revisions and redlines on drawing sets that already exist
	•	Other trades when they come up — millwork, electrical, plumbing, metal work, general construction details. Being a solid all-around drafter matters more to us than knowing any one trade inside out.


What we're looking for

	•	Good AutoCAD skills. Layers, blocks, xrefs, layouts and viewports, dimension and text styles.
	•	Experience drafting construction drawings of some kind. Tile, roofing, metal, millwork, steel, curtain wall, MEP, architectural, civil, interiors, whatever. If you can draw a clean section and read a drawing set, you can do this work.
	•	You can read an architectural drawing and pull out what you need.
	•	You understand how an assembly stacks up. Deck, insulation, membrane, protection, finish — or substrate, membrane, mortar, tile. Getting a section right matters more to us than getting it fast.
	•	Clean, consistent linework. Proper lineweights, sensible layering, readable text. These drawings go in front of architects and engineers for approval, so they have to look right.
	•	You can work in someone else's standards — our title block, our layers, our way of doing things.
	•	Decent written English. Enough to follow a markup and ask a clear question when something doesn't make sense.
	•	DWG and PDF on delivery.
	•	Some overlap with US Eastern Time for a quick check-in each day.

Nice to have but not required: roofing, waterproofing or building envelope experience, tapered insulation layouts, pedestal paver layouts, or familiarity with NYC construction documents.

You don't need a degree, you don't need Revit or BIM, and you won't be designing anything. This is 2D AutoCAD production drafting.

Rate

$3–$5 USD/hour depending on experience. Hourly through Upwork with time tracking.

Part-time to start, with steady ongoing volume for the right person. We're looking for someone to stick with us, not fill a one-off gap.

How to apply

Please send samples of drawings you drafted yourself. PDF is easiest. If you have tile shop drawing samples, include those first. We won't review applications without samples, so don't skip this part.

Also let us know:

	1.	What kind of construction drawings you've done, and how long you've been at it — and specifically whether you've done tile shop drawings
	2.	Your AutoCAD version
	3.	Your hours in US Eastern Time

Start your proposal with the word "FLASHING" so we know you actually read this.

If we shortlist you, we'll send over a short paid test drawing before anything else.

Looking forward to seeing your work!

items.title: n8n Business Automation Specialist
items.description:
I’m looking for someone who can help me automate a few repetitive business processes using n8n.

Right now, some of our tasks still require manual data entry, moving information between different tools, updating records, sending notifications, and following up on certain actions. I’d like to turn these processes into reliable workflows that can run automatically.

I’m not looking for someone who will simply connect a few apps and call it finished. I need someone who can understand the process first, identify what should happen at each stage, and then build the automation properly.

What I need help with

Depending on the workflow, this may include:

Custom n8n workflow automation
Connecting different business applications
API and webhook integrations
CRM updates and data synchronization
Lead capture and lead routing
Automated email or notifications
Data processing and transformation
Conditional logic and workflow branching
AI-powered steps where they actually make sense
Error handling and workflow testing
Connecting tools such as Google Sheets, Airtable, Gmail, Slack, CRMs and other platforms

The goal is to take a process that currently looks something like:

Information comes in → someone checks it → data is entered → another system is updated → notification is sent → follow-up happens

and turn it into a clean automated workflow.

What I'm looking for

I’d like to work with someone who has practical experience with n8n automation, business process automation, API integrations, CRM workflows and multi-step workflows.

You should be comfortable taking a process that isn't perfectly organized, asking questions when something is unclear, mapping the workflow, building it in n8n, testing different scenarios, and fixing issues before delivery.

Reliability is important to me. I don't want an automation that works during the demo but breaks when something unexpected happens.

To apply

Send:


What manual process it replaced.
Which applications or APIs you connected.
How you handled errors or unexpected data.

If you understand business workflow automation and can turn repetitive manual processes into reliable n8n systems, I'd be interested in discussing the project.

items.title: Amazon PPC & Listing Optimization Specialist
items.description:
Amazon PPC & Listing Optimization Specialist — Part-Time

Budget: $12–$18/hour | 8–10 hours/week initially

I am the owner of a growing African food and commodity brand selling on Amazon. I am looking for an experienced Amazon PPC + Listing Optimization Specialist who can help me improve the performance of my existing products while building a repeatable Amazon growth system.

This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.

I am NOT looking for a generic virtual assistant. I need someone who understands Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Ads, keyword research, listing optimization, and PPC data analysis.

What you will be responsible for

1. Amazon PPC Management

You will help manage and optimize Amazon advertising campaigns, including:

* Reviewing campaign performance
* Search term analysis
* Keyword research
* Keyword harvesting
* Adding negative keywords
* Bid adjustments
* Budget adjustments
* Campaign structure recommendations
* Identifying wasted spend
* Identifying promising keywords/products
* Reviewing CTR, CPC, CVR, ACOS, ROAS and related metrics
* Creating new campaigns when appropriate
* Moving successful search terms into appropriate match types/campaigns
* Monitoring campaigns and making controlled optimizations
* Providing a concise weekly PPC report

I want someone who can explain WHY they are making a change, not someone who blindly changes bids.

2. Amazon Listing Optimization

Help research and optimize:

* Titles
* Bullet points
* Product descriptions
* Backend search terms
* Keywords
* Competitor positioning
* Product benefits
* Search relevance
* Conversion-focused listing structure

You will research competitors and keywords and provide recommendations/drafts.

I will have final approval over major changes to brand positioning and product messaging.

3. Competitor & Keyword Research

For each product, I want you to be able to:

* Identify relevant competitors
* Analyze competitor titles/bullets
* Identify important keywords
* Identify keyword gaps
* Identify potential long-tail keywords
* Identify opportunities competitors are missing
* Help determine which keywords should be targeted organically vs. through PPC

4. Weekly Reporting

Every week, provide a simple report showing:

* Spend
* Sales attributed to PPC
* ACOS
* ROAS
* Impressions
* Clicks
* CTR
* CPC
* Conversion rate where available
* Top-performing keywords
* Poor-performing keywords
* Negative keywords added
* Major changes made
* What you recommend doing next

I do NOT want a giant spreadsheet that nobody reads.

I want a concise report that tells me:

What happened → Why it happened → What you changed → What we should do next.

Current situation

I currently have several African food/commodity products on Amazon, including products such as:

* Moringa
* Dried hibiscus/sobolo
* Shea butter
* Tiger nuts
* Fufu
* Other African grocery/commodity products

The goal is to build Africa Unite into a recognizable brand rather than simply selling random products.

Because of that, I want someone who understands that PPC, keywords, listing quality, pricing, conversion and branding all need to work together.

VERY IMPORTANT — How I want this role to work

I am the business owner and will continue making the major strategic decisions.

You will be responsible for research, analysis, execution and recommendations.

You should NOT make major changes to:

* Product positioning
* Pricing strategy
* Brand messaging
* Major advertising budget increases
* Major listing rewrites

without discussing them with me first.

I want you to bring me data-backed recommendations.

Trial Assignment

Before hiring, I will ask shortlisted applicants to complete a small trial exercise.

I will provide an Amazon product/listing and some basic PPC information.

Please provide:

1. Your assessment of the listing
2. 5–10 keyword opportunities
3. 3–5 competitor observations
4. What you would change in the listing
5. What you would change in the PPC campaign
6. What you would NOT change yet
7. Your reasoning behind your recommendations

I care much more about your reasoning and Amazon knowledge than simply giving me a long list of changes.

Required experience

You should have:

* Real Amazon Seller Central experience
* Amazon PPC experience
* Experience with Sponsored Products
* Keyword research experience
* Listing optimization experience
* Experience interpreting PPC data
* Understanding of Amazon search terms and indexing
* Strong written English
* Ability to communicate recommendations clearly
* Experience working with small/growing brands

Experience with African food, grocery, supplements, beauty products, or other commodity/CPG products is a plus, but not required.

Please do NOT apply if:

* You have only watched Amazon PPC courses but haven’t managed real campaigns
* You are a generic VA who wants to learn Amazon on my account
* Your strategy is simply “increase bids”
* You cannot explain ACOS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate and search term performance
* You want to make major changes without explaining your reasoning
* You use automated tools without understanding the underlying data
* You have no examples of Amazon work you personally performed

What I expect from the right person

I want someone who can eventually become my Amazon execution partner.

As the brand grows, this role can expand into:

* More products
* More PPC campaigns
* New product launches
* More sophisticated keyword research
* Listing testing
* Catalog management
* Competitor monitoring
* Amazon growth reporting

If you perform well, I am interested in a long-term relationship, not a one-time project.

To apply

Please answer these questions:

1. How many Amazon PPC accounts/campaigns have you personally managed?
2. How long have you worked with Amazon PPC?
3. What is your approach to optimizing a campaign that has clicks but no sales?
4. What is your approach to a listing with low CTR?
5. What is your approach to a listing with good CTR but poor conversion?
6. Give one example of a PPC optimization you personally made and what happened afterward.
7. Give one example of an Amazon listing you personally optimized.
8. Which Amazon PPC metrics do you review every week?
9. What tools do you use for keyword research?
10. What is your hourly rate?
11. How many hours per week can you commit?
12. Please include screenshots or examples of Amazon work you personally performed, with confidential information removed.

Start your proposal with the words “AFRICA UNITE” so I know you read the entire posting.

items.title: Manhattan Dentist Email Research—Delta Dental & ADA Directories
items.description:
I am seeking an experienced web researcher or data extraction specialist to compile a comprehensive, verified list of publicly displayed email addresses associated with Manhattan dental offices listed in:
•	Delta Dental’s provider directory
•	The American Dental Association’s ADA Find-a-Dentist directory
The project covers 34 ZIP codes and every available dental specialty in both directories, including all Delta Dental networks. I need systematic coverage of the entire scope, rather than a sample or a predetermined number of contacts.
Geographic Scope
Include offices physically located in these ZIP codes:
10001, 10002, 10003, 10004, 10005, 10006, 10007, 10009, 10010, 10011, 10012, 10013, 10014, 10016, 10017, 10018, 10019, 10020, 10021, 10022, 10023, 10024, 10025, 10028, 10029, 10036, 10038, 10044, 10065, 10069, 10075, 10128, 10280, 10282.
Search results may include nearby offices outside these ZIP codes. Verify each office’s actual address before including it.
Required Work
•	Search every listed ZIP code across every available specialty in each directory.
•	Include all Delta Dental networks; search ADA without restricting results to a particular insurer.
•	Review every available results page and relevant provider profile.
•	Identify and address search-result caps or other limitations that could leave eligible listings unreviewed.
•	Extract every publicly displayed email associated with an eligible office. Include multiple distinct emails for the same practice when available.
•	For ADA profiles with an “Email” feature, determine whether it exposes an actual email address or only a contact form. Contact forms do not count as email addresses.
•	Deduplicate emails without regard to capitalization, both within and across the two directories. Consolidate dentist names when several dentists share an email.
•	Compare the findings with my existing Excel master, which I will provide, and add only new addresses while preserving existing records.
•	Save progress regularly so interrupted work can resume without repeating completed research.
Do not guess email addresses, purchase contact lists, or substitute unrelated directories for the requested sources. Any proposed use of practice websites to supplement missing emails must be described separately in your proposal. Use methods that respect website access restrictions.
Deliverables
1.	Updated Excel master: Existing records plus newly discovered, unique email addresses.
2.	New additions worksheet: Dentist name(s), practice name, specialty, office address, ZIP code, email, directory source, source URL, and date verified.
3.	Microsoft Word document (.docx): All unique email addresses from the final updated Excel master, arranged in clearly labeled groups of 95 addresses each. Separate each address with a comma followed by a space. Place each group in a separate paragraph so it can be copied easily. The final group may contain fewer than 95 addresses. Include each address exactly once, omit names and other information from the email paragraphs, and show the number of addresses in each group and the total count.
4.	Separate coverage logs for Delta Dental and ADA: Each ZIP-by-specialty search, pages reviewed, completion status, and any unresolved limits or access restrictions.
5.	Completion report: Providers/offices reviewed, unique emails found, duplicates excluded, new emails added, and listings with no publicly available email. Show results separately for each directory and explain how overlapping records were counted.
Verify that the Word document contains exactly the same unique email addresses as the final Excel master, with no omissions or duplicates.
Completion means every specified search and accessible relevant profile has been reviewed. I recognize that some dentists do not publish an email address. Any remaining coverage gaps must be clearly documented.
Qualifications
Experience with provider-directory research, web data extraction, source verification, Excel deduplication, and Microsoft Word formatting. Manual research, automation, or a combination is acceptable.
Please Include in Your Proposal
•	Your method for achieving complete coverage of both directories.
•	How you will handle pagination, duplicate listings, result caps, and interruptions.
•	Confirmation that you have tested both directories, including how ADA’s “Email” feature works.
•	Your estimated turnaround time.
•	Separate fixed-price quotes for the Delta Dental and ADA portions, plus a combined project price that includes all deliverables.
•	A small sample from each directory for one listed ZIP code, with source evidence.
Please quote for completing the defined scope, rather than delivering a fixed number of emails. The project can be organized into two milestones—Delta Dental and ADA—with a final combined, deduplicated Excel workbook and the Microsoft Word document described above.

items.title: Registered Nurse Job Application Specialist – Ontario
items.description:
Hi,

I’m looking for someone to help manage nursing job applications in Ontario, primarily for RN opportunities in hospitals and long-term care homes.

Quality is very important to me. I’m not looking for someone to mass-apply or rush through a large number of applications. I would rather have fewer, high-quality applications where each job posting is properly reviewed and the resume is genuinely tailored to the specific position. Cover letters should also be customized when appropriate.

I would like the search to focus mainly on recent postings, ideally within 2–3 days of being posted. Applications should include hospital and long-term care career websites, Workday, Indeed, LinkedIn, and other relevant Ontario healthcare job sources.

I’m also looking for someone who can:

* Complete employer applications and screening questions accurately
* Ask me whenever a screening question requires information that hasn’t been provided rather than guessing
* Keep an organized tracking sheet of every application
* Provide proof that applications were submitted

Before moving forward, could you please tell me:

1. Have you previously handled RN or nursing applications in Ontario or Canada?
2. Which job boards and employer websites do you typically use for nursing positions?
3. How do you tailor the resume and cover letter for each individual job?
4. Approximately how much time do you normally spend on one application when doing this level of customization?
5. Are you comfortable applying directly through hospital career websites and ATS platforms such as Workday?
6. How do you provide proof and tracking of completed applications?
