items.title: Azure SQL + Python Data Pipeline Support (Part-Time, Ongoing, ~2–4 hrs/month)
items.description:
About us
We run an Azure SQL database (about 250 GB) that is loaded automatically with public financial and economic data. The sources include FRED, the NY Fed (Primary Dealer statistics, repo operations, reference rates), FINRA fixed-income data, the FDIC, and the Federal Reserve/FFIEC (Call Reports and FR Y-9C). The system is already built, working, and documented. We need a reliable person to keep it healthy and to handle occasional small changes.
How the system works
An Ubuntu 24.04 VM on Azure stays off most of the day. An Azure Automation Account starts it on a schedule four times a day. Cron then runs a central shell script, which runs the daily and weekly Python scripts (each set has its own virtual environment), writes logs, and shuts the VM down again. The scripts load data into Azure SQL Database. Two datasets, Call Reports and FR Y-9C, are downloaded by hand and loaded with Python scripts. The schema is documented table by table, and the previous developer will hand over access and answer questions.
What you'll do
•	Investigate and fix failed or incomplete data loads. This includes reading logs, fixing Python scripts when a source API or file format changes, and re-running loads.
•	Keep the VM, cron jobs, Azure Automation runbooks and schedules, and Python environments working.
•	Create views, indexes, and occasionally new tables when our analysts ask for them.
•	Keep an eye on database size (currently about 70% of capacity), performance, and Azure costs, and recommend changes when needed.
•	Manage user access, firewall rules, and basic security on the database.
•	Check that backups and recovery are in place.
•	From time to time, add a new data source or extend an existing pipeline.
Workload and expectations
•	Roughly 2–4 hours per month, billed hourly. Some months will be quiet, and some will have a bigger task.
•	When something breaks, we need a response within 48 hours at the latest. A same-day response is strongly preferred.
•	You must be available during US Eastern business hours.
•	This is a long-term relationship. We want someone we can rely on for years.
Required skills
•	SQL Server / Azure SQL Database: T-SQL, views, indexing, performance tuning, and user and permission management
•	Python for data pipelines: API calls, parsing JSON/CSV, loading data into SQL Server, and debugging existing code you didn't write
•	Linux administration (Ubuntu): bash, cron, virtual environments, reading logs
•	Azure: VMs, Automation Accounts and runbooks, SQL Database settings, firewall rules, and cost awareness
•	Clear written communication. After each fix, you should be able to explain briefly what broke and what you changed.
Nice to have
•	Experience with financial or economic data (FRED, Federal Reserve, FFIEC, FINRA)
•	Experience taking over an existing system from another developer
Budget
$70–100 per hour, depending on experience.
To apply, please include:
1.	A short description of a similar system you've supported: scheduled Python jobs loading data into SQL Server or Azure SQL.
2.	How you would investigate this scenario: "The 5 pm daily load didn't update one table, but the logs show no errors."
3.	Your usual response time for urgent issues, and your hours relative to US Eastern time.
4.	Your hourly rate.

items.title: White-Hat Link Building Specialist: Chicago Apartment & Relocation Niche
items.description:
Here's a description you can paste straight into Upwork:

---

**About Dibze**

Dibze (dibze.com) is a Chicago apartment locating service focused on the city's downtown neighborhoods, including River North, West Loop, Streeterville, Gold Coast, South Loop, and The Loop. We built our own real-time listings platform, so renters see apartments that are actually available, with accurate pricing.

The site is technically strong and has 70+ in-depth articles on Chicago neighborhoods, rent prices, neighborhood comparisons, and relocating to Chicago. What we need now is authority: real links from real sites.

**What you'll do**

- Find relevant sites and pitch them for editorial links to Dibze, using white-hat methods such as broken-link replacement, resource page outreach, local partnerships, and journalist or blogger outreach.
- Send me each target site for approval before you reach out.
- Track your outreach and placed links in a shared spreadsheet.
- Deliver 4–6 quality links per month to start, with room to grow.

**Sites we want links from**

- Chicago-focused sites: local blogs, neighborhood publications, community organizations, and city guides.
- Real estate, renting, relocation, and moving sites.
- Lifestyle and career sites whose audience includes people moving to or within Chicago.

**Every link must meet these standards**

- The site has real organic traffic. Show it in Ahrefs or Semrush, not just DR.
- The link sits inside a relevant article's body text, not a footer, sidebar, author bio, or "partners" page.
- The site does not openly sell links and isn't full of unrelated outbound links (casino, CBD, loans, etc.).
- Anchor text is natural: mostly our brand name, our URL, or descriptive phrases. No repeated exact-match keywords.
- Links point to the pages I specify, mainly our neighborhood guides and market data pages.
- Each link is from a new domain that hasn't linked to us before.

**What I'm not looking for**

No private blog networks, link farms, link exchanges, "DR 70 guest post" price lists, bulk packages, directory blasts, or anything that violates Google's spam policies. If your method is buying placements from a list of sites, this job isn't a fit.

**Payment**

- Pay per live link that meets the standards above, from $150 to $350 per link depending on the site's quality and relevance. We'll agree on the rate for each site before outreach.
- Links must stay live for at least 90 days. If one is removed, it gets replaced.
- We'll start with a paid trial of 2–3 links. If it goes well, this becomes an ongoing monthly engagement.

**To apply, please include:**

1. 5–10 live links you've personally built in the past 12 months, with the page URL where each appears.
2. Any experience with local businesses, real estate, or relocation brands.
3. A short explanation of your outreach process: how you find sites and how you pitch them.
4. Two or three Chicago or real estate sites you think would be good targets for Dibze, and why.

Start your proposal with the word "Lakefront" so I know you read this.

---

The last line filters out copy-paste and AI-generated bulk proposals, which is a common Upwork problem. If you'd rather offer a monthly retainer instead of paying per link, I can adjust the payment section.

We're NexusCai, an AI B2B SaaS company. We build AI phone receptionists, AI agents, CRMs, automations and some custom apps for real businesses. Right now our main focus is Voice AI: AI that answers the phone, qualifies callers and books appointments so our clients stop missing calls and losing leads.

We're growing fast. I'm the founder. I sell and set the direction. What I need now is an experienced operator who turns plans into finished work and pushes things over the line.

The role

As Head of Operations, you're my right hand. I tell you where we're going. You build the plan, organize the systems, assign the owners, set the deadlines, and make sure it gets done, quickly and properly. You hold the team accountable, and you keep me updated without my having to ask.

What you'll own

Execution: take a plan and get it implemented fast. Projects don't sit; they get finished.

items.title: PR Specialist Needed — HVAC / Home Services | National Media & Major Publications
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Public Relations specialist with strong media relationships in the HVAC, home services, energy, real estate, business, or consumer services industries**.

We are working with an established heating and air conditioning company that is looking to significantly expand its media exposure and position its leadership as an industry authority.

### What We're Looking For

We need someone who can develop strong PR angles and **actively pitch journalists, editors, producers, and contributors** at major media outlets.

Our goal is to pursue coverage in high-authority national and business publications, including outlets such as:

- Bloomberg
- Forbes
- Business Insider
- CNBC
- Entrepreneur
- Inc.
- USA Today
- Major regional newspapers and business publications
- HVAC, energy, real estate, and home-services trade publications

We understand that legitimate PR cannot guarantee placement in a specific publication. We are looking for someone who has the **relationships, experience, strategy, and pitching ability to realistically pursue this level of coverage.**

### Responsibilities

You may be responsible for:

- Developing newsworthy PR angles for an HVAC/home-services company
- Positioning the owner/executives as expert sources
- Creating and executing media-pitching campaigns
- Identifying relevant journalists and editors
- Direct outreach and follow-up with media contacts
- Securing interviews, expert commentary, features, and contributed opportunities
- Identifying breaking-news opportunities where our client can provide expert commentary
- Building relationships with national, regional, and trade media
- Advising us on what stories and data we need to create to attract major media attention

### IMPORTANT — Please Provide Proof of Results

We are **not looking for someone whose primary strategy is distributing press releases.**

When applying, please provide:

1. Examples of media coverage you personally helped secure.
2. Links to your strongest national or major-market placements.
3. Any experience with HVAC, home services, energy, construction, real estate, or related industries.
4. Examples of business/financial media placements, especially Bloomberg, Forbes, CNBC, Business Insider, WSJ, Fortune, Fast Company, or comparable publications.
5. A brief explanation of how you would approach PR for an HVAC company.
6. Whether you already have journalist relationships relevant to this campaign.

Please clearly distinguish between **earned media you secured through pitching** and paid/sponsored placements.

### Potential Long-Term Opportunity

This would begin with one client, but we are a marketing agency with an existing client base. If the relationship is successful, there is potential for additional PR accounts and ongoing work.

We are looking for someone we can work with long term — not simply a one-time press-release service.

When applying, please start your proposal with the words **“HVAC PR”** so we know you read the full posting.

items.title: Real-world tester in the Netherlands or Belgium: two short street parking sessions with a new app
items.description:
We are Parkwide, a new way to pay for street parking. Before we open it to the public, we want ordinary people, not professional testers, to use it in real life and tell us what happened.

The job: in October, in a Dutch or Belgian city where Parkwide is available (we check your city when you apply), you pay for public on-street parking twice through Parkwide, at two different locations. The two sessions take place on the same day, at least two hours apart. The second session may take place the following day if agreed with us in advance.
We will agree the exact day with each selected tester and confirm it after our final technical check.

Session 1 runs entirely in WhatsApp. Please do not install our app before this session; we will send you the app link afterwards.

Session 2 runs in our app. Before you park, you photograph the parking sign and let the app explain it. Compare the explanation with the actual sign and tell us whether it was correct; do not rely on it without checking. During session 2 you also extend the parking once by the smallest amount offered.

Each session lasts at least 15 minutes, or longer if the location has a higher minimum. You fill in a five-minute form after each session and join a 5 to 10 minute video call the week after.

You do not need to bring or park a car.

YOU NEED:

- To be in the Netherlands or Belgium on your test day.
- A phone with WhatsApp. WhatsApp is required.
- Your own bank card, because you pay for the parking yourself.
- The license plate of a car you own or have permission to use.

Payment: a fixed price of $75 when you complete both sessions, both forms and the video call. The parking charges, up to EUR 10 per session and EUR 20 in total, are refunded manually to the same card. The refund may take up to five business days to appear. Only parking completed through Parkwide according to our instructions is refunded. If something in the service does not work and you report it properly, that still counts as completing.

We are looking for visitors, non-residents and recent arrivals who are not familiar with Dutch or Belgian parking. Long-term residents are welcome to apply and may be selected as reserves. This test is not for professional QA testers.

items.title: Full-Cycle Sales Rep for Agency | Commission-Based
items.description:
About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Full-Cycle Sales Representative to help grow our agency.

This is not a lead-generation-only role. We’re looking for someone who can own the sales process from prospecting to close.

What you’ll do:
- Identify and research qualified prospects that fit our ideal client profile
- Conduct outbound prospecting through channels you believe will be most effective
- Start conversations and qualify potential clients
- Conduct sales calls and present our services confidently
- Follow up consistently with prospects
- Handle objections and move opportunities through the pipeline
- Close new clients
- Keep the pipeline organized and provide visibility into outreach, conversations, and results

Compensation
This is primarily a performance-based opportunity. 

For every new client you successfully close, you will receive 100% of that client’s first monthly payment.

There will also be an initial setup payment for getting started together. We can discuss the details with shortlisted candidates.

Our goal is to build a long-term relationship with the right salesperson, not simply hire someone for a one-time project. As the agency and sales operation grow, there is potential for the role and compensation structure to evolve as well.

Who we’re looking for
You should have previous experience in B2B sales, ideally selling services, agency services, outsourcing, staffing, or similar solutions. 

You should be comfortable prospecting independently, speaking with decision-makers, conducting sales calls, following up, and closing.

We already have our services, positioning, website, and target client profile in place. We’re looking for someone who can take that foundation and turn it into conversations and clients.

When applying, please tell us:
1. What have you sold before?
2. Have you managed the full sales cycle yourself, from finding the prospect through closing?
3. What outbound channels would you use for a business like ours?
4. What results have you achieved in previous sales roles?
5. Are you comfortable with a compensation model where you receive 100% of the first monthly payment from every client you bring in and close?

items.title: Growth & Monetization Strategist — Coaching / Expert-Led Brand
items.description:
Project ManagHer is seeking an aggressive Growth & Monetization Strategist to help scale an established project-management career education and personal brand into a stronger revenue-generating business.

We already have an active content operation, growing organic social presence, established services, educational IP, client/student proof, and team members supporting social media, video editing and content production.

Our next priority is monetization.

We are looking for someone who has successfully helped coaches, consultants, educators, creators, or expert-led personal brands turn audience attention into qualified leads and consistent sales.

This is not a social media management position. We need someone who can look across the business and determine what should happen between someone discovering the brand and becoming a paying customer.

Responsibilities include:

Audit our current audience, offers, positioning, content-to-sale journey and existing sales/marketing activity
Identify where potential customers are dropping out of the journey
Evaluate and strengthen our offer suite, messaging, pricing/packaging and customer pathways where needed
Develop strategies for converting organic social attention into leads and customers
Determine the appropriate role of lead magnets, email, CRM, DMs, consultations, workshops, webinars, launches, evergreen funnels and paid advertising
Establish conversion KPIs and use data to determine what's working
Design and oversee monetization experiments
Give clear strategic direction to existing execution team members rather than duplicating their roles
Build an actionable 90-day growth and revenue roadmap and continue optimizing it based on results

Ideal candidate:

Has measurable experience growing revenue for coaching, consulting, education, creator or expert-led businesses
Understands both personal-brand marketing and conversion
Can work with a founder-led brand where personality, lifestyle, expertise and values are all part of the brand—not strip it down into generic “coach marketing”
Understands organic content funnels, email/CRM, sales funnels and paid acquisition
Is highly analytical but also commercially creative
Can distinguish content designed for reach from content designed for trust, demand and conversion
Is comfortable directing specialists and working within an existing team

Please include 2–3 relevant case studies showing:

Starting situation
What you changed
Size/type of audience
Leads or sales generated
Revenue or conversion improvement where available
Your personal role in achieving the result

Engagement: We are initially considering a 3-month engagement with the potential for an ongoing relationship based on performance.

items.title: Cinematic / Comedy Video Advert for UK Virtual Office Business
items.description:
I am looking for a talented video creator/editor to produce a high-quality 20–30 second social media advert for Thames House, a UK virtual office and workspace business.

This is not intended to look like a typical Canva-style corporate advert.

I want something that feels like a mini cinematic scene or streaming-series trailer: strong storytelling, dry British humour, professional cinematography, excellent sound design and a polished commercial finish.

The advert will primarily be used on Instagram/Facebook Reels and paid social advertising.

THE CONCEPT

The advert highlights one of the genuine problems with using your home address as your business address.

Opening scene:

A smart but ordinary suburban UK home.

Sunday morning.

A small-business owner answers the front door wearing a dressing gown.

Standing outside is a serious-looking potential customer/client holding a folder or paperwork.

Customer:

“Morning. I’m here for Johnson Consulting.”

The business owner hesitates.

Business owner:

“Yeah… that’s me.”

The customer looks past him into the house.

We hear/see normal family chaos in the background — child running through the hallway, breakfast happening, perhaps a dog barking.

From upstairs his partner shouts:

“WHO IS IT?!”

The business owner awkwardly tries to close the door slightly.

Customer:

“Google says this is your head office.”

Pause.

The owner looks down at his dressing gown.

CUT TO BLACK.

Large cinematic typography:

STOP USING YOUR HOME ADDRESS FOR BUSINESS.

Music changes and the advert transitions from comedy into a premium commercial.

We reveal Thames House.

Cinematic shots of the building/entrance/business environment and professional mail handling.

On-screen messaging:

THAMES HOUSE

Professional Business Address

Langley • Elizabeth Line • Near Heathrow

From £29 + VAT / month

Potential closing line:

YOUR BUSINESS DESERVES ITS OWN ADDRESS.

Website:

thames-house.co.uk

STYLE

The opening should feel like a scene from a professionally produced British comedy/drama rather than an obvious advertisement.

Natural acting, cinematic lighting, realistic UK house, subtle humour and believable dialogue.

Once Thames House is revealed, the visual style should change into something much more premium and aspirational.

I particularly want attention paid to:

* Cinematic camera movement and framing
* Realistic AI characters/acting if AI generation is used
* Natural UK/British voices
* Excellent sound design
* Music that builds after the Thames House reveal
* Professional typography
* Colour grading
* Pacing and comedic timing
* A strong first 2–3 seconds to stop people scrolling

Please avoid generic corporate stock-video aesthetics.

AI / PRODUCTION

I am open to this being created using a combination of:

AI video generation (Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway, Higgsfield, etc.), real Thames House footage/photos that I can provide, stock footage where appropriate, traditional editing, AI voice generation and professional sound design.

I care more about the quality and realism of the finished advert than which tools are used.

I can provide photographs/video of Thames House, branding/logo, website details and any additional information required.

FORMAT

Primary version:

9:16 vertical
Instagram/Facebook Reels & Stories
Approximately 20–30 seconds
1080 × 1920 minimum

I would also like the project structured so that alternative hooks, wording or endings could potentially be tested later.

IMPORTANT

Please do not send a generic proposal.

When applying, please:

1. Send examples of your best cinematic/commercial video work.
2. Tell me how you would produce the opening doorstep scene.
3. Tell me which AI/video tools you would use, if applicable.
4. Explain briefly how you would make the characters, voices and environment feel genuinely British rather than generic AI.
5. Give me your estimated turnaround time.
6. Confirm whether revisions are included.

If you have previously created cinematic AI commercials, comedy adverts or performance marketing creatives, please put those examples at the top of your application.

There is potential for ongoing work.

If the first advert performs well, I intend to create several adverts around different problems experienced by people running businesses from home, using Thames House as the solution.

items.title: US English Audio Annotators | US-based | AI Project
items.description:
Location: United States
Locale: en-US
Initial Pilot: 2,000 turns
Expected Commitment: Approximately 2.5 hours of production work per day

We are launching a pilot project for a large-scale U.S. English audio evaluation program and are looking for reliable, detail-oriented freelancers to join our annotation team.

The pilot consists of 2,000 turns, with three evaluation passes required for each turn. Each approved pass is paid at $0.60 USD.

Following the successful completion of the pilot, the overall project is expected to scale to approximately 500,000 turns, creating an opportunity for consistent, longer-term work for high-performing contributors.

What You’ll Do

As an Audio Annotator, you will listen to recordings of user-agent interactions and evaluate the quality of the agent’s spoken responses across two key dimensions:

1. Content

You will assess whether the agent’s response is:

Helpful
Accurate
Relevant to the user’s request
Appropriate to the context

2. Prosody

You will evaluate how naturally the agent communicates, including:

Naturalness of delivery
Pacing
Intonation and overall flow
Human-like quality of the voice

Your evaluations will contribute to the development and improvement of AI-powered conversational and voice experiences.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for individuals who:

Are currently based in the United States
Have lived in the relevant U.S. English locale for at least 5 years
Have excellent English listening and comprehension skills
Can accurately understand and evaluate spoken English
Are comfortable working with audio recordings and detailed evaluation guidelines
Have strong attention to detail and can maintain consistent ratings
Can work independently and meet project quality standards
Can commit to approximately 2.5 hours of production work per day
Time Commitment

The expected production commitment is approximately 2.5 hours per day.

The initial estimated AHT (Average Handling Time) is approximately 5 minutes per evaluation. As you become familiar with the workflow, guidelines, and annotation tool, we expect the average handling time to decrease to approximately 3 minutes or less.

Payment
$0.60 USD per approved evaluation pass
Each turn requires three passes
Payments are based on approved work
The pilot includes 2,000 turns
The broader project is expected to scale to approximately 500,000 turns
Why Join?

This is an opportunity to contribute to a large-scale AI voice and conversational quality project while building experience in audio evaluation and AI data annotation.

Freelancers who demonstrate high-quality, consistent work during the pilot may have the opportunity to continue with the project as it scales.

If you have strong U.S. English listening skills, excellent attention to detail, and enjoy evaluating how naturally people—and AI—communicate, we’d love to hear from you!

items.title: Business Development Executive – U.S. B2B Outsourcing
items.description:
## Fractional Business Development Executive – U.S. BPO/Outsourcing Sales

We are looking for an experienced **Business Development Executive** to help build and advance a U.S.-focused sales pipeline for outsourcing services.

This is a **fractional independent contractor position for an initial 90 days**, with a **$2,000 monthly retainer plus up to $500 per month in performance-based compensation**.

### What You’ll Do

- Develop and execute a focused U.S. prospecting plan across approved target industries and buyer profiles.
- Identify and research target organizations, decision-makers, and potential outsourcing opportunities.
- Conduct consistent outreach through telephone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, networking, and direct engagement.
- Introduce our outsourcing capabilities and communicate the value proposition accurately to prospective clients.
- Qualify prospects based on their operational needs, challenges, decision-making process, budget, timing, and readiness to outsource.
- Identify opportunities for dedicated teams, managed services, staff augmentation, overflow capacity, and other outsourcing models.
- Secure discovery and presentation meetings with qualified prospects.
- Coordinate with management and the delivery team throughout the sales process.
- Support proposal preparation, presentations, and consistent follow-up.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, including activities, next steps, pipeline value, probability, and expected timing.
- Build relationships with industry organizations, channel partners, and referral sources.
- Provide concise weekly pipeline and performance reports.
- Work toward agreed targets for meetings, opportunities, proposals, contracts, seats, and recurring revenue.

### Target Markets

The primary focus will be on U.S. organizations in areas such as:

- Medical coding, billing, and revenue cycle management
- Healthcare contact centers and practice support
- Insurance claims processing and administration
- Contact center customer experience and enterprise BPO
- Accounts receivable and revenue recovery support

### What We’re Looking For

- Proven experience in **U.S. B2B sales or business development**
- Experience selling **BPO, outsourcing, healthcare services, contact center, staffing, technology, or professional services** is highly relevant.
- Strong prospecting and cold outreach skills
- Ability to identify and engage decision-makers
- Experience building and managing a sales pipeline
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Comfortable working independently and managing outreach activity
- Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate sales records
- Ability to understand client needs and identify suitable outsourcing opportunities

### How We’ll Work

You will be responsible for **originating, qualifying, and advancing sales opportunities**. Management will handle commercial strategy, pricing, negotiations, and contracting, while the delivery team will support solution design, staffing, and operations.

We value consistent communication, accurate reporting, disciplined follow-up, and measurable progress.

**Engagement:** Fractional Independent Contractor 
**Initial Term:** 90 days 
**Compensation:** $2,000/month retainer + up to $500/month performance-based compensation 
**Market:** United States 
**Work Arrangement:** Remote

items.title: Argentine attorney: legal opinion on recycling coins bought at BCRA auctions and metal export
items.description:
We are a US company evaluating a metal-recycling project in Argentina. The Banco Central de la República Argentina has sold legal-tender coins by public auction (through Banco Ciudad) on condition that the buyer deforms them under BCRA supervision. Before taking part in any such auction, we need a written legal opinion from an attorney admitted in Argentina.

Please cover, citing the statute and article for each point:
1. What Argentine law says about deforming, melting or otherwise destroying coins, distinguishing current legal tender, withdrawn coins, and coins acquired from the BCRA under auction conditions.
2. Who holds title to coins bought at a BCRA auction, and any limits the auction conditions place on their later use or sale.
3. Whether a foreign company may register and bid, and what registration, tax identification (CUIT or CDI) and anti-money-laundering obligations apply to the buyer.
4. Export of the resulting copper and nickel alloy scrap: current permissions, registration, duties, and any remaining restriction after Decreto 1/2025.
5. Tax treatment of the purchase and of the sale of the scrap.
6. Any environmental or industrial permits needed to deform or process the coins in Argentina.

To apply, include: your matrícula (bar association and registration details); one comparable matter you can describe without breaching confidentiality (central-bank, customs, export of metals, or regulatory opinions); your fixed fee for this opinion. If this is outside your practice, please say so plainly; a referral is more useful to us than a broad proposal.

All communication stays on Upwork.

items.title: Deutschsprachiger B2B Cold Caller (Terminvereinbarung) auf Provisionsbasis

Wir sind Inamclean Gebäudeservice aus Marl (NRW) und suchen einen deutschsprachigen Cold Caller für die B2B-Terminvereinbarung.

- Gewerbliche Kontakte anrufen (Kitas, Praxen, Büros, Hausverwaltungen) und Gespräche für ein Angebot zur Gebäudereinigung vereinbaren
- Unsere Leadlisten und unser Gesprächsleitfaden werden gestellt

- Deutsch fließend (mindestens C1), freundlich und souverän am Telefon

- Eigene Ausstattung (PC, Headset, stabiles Internet)
- Zuverlässig und selbstständig

- Provision pro qualifiziertem Termin: 10% vom Gewinn
- Keine feste Arbeitszeit, du arbeitest als selbstständiger Dienstleister und teilst dir deine Zeit selbst ein

WICHTIG
- Es werden ausschließlich Gewerbetreibende angerufen, keine Privatpersonen
- Bitte nenne in deiner Bewerbung deine Erfahrung und einen kurzen Sprachbeispiel-Satz auf Deutsch
- Start mit einer 1-wöchigen Testphase, bei guten Ergebnissen langfristige Zusammenarbeit

items.title: Project Manager – Mechanical Engineering
items.description:
About the Role

I am seeking an experienced Engineering Project Manager to lead the day-to-day execution of mechanical engineering projects.

This role combines engineering project management, mechanical design coordination, team management, and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate can bridge technical engineering requirements with project execution and keep projects moving from requirements through design, review, manufacturing, and delivery.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan and schedule engineering projects, including new product development and design revisions.
- Break projects into clear tasks, milestones, timelines, and deliverables.
- Manage the day-to-day workload and priorities of the Mechanical Engineering team.
- Track project progress, blockers, scope changes, timelines, and budget.
- Translate customer requirements into engineering specifications and realistic delivery timelines.
- Coordinate with Quality and manufacturing partners regarding drawings, specifications, revisions, and manufacturability.
- Review SolidWorks models, engineering drawings, and BOMs for accuracy and potential issues.
- Identify design and manufacturability concerns before designs reach suppliers or customers.
- Maintain engineering documentation, specifications, drawings, and revision history.
- Ensure engineering projects follow established product development processes.
- Report project status, risks, blockers, and timelines to leadership.
- Step in and assist with design work when the engineering team needs additional support.
Qualifications
- Experience managing engineering or technical projects.
- Experience in manufacturing, industrial equipment, hardware, or a similar engineering environment.
- Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles.
- Ability to read, review, and provide meaningful feedback on SolidWorks models and drawings.
- Ability to identify potential manufacturability and design issues.
- Experience with project-management platforms such as Monday.com, ClickUp, Slack, or similar tools.
- Strong organizational and communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple engineering projects and competing priorities.
- Ability to work independently in a growing organization.
- Willingness to take a hands-on approach and assist with design work when needed.
Preferred Experience
- Experience working with overseas manufacturing partners.
- Industrial equipment engineering experience.
- Experience coordinating engineering revisions with contract manufacturers.
- Experience with product development and DFM processes.
SolidWorks Portfolio Required
Because this position requires reviewing and providing feedback on SolidWorks models and drawings, please include examples of your SolidWorks work with your application.
You may provide:
- SolidWorks part models
- Assemblies
- Engineering drawings
- Manufacturing drawings
- BOMs
- Sheet-metal designs
- Weldments
- Mechanical equipment designs
- Screenshots or PDF examples of completed work

Please remove or redact any confidential, proprietary, or client-sensitive information before submitting samples.

For each sample, briefly explain your role in creating or reviewing the design and what the project involved.

How to Apply

Please include:
1. A brief summary of your engineering project management experience.
2. Your experience managing mechanical engineering teams.
3. Your level of SolidWorks experience.
4. Your experience with manufacturing or overseas suppliers.
5. The project-management tools you have used.
6. At least 1–3 examples of SolidWorks work, with confidential information removed.
7. A brief explanation of one design or manufacturability issue you identified and how you helped resolve it.

We are looking for someone who can manage the work, understand the engineering, identify problems early, and keep projects moving through execution.

items.title: Meta Ads Specialist / Media Buyer : Event Marketing & Ticket Sales (Per-Project/ Retainer Potential)
items.description:
We're seeking a highly skilled Meta Ads Specialist (Facebook & Instagram) with a proven track record of filling live, virtual, and hybrid events using paid ad campaigns.

This is a per-project role with significant potential for ongoing, recurring monthly work for the right candidate as we scale our event calendar. You will be responsible for creating, launching, optimizing, and scaling Meta ad campaigns designed specifically to drive event registrations, application submissions, and ticket sales for our clients.

Key Responsibilities:
Campaign Strategy & Setup: Build end-to-end Meta ad campaigns (lead generation, conversion, custom landing page funnels) tailored to event lead times and deadlines.

Audience Targeting & Retargeting: Develop hyper-targeted audience segments, custom lookalikes, and multi-stage retargeting funnels to convert high-intent prospects before event registration deadlines.

Ad Creative & Copy Guidance: Provide strategic direction or write/create compelling ad copy and creative direction (video hooks, static graphics, UGC angles) designed to maximize CTR and conversions.

Optimization & Budget Allocation: Actively manage daily budgets, bid strategies, and placement optimizations to achieve the lowest possible Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) / Cost Per Lead (CPL).

Tracking & Analytics: Ensure clean tracking setup (Meta Pixel, Conversions API / CAPI, custom conversion events, UTM parameters).

Reporting & Performance Insights: Provide clear, data-driven updates and post-campaign performance breakdowns with actionable recommendations for future events.

Requirements & Qualifications:
Proven Event Marketing Experience: Specific expertise running Meta ad campaigns for live, virtual, or hybrid events (workshops, summits, masterclasses, ticketed gatherings, etc.).

Case Studies Required: Ability to share verified past campaign results, case studies, or portfolio examples demonstrating clear ROI, ROAS, or low CPLs for events.

Full-Funnel Mastery: Deep understanding of Meta’s current ad algorithm, Conversions API (CAPI), Advantage+ campaigns, lead generation forms vs. custom funnel pages, and retargeting logic.

Copywriting / Creative Strategy: Strong grasp of high-converting direct-response ad copy and visual hooks specific to event urgency.

Communication & Reliability: Excellent communication skills, proactive updates, and ability to work efficiently under tight event launch schedules.

Project Scope & Structure:
Contract Type: Per Project (Fixed-Price or Hourly per campaign) with potential to transition into a monthly retainer.

Immediate Need: Launching campaigns for upcoming client events.

How to Apply:
When submitting your proposal, please include:

Case Studies / Examples: 1–3 specific examples or case studies of Meta ad campaigns you ran for events (include context on event type, spend, CPL/CPA, and key outcomes).

Your Approach: A brief 2–3 sentence overview of your strategy for filling an event on short notice (e.g., 2–4 week lead time).

Rates: Your typical rate structure (per campaign, hourly, or monthly retainer options).

items.title: Android Developer Needed for Expat Utility App – Kotlin, APIs & Firebase
items.description:
We are building Everyday Expat, a premium Android utility app for Bangladeshi expatriates.

IMPORTANT: This is a real product project, not a quick demo or low-quality prototype. Quality, clean architecture, stability, and maintainable code are more important than rushing.

We already have completed UI/UX and product architecture from the previous design phase. The selected developer will receive the existing Figma/design and project materials and must follow the approved product direction.

V1 focuses on these core features:

1. Live Currency / Bank Rates
2. Gold & Silver Rates
3. Prayer Times + Qibla + Azan foundation
4. Supermarket Deals / Flyer section

Target countries for V1:
Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Malaysia.

The app should be designed so country-specific content can be switched based on the user's selected/detected country.

CORE TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Native Android development using Kotlin
• Clean and maintainable Android architecture
• Proper API integration
• Firebase integration where required
• Loading, empty, error, and network-failure states
• Basic local caching/offline handling where appropriate
• Location/country detection or country-selection logic
• Bengali, English, and Arabic RTL support for the core screens
• Responsive UI following the provided Figma design
• Good performance and no unnecessary battery/memory usage
• Proper handling of API failures and unavailable data
• Code should be structured so future features can be added without rebuilding the app from scratch
• Release-ready Android project/AAB build and complete source-code handover

AUTOMATION:

Where a reliable API/feed/data source is available, the app should retrieve and update data automatically rather than requiring hardcoded values.

However, please do NOT promise impossible automation. Third-party API subscriptions, data-provider costs, supermarket data licenses/feeds, and external service charges are not assumed to be included in the $300 development budget unless explicitly agreed.

BUDGET & SCOPE:

Maximum developer budget: $300 fixed price.

We understand that the complete long-term product is larger than a $300 contract. Therefore, this contract is specifically for the agreed V1/core Android implementation and foundation.

We prefer a smaller number of features implemented properly rather than many features implemented poorly.

The project will be divided into milestones. Payment will be released only after the corresponding milestone is delivered and reviewed.

QUALITY REQUIREMENTS:

• Do not use copied/template code without disclosure.
• Do not hardcode live data where an agreed API/data source is required.
• Do not remove or simplify required functionality without discussing it first.
• Do not claim that features are complete when they are only mock

items.title: InDesign Automation Expert – Database-Driven 200-Page Directory of Services
items.description:
We are seeking an expert Adobe InDesign specialist with strong database-publishing and automation experience to build a 200-page Directory of Services and Price Guide.

The directory consists of dense tables containing test names, codes, pricing, and turnaround times. This data must be imported and dynamically mapped from a CSV spreadsheet. We cannot accept manual copy-pasting due to the scale and the high risk of human error.

The ideal freelancer will design a premium, modern corporate layout template and then use automated data workflows to populate the pages.

Note: The visual aesthetic must match a high-end, clean medical/veterinary diagnostics directory. To protect proprietary information, we will share a reference sample of our layout style privately with shortlisted candidates.

🛠️ Key Responsibilities
Template Design: Create a beautiful, premium corporate catalog template in Adobe InDesign utilizing Master Pages, baseline grids, and robust paragraph/character/table styles.

Data Automation Setup: Configure Adobe InDesign Data Merge, EasyCatalog, or a structured XML/XML-to-Table import pipeline to cleanly map our master CSV/Excel file directly into the designed layouts.

Complex Table Formatting: Ensure the automated import cleanly handles column wrapping, zebra-striping, nested table styles, and varying text lengths without breaking the layout.

Editorial Integration: Seamlessly integrate static editorial pages, visual section dividers, and marketing spreads between the automated data-driven pages.

Quality Assurance & Hand-off: Package the fully dynamic InDesign files, templates, and link assets so we can easily run updates or re-import future CSV data cycles ourselves.

🎯 Required Skills & Experience
🚀 Proven expertise in Adobe InDesign Data Automation (Data Merge, EasyCatalog, or XML import) is absolutely mandatory.

Expert-level understanding of advanced InDesign features (Nested Styles, GREP styles, Keep Options, and running headers).

Experience handling large-scale publication projects (100+ pages of data-heavy layouts).

Exceptional eye for clean corporate typography, margins, and grid-aligned structures.

High attention to detail to ensure zero data misalignment or truncation during the automation process.

📦 Project Scope & Deliverables
Volume: ~200 pages of automated tables interspersed with designed editorial divider pages.

Source Input: Master CSV/Excel file containing test codes, categories, names, and pricing.

Deliverables: Fully functioning automated InDesign Template package (INDD/INDT), a print-ready PDF, and an interactive digital PDF.

items.title: Personal/Executive Assistant Support
items.description:
I'm a busy professional, my spouse has ADHD and I need to manage most of the household, while working full time. I'm looking for a long-term personal assistant to act as my external executive function partner. The job is less about executing tasks I hand you and more about noticing what needs to happen and making sure nothing falls off the radar.

What you'll own:

Calendar management and a weekly written briefing (what's coming, what's at risk, what needs my decision)
Email and message triage, drafting routine replies, and flagging what needs me
Follow-through on my task list (Todoist): chasing open items and surfacing what's slipping
Household and family logistics: grocery ordering, recurring cleaner scheduling, babysitters and date nights, and scheduling home repairs, car, medical, and pet appointments
Occasional phone calls to US offices to schedule appointments and handle customer service
Day-to-day budget tracking and a monthly spending summary
Light accountability nudges on rest, exercise, and screen time

What I need from you

Proactive by default: you tell me what I'm missing before I ask
Excellent written English and clear spoken English for US phone calls
Strict confidentiality (you'll see sensitive information)
Comfort with Google Workspace, Todoist, Slack, and a password manager
One fixed weekly call window (1 hour, between 8 and 11am US Central) plus a weekly 30-60 min check-in with me. Otherwise async.

Details: Hourly contract, 6-8 hrs/week (up to 10 during the first month of setup). 90-day initial engagement with room to grow. A one-page role overview is attached.

To apply, answer these:

items.title: Follow-Up Rep Wanted: Turn Warm Leads Into Closed Deals (Remote, Part-Time, Commission Bonuses)
items.description:
Do you love the chase of a follow-up call? Do you get a rush when a "maybe" turns into a "yes"? We need someone who lives for the close.

We're a fast-moving acquisitions team, and we have a problem you can solve: leads who almost said yes. Every month, dozens of promising sellers slip through the cracks — not because they said no, but because nobody followed up at the right time, with the right approach. That's where you come in.
This isn't a script-reading, box-checking VA role. This is a real sales seat with real earning upside, and a real path to grow into an Acquisition Manager role with significantly higher pay.

What You'll Actually Be Doing
You'll own our warm-lead pipeline. Your job: re-engage sellers who didn't close the first time, qualify them, and hand off gold to our Acquisition Managers.
Make 50+ outbound calls a day to inbound leads who need a nudge
Qualify and "pass off" at least 1 solid lead per day
Build enough rapport and trust that sellers stay engaged until they're ready
Keep the CRM spotless — notes, stages, due dates, all current
Show up to 3 short team huddles a week, know your numbers cold
What Winning Looks Like
1 qualified "pass off" lead per day
1 qualified lead per week goes under contract
You're a driver of $30,000+ in new monthly gross profit for the business
Your CRM and admin trail are clean enough that anyone could pick up where you left off
The Schedule
Part-time, 20+ hours/week, remote
Calling window: 1 PM–6 PM MST (peak seller availability)
WhatsApp availability: 10 AM–6 PM PST daily
Huddles: Mon/Wed/Fri at 9:30 AM MST
You set your own hours around these anchors — this is flexibility with accountability, not a 9-to-5
Pay
$6.50/ HR USD/month base
+ $200 USD bonus per closed deal, paid 3 business days after funds are received
Top performers who consistently qualify and close will see this add up fast — and this role is the on-ramp to our Acquisition Manager track, where earning potential jumps significantly
Who Thrives Here
You build rapport fast — you don't need to be loud, just genuine
You keep your word. You only qualify people who actually fit, because you know that protects the whole pipeline
You want a win-win outcome, not just a number on a board
You're hungry, coachable, and you track your own numbers without being chased
You stay calm when a conversation gets tense — sellers are often navigating a big decision
Where This Leads
This role is a launchpad, not a ceiling. Follow-up Reps who master the CRM, consistently hit KPIs, and start shadowing negotiations move into our Jr. Acquisition Manager track — with materially higher earning potential. If you want to grow into closing deals yourself, this is exactly where that path starts.

We're looking for someone who can start soon and is serious about hitting numbers from week one.

items.title: Video Editor - AI Tools Expert - Bilingual (English/Spanish) - Remote
items.description:
Project Description
We're a residential mortgage lending company based in Miami, FL, looking for a skilled Video Editor who works fluently with AI-powered editing tools to help us produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently for our YouTube channel and social media presence. This is an ongoing, fully remote role.

Scope of Work

Edit long-form and short-form video content using a combination of traditional editing skills and AI-powered tools
Use generative AI tools for backgrounds, B-roll enhancement, auto-captioning, and content repurposing (e.g., turning long videos into short clips)
Apply AI-assisted color grading, audio cleanup, and pacing optimization to speed up turnaround without sacrificing quality
Create motion graphics, intros/outros, and lower thirds, leveraging AI tools where they improve speed and consistency
Repurpose long-form content into vertical/short-form clips (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) using AI-assisted workflows
Stay current on new AI video tools and proactively suggest ways to improve our content pipeline

Requirements

Strong, demonstrable experience using AI video editing tools (e.g., Runway, Topaz Video AI, Descript, OpusClip, Adobe's AI-powered Premiere features, or similar) — this is a core requirement, not a bonus
Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro; After Effects knowledge is a plus
Portfolio showing before/after examples of AI-assisted edits (required)
Bilingual: English and Spanish required
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision
Experience with finance, business, or educational content is a plus

Compensation
$18–$25/hour, paid through Upwork, based on experience and demonstrated AI tool proficiency
Fully remote, ongoing contract

How to Apply
Please apply with a short introduction of your relevant AI video editing experience, along with 2-3 portfolio examples that specifically show AI tools in your editing workflow (not just traditional editing). Start your proposal with the word EDIT so we know you read the full post. Applications without AI-tool examples will not be considered.

Skills: Adobe Premiere Pro, AI Video Editing, Generative AI, Runway, Topaz Video AI, Descript, Content Repurposing, Motion Graphics, Video Editing

- Reviewing the general ledger for errors or unusual transactions

2. How many years of QuickBooks Desktop experience you have.
3. Whether you have experience with U.S. small-business bookkeeping.
4. Whether you regularly prepare and review Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reports.

items.title: Water Mitigation Claims Specialist
items.description:
# Water Mitigation & Mold Claims Specialist

**Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | U.S. Insurance Claims Experience Required**

We are looking for an experienced **Water Mitigation & Mold Claims Specialist** to join our team and take ownership of reviewing water mitigation and mold remediation claims.

This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience in **water mitigation, water restoration, mold remediation, property damage restoration, or insurance claims** who understands how mitigation and remediation work is documented, estimated, invoiced, and submitted to insurance carriers.

You will be responsible for reviewing invoices, estimates, photographs, testing reports, moisture documentation, and other claim records to determine whether the work performed has been properly accounted for in the insurance carrier's estimate and payment.

You will also be responsible for identifying underpayments and communicating directly with insurance carriers and adjusters to pursue additional payment where the documentation supports it.

## Responsibilities

* Review water mitigation invoices, estimates, photographs, moisture documentation, drying records, and supporting claim documentation.
* Review mold estimates, mold testing invoices, photographs, reports, and other supporting documentation.
* Understand the scope of work performed by water mitigation and mold remediation companies.
* Compare contractor/mitigation invoices and estimates against insurance carrier estimates and payments.
* Identify missing scope, discrepancies, omissions, and potential underpayments.
* Determine where the insurance carrier has failed to account for work or services that were actually performed.
* Prepare clear and well-supported requests for additional payment.
* Communicate directly with insurance adjusters, carriers, and other claims representatives.
* Negotiate and advocate for additional payment when supported by the claim documentation.
* Clearly explain and defend the requested scope and amounts.
* Follow up consistently on outstanding supplements and disputed payments.
* Maintain accurate records of claim status, carrier communications, documentation, and outstanding balances.
* Work with mitigation/restoration companies and internal team members to obtain additional documentation when required.
* Ensure all supplement requests are properly documented and supported by evidence.
* Escalate complex or disputed claims when necessary.

## Requirements

* Previous experience in **water mitigation, water restoration, property damage restoration, mold remediation, or insurance claims**.
* Strong understanding of water mitigation and/or mold remediation processes.
* Experience reviewing mitigation or remediation invoices, estimates, photographs, and supporting documentation.
* Experience comparing contractor invoices against insurance estimates or payments.
* Experience identifying insurance claim underpayments or discrepancies.
* Strong understanding of insurance claims terminology and processes.
* Experience communicating and negotiating with insurance carriers or adjusters.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and analytical ability.
* Ability to confidently explain and defend the scope of work and amounts being requested.
* Ability to manage multiple claims simultaneously and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

## Preferred Qualifications

* **Xactimate** experience.
* Experience preparing or reviewing insurance supplements.
* Experience working directly with restoration or mitigation contractors.
* Experience handling residential property damage claims.
* Experience with mold claims and remediation documentation.
* Familiarity with IICRC water mitigation standards and terminology.
* Experience negotiating disputed or underpaid mitigation/remediation invoices.

## The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who understands the full claims review process and can confidently analyze documentation to determine:

**What work was performed → What was billed → What the carrier allowed → What was paid → What is missing → What additional payment can be supported.**

You should be analytical, persistent, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating with insurance carriers and adjusters.

You should also be comfortable pushing back professionally when the documentation supports additional payment.

## What We Offer

* Remote position
* Long-term opportunity
* Work with a U.S.-based team
* Opportunity to take ownership of an important claims function
* Collaborative and professional working environment

## How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. Briefly describe your experience with **water mitigation, restoration, mold remediation, and/or insurance claims**.
2. How many years of relevant experience do you have?
3. Do you have experience reviewing mitigation or mold invoices against insurance estimates and payments?
4. Do you have experience negotiating supplements or additional payments with insurance carriers?
5. Do you have experience with **Xactimate**? If yes, please describe your experience.
6. What types of property damage claims have you worked with?
7. What is your preferred hourly rate?
8. Please provide a brief summary of your most relevant experience for this position.

**Please only apply if you have direct, relevant experience in water mitigation, mold remediation, restoration, or property damage insurance claims.**

items.title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant – Transaction Desk, Realtracs & Social Media (Part-Time, Ongoing)
items.description:
ABOUT US
We're The Sold Sisters, a high-volume real estate team with Evolve Real Estate serving Clarksville, TN, Fort Campbell, and Oak Grove, KY. We closed about 150 transactions last year and are scaling to 200. We're looking for a detail-oriented virtual assistant to support our paperwork, MLS, and marketing so our team can stay focused on clients.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Transaction & Listing Paperwork
- Prepare, upload, and organize documents in Transaction Desk
- Route documents for e-signature and follow up on missing signatures or initials
- Keep transaction files complete and compliance-ready

MLS Prep (Realtracs)
- Input new listings, including property details, photos, and remarks
- Update status changes, price changes, and showing instructions
- Pull comps and market data as requested

Social Media & Marketing
- Create and schedule posts for new listings, open houses, under contract, and sold
- Design graphics in Canva using our brand style
- Write listing descriptions and captions
- Help keep content consistent across Facebook and Instagram

HOURS
- 15-20 hours per week to start, with potential to grow as we scale
- Flexible schedule, but must be available for some weekday hours in Central Time (CST)
- Long-term, ongoing role

REQUIREMENTS
- Experience with Transaction Desk and Realtracs (required)
- Real estate VA or transaction support experience
- Social media marketing experience and working knowledge of Canva
- Highly organized and self-directed; completes tasks without reminders
- Responsive communicator
- Willing to sign an NDA

NICE TO HAVE
- Tennessee and/or Kentucky real estate experience
- Familiarity with CRMs and Google Workspace

TO APPLY
Please include:
1. Your experience with Transaction Desk and Realtracs
2. 2-3 samples of real estate social media posts you've created
3. Your hourly rate and weekly availability (CST)

Start your proposal with "Sold Sisters" so we know you read the full post.

items.title: SEO & GEO Specialist for Local Businesses
items.description:
SEO & GEO Specialist / Manager | U.S. Local Businesses | Long-Term

We are looking for a highly capable **SEO & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Specialist** to join our growing digital marketing and AI development business.

This is not a one-time SEO project.

We operate multiple businesses ourselves and are building an internal SEO/GEO capability that will eventually support additional client businesses.

Our first projects will focus primarily on **U.S. local service businesses**, including multi-location businesses.

## Hours & Compensation

**Starting:** 10–15 hours/week 
**Budget:** $6–$10 USD/hour 
**Location:** Worldwide 
**Position:** Long-term, with opportunity for increased hours and responsibility

We care much more about **results, technical ability, reliability, and efficiency** than location or formal education.

---

## What You'll Be Responsible For

You will help develop and execute our SEO strategy, including:

- Local SEO
- Google Business Profile optimization
- On-page SEO
- Technical SEO
- Keyword research
- Competitor analysis
- Local keyword/rank tracking
- Location/service page optimization
- Internal linking
- Schema/structured data
- Citation/NAP management
- Backlink analysis and link-building opportunities
- Google Search Console
- GA4
- SEO audits
- Content optimization
- SEO content planning
- Multi-location SEO
- WordPress/CMS optimization
- Conversion-oriented SEO improvements

### GEO / AI Search

We also want someone interested in the rapidly changing area of **AI search visibility / GEO**.

This includes understanding how businesses can improve their visibility and citations across AI-powered search and answer platforms.

You do NOT need to claim to be a “GEO expert.”

We prefer someone with excellent SEO fundamentals who actively tests, researches, and adapts as search changes.

---

# We Care About Execution, Not Reports

We already have access to SEO tools and reporting.

We are **not looking for someone whose primary job is generating SEO reports.**

We want someone who can look at the data and say:

**Here is the problem. 
Here is what I recommend. 
Here is what I changed. 
Here is what happened afterward.**

You should be comfortable actually implementing improvements, not simply identifying them.

---

## Tools

Experience with the following is useful:

- SE Ranking
- Google Search Console
- Google Analytics / GA4
- Google Business Profile
- WordPress
- Screaming Frog
- Ahrefs / Semrush or similar tools

We currently use **SE Ranking**, so experience with it is a plus.

---

# Required Experience

You MUST have hands-on SEO experience.

Strong preference will be given to candidates with:

- U.S. local SEO experience
- Local service business experience
- Google Business Profile experience
- Multi-location SEO experience
- Technical SEO knowledge
- WordPress experience
- Demonstrable SEO results
- Strong written English
- Ability to work independently

---

# Important: Show Us Results

Please provide **2–3 examples of websites you personally worked on**.

For each example, briefly tell us:

1. What the business was
2. What you personally did
3. What measurable result occurred
4. Approximately how long it took

Screenshots from Google Search Console, GA4, ranking tools, or other evidence are welcome.

Please do not simply send an agency portfolio if you cannot explain what YOU personally did.

---

# How to Apply

Start your proposal with:

**LOCAL SEO**

Then answer these questions:

1. How many years have you worked professionally in SEO?

2. Describe your experience with U.S. local businesses.

3. What are the most important things you would examine during your first week working on a local service business?

4. Describe one local SEO project where you personally improved rankings, organic traffic, leads, or Google Business Profile performance.

5. What SEO work do you personally implement versus only recommend?

6. What is your experience with Google Business Profile?

7. What is your experience with WordPress and technical SEO?

8. What SEO tools do you use regularly?

9. Have you used SE Ranking?

10. What do you currently do differently because of AI-powered search and GEO?

11. How do you determine whether SEO work is actually generating business results rather than simply increasing rankings?

12. Are you willing to complete a **paid practical SEO assessment**?

13. What is your hourly rate and weekly availability?

Generic or AI-generated applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.

We are looking for someone interested in becoming a **long-term member of our team** as our SEO operations grow.

items.title: Authority Link Building & Digital PR Specialist for B2B Digital Agency
items.description:
***Please submit your final bid only.***

We are looking for an experienced link-building and digital PR specialist to help build authoritative backlinks and brand mentions for an established digital marketing and consulting agency.

**This is NOT a bulk backlink project.**

We are specifically looking for placements on legitimate, recognizable, high-authority websites with real audiences and established brands.

Examples of the caliber of websites we are interested in include Wikipedia, Forbes, Entrepreneur, Inc., HubSpot, Search Engine Journal, Search Engine Land, TechCrunch, Clutch, Crunchbase, established business publications, industry associations, universities, chambers of commerce, major SaaS companies, and other respected industry-specific publications.

These examples are provided to demonstrate the **quality and legitimacy** we are looking for. We do not expect or require guaranteed placements on these specific websites.

## What We Are Looking For

We want backlinks and brand mentions obtained through legitimate strategies such as:

- Digital PR and journalist outreach
- Editorial mentions
- Expert contributions and quotes
- Original research/data outreach
- Resource-page placements
- Relevant industry associations and organizations
- High-quality guest contributions to established publications
- Other legitimate editorial opportunities

Links should be acquired gradually and naturally rather than delivered in a large batch.

## Quality Standards

We care more about the **actual reputation and legitimacy of the website** than an arbitrary DA or DR number.

Sites should have:

- An established brand or legitimate organization behind them
- Real organic traffic
- Genuine editorial standards
- Relevant topical authority
- A real audience
- A healthy backlink and organic traffic profile
- Long-term value beyond simply providing a backlink

## What We Will NOT Accept

We are **not interested in**:

- PBNs
- Link farms or link networks
- Bulk backlink packages
- Temporary or rented backlinks
- Sites created primarily to sell guest posts
- Generic "write for us" networks
- Web 2.0 spam
- Automated backlinks
- Spammy directories
- Forum/profile spam
- Comment backlinks
- Paid press-release networks
- Expired-domain networks
- Sites with artificially inflated DA/DR
- Irrelevant foreign-language websites
- Casino, gambling, crypto, adult, or unrelated websites
- Hundreds of low-quality links disguised as "authority link building"

**We would rather acquire 2–5 exceptional links than 50 mediocre ones.**

## Transparency Is Required

Before proceeding with placements, we want to understand the websites you intend to target and why they are appropriate.

Reporting should include:

- Website/domain
- Type of placement
- Relevance to our agency
- Estimated organic traffic
- DA/DR or comparable authority metrics
- Anchor text
- Target URL
- Live backlink URL
- Whether the link is follow, nofollow, or sponsored

## To Apply

Please answer the following:

1. How would you acquire backlinks from recognizable, established websites for a digital marketing agency?
2. Please provide 3–5 examples of **actual high-authority websites** where you have successfully secured links or editorial mentions for previous clients.
3. Please provide live examples of those placements where possible.
4. How many genuinely high-quality placements would you realistically expect to secure each month?
5. Do you own, operate, or regularly purchase placements from PBNs, guest-post networks, or websites primarily created for selling backlinks?
6. What would you need from us to improve your chances of earning editorial links from major publications or recognized industry websites?

Please begin your proposal with the words **"Quality Outreach First"** so we know you have read the entire posting.

### Project Structure

We prefer a milestone-based arrangement based on **approved, successfully acquired placements**, rather than paying for a predetermined quantity of backlinks regardless of quality.

**Quality, legitimacy, relevance, and permanence are considerably more important to us than volume.**

items.title: HubSpot Email Campaign Specialist – Immediate Start – 9 Emails / 3-Stage Campaign
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced HubSpot Email Marketing specialist who can begin immediately and help us launch an upcoming ICP email campaign for PooStation, our commercial pet waste management brand.

BUDGET: $60 FIXED PRICE — THREE $20 MILESTONES

IMPORTANT FOLLOW-UP OPPORTUNITY: We are currently adding approximately 8,000–10,000 additional contacts during October. If the initial portion of this first campaign is executed successfully, we expect to open a second separate $60 HubSpot campaign for those new contacts.

You will NOT necessarily need to finish all three stages of the first campaign before the second project begins. The two projects may overlap.

We are looking for someone who can start immediately, communicate reliably, and personally perform the HubSpot work.

CURRENT CAMPAIGN
The first campaign will cover approximately 7,000–8,000 qualified contacts.

Our 10 established ICPs are organized into four campaign groups:
1. Residential Communities: HOA Management Companies, Luxury Class A Apartment Operators, Commercial Property Management Companies, Luxury Senior Living Operators.
2. New Communities & Development: Luxury Master-Planned Home Builders, Luxury Build-to-Rent Community Developers, Active Adult Community Developers.
3. Parks, Recreation & Public Spaces: Municipalities/Parks & Recreation Departments and University Campus Operators.
4. Hospitality, Resorts & Outdoor Destinations: Resort/Hospitality Property Operators.

CAMPAIGN STRUCTURE & ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
The first $60 project consists of nine HubSpot marketing emails across three stages.

Milestone 1 — $20: Build and test four category-specific introductory emails. Verify audiences and ICP segmentation; confirm final recipient counts; designate only approved eligible recipients as HubSpot Marketing Contacts; configure personalization, links, selling sheets/PDFs, CTAs, suppression/unsubscribe handling and tracking; perform test sends and QA; then successfully launch the first campaign send. We are targeting Tuesday for the first campaign send.

Milestone 2 — $20: Approximately one week later, build, test and successfully send one universal educational/editorial email about the long-term financial and operational costs associated with traditional pet waste stations.

Milestone 3 — $20: Approximately one week later, build, test and successfully send four category-specific follow-up emails with clear calls to action.

The project is complete after the final campaign emails have been successfully sent and final campaign results reviewed. Total email builds: 9 — 4 introductory, 1 universal educational/editorial, 4 follow-up.

After each send, monitor for obvious delivery/setup issues and provide a concise update using available HubSpot engagement results.

HUBSPOT MARKETING CONTACTS — IMPORTANT
Do NOT indiscriminately convert every CRM record into a Marketing Contact. Review and confirm the eligible campaign audience and recipient count before changing Marketing Contact status because this can affect HubSpot billing.

This project does not include a complete CRM cleanup. Database cleanup and expansion are handled separately.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
Hands-on experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub, marketing emails, lists/segmentation, custom properties, Marketing Contacts, workflows/automation, personalization, suppression/unsubscribe management, testing/QA, and campaign monitoring/reporting.

No A/B testing is required for this initial campaign; we want to establish baseline results first.

SECOND $60 CAMPAIGN / CONTINUING WORK
We are acquiring approximately 8,000–10,000 additional contacts during October. If you successfully execute the initial portion of this campaign — including accurate segmentation, recipient verification, correct Marketing Contact handling, email construction/testing and the initial campaign launch — we expect to open a second separate $60 campaign for the new contacts.

The second project may begin while stages two and three of the first campaign are still underway. This creates the potential for $120 across two separate projects in a relatively short period, followed by additional HubSpot work as our database and marketing activity grow.

We are looking for someone we can develop a longer-term working relationship with.

When applying, begin your proposal with the words: HUBSPOT CAMPAIGN

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in marketing and sales, with expertise in lead generation, web scraping, LinkedIn automation, and proficiency in tools like Dripify, Monday.com, and Slack.

items.title: 2D Game Artist for Slot-Style Social Games (Paid Test Project)
items.description:
I'm building a social games platform for bars: slot-style games, fish and arcade games, and table games. It's play-for-fun only (no cash value, 21+), and I'm replacing placeholder art with hand-made art. I'm looking for a 2D game artist, ideally with Spine experience, to start with a short paid test and then continue on a longer series if it goes well.

PAID TEST PROJECT (Day of the Dead fiesta slot theme)
1. One lobby tile illustration, portrait 3:4, 1536x2048 px, with NO text in the art (titles are added in code). Think papel picado banners, marigolds, sugar skulls, warm lantern light.
2. Three slot symbols (for example a sugar skull, a guitar, and a marigold wreath) on transparent backgrounds, 512x512 px, matching the tile's style and readable at small size.
3. One short Spine animation: a 1.5-2 second win loop on one of the symbols.

Deliver layered source files (PSD, Procreate, or AI), exported PNGs, the Spine project and atlas, and a short MP4 or GIF preview.

STYLE
Warm, physical, hand-painted look: walnut brown, amber and gold, cream. Bold, readable shapes with Western Americana and Mexican folk art influences. No neon or purple, and nothing that looks like a generic AI image.

REQUIREMENTS
- 100% human-made. No generative AI at any stage (concepts, textures, fills, or upscaling). I'll ask for work-in-progress files or process screenshots.
- Original work only: no copying existing games, characters, or brands, and no unlicensed stock.
- Ownership transfers to my company on payment, with a short IP assignment.
- Written communication is fine; replies within 24 hours work for me.

IN YOUR PROPOSAL, PLEASE TELL ME
1. Two or three portfolio pieces closest to this style.
2. Whether you'll do the art yourself or with a team.
3. Your tools, and confirmation that you don't use generative AI.
4. Your turnaround time for the test, and your hourly or per-piece rate for ongoing work.
5. Your weekly availability.

If the test goes well, there is ongoing work: ten or more game themes (symbols, backgrounds, logos), fish and arcade art, UI, and more Spine animation.

items.title: Creative Strategist — Specialized in Long-Form Ads
items.description:
We're looking for someone who is genuinely great at storytelling for Meta ads: long stories in the primary text that our audience recognizes themselves in. It has to grab them and hold them to the end.

We run a jewelry e-commerce brand that scales on Facebook & Instagram ads. Our best ads are long-form story ads — long, gripping stories in the primary text that a reader can't stop reading, and then buys from.

Our audience is women 65+. You know how to write for them — what they feel, what they worry about, what makes them stop scrolling and read.

What the job is: writing one captivating story after another. The copy is everything. We make the images ourselves — they're just support for the text.

You must have real experience with AI and know exactly what makes a story gripping. You use AI to write faster and produce volume, while keeping the hooks, the voice and the quality fully in your hands.

Pay is 100% performance-based — you're paid per story that passes our testing. The winners pay very well.

Please don't apply if you're new to this, have never written copy tested on cold traffic, or have never had an ad perform. Experts only.

To apply: send 2–3 long-form ads you've written that were actually run, plus 2–3 sentences on why you're the right fit.

items.title: WordPress Developer: Shopify to WordPress Rebuild for Local Service Company (Local SEO Focus)
items.description:
Octoraa is a boutique digital marketing agency serving home service contractors. We handle strategy, SEO, and the client relationship, and we're looking for a reliable WordPress developer to execute builds from our blueprints. As well as help improve site performance, optimize pages for search visibility, and assist with website updates and maintenance. This is a part-time role for someone who can work independently, communicate clearly, and contribute to long-term client success. If you have experience supporting agency workflows and delivering consistent results, we’d love to hear from you. This is our first project together, with more contractor builds in the pipeline for the right person.

The project
Rebuild an impact windows, doors, and roofing company's website, moving it from Shopify to WordPress and building it for local SEO. Scope:

Migrate off Shopify, with 301 redirects from all old URLs
Service page sections for impact windows, impact doors, and roofing
Multiple city/location pages from a template we provide
Schema markup (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ)
Strong mobile PageSpeed scores, not just "passing"
Lead forms with SMS/texting consent language, connected to our CRM
Klaviyo integration
Built to support a Spanish version later (WPML or Polylang)

Who we're looking for

Strong WordPress portfolio with live links
Experience building local service business sites with location pages
Experience migrating sites off Shopify
Understands technical SEO basics: redirects, schema, site speed
Clear communication, honest timelines, and comfortable working under our agency brand

Terms

All hosting, domains, and accounts stay in the agency's or client's name
NDA required, and work is white-labeled under Octoraa
