items.title: Appointment Setter — 🔥 Call Warm Home Sellers & Book Appointments (Fast Growing Real Estate Co.) 🔥
items.description:
THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

We're hiring a full-time Appointment Setter to turn warm home-seller
leads into booked, show-up appointments for our Investor Partners in
markets all over the United States.

Currently this is 40 hours per week, consistent work, for the long term.

We are not looking for a "worker." 
We are looking for a teammate.

You will not be treated like a "contract." You'll be a pillar of a purpose-driven business that solves real problems for homeowners — people burdened with a house they don't want, or who are in financial distress and need a way out fast.

HOW OUR PROCESS WORKS
Every day, property owners reach out to us wanting to sell their house
fast, for cash, as-is. Nobody is cold-called. These people raised their
hand.

Our Data Intake Specialists gather the property information and qualify
the seller.

Your job starts there. 

You'll call those sellers back, build trust,
answer their questions, handle hesitation, and get a firm appointment on
the calendar for one of our Investor Partners to meet them on-site and
make a fair cash offer.

You'll work directly with Matthew, our Head of Acquisitions & Deal
Evaluator, and your appointments feed our Investor Partner clients
directly — so the work you do is visible and it matters the same day
you do it.

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO EACH DAY
- Call back and text/email warm inbound seller leads, same day where possible
- Build rapport fast with people who are stressed, skeptical, or in a
 tough spot
- Confirm the basics (condition, timeline, motivation, who's on title)
 and set a firm on-site appointment
- Work our follow-up cadence so no lead goes cold — speed to lead and
 follow-through are the whole game
- Confirm and re-confirm appointments so they actually show up
- Keep every card and note in Airtable clean and current, in real time
- Track your own numbers daily and show up to our weekday Zoom call
 with them

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

Your success is measured in appointments booked and appointments that
actually show up — not calls made.

You'll own a simple scorecard:
- Appointments set per week
- Show-up rate
- Speed to lead (how fast a new lead gets a first call)
- Follow-up cadence hit rate


TOOLS & TRAINING

All training is provided. 

We're HUGE on personal development and
mastering our craft. 

We've built Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
around our best practices — you must be able to follow instructions
exactly.

We use:
- Airtable — database and workflow
- Salesmsg — calling and texting sellers
- Gmail — email
- Zoom — daily weekday team call where any question you have gets
 answered

[SCHEDULE — EDIT] 
Hours are [8:00am–5:00pm Central, Monday–Saturday].

You must be able to work US business hours consistently. 


WHAT WE REQUIRE (PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING)

Extremely detail-oriented. 
This is not optional. It is required.

Strong computer skills, stable high-speed internet, and clear phone
audio with a quiet place to work. 

If that's not you, please do not apply.

Strong communication skills and clear, confident English on the phone.

You must be comfortable being assertive, taking control of the
conversation and owning the process — while still being a genuinely
good listener who can build trust fast.

If that's not you, please do not apply for this position.

Someone who finds joy in mastering a specific set of tasks each day and
enjoys gamifying their results — appointments set, show-up rate,
follow-up cadence hit. If you're not internally competitive and don't
want to track your own numbers and hold yourself accountable, please do
not apply.

High personal standards. 

Greatness is a core belief here. We only want to work with A-players, and you should only want to work with A-players too. 

Plenty of people don't like this environment because it requires
you to constantly level up. If you do like it, we want to hear from you.

And lastly: an obsessed learner and a capable leader who wants more
responsibility over time. 

As you master this role, there's room to grow into running parts of our client pipeline and training new setters as we scale.

The right person has ambition and doesn't shy away from ownership of
outcomes.

NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience in real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, or ISA/setter
 work

- Experience with Airtable, Salesmsg, CallTools, Podio, or similar

- Experience talking to distressed or probate/pre-foreclosure sellers
PAY

$[6]/hr to start, and up to $[12]+/hr once you've mastered the role and
can help train others as we grow.

Short walkthrough video of the position:
https://www.loom.com/share/d4671f12e9f342ed8371729935a5d4c9


HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY — WE READ THESE FIRST)

We're hiring for detail and for phone presence, so your application is
the first test.

1) Start your proposal with the word "APPOINTMENT" so we know you read
 to the bottom.

2) Record a 60–90 second Loom (unlisted link is
 fine) that covers:
 a) Who you are and why this role fits you
 b) Your experience on the phone with English-speaking customers
 c) Role-play this for us: a homeowner says "I just want a number
 over the phone, I don't want anyone coming to my house." Respond
 the way you would on a live call.

3) Answer these three questions in writing (or) in the loom video:
 - What were your numbers in your last phone role (calls, sets,
 conversion) and how did you track them?
 - Describe your internet speed, headset/mic, and where you work from.
 - What hours are you available in US Central Time?

Applications without the loom recording will not be reviewed. 

We're hiring one person for the long haul and we'd rather look at 10 serious
applications than 200 copy-pasted ones.

answer their questions, handle hesitation, and get a firm appointment on
the calendar for one of our Investor Partners to meet them on-site and
make a fair cash offer.

You'll work directly with Matthew, our Head of Acquisitions & Deal
Evaluator, and your appointments feed our Investor Partner clients
directly — so the work you do is visible and it matters the same day
you do it.

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO EACH DAY
- Call back and text/email warm inbound seller leads, same day where possible
- Build rapport fast with people who are stressed, skeptical, or in a
 tough spot
- Confirm the basics (condition, timeline, motivation, who's on title)
 and set a firm on-site appointment
- Work our follow-up cadence so no lead goes cold — speed to lead and
 follow-through are the whole game
- Confirm and re-confirm appointments so they actually show up
- Keep every card and note in Airtable clean and current, in real time
- Track your own numbers daily and show up to our weekday Zoom call
 with them

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

Your success is measured in appointments booked and appointments that
actually show up — not calls made.

You'll own a simple scorecard:
- Appointments set per week
- Show-up rate
- Speed to lead (how fast a new lead gets a first call)
- Follow-up cadence hit rate


TOOLS & TRAINING

All training is provided. 

We're HUGE on personal development and
mastering our craft. 

We've built Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
around our best practices — you must be able to follow instructions
exactly.

We use:
- Airtable — database and workflow
- Salesmsg — calling and texting sellers
- Gmail — email
- Zoom — daily weekday team call where any question you have gets
 answered

[SCHEDULE — EDIT] 
Hours are [8:00am–5:00pm Central, Monday–Saturday].

You must be able to work US business hours consistently. 


WHAT WE REQUIRE (PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING)

Extremely detail-oriented. 
This is not optional. It is required.

Strong computer skills, stable high-speed internet, and clear phone
audio with a quiet place to work. 

If that's not you, please do not apply.

Strong communication skills and clear, confident English on the phone.

You must be comfortable being assertive, taking control of the
conversation and owning the process — while still being a genuinely
good listener who can build trust fast.

If that's not you, please do not apply for this position.

Someone who finds joy in mastering a specific set of tasks each day and
enjoys gamifying their results — appointments set, show-up rate,
follow-up cadence hit. If you're not internally competitive and don't
want to track your own numbers and hold yourself accountable, please do
not apply.

High personal standards. 

Greatness is a core belief here. We only want to work with A-players, and you should only want to work with A-players too. 

Plenty of people don't like this environment because it requires
you to constantly level up. If you do like it, we want to hear from you.

And lastly: an obsessed learner and a capable leader who wants more
responsibility over time. 

As you master this role, there's room to grow into running parts of our client pipeline and training new setters as we scale.

The right person has ambition and doesn't shy away from ownership of
outcomes.

NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience in real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, or ISA/setter
 work

- Experience with Airtable, Salesmsg, CallTools, Podio, or similar

- Experience talking to distressed or probate/pre-foreclosure sellers
PAY

$[6]/hr to start, and up to $[12]+/hr once you've mastered the role and
can help train others as we grow.

Short walkthrough video of the position:
https://www.loom.com/share/d4671f12e9f342ed8371729935a5d4c9


HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY — WE READ THESE FIRST)

We're hiring for detail and for phone presence, so your application is
the first test.

1) Start your proposal with the word "APPOINTMENT" so we know you read
 to the bottom.

2) Record a 60–90 second Loom (unlisted link is
 fine) that covers:
 a) Who you are and why this role fits you
 b) Your experience on the phone with English-speaking customers
 c) Role-play this for us: a homeowner says "I just want a number
 over the phone, I don't want anyone coming to my house." Respond
 the way you would on a live call.

3) Answer these three questions in writing (or) in the loom video:
 - What were your numbers in your last phone role (calls, sets,
 conversion) and how did you track them?
 - Describe your internet speed, headset/mic, and where you work from.
 - What hours are you available in US Central Time?

Applications without the loom recording will not be reviewed. 

We're hiring one person for the long haul and we'd rather look at 10 serious
applications than 200 copy-pasted ones.

items.title: Diseño de Producto
items.description:
Buscamos una empresa o equipo de ingeniería y diseño industrial que pueda acompañarnos en el desarrollo integral de un sistema compuesto por una cápsula y un termo.

No buscamos únicamente el diseño estético del termo. Necesitamos desarrollar técnicamente ambos componentes como un único sistema funcional.

El trabajo que necesitamos realizar contrmpla :

• Diseño industrial y mechanical engineering.

• Modelado CAD/3D.

• Selección de materiales.

• Desarrollo de prototipos funcionales.

• Pruebas y ajustes del sistema 

• Design for Manufacturing (DFM).

• Desarrollo de planos, tolerancias y archivos técnicos necesarios para posteriormente fabricar moldes y llevar el producto a producción industrial.

Actualmente contamos con el concepto del producto y algunas dimensiones y características preliminares, pero necesitamos un equipo que pueda transformar la idea en un prototipo funcional y posteriormente en un producto listo para manufactura.



Nos gustaría saber:

Si cuentan con experiencia en desarrollo de cápsulas, sistemas de bebidas, envases para alimentos o mecanismos similares.
Si pueden realizar internamente tanto el diseño industrial como la ingeniería y prototipado.
Qué tiempos proponen para desarrollar un proyecto de estas características.

Presupuesto aproximado para llegar hasta un prototipo funcional.

El producto está destinado inicialmente al mercado de Estados Unidos, por lo que los materiales utilizados deberán ser compatibles con los requerimientos aplicables para productos en contacto con alimentos y bebidas calientes.

Quedo atenta para a su respuesta .

items.title: B2B Lead Research – Seattle Multifamily Property Owners & Managers
items.description:
We are an HVAC and electrical contractor in the Seattle area developing an EV charging installation program for multifamily properties. We are looking for an experienced lead researcher to build a highly targeted prospect list of multifamily properties located within Seattle City Light's service territory.

This is a research/enrichment project, not simply an email scraping project. We want accurate property, ownership, management, and decision-maker information.

## Initial Pilot

We would like to begin with **100 qualified multifamily properties** and **25 multifamily property management companies**.

If the data quality is strong, this can expand into a substantially larger ongoing list-building project.

## Target Properties

Prioritize:

- Multifamily apartment properties
- Located within Seattle City Light service territory
- Approximately **20–200+ units**
- Existing off-street parking
- Surface parking, garages, or structured parking are all acceptable
- Existing buildings rather than new developments
- Privately owned or professionally managed properties
- Properties where EV charging could reasonably be added

Please exclude:

- Properties with no off-street parking
- Condominiums unless there is a clear centralized ownership/management opportunity
- Properties outside Seattle City Light territory
- Properties that already appear to have substantial EV charging infrastructure

## Information Required for Each Property

Please provide:

1. Property name
2. Street address
3. City/ZIP
4. Approximate unit count
5. Approximate number/type of parking spaces if available
6. Property owner/legal ownership entity
7. Property management company
8. Owner/management company website
9. Primary decision-maker name
10. Decision-maker title
11. Verified business email
12. Direct phone number if available
13. LinkedIn profile
14. Existing EV chargers: Yes / No / Unknown
15. Other properties owned or managed by the same company, if readily identifiable
16. Source URLs used to verify the information
17. Any useful notes about the property

## Decision Makers

Preferred contacts include:

- Property Owner
- Principal
- Asset Manager
- Director of Property Management
- Regional Property Manager
- Director of Facilities
- Facilities Manager
- Portfolio Manager

Please avoid generic leasing agents and on-site leasing staff unless no higher-level contact can be identified.

## Property Management Company List

Separately identify **25 property management companies** managing multifamily properties within Seattle City Light territory.

For each company, provide:

- Company name
- Website
- Approximate number of properties/units managed if available
- Geographic service area
- Relevant decision-maker
- Title
- Verified email
- Phone
- LinkedIn
- Examples of Seattle City Light-area properties they manage

We are especially interested in regional management companies controlling multiple properties, as these may become portfolio-wide opportunities.

## Deliverable

Please provide the completed research in Google Sheets or Excel with one row per property and clearly labeled columns.

Accuracy is more important than volume.

**Do not provide a pre-purchased or generic lead database.** Each property should be researched and qualified against the criteria above.

## Paid Sample

Before awarding the full project, we would like a **paid sample of 10 properties and 3 property management companies** using the criteria above.

We will evaluate:

- Property qualification
- Accuracy of ownership information
- Quality of decision-maker identification
- Email verification
- Completeness of source information
- Overall usefulness for outbound sales

If the sample is strong, we will immediately proceed with the full 100-property / 25-management-company project.

## When Applying

Please briefly explain:

1. Your experience researching commercial real estate or multifamily ownership.
2. Which data sources/tools you use.
3. How you verify email addresses.
4. How you determine the actual owner/property manager of a building.
5. Your price for the paid sample and the full project.

Please begin your proposal with the words **"Seattle Multifamily"** so we know you read the full project description.

items.title: RFID PCB Project Development
items.description:
Senior Hardware / RF Electronics Engineer
Independent Review of an RFID System
Project overview
We are developing a 13.56 MHz RFID system that identifies RFID tags at multiple antenna positions and reports their numeric tag data and antenna location to our software.
We have draft main-controller and antenna-node schematics in KiCad, developed with AI assistance. We want an experienced electronics engineer to independently evaluate the architecture, verify component choices and electrical design, identify required corrections, and establish a practical path to validated prototypes.
The initial engagement is a paid engineering review. PCB completion, prototype bring-up, manufacturing support, and certification can be quoted as follow-on work.
Firmware and software development are being handled by us and are not part of the initial engineering review.

See attached document for greater details

items.title: Soft-Goods Designer for Travel Medicine Kit
items.description:
We're a new consumer health brand launching a premium travel medicine kit in March 2027. We need an experienced soft-goods designer to adapt an existing factory amenity case (not design one from scratch) and see it through factory sampling. Most of the work is the interior: a clean, organized layout that holds our contents securely and looks considered when opened. Our first production run is 10,000+ units.

WHAT THE CASE HOLDS
- 3 travel-size medicine vials, approx. 0.75" diameter x 2.75" tall
- 3 squat medicine bottles, approx. 1.5" diameter x 2" tall
- 12-15 hydration stick packs, approx. 5" x 1.25"
These sizes are estimates and will be confirmed before the tech pack is finalized, so the interior should tolerate small changes. Physical samples will be provided.

CURRENT DIRECTION
- Compact, structured soft case with a matte black premium textile exterior
- Target size about 5.5-6.5" W x 4-4.5" H x 2.5-3" D. We want your recommendation based on the contents.
- Three-sided zipper with near-flat opening preferred
- Clean, wipeable interior lining
- Minimal exterior branding (deboss, small patch or custom zipper pull)
- Open to cut-and-sew, neoprene or fabric-laminated molded construction, whichever gives the best result at our cost and timeline
- Reference images and our concept mockup will be shared with shortlisted candidates

DELIVERABLES
1. Recommended final dimensions and construction
2. 2-3 interior layout options
3. Materials and finishes specification: exterior textile, lining, zipper, pull, logo treatment
4. Factory-ready tech pack and bill of materials
5. Direct communication with the manufacturer and review of 1-2 sample rounds through pre-production approval

MANUFACTURER
We're sampling stock cases from several factories and haven't selected one. We're open to a manufacturing partner you already know and trust, in Asia or elsewhere. Unit cost is a major consideration, so please tell us where your partners produce and the typical price range for comparable cases at 10,000 units.

TIMELINE
- Start immediately
- Factory-ready tech pack by early November 2026
- Approved pre-production sample by early December 2026
- Production complete before Chinese New Year (ex-factory by about January 20, 2027)

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- Has shipped bags, cases or organizers with overseas factories
- Can share a tech pack from a past production project
- Comfortable working within a factory's existing patterns and material library
- Mandarin, Cantonese or Vietnamese ability, or an on-the-ground presence, is a plus

TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE
- 2-3 relevant shipped projects, noting your role and the factory
- A sample tech pack (redacted is fine)
- Your fixed-fee quote and availability over the next 6 weeks
- Any manufacturing partner you'd propose, and what you've made together

Payment will be by milestone: layout approval, tech pack, and approved pre-production sample. An NDA is required before brand and product details are shared.

items.title: Social Media Manager for Behavioral Health Billing Company (3 hrs/week, Ongoing)
items.description:
Bridgeway Billing is a revenue cycle management company based in Utah that serves residential and outpatient behavioral health providers across the country. We're looking for a part-time social media manager to help grow our presence on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram and turn those profiles into a real channel for prospective clients to find us.

This is an ongoing role of about 3 hours per week.

What you'll do:

Engage daily or several times a week on our behalf: liking, commenting on, and sharing relevant posts from behavioral health providers, treatment centers, industry leaders, and related organizations

Grow our following through targeted, authentic engagement with accounts in the behavioral health and healthcare space

Create branded graphics for posts we want to share (company updates, industry news, team highlights, service announcements)

Write post captions designed to maximize reach and engagement, including hashtags and calls to action

Suggest content ideas and posting strategies that support our goal of attracting new provider clients

What we're looking for:

Proven experience managing business social media accounts, ideally B2B or healthcare
Strong graphic design skills (Canva, Adobe Express, or similar)

Clear, professional writing with a feel for what drives engagement on each platform
Familiarity with LinkedIn as a B2B growth tool
Reliability and good communication, since you'll be representing our brand publicly

Bonus: experience in healthcare, behavioral health, or medical billing

items.title: Bilingual Texas Market Research & Business Development Consultant — Hispanic Retail / Fintech
items.description:
We would like to validate the market for out product: POS installment financing for working consumers with limited or thin U.S. credit history

 We are planning a Texas market-research trip and are looking for a local bilingual professional who can help us understand the retail landscape, customer-acquisition channels and Mexican/Hispanic business ecosystem.

Responsibilities
Before the trip
- Research relevant retail and commercial areas in Austin, San Antonio and Houston
- Identify Mexican/Hispanic-oriented retailers (furniture, appliances, home improvement, electronics, healthcare)
- Prepare a shortlist of relevant businesses and arrange meetings where possible

During the trip
- Accompany the founder during store visits and business meetings
- Introduce us to local retailers, business owners and community organizations
- Help approach and communicate with potential interview participants
- Explain the local retail environment, customer behavior and commercial practices

Required profile
- Based in Texas, ideally Austin, San Antonio or Houston
- Fluent in Spanish and English
- Good understanding of Mexican/Hispanic communities in Texas

Deliverables
- Contact details of 30–50 relevant businesses and organizations
- Suggested retail areas and routes in all three cities
- 8–12 pre-arranged meetings or introductions, where feasible
- 3-city fieldwork itinerary
- Short written summary of findings and recommended next steps
- List of potential pilot merchants / partners
Nice to have
Experience with:
- POS financing / BNPL / lease-to-own
- Consumer interviews

items.title: Social Media Manager
items.description:
Social Media Manager
About the Role
The Social Media Manager creates, schedules, and publishes content for several FourteenG clients. You’ll work from approved plans and brand guidelines, while helping make sure each post is clear, accurate, and ready to go on time.
This is a hands-on role focused on producing and managing content. FourteenG’s leadership team sets the overall strategy and creative direction.
Responsibilities
Manage client social media calendars and keep upcoming posts on track.
Write and edit captions in each client’s voice. You may use AI tools to help draft content, but you are responsible for checking and improving the final copy.
Create graphics and carousels in adobe and edit simple videos.
Schedule, publish, and check posts for accuracy, including links, dates, tags, alt tags, and formatting.
Organize client photos, videos, logos, and other content files.
Prepare email newsletters and make routine website content updates.
Help with assigned local SEO tasks, such as updating business information.
Schedule approved content and campaigns in GoHighLevel (GHL).
Gather results and prepare information for client reports.
Flag missing information, delays, or potential errors before content goes live.
What This Role Does Not Lead
The Social Media Manager does not set client marketing strategy, brand identity, creative direction, paid advertising strategy, or technical website and SEO plans. The role helps carry out those plans once they are approved.
Who You’ll Work With
You’ll work closely with Desiree, Project Manager, and receive direction from Michael, Creative Director, and Gary, Director of Growth. Our developer handles technical website work.
How We’ll Measure Success
We’ll look at whether content is delivered on time, follows each client’s brand, needs few revisions, and is published accurately. Keeping calendars and files organized and following our review process also matter.

Budget: 
Is set on a monthly price, part time hours 4 hours a day, 5 days a week. Would prefer for someone who can work on US Est time zone to be available for questions, calls during that time frame.

items.title: AI Social Media Agent Builder - Raw Footage → Daily Content → Approval → Posting
items.description:
We are looking for an experienced AI/agentic automation expert who has already built an end-to-end social media content system.

We want to start with ONE brand as a pilot: OUR SPA BRAND

We already have a very large library of raw video footage and established accounts across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X/Twitter, Pinterest and other platforms.

We want a system that can:

•⁠ ⁠Review large amounts of raw footage automatically
•⁠ ⁠Identify the strongest and most engaging moments
•⁠ ⁠Turn them into polished Reels/Shorts
•⁠ ⁠Create approximately 1 strong short-form video every day
•⁠ ⁠Create daily Stories/content when appropriate
•⁠ ⁠Write strong hooks, captions and CTAs
•⁠ ⁠Adapt content appropriately for each platform
•⁠ ⁠Schedule/distribute approved content across all relevant platforms
•⁠ ⁠Maintain our brand voice and visual identity
•⁠ ⁠Create content with a clear purpose: engagement, leads, bookings and sales
•⁠ ⁠Track performance and learn which content performs best
•⁠ ⁠Organize our raw and finished content library

IMPORTANT: Human approval is required before publishing.

We need a simple approval workflow where our team can review, approve, reject or request changes. Nothing should accidentally publish without approval.

We are NOT looking for a traditional video editor or someone manually posting every day. We want someone who can build an AI-powered/agentic system that automates as much of this process as realistically possible while maintaining excellent quality.

Please answer ALL of these questions:

 1.⁠ ⁠What would you charge to BUILD this system for ONE brand?

 2.⁠ ⁠After it is built, what would the ongoing monthly cost be for ONE brand, including your management/maintenance?

 3.⁠ ⁠What additional monthly software/API costs should we expect?

 4.⁠ ⁠Can the same system later be duplicated for 3 additional brands? What would you charge per additional brand?

 5.⁠ ⁠Please show us a REAL system you have already built.

 6.⁠ ⁠Please show examples of finished videos/content created from raw footage by your system.

 7.⁠ ⁠Which parts are truly automated and which still require a human?

 8.⁠ ⁠How does the approval process work?

 9.⁠ ⁠How do you prevent incorrect, inappropriate or off-brand content from being published?

10.⁠ ⁠How do we measure results - views, engagement, leads, bookings and sales?

Paid Test

We plan to shortlist several candidates and give each candidate the same folder of our raw footage.

Your system should identify the best moments and create several finished pieces of social content from that footage.

Please tell us your price for this paid test.

We will compare quality, automation, reliability, ease of approval and cost before selecting the final developer.

If the pilot is successful, we have 3 additional brands we would like to add.

Please start your proposal with the word AGENTIC so we know you read the entire description.

items.title: Appointment Setter for Glid3
items.description:
About us
Glid3 is a B2B experiential marketing company. We build premium, attention-grabbing activations inside conference booths for growth-stage tech companies. Think of us as the reason people stop at a booth, stay longer, and actually talk to the sales team.
We are founder-led, moving fast, and building our outbound sales engine from scratch. You will be one of the first people on the phones.
The role
We need a confident cold caller to turn our prospect lists into booked meetings. You will call event marketing and marketing leaders at B2B companies, run a short qualification conversation, and book qualified meetings directly onto our founder's calendar.
This is a pure appointment-setting role. You are not closing deals. Your job is to open doors and fill the calendar.
Hours and pay
3 hours per day, Monday to Friday, during US Pacific business hours (for example 9am to 12pm PT)
$3-$6 per hour to start
Bonus for every qualified meeting that actually happens. Top performers earn more than the base rate, and we raise the base for setters who consistently deliver
What you will do
Make 60 to 100 outbound dials per day using our call list and script
Have short, natural qualification conversations with marketing and events leaders
Book qualified meetings directly onto the founder's calendar with a short written brief on each prospect
Log every call outcome in our shared tracker (Google Sheets) so nothing gets lost
Follow up with no-shows and reschedule when needed
Give us honest feedback on what prospects are saying so we can sharpen the pitch
What good looks like
2 to 4 qualified meetings booked per week after your first two weeks
Clean notes on every conversation
A calendar that fills up, not a call log that fills up
Requirements
Excellent spoken English with a clear, confident phone voice. This is the single most important requirement
Previous B2B cold calling or appointment setting experience strongly preferred
Comfortable with rejection and high call volume
Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset
Available during US Pacific daytime hours, Monday to Friday
Able to follow a script while still sounding like a human being
To apply (read carefully)
We get a lot of applications, so follow these steps or yours will be skipped:
Record a 60 second voice message introducing yourself and pretending to cold call a marketing manager about a conference booth activation. We are listening for confidence, clarity, and energy, not perfection.
Answer these questions in your proposal:
How many years of B2B cold calling experience do you have?
How many dials can you make per hour, honestly?
Have you ever booked meetings for someone else's calendar? What was the weekly result?
Can you work 9am to 12pm Pacific, Monday to Friday?
What calling tools or dialers have you used?
Shortlisted candidates will do a paid trial week. If you book real meetings in the trial, the role is yours.

items.title: Fractional CFO for Solar Equipment Business
items.description:
We import solar equipment into Sudan and sell it to dealers, buying in dollars, selling in Sudanese pounds, and holding euros, in a currency that loses value almost weekly. We need a fractional CFO to clarify our cash flow, identify where profit and cash diverge, and recommend practical financial decisions based on the numbers. The right freelancer should be able to assess our current financial position, explain the impact of currency fluctuations, and help us make better choices to improve cash flow and profitability.

There is a trial task attached. It uses our real figures: a container in the warehouse, a supplier payment due 14 October, and four currencies in between.

The first ten candidates who submit receive $20 for the work (message first to see if we are not already booked). The reward for the strongest submission is the assignment itself, not a one-off report, but a sparring partner we keep coming back to. We are committing to at least 10 hours in November to start, with the expectation that it continues as the work demands.

Everyone who takes part gets to see the winning submission. So you either win the work, or you take something away from it, a real problem, real numbers, and someone else's thinking to measure your own against. Either way, you will have learned something and received 20$.

items.description:
I need a U.S.-registered CPA to provide a full review and audit of my newly established business’s income statement, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement based on U.S. 
GAAS, or PCAOB standards.

All underlying books are closed, organized in excel and bank reconciliations are up to date. In my first message, I will ask you to provide your board registration number, and confirm that the CPA license is under your name. In messages after, I will send you all the financial statements and supporting items. Your role is to do a comprehensive audit and review of my blank statements for my newly incepted company, including but not limited to: test the figures, prepare any adjusting journal entries, draft the auditor’s report, and return final, signed & stamped financials ready for submission to SEC. 

 Some of the requirement for the audit and review: 

 Balance sheet: Confirming bank balances Testing cash Testing receivables Examining liabilities Testing fixed assets Testing equity Searching for unrecorded liabilities Income statement: Testing revenue Testing expenses Testing payroll Testing significant transactions Examining unusual transactions Testing cutoff Cash-flow statement: Reconciling cash flows to the underlying financial statements Testing classification of operating/investing/financing transactions Stockholders' equity: Testing shares issued Testing capital contributions Testing distributions Testing retained earnings Reconciling beginning and ending balances Notes: Testing whether required disclosures are supported 

Reviewing accounting policies Related-party disclosures Debt/contractual obligations Subsequent events Going-concern considerations 

Acceptance criteria

 • USA board registered certified public accountant.

 • 
Comprehensive Audited Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement (PDF + editable file)

 • Independent Auditor’s Report on letterhead, signed& stamped with current CPA license number

 • Management letter outlining any material weaknesses or recommendations 

• All workpapers in a standard audit file structurePlease confirm your valid U.S. CPA license and estimated turnaround time in your bid.

items.title: LinkedIn B2B Marketing Specialist
items.description:
Seeking an experienced LinkedIn B2B marketing, organic growth, and lead-generation specialist to build and grow the LinkedIn presence for Elite Field Evaluations, a commercial property inspection and field-services business.
The objective is to turn LinkedIn into a consistent business-development and client-acquisition channel, not simply a page where content is posted. We want to increase our visibility and credibility with companies and decision-makers who purchase, coordinate, subcontract, or assign commercial property inspection and field-support services.
Our services include commercial property inspections, Phase I ESA and PCA field support/site visits, construction draw inspections, property site visits, photo and field documentation, property research, inspection report support, and QA/review services.
The specialist will be responsible for improving our LinkedIn positioning and company page, developing an industry-specific B2B content strategy, researching and identifying target companies and decision-makers, creating professional content, increasing organic reach and engagement, and developing strategies for building relevant professional connections.
Our target audience may include environmental consulting firms, engineering firms, commercial inspection companies, lenders, construction companies, property management firms, commercial real estate organizations, due-diligence companies, national field-service companies, and other organizations that outsource inspection or property fieldwork.
We want someone who understands how to move beyond impressions and followers and use LinkedIn to create qualified conversations, vendor opportunities, subcontracting relationships, direct-client opportunities, referrals, and long-term business relationships.
The specialist should also track performance, including organic reach, engagement, company-page growth, profile/page visits, connection growth, target-company engagement, inquiries, conversations, and qualified business opportunities so we can determine what is actually working.
Experience with LinkedIn B2B marketing, organic growth, lead generation, audience research, content strategy, company-page optimization, analytics, and relationship-based outreach is important. Experience marketing professional services within commercial real estate, property inspections, environmental services, engineering, construction, due diligence, or related B2B industries is a strong advantage.
This is not a basic social-media posting position. We are looking for someone who can build a strategic, repeatable LinkedIn system that increases industry visibility, establishes Elite Field Evaluations as a credible professional resource, reaches the right decision-makers, and ultimately contributes to measurable business opportunities.


Describe a LinkedIn B2B account or company page you have personally grown. What was the starting point, what actions did you take, and what measurable results did you achieve in reach, engagement, qualified connections, inquiries, leads, or business opportunities?

If you were hired to grow Elite Field Evaluations, how would you identify and reach decision-makers at environmental firms, engineering firms, commercial inspection companies, lenders, property management companies, construction companies, and other organizations that outsource commercial inspection or fieldwork?

Explain your first 30-day LinkedIn strategy for Elite Field Evaluations. Include company-page optimization, target-audience research, content strategy, organic growth, engagement, connection building, and how you would begin generating qualified B2B conversations.

How would you measure whether our LinkedIn marketing is actually producing business results? Please explain the KPIs you would track beyond followers, likes, and impressions, including how you would track inquiries, qualified conversations, vendor opportunities, subcontracting opportunities, and potential clients.

Please provide 1–3 examples of LinkedIn B2B work you have completed and explain your exact role and results. Also state how many hours per week you recommend initially for this project and what you would realistically accomplish within those hours.

items.title: Executive Assistant
items.description:
We are a fast-moving early-stage venture investment firm run by a solo Managing Partner. We're hiring a full-time Executive Assistant who will function as a Chief of Staff, not a scheduler. 

This is not an entry-level admin role. You will own inbox triage, investor and deal-flow pipeline management, calendar protection, and a heavy volume of AI-assisted evaluation and correspondence, largely without waiting for approval.

The core of this job is working inside AI tools (Claude and ChatGPT) all day, every day. If the phrase "prompt engineering" makes you nervous rather than curious, this is not your role.

What you'll actually do

Triage 150 to 250 emails a day across cold inbound pitches, investor correspondence, portfolio updates, and deal flow, using established decision rules (most of which you'll execute without asking first)

Run evaluations and scoring using internal AI prompts, using both Claude and ChatGPT in parallel, and know the difference between the two

Manage a CRM and Airtable: import contacts, merge duplicates, rate and stage prospects, track pipeline status

Draft and send warm intros, meeting scheduling replies, and pass emails on opportunities below the investment bar, entirely on your own

Manage LinkedIn inbound: intro requests, cold pitches, InMails
Support due diligence: organize data rooms, save call transcripts, run evaluation prompts, flag follow-up questions

Keep a living operating manual current as processes change (we iterate constantly and expect you to document it)

Protect the Managing Partner's calendar and personal time; know what needs him and what doesn't

What this role is not
Not a "forward every email and wait for instructions" job. If you sit on a decision the playbook already answers, that's a miss, not caution.

Not a role where you avoid AI tools because they feel unfamiliar. You'll be running dozens of AI evaluations daily within your first month.

Not 9 to 5 clock watching. Fast, imperfect replies beat slow, polished ones. Speed is the explicit success metric here.

Who succeeds in this role
You're comfortable making judgment calls with incomplete information and would rather ask forgiveness than sit paralyzed

You've used ChatGPT or Claude beyond writing an email; you understand what "running a prompt" means and you're not intimidated by an evolving toolkit

You have some exposure to sales, CRM hygiene, or high-volume inbox management, ideally in a startup or fast-moving small-team environment

You take correction well and fast. You will be corrected constantly in the first month. That's the training process, not a red flag

Excellent written English. You'll be drafting external correspondence to founders and investors under this firm's name

Schedule
Full-time, Monday through Saturday, aligned to give 5 to 6 hours of overlap with US Pacific time business hours. 

Tools you'll use daily
Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Claude, ChatGPT, Airtable, a CRM system, Calendly, TextExpander, Fireflies/Fathom (call transcription), Chrome extensions for contact enrichment (Apollo, Seamless.ai)

Compensation and structure
Part-time to start contract. Rate commensurate with experience; open to discussing hourly vs. monthly. First 30 days include a structured onboarding program with weekly check-ins to build the working relationship and get you fully autonomous on the core workflows.

To apply
Tell me, in two sentences, the difference between how you'd handle a cold inbound pitch versus a warm introduction from a trusted contact, based on general operating norms (not this specific firm's playbook, we'll teach you that). I'm filtering for people who've thought about this before, not people who get it right on the first guess.

Applications that are obviously copy-pasted boilerplate with no reference to the actual job description will not get a response.

items.title: Influencer Seeding Specialist for Amazon Consumer Brands
items.description:
Description:

We run several consumer brands sold on Amazon, mostly men's grooming and personal care, plus skincare. We're looking for an organized, persistent person to run product seeding: finding creators, reaching out, shipping them free product, and tracking who posts.

This is ongoing work with a new brand launch starting now. Strong performers get more brands and more hours.

What you'll do

Find 50–100 relevant creators per week on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube (mostly micro creators with 5K–100K followers) in men's lifestyle, fitness, grooming, comedy, and skincare
Check that each creator is a good fit: real engagement, audience mostly in the US, content that suits our brand
Write and send personal outreach DMs and emails using our templates, and follow up
Collect shipping details from creators who say yes and send them to us for fulfillment
Track everything in a Google Sheet or Trello: creator, handle, followers, status, ship date, post link, views
Follow up after delivery to encourage a post, and save the best content for us to reuse (with permission)
Send a weekly report with outreach sent, reply rate, products shipped, posts live, and the best performers

Requirements

Proven influencer outreach or seeding experience (share examples or results)
Fluent written English. Our brands use bold, edgy humor, so you need to match that tone
Comfortable with TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creator search; experience with tools like Modash, Upfluence, or TikTok Creator Marketplace is a plus
Very organized, with fast replies on WhatsApp
You must follow FTC rules. Creators disclose gifted product (#gifted / #ad). We never ask for or pay for Amazon reviews, and never offer product in exchange for a review.

Pay

Hourly ($X–$X/hr), about 10–20 hrs/week to start, or
Fixed fee per creator who receives product and posts (open to proposals)
Bonus for creators whose posts hit view targets

To apply, answer these:

Share a seeding or outreach campaign you ran. How many creators did you contact, and how many posted?
What's your typical reply rate on cold creator DMs?
How would you find 50 men's grooming creators in the US this week?
Write a short outreach DM for a funny, edgy men's personal care brand.
What tools do you use to vet creators for fake followers?

items.title: UE5 Ocean Navigation Prototype
items.description:
Hi! I came across your profile and I’m interested in working with you on a small Unreal Engine 5 prototype.

For the first prototype, I want a simple navigable ocean inspired by the general maritime navigation feel shown in One Piece Fighting Path.

The important detail is that I do not need realistic boat physics or buoyancy simulation.

The ocean can remain visually flat/stable. I mainly need:

* A navigable ocean
* Visual waves on the water surface

items.title: Social media manager for a newly launched AI travel planning app (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook)
items.description:
This is an ongoing monthly engagement, not a one-off project. The budget will be split into one milestone per month. The first milestone is smaller and covers setup plus an initial batch of content.

We are a newly launched AI travel planning web app. A traveler enters a destination, dates and who is going, and the product returns a practical trip plan: weather, visa and entry guidance, a packing list, things to do, where to stay, food, and a day-by-day schedule. The first trip is free and there is a paid subscription. There is also a list of things recommended to buy in preparation for the trip which comes from our partners as affiliate marketing.

We are looking for someone to run our social media from scratch and turn views into registered users and paid subscribers. The accounts do not exist yet, so you would be starting clean.

Scope of work

1. Set up TikTok, Instagram and Facebook business accounts under our ownership, including bios, profile assets and the link destination
2. Short-form video, roughly 8 to 12 pieces a month, cross-posted across the three platforms
3. Carousels, roughly 2 to 4 a month
4. Instagram stories on daily basis, including interactive stickers and link stickers
5. Scripts and captions in our brand voice, following the brand and copy guidelines we will provide
6. Community management, replying to comments and messages within an agreed response time
7. Running a small monthly boosting budget inside our own ad accounts
8. A monthly report against agreed targets

How we measure success
Registered sign-ups, trips created, and free to paid conversion. We will provide tracked links and analytics access. Follower growth matters but it is not the target, and a report built on reach alone will not be accepted.

What we need in your proposal

1. Two or three accounts you have grown, with the handle, the period you ran it, and what the numbers did. Links, not screenshots.
2. One example of content that produced measurable sign-ups or sales, and how you knew it did.
3. Your view of our category. Wanderlog, Layla, TripIt and Mindtrip are in this space. What would make a traveller pick a new product over them?
4. Three hook ideas for our first week. One line each is enough.
5. Your monthly fee for the scope above. Quote your fee separately from any advertising spend.
6. Exepcted monthly advertising spend for each platform.
7. Who appears on camera in your videos, and ownership of the content if we stop working together.

Conditions
All social accounts, ad accounts and content are created under our ownership and remain ours, with you added as an administrator. Advertising spend is paid on our own payment method, at cost, and does not pass through this contract. We will ask for a short call before awarding.

This is an ongoing monthly engagement, not a one-off project. We have not stated a budget on purpose. We want to see how you would price the work, so please quote your own monthly fee. We will set up one milestone per month, with a smaller first milestone covering setup and an initial batch of content.

Please price both of these

Package A: 12 short videos a month, 4 carousels, daily Instagram Stories, community management, monthly reporting.

Package B: 8 short videos a month, 2 carousels, Stories three times a week, community management, monthly reporting.

Please begin your proposal with the word TRIPLIST so we know you have read this.

items.title: Research Coder for Course Classification
items.description:
Seeking 3 research coders to classify short college course descriptions . 

Summary. You will read short descriptions of college art and design courses and mark what each one teaches, using a one-page codebook and a web tool that moves you through the courses one at a time. No subject expertise is required; careful reading is. Your answers are used to measure the reliability of a research instrument, so there is no "right" rate of any answer — we are measuring agreement, not grading you.

What you'll do

-- Read the codebook once (one page; link provided). It defines five categories and gives worked examples.

-- Open the coding link. Choose the first set, enter the coder ID you're given, and begin.

-- For each course you'll see a code, a title, and a description. Read the whole description and decide what type of course it is, or select multiple categories if it applies. The rules are shown on screen beside every course.

-- Your progress saves automatically after every answer; you can stop and come back to the same link on the same device.
When a set shows "complete," press Export and send me the file (or paste the text if the download doesn't work). Send the calibration file first and wait for a go-ahead before starting the main set.

Rules

-- Use one browser on one device for the whole job.
-- Decide from the description only. Do not look up the course, the school, or anything else.
-- Do not go back or revise earlier answers (the tool doesn't allow it).


Scope and time. 977 courses total. The link you will use has the codebook on the screen and is multiple choice, most coders can categorize each class description in 10-20 seconds each. 

Payment is $33 each coder for the job. 

Requirements. Fluent English reading; a desktop or laptop browser; ability to follow a written protocol consistently. Academic background welcome but not required.

Deliverables. Three exported files from the online coding link.

items.title: Senior Power Apps Developer Needed to Troubleshoot a Therapist Scheduling Application
items.description:
Senior Power Apps Developer Needed to Troubleshoot a Therapist Scheduling Application

We need an experienced Power Platform developer to help complete an existing therapist scheduling application. The interface is largely finished, but the availability lookup and scheduling workflow need focused troubleshooting before production.

The application uses Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Microsoft Graph. There are two versions: Copy, the original application, and Dev, the newer version intended for production. Dev will be the working baseline, with Copy available for comparison.

Current issue

Users select a client and their treatments, then click Confirm to find suitable therapists and appointment times. The Confirm button invokes the GetTherapist v2 filtering logic. Processing currently takes approximately 15–30 seconds, but the final screen does not display the expected therapist names or selectable time slots.

The existing formulas reportedly show no errors. We need someone who can trace actual runtime behavior across the app, flows, and underlying data to identify the cause.

Scope of work

- Diagnose the GetTherapist v2 workflow, including its inputs, returned results, collections, variables, and final-screen bindings.
- Review the nested Power Fx filters and recent changes to button behavior, OnSelect, and OnVisible logic.
- Validate the Dataverse records and relationships used for therapist availability, base schedules, holidays, PTO, temporary schedules, and TP Held. Investigate missing or incomplete source data where relevant.
- Review repeated logic across screens and address unnecessary processing contributing to the delay.
- Compare the two app versions and incorporate useful working components into Dev.
- Validate treatment-duration handling. A 90-minute SM selection must allocate 60 minutes to SM and 30 minutes to protocols. Confirm whether the protocol component exists and complete the agreed behavior.
- Verify that confirmed selections populate the daily schedule correctly.
- Review and complete Microsoft Graph event creation from the stored schedule. Dataverse should remain the scheduling data source; the intended workflow no longer fetches availability from Outlook.
- Remove obsolete components affecting the workflow and document the final changes.

Expected outcome

The application displays eligible therapists and selectable times, applies the agreed duration rules, saves the correct schedule, and creates matching calendar events. The complete workflow should be tested using agreed examples, including unavailable therapists and empty availability results.

Required experience

Strong hands-on experience with Power Apps canvas applications, Power Fx, Power Automate, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph calendar integrations, and debugging inherited applications.

This is an initial troubleshooting and completion engagement, with possible follow-on work such as scheduled cleanup of temporary records.

Please share a relevant troubleshooting example, your earliest availability, and your approach to the initial diagnosis. We will confirm the implementation estimate after reviewing the application.

The application uses Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Microsoft Graph. There are two versions: Copy, the original application, and Dev, the newer version intended for production. Dev will be the working baseline, with Copy available for comparison.

Current issue

Users select a client and their treatments, then click Confirm to find suitable therapists and appointment times. The Confirm button invokes the GetTherapist v2 filtering logic. Processing currently takes approximately 15–30 seconds, but the final screen does not display the expected therapist names or selectable time slots.

The existing formulas reportedly show no errors. We need someone who can trace actual runtime behavior across the app, flows, and underlying data to identify the cause.

Scope of work

- Diagnose the GetTherapist v2 workflow, including its inputs, returned results, collections, variables, and final-screen bindings.
- Review the nested Power Fx filters and recent changes to button behavior, OnSelect, and OnVisible logic.
- Validate the Dataverse records and relationships used for therapist availability, base schedules, holidays, PTO, temporary schedules, and TP Held. Investigate missing or incomplete source data where relevant.
- Review repeated logic across screens and address unnecessary processing contributing to the delay.
- Compare the two app versions and incorporate useful working components into Dev.
- Validate treatment-duration handling. A 90-minute SM selection must allocate 60 minutes to SM and 30 minutes to protocols. Confirm whether the protocol component exists and complete the agreed behavior.
- Verify that confirmed selections populate the daily schedule correctly.
- Review and complete Microsoft Graph event creation from the stored schedule. Dataverse should remain the scheduling data source; the intended workflow no longer fetches availability from Outlook.
- Remove obsolete components affecting the workflow and document the final changes.

Expected outcome

The application displays eligible therapists and selectable times, applies the agreed duration rules, saves the correct schedule, and creates matching calendar events. The complete workflow should be tested using agreed examples, including unavailable therapists and empty availability results.

Required experience

Strong hands-on experience with Power Apps canvas applications, Power Fx, Power Automate, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph calendar integrations, and debugging inherited applications.

This is an initial troubleshooting and completion engagement, with possible follow-on work such as scheduled cleanup of temporary records.

Please share a relevant troubleshooting example, your earliest availability, and your approach to the initial diagnosis. We will confirm the implementation estimate after reviewing the application.

items.title: Part-Time Business Development & Partnerships Representative
items.description:
Part-Time Business Development & Partnerships Representative

Think Wellness NY is an established New York-based company providing professional development, employee engagement, educational enrichment, and customized programming for schools, corporations, government agencies, nonprofits, and community organizations.

We are looking for a sharp, professional, organized, and persistent **Business Development & Partnerships Representative** to help us expand our client base and create new conversations with decision-makers.

This is **not a high-volume call-center position**, and we are not looking for someone to send hundreds of generic emails.

We want someone who can learn our company, understand the organizations we serve, research the right contacts, communicate professionally, and follow up consistently. Our goal is quality outreach that leads to real relationships, qualified conversations, and new business opportunities.

## What You'll Do

- Research and identify appropriate decision-makers within school districts, corporations, government agencies, nonprofits, and community organizations
- Conduct personalized email outreach using company-approved messaging and templates
- Follow up consistently with prospective clients
- Reconnect with past clients, warm leads, and dormant opportunities
- Make targeted outbound calls when appropriate
- Introduce Think Wellness NY clearly and professionally
- Qualify prospective opportunities and book meetings with our Director of Community Partnerships
- Maintain accurate prospect information, notes, and follow-ups in our CRM
- Track outreach activity, responses, meetings, and opportunities
- Help identify new organizations and markets that may be a strong fit for our services

Initially, you will **not** be responsible for creating proposals, negotiating pricing, providing detailed program recommendations, or closing complex sales.

Your primary role will be to **open doors and create qualified conversations**. Interested prospects will be connected with our Director of Community Partnerships.

As you learn the company and demonstrate strong performance, there may be an opportunity to take on greater responsibility within the sales process.

## Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if you:

- Have previous B2B business development, appointment setting, lead generation, or outbound sales experience
- Have excellent written and spoken English
- Communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently by phone
- Are comfortable communicating with U.S.-based executives, HR professionals, school administrators, government contacts, and organizational leaders
- Can write warm, professional, conversational emails rather than generic sales messages
- Understand how to personalize outreach rather than simply sending mass emails
- Are persistent without being pushy
- Are highly organized and excellent at follow-up
- Are comfortable working independently
- Have experience using a CRM
- Know how to research organizations and identify the appropriate decision-maker
- Are comfortable being measured on activity, qualified conversations, meetings, and opportunities generated

Experience selling or prospecting for **professional services, education, training, HR services, employee programs, events, consulting, or other B2B services** is a plus.

## Hours & Opportunity

Approximately **10 hours per week to start**.

This will begin as a **90-day trial**, but we are looking for someone who could potentially grow into a larger, long-term business development role with Think Wellness NY.

For the right person, strong performance may lead to increased hours, greater sales responsibility, performance-based bonuses, and additional compensation.

We are interested in building a long-term relationship with someone who takes ownership of their work and wants to grow alongside the company.

## To Apply

Please answer the following questions in your proposal:

1. Tell us briefly about your B2B outreach, business development, or appointment-setting experience.

2. What types of decision-makers have you contacted in previous roles?

3. Tell us about a service or company for which you successfully generated appointments, leads, or sales opportunities. What was your role?

4. Do you have more experience with email outreach, phone outreach, or both?

5. What CRM and prospecting tools have you used?

6. What is your current hourly rate and weekly availability?

7. How do you personalize outreach when contacting a new prospect?

### Communication Sample

Please include a **short audio or video introduction of approximately 60 seconds**.

Introduce yourself as though you were speaking to a prospective U.S.-based client for the first time.

We are looking for clear, confident, warm, and professional communication.

### Short Sales Exercise

Imagine you previously emailed an HR Director about customized employee professional development and engagement programs. You have not received a response.

**Write the short follow-up email you would send five business days later.**

Please write it exactly as you would send it to the prospect.

Applications that do not answer the questions above may not be considered.

## About Think Wellness NY

Think Wellness NY has been serving organizations for more than a decade. Our work includes professional development, customized employee and staff programming, educational enrichment, retreats, special initiatives, and interactive experiences.

We work with schools, corporations, agencies, nonprofits, and community organizations and are continuing to expand our partnerships throughout New York.

We are a **New York State and New York City certified Women-Owned Business Enterprise (WBE)** and an approved vendor serving organizations across the region.

We are entering an exciting stage of growth and are looking for the right person to help us build the next chapter of our business development efforts.

items.title: Vector/CAD Designer – 3 Seamless Wrap Patterns as Clean DXF Files for SolidWorks
items.description:
e need an experienced vector/CAD designer to create production-ready DXF files for three surface textures that will be wrapped around a 3D-printed titanium cylindrical product. Our engineer applies these in SolidWorks, so the files must be clean, precise geometry, not artwork traced from images.

THE THREE DESIGNS:
1. Snake scale: a repeating snake-scale pattern covering the full surface, plus a separate wrap-around band featuring a snake head and our claw logo mark.
2. Topographic map: a repeating topo contour-line pattern, with our claw logo mark as a separate feature.
3. Geometric hexagon: a large-cell hex pattern (about 5 cells around the circumference) with our claw logo mark integrated so the hex lattice flows around it.

We will provide the claw logo as vector artwork plus reference concept images.

SIZES (width = circumference, height = patterned length):
- Snake scale and topo: 4.9323" W x 5.000" H
- Hexagon: 5.3407" W x 5.528" H
Files may be oversized slightly as long as proportions are correct.

FILE REQUIREMENTS (non-negotiable):
- Each design element delivered as a SEPARATE file (e.g., background pattern in one file, logo/band in another)
- For every element: one .DXF + one high-resolution .PNG for reference
- SEAMLESS horizontal repeat: the left and right edges must match exactly so the pattern wraps with no visible seam
- All shapes must be CLOSED paths: no gaps, open loops, overlaps, or duplicate lines
- Organic shapes (scales, topo lines, logo) as splines/Bezier curves, NOT chains of arcs
- Geometric shapes (hexagons) as straight lines only
- Minimum feature/line width about 0.010"; avoid hairline details that won't survive printing and finishing
- Units in inches
- Built natively as vectors. No AI-generated images and no auto-tracing from JPGs.

TIMELINE:
Urgent. All three designs delivered within 3 business days of hire, with the first design within 24–48 hours. Quick revision turnaround is required.

TO APPLY, please include:
1. Examples of DXF/CAD-ready vector work (laser, CNC, engraving, or texture-mapping projects preferred)
2. Your answer to: "How would you make a pattern tile seamlessly around a cylinder with a 5.3407" circumference?"
3. Your experience with SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Illustrator, or similar, and how you ensure closed, clean paths in DXF exports
4. Your availability over the next 3 business days

items.title: Bookkeeper with ERPNext Experience
items.description:
Part-Time ERPNext Bookkeeper & Payroll Assistant | U.S. Businesses

We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented **ERPNext Bookkeeper & Payroll Assistant** to support multiple U.S.-based businesses.

This is intended to become a **long-term position** for the right person.

## Hours & Pay

- **10-20 hours per week initially**
- **$5–$7 USD/hour**
- Flexible schedule
- Remote
- Opportunity for additional hours as our businesses grow

## What You'll Do

- Maintain bookkeeping in ERPNext
- Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts
- Categorize transactions accurately
- Manage A/R and A/P bookkeeping
- Record Stripe and other payment-processor deposits and fees
- Prepare journal entries
- Prepare weekly payroll for owner approval
- Produce P&L and balance-sheet reports
- Maintain books across multiple companies/entities
- Identify discrepancies and accounting issues
- Help migrate accounting records from QuickBooks to ERPNext
- Reconcile migrated balances against source records
- Document bookkeeping processes as we build our accounting system

## Payroll Responsibilities

You will **prepare and verify payroll**, but the owner will retain final authorization to release payments.

Initially, you will NOT have authority to:

- Release funds
- Approve payments
- Add payment recipients
- Change employee or contractor banking information

## REQUIRED

**Hands-on ERPNext accounting experience is mandatory.**

You should also have:

- Strong bookkeeping/accounting fundamentals
- Bank and credit-card reconciliation experience
- Experience preparing P&L and balance-sheet reports
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good written English
- Ability to identify problems and ask questions instead of guessing

## Strongly Preferred

- U.S. bookkeeping experience
- QuickBooks Online experience
- QuickBooks → ERPNext migration experience
- Multi-company/multi-entity bookkeeping
- Payroll preparation experience
- Stripe/payment-processor reconciliation

## Paid Skills Test

Finalists will be offered a **paid 60–90 minute ERPNext bookkeeping assessment**.

The assessment will involve working with sample transactions in an ERPNext test environment, performing reconciliation, identifying accounting issues, and producing basic financial reports.

Accuracy is more important than speed.

## How to Apply

Please begin your proposal with:

**ERPNext Accounting**

Then answer the following questions:

1. How many years have you worked with ERPNext?
2. What accounting/bookkeeping tasks have you personally performed inside ERPNext?
3. Have you migrated accounting records from QuickBooks to ERPNext? If yes, describe what you did.
4. How would you verify that balances migrated from QuickBooks into ERPNext are correct?
5. Describe your experience bookkeeping for U.S. businesses.
6. Have you managed bookkeeping for multiple companies/entities simultaneously?
7. What experience do you have preparing payroll?
8. What experience do you have reconciling Stripe or other payment processors?
9. If you encounter a transaction you cannot confidently categorize, what do you do?
10. Are you willing to complete a paid 60–90 minute ERPNext skills assessment?

Please also include your **hourly rate and weekly availability**.

Generic proposals that do not answer these questions will not be considered.

items.description:
I am a transportation and logistics professional with hands-on experience in trucking dispatch, safety and compliance, driver communication, tracking, and transportation documentation.
My experience includes track & trace, monitoring driver locations and ETAs, HOS compliance, maintaining driver and transportation records, dispatch coordination, and communicating by phone with drivers, shippers, customers, and other transportation contacts.
I can collect shipment and trip details, enter and maintain information in transportation systems, follow up on pickups and deliveries, communicate with drivers, and support day-to-day dispatch and transportation operations.
I have also worked in safety and compliance and supported dispatch and reservations for a motor coach operation.
I am currently looking for a new opportunity with a trucking, logistics, transportation, fleet, or motor coach company where I can contribute my existing experience and continue developing professionally.
I am looking for someone who can help identify legitimate companies that are currently hiring, find appropriate contacts or decision-makers, research suitable positions, and assist with professional outreach and applications.
If you have experience in transportation recruiting, business development, lead generation, or connecting transportation professionals with employers, I would appreciate the opportunity to work with you.
I can provide my resume and additional details about my experience upon request.
